sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text: Guard Pippi Pinecone has ambient dialogue that clues the observant player on how to initiate this quest.

sections.title: The Hungry Guard
sections.text:
Guard Pippi Pinecone places a hand over her stomach.

Guard Pippi Pinecone says, "I'm famished! What I wouldn't do for a sweet treat right about now."

Give Guard Pippi Pinecone 1 x Jelly Cupcake, which you can obtain from completing Mierra's Famed Cupcakes.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Defenders of Faelindral got better.

Guard Pippi Pinecone says, "Oh, for me? You shouldn't have!"

Guard Pippi Pinecone proceeds to devour the cupcake in a two-bite display, then lets out a satisfied huff and pats her stomach.

Guard Pippi Pinecone says, "Such decadence! Thank you, my friend. I'll never not enjoy one of Mierra's cupcakes. It makes my brother so jealous that I'm able to indulge in such confectionery!"

You say, "Your brother?"

Guard Pippi Pinecone says, "Oh yes, I have a brother posted in the smallfolk district of Night Harbor, far from the Weald. Do you think that you'll be traveling that way any time soon?"

Guard Pippi Pinecone says, "You see, my brother always complains that there's nothing sweet for him to eat in Szuur. I've always wanted to send my brother a full dozen of Mierra's beautiful cupcakes as a tease- I mean a gift!"

Guard Pippi Pinecone pauses.

Guard Pippi Pinecone says, "Mostly a gift."

Guard Pippi Pinecone says, "Could you ask Mierra to pack up a dozen for me? Then, if you bring the packed cupcakes to me, I'll write a note telling my brother to compensate you for playing the part of the courier."

Head to Mierra Willowshade near the inn.

You say, "Could you pack up a dozen of the jelly cupcakes?"

Mierra Willowshade says, "A whole dozen?! Sleepers rest, I suppose I could... though you'd still have to provide me with the royal jelly I require for the batch."

Mierra Willowshade says, "Not to mention the packaging... hmm. If you bring me twelve royal jelly and a satchel from the bag vendor, I should be able to pack everything up for you."

Bring 12 x Royal Jelly and 1 x Satchel to Mierra Willowshade.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Citizens of Faelindral got better.

Mierra Willowshade says, "I'm impressed that you found so much! Did you locate a secret hive? Hmm, hmm. You might just have to become my main supplier!"

Mierra Willowshade says, "Regardless, let me get this dozen baked perfectly for you!"

Mierra Willowshade hums a tune as she sets to work preparing a dozen freshly baked jelly cupcakes. A familiar aroma fills the kitchen as she carefully packages the cupcakes into the satchel and returns it to you.

Mierra Willowshade says, "Here you are, my friend. I must say, you're probably the biggest fan of my cupcakes! Thank you once again for your business."

You receive Packaged Cupcakes from Mierra Willowshade.

Deliver 1 x Packaged Cupcakes to Guard Pippi Pinecone.

You gain experience!!

Guard Pippi Pinecone says, "Oh, how wonderful! I'm very tempted to keep these cupcakes for myself, but I could never spoil the effort you went through to get these!"

Guard Pippi Pinecone says, "My brother should compensate you well for your travel time as he earns a guard's wage in Night Harbor."

Guard Pippi Pinecone attaches a small note to the package and returns it to you.

Guard Pippi Pinecone says, "Pete Pinecone is his name. Thank you for doing this for me, friend!"

You receive Packaged Cupcakes from Guard Pippi Pinecone.

sections.title: Delivery
sections.text:
Travel to the Smallfolk District in Night Harbor and search for Guard Halfsies.

You say, "Hail, Guard Halfsies."

Guard Halfsies says, "Never you fear when Guard Halfsies is near! I'll kick evil-doers right in their rear!"

You say, "Do you know a Pete Pinecone?"

Guard Halfsies says, "That's me, Pete Pinecone! Though I go by Guard Halfsies around here. Not on account of my size, but due to how generously I share half of my shift with my fellow guards!"

Hand the Packaged Cupcakes to Guard Halfsies.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Smallfolk Alliance got better.

Guard Halfsies says, "From my dear sister, Pippi? What a sweetheart, not to mention a sweet tooth! I suppose it runs in the family. Hmm, let's have a taste, shall we?"

Guard Halfsies proceeds to devour one of the jelly cupcakes in two bites. He lets out a sigh of delight as he goes in for a second, then a third, and a fourth. Crumbs pepper the halfling's mouth as he gorges himself on eleven of the dozen cakes.

Guard Halfsies says, "Exquisite! Delightful! Masterworks, all! I cannot thank you enough, my new best friend!"

Guard Halfsies takes one final bite of the twelfth cupcake, depositing what remains of the half-eaten morsel into your hand alongside some silver coins.

You receive 5 silver from Guard Halfsies.

You receive Half of a Jelly Cupcake from Guard Halfsies.

Guard Halfsies says, "Here, some coin for your services. If only my cousin knew how to bake such wonderful delicacies, my sweet tooth wouldn't be so starved out here in Szuur!"

You say, "Your cousin?"

Guard Halfsies says, "Oh, my cousin? Violyn is her name. She cooks at the Crimson Oasis over in Sageside these days."

Guard Halfsies says, "In fact, you should show her that last portion of cupcake as a measure of what she should strive toward! I'm sure she'll be nothing but grateful to receive an example of premium baking to learn from!"

Travel to Chef Violyn, who is located at the Crimson Oasis Inn near the North Gate of Night Harbor.

Hand the Half of a Jelly Cupcake to Chef Violyn.

You gain experience!!

Chef Violyn stares at the half-eaten cupcake with a look of incredulous outrage. Her face grows red as she crushes what remains of the cake in her fist and tosses it into the cooking oven.

Chef Violyn says, "That half-hearted, half-brained, half-witted, half-halfling Halfsies! Ooh, if he weren't my cousin I'd thrash him with my cooking iron!"

Chef Violyn says, "He thinks he can tell me how I'm to do my baking? Oh, I'll bake him a batch of extra special cupcakes, you can be sure of that!"

Chef Violyn grumbles as she scratches out a list and tosses it along with a grocery basket into your arms.

Chef Violyn says, "Go fill that grocery basket with the ingredients on the list! I'll make it worth your while, don't you worry. This will be a batch of cupcakes that he never forgets!"

You receive Violyn's Grocery Basket from Chef Violyn.

You receive Violyn's Grocery List from Chef Violyn.

sections.title: A Fiery Treat
sections.text:
Additional information regarding collection of the grocery list items would be beneficial.

Violyn's Grocery List notes the required items, but not where to obtain them.

Purchase 2 x Dried Dragon's Breath Pepper from Spices Merchant in Night Harbor.

Purchase 1 x Baladi from the Mukhtar Brewery in the river pirate tavern.

Purchase 4 x Basilisk Seasoning from An exotic cook in Shallow Shoals.

Purchase 2 x Viper's Kick which can be obtained from the Viper's Kick Recipe quest.

Combine 2 x Dried Dragon's Breath Pepper, 1 x Baladi, 4 x Basilisk Seasoning, and 2 x Viper's Kick in Violyn's Grocery Basket.

Turn in Violyn's Full Grocery Basket to Chef Violyn in Night Harbor.

Your faction standing with Smallfolk Alliance got better.

Chef Violyn takes a look into the basket as her mouth curls into an insidious grin.

Some of the following dialogue is incomplete and needs correction.

Chef Violyn says, "Yes, yes, this will do perfectly. Good job, <player>. With this forgive for even bringing me that half-eaten pile of slop to begin With. Now to get baking..."

Chef Violyn is forced to wear a mask as she combines the various ingredients into a thick mixture that stings your nostrils even from a distance. A cloud of pungent smoke billows out from the oven as the "cupcakes" bake that is enough to make your eyes water.

Chef Violyn takes the completed batch from the oven using a pair of tongs, then dumps them into a pouch which already struggles to hold back the steam escaping from the potent cakes.

Chef Violyn says, "Here, take these back to Halfsies so he can get a taste of real baking."

You receive Violyn's Special Batch of Cupcakes from Chef Violyn.

Chef Violyn says, "If he survives, bring me what's left of him and you'll get your reward for all the running around you did. Oh, and you just rip up the list I gave you. You shouldn't need it any longer."

Give Violyn's Special Batch of Cupcakes to Guard Halfsies.

Your faction standing with Smallfolk Alliance got better.

Guard Halfsies says, "What's this? Ah, so Violyn took it upon herself to learn from the example we sent? Good for her! Let's give these a try and see how she did!"

Guard Halfsies opens the pouch and reaches in to grab a cupcake, recoiling slightly at first.

Guard Halfsies says, "Youch! Oh my, they're still fresh from the oven! What a charming color, as well. I better not waste any more time, then!"

You receive Half of Violyn's Cupcake from Guard Halfsies.

Guard Halfsies chuckles softly and quickly brings a piping hot cupcake to his mouth, taking a bite and eating half in a single fearless chomp.

Guard Halfsies chews only once before suddenly going motionless, his face turning a brilliant crimson. He attempts to draw in a deep breath, though it only serves to further fuel the fire within his mouth. Until...

Guard Halfsies belches out a gout of flame that leaves the ends of his own hair singed. He collapses to the floor and passes out, finally taking the nap he had always longed for.

Give Half of Violyn's Cupcake to Chef Violyn.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Smallfolk Alliance got better.

Chef Violyn lets out a hearty cackle as she takes the remains of the cupcake and tosses it into the oven. The pastry explodes in a small puff of flame that causes even Violyn to recoil.

Chef Violyn says, "Got What he deserved, I hope Halfsies has always had half a brain. He's certainly not as bright as that sister of his. I wonder how she's doing?"

Chef Violyn shrugs and tosses a few coins into a wooden tankard.

Chef Violyn says, "This is for your trouble, some coin and a fine stein that's served me well over the years. You look worn out after all that running around."

Chef Violyn says, "Maybe you'd like a cupcake?"

Chef Violyn grins.

Chef Violyn says, "Kidding, of course. Thanks again."

You receive 50 silver from Chef Violyn.

You receive Stein of Baker's Scorn from Chef Violyn.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Witcher Sayyaad is located in the Necropolis found within Night Harbor. Enter the Necropolis from the south entrance with the purple "Concourse of Souls" banner and immediately turn right.

You say, "Hail, Witcher Sayyaad."

Witcher Sayyaad says, "Are you here to slay me?"

Witcher Sayyadd chuckles.

Witcher Sayyadd says, "I suppose not. Well, you appear pure enough."

Witcher Sayyadd says, "I'm Witcher Sayyaad. I purge the unnatural from this realm. These days it feels like there are monsters around every corner in Night Harbor."

You say, "What monsters?"

Witcher Sayyaad says, "A winged terror swoops through the skies at night. We've heard reports of attacks in Saltbreeze Park and other places in the city. Should you encounter this foul beast, slay it and bring me a part of its body as proof."

Kill Night Terror, a level 8 named bat that spawns only at night in the Necropolis Courtyard and Saltbreeze Park areas of Night Harbor.

Night Terror will drop one of three items randomly, which can be returned to Witcher Sayyaad for a reward.

Give Night Terror's Wing to Witcher Sayyaad

You receive Mantle of Night from Witcher Sayyaad.

You gain experience!!

Witcher Sayyadd says, "You felled the beast and lived to tell the tale. Well done. Take this for your efforts."

Give Night Terror's Fur to Witcher Sayyaad

You receive Tunic of Night from Witcher Sayyaad.

Witcher Sayyadd says, "You felled the beast and lived to tell the tale. Well done. Take this for your efforts."

You gain experience!!

Give Night Terror's Head to Witcher Sayyaad

You receive Necklace of Night from Witcher Sayyaad.

You gain experience!!

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Obsidian Shackle

This quest is the prelude for access to the city via the various Ail'Vorith Class Quests.

sections.title: Comprehension Test
sections.text:
Read the Imbued Parchment you start with as a new character in Ail'Vorith:

You have been spared.

You only exist by the mercy of:

THE ETERNAL QUEEN AND HIGH LISTENER,
QUEEN NALIADRA
The Queen of Corruption, She Who Spoke With
the Shadow, the Immortal Consort of the
Darkness, and the Avatar of Barbhaal

Make no reference to your former house from this point forward, as *it never existed*.
Therefore, you have no privileged beyond the breath you breathe and your ability to *serve
our Queen*.

You have been cast out of Ail'vorith, welcome
only in its Foreign Quarter, as befitting one of 
the shadowless. Any attempt to enter further 
districts will result in your immediate 
extermination. You have been warned.

To prove yourself useful to our Queen and the 
Houses of Ail'vorith, seek the head toilmaster 
outside the city. Find him and present to him 
this writ if you wish to be tested for any worth 
left in you.

*You are now a shadowless nothing*. It is 
your decision as to whether you remain such.

You are looking for Toilmaster Verith or Toilmistress Rallvessa, who are mere feet away from where you spawn as a new character in Ail'Vorith.

Hand Toilmaster Verith or Toilmistress Rallvessa your Imbued Parchment.

Toilmaster VerithToilmistress Rallvessa
Toilmaster Verith says, "What's this, then?"
Toilmaster Verith looks over the writ and then turns to regard you with newfound disdain.
Toilmaster Verith says, "Yet another shadowless exile comes barking at my quarry for a morsel? Very well."
Toilmaster Verith says, "I care not for your status so long as you're able to toil for me like any good meat should."
Toilmaster Verith says, "First you'll have to prove to me that you're not completely blind, deaf or dumb."
Toilmaster Verith says, "There are crates with pickaxes next to us, open those so-called eyes of yours and look for a pickaxe that isn't broken or damaged."
Toilmaster Verith says, "You do at least know how to look, don't you?"
Toilmaster Verith says, "Once you find one that isn't damaged, take it. Then bring it here and show it to me."
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "What do you want?"
Toilmistress Rallvessa reads over the writ and then turns to regard you with newfound disdain.
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "Yet another shadowless exile comes barking at my quarry for a morsel? Very well."
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "I care not for your status so long as you're able to toil for me like any good meat should."
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "First you'll have to prove to me that you're not completely blind, deaf or dumb."
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "There are crates with pickaxes next to Toilmaster Verith, look for a pickaxe that isn't broken or damaged."
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "You know how to give them a good look, don't you?"
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "Once you find one that isn't damaged, bring it here and show it to me."

You gain experience!!

Using MUD Commands, you will search the nearby crates for a Slave Pickaxe.

/look crate
A haphazard heap of pickaxes reside within this crate, all of which appear to be broken or worn from use. The crate itself appear to be labeled with a placard that clearly states, "BROKEN".
/take pickaxe
You take one of the worn pickaxes from the crate labeled "BROKEN". It does not look as though it could survive another strike against the stone.
You receive Broken Slave Pickaxe.
If you hand the Broken Slave Pickaxe to Toilmaster Verith...
Toilmaster Verith scowls at you as he tosses the already broken pickaxe to the ground, shattering it completely.
Toilmaster Verith says, "Are you blind, or just incredibly stupid?! You need a pickaxe that is NOT broken or damaged if you're to do any toil for me!"
Toilmaster Verith proceeds to strike you with the back of his heavy gauntlet.
Toilmaster Verith's Slam hits YOU for 2 points of damage!
Toilmaster Verith says, "Use your eyes, you useless thing! Take a pickaxe from the clearly labeled crate, if you only knew how to look!"

/look crate

This crate appears to be filled with recently repaired pickaxes, all of which are crude but serviceable. The crate itself is clearly labeled, "REPAIRED".

/take pickaxe

You take one of the repaired pickaxes. It feels hefty in your grip, but should serve well for the tasks ahead.

You receive Slave Pickaxe.

Hand the Slave Pickaxe to Toilmaster Verith or Toilmistress Rallvessa

Toilmaster VerithToilmistress Rallvessa
Toilmaster Verith says, "So you're not actually that blind or stupid? How surprising."
Toilmaster Verith tosses the pickaxe back to you.
Toilmaster Verith says, "If you do have a brain, then I am sure you can guess what is required next of you, yes?"
Toilmaster Verith says, "You will use that pickaxe to toil for me until you've hewed at least one full stack of stone from the old quarry. That is at least twenty rocks worth."
Toilmaster Verith says, "Return to me with what you gather alongside your pickaxe."
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "So you're at least half capable."
Toilmistress Rallvessa tosses the pickaxe back to you.
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "If you do have a brain, then I am sure you can guess what is required next of you, yes?"
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "You will use that pickaxe and bring me a full stack of stone from the old quarry. At least twenty rocks worth."
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "Return to me with the stones and your pickaxe."

sections.title: Mining
sections.text:
Head south from the Toilmaster (the direction he's facing; away from the city) into the water and then right. Follow the wall until you find a small cave with several mining nodes. The nodes will respawn quickly (5-10 seconds) once mined. Place the Slave Pickaxe in your Main Hand slot and right-click the rocks to mine the Stone Ore veins until you have 20 Fragile Quarry Rock.

Hand in a stack of 20 Fragile Quarry Rock and your Slave Pickaxe.

Toilmaster VerithToilmistress Rallvessa
Toilmaster Verith proceeds to toss your pickaxe into the nearby crate labeled "BROKEN". He then deposits the rock you harvested into a neatly filled pack before heaving it to you without warning. You nearly lose your footing at the heft of the bag as it slams into your arms, weighing you down considerably.
Toilmaster Verith says, "Congratulations! You earned a trip to the foreign quarter."
Toilmaster Verith says, "Proceed towards the footbridge that leads into Ail'vorith."
Toilmaster Verith says, "You're to deliver this pack of rock to Supplier Jul inside the supply shop. It's the building directly to your left as you enter the foreign quarter."
Toilmaster Verith says, "He should have a delivery of sharpening stones that you will bring back here, to me."
Toilmaster Verith says, "Keep in mind that you are still worthless. You are not permitted to enter any other district of the city, or you'll be disposed of on sight."
Toilmaster Verith says, "I don't rightly care what happens to you, but I do care about what happens if you lose my shipment, so just do as you're told."
Toilmaster Verith says, "Now go!"
You receive Pack of Stone from Toilmaster Verith.
Toilmistress Rallvessa deposits the rock you harvested into a neatly filled pack before heaving it to you without warning. You nearly lose your footing at the heft of the bag as it slams into your arms, weighing you down considerably.
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "Congratulations! You earned a trip to the foreign quarter."
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "Proceed towards the footbridge that leads into Ail'vorith."
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "You're to deliver this pack of rock to Supplier Jul inside the supply shop. It's the building directly to your left as you enter the foreign quarter."
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "He should have a delivery of sharpening stones that you will bring back to Toilmaster Verith across from me."
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "Keep in mind that you are still worthless. You are not permitted to enter any other district of the city, or you'll be disposed of on sight."
Toilmistress Rallvessa says, "I don't rightly care what happens to you, but I do care about what happens if you lose my shipment, so just do as you're told."
You receive Pack of Stone from Toilmistress Rallvessa.

You are encumbered.

You gain experience!!

sections.title: The Supplier
sections.text:
Change Language to Deep Common
From this point forward in the quest, be sure you have set your language to Deep Common (right-click Main Chat window > Languages > Deep Common), or quest NPCs may not respond to your prompts.

Carry the heavy pack of stone up the hill behind Toilmaster Verith and follow his verbal instructions to find Supplier Jul.

Hand Supplier Jul your Pack of Stone

You are no longer encumbered.

Supplier Jul says, "Another supply from Vorith? Good. Set it down there, I'll get to it later."

Supplier Jul eyes you up and down a moment. He smiles broadly.

Supplier Jul says, "As for his sharpening stones, I'm afraid he'll have to wait."

Supplier Jul says, "The smith has been requisitioned by House Vael'xirith and hasn't felt the need to waste his time with petty stone work, you see."

Supplier Jul says, "Unless you feel you're up to the task? You exiles are searching for a means to get back into standing with the Houses, are you not?"

Supplier Jul says, "I'll throw in a good word for you to your master."

Supplier Jul says, "The sharpening stones that Vorith needs are simple enough for a novice to make, and I'll provide you materials and directions to finish the work order."

Supplier Jul says, "What do you say, will you do it?"

You say in Deep Common, "I will do it."

Supplier Jul says, "Wonderful! I don't want to have to deal with Vorith's complaints and you want to get on his good side, so this is a win-win situation for us both."

Supplier Jul produces a satchel and offers it to you, alongside a slip of parchment.

Supplier Jul says, "Here's a satchel and the recipe to fashion sharpening stones. Take as much rock as you need from the pile next to me. You're going to want enough to craft five stones worth."

Supplier Jul says, "Once you have the rock you need, take a left out of the shop and head through the gate to the foreign trader's market."

Supplier Jul says, "At the end of the market you'll find a grinding stone next to the forge that you can use to turn these into proper sharpening stones. You'll need five of them to complete the work order."

Supplier Jul says, "Place five sharpening stones in that satchel and then seal the container before returning it to me."

You receive Sharpening Stone Satchel from Supplier Jul.

You receive Recipe: Fragile Sharpening Stone from Supplier Jul.

Right click the recipe to learn how to craft Fragile Sharpening Stone.

You have learned a new recipe!

Use your MUD Commands again to search the crate next to Supplier Jul and acquire some Fragile Quarry Rock.

/look crate

You notice a crate filled with rocks.

/take rock

You take one of the rocks.

You receive Fragile Quarry Rock.

Repeat this until you have 5-8 Fragile Quarry Rock, as you may fail a couple combines. There is a slight delay between MUD commands, so you may have to wait a few seconds between collecting each rock.

Note that you skill up in Stone Cutting (trivial at 5), so feel free to collect extra rocks.

sections.title: Grinding (not that kind!)
sections.text:
Once you have your rocks, take a left out of the shop and head through the gate. Proceed through the marketplace and turn right and proceed through the tunnel. At the fork in the tunnel, take the right path. After exiting the tunnel, enter the first building on your right and turn right to find Blacksmith Zorvek and a small grinding wheel next to the forge.

Click on the grinding wheel and create 5 Fragile Sharpening Stone. Place the Fragile Sharpening Stone in your Sharpening Stone Satchel and click Combine to create a Full Sharpening Stone Satchel.

Sharpening Stone Satchel is consumed while crafting.

You craft Full Sharpening Stone Satchel.

Return the Full Sharpening Stone Satchel to Supplier Jul.

Supplier Jul grins.

Supplier Jul says, "That wasn't so bad, now was it? Granted you were working with quarry rock, and the most those can sharpen are the dull tools that Vorith has his slaves laboring with."

Supplier Jul writes out a receipt and includes it in the package before offering it back to you.

Supplier Jul says, "There you are, one full delivery of sharpening stones for your master! I included a note inside about how you chipped in."

Supplier Jul says, "I'm sure Vorith will reward your efforts."

Supplier Jul smiles.

You receive Sharpening Stone Delivery Satchel from Supplier Jul.

You gain experience!!

sections.title: Useless!
sections.text:
Return the Sharpening Stone Delivery Satchel to Toilmaster Verith.

Toilmaster Verith grunts dismissively as you return with the delivery.

Toilmaster Verith says, "It's about time, exile. About the only thing the meat out here is good for is hewing rock, so a sharp pickaxe is essential."

Toilmaster Verith opens the package and regards the note that was left by Supplier Jul. He scans the message quickly, his features soon hardening into a wicked scowl.

Toilmaster Verith pulls out a stone that you recognize; a stone crafted by your own hand. He clenches it in his fist and the fragile stone crumbles immediately into dust.

Toilmaster Verith says, "WHAT IS THIS?!"

Toilmaster Verith says, "These stones are completely useless to me!"

Toilmaster Verith says, "I had ordered hardened stones to be used on metal tools, not this worthless dreck!"

Toilmaster Verith says, "Jul's message says that YOU took it upon yourself to make these in his stead? Explain yourself, meat!"

Toilmaster Verith says, "Yes or no, did you make these stones?"

You say in Deep Common, "Yes I made them"

Toilmaster Verith says, "Then you are either a fool or a subservient sap. Perhaps both."

Toilmaster Verith narrows his eyes at you, his expression cooling.

Toilmaster Verith says, "Jul has undoubtedly kept my commission for himself so that he could profit from it and pass the blame on to a desperate exile like yourself."

Toilmaster Verith says, "He was counting on me slaying you where you stand. Instead, I shall find out if there is yet a fire for vengeance burning in the embers of your lost soul, meat."

Toilmaster Verith says, "This will also be a test of your ability. Are you prepared?"

You say in Deep Common, "I am prepared!"

Toilmaster Verith says, "Good. You are to prove if you are proficient enough to survive the caverns of Ail'vorith."

Toilmaster Verith says, "Venture past the safety of these surroundings and murder the pathetic creatures you find there and fill this satchel with their remnants."

Toilmaster Verith says, "I require two bone chips, two myconid caps and two deep beetle legs."

Toilmaster Verith throws you a small leather satchel.

You receive Small Leather Hunting Satchel from Toilmaster Verith.

Toilmaster Verith says, "Should you not survive, then good riddance. If you do manage it, return to me the filled satchel."

sections.title: Finally, some killing!
sections.text:
Walk down the hill and begin hunting the newbie creatures for the required parts.

Bone Chips are dropped by a decayed skeleton
Deep Beetle Legs are dropped by a small beetle and a deep beetle
Damaged Fungus Cap are dropped by a cave sporeling

When you have all six items, place them in the Small Leather Hunting Satchel in single stacks and click Combine to create Filled Leather Hunting Satchel.

Small Leather Hunting Satchel is consumed while crafting.

You create Filled Leather Hunting Satchel.

Hand the Filled Leather Hunting Satchel to Toilmaster Verith.

Toilmaster Verith takes the satchel and inspects the contents, nodding with satisfaction.

Toilmaster Verith says, "You yet live? Perhaps there is hope for you to serve after all. Most of the dregs who wash onto my shore are not even fit to cull a simple beetle."

Toilmaster Verith says, "You also, for better or for worse, blindly follow instructions. Your subservience could be better suited to a House that would put it to use, but that is still to be determined."

Toilmaster Verith produces a writ and adds it into the satchel before sealing it once more and offering it back to you.

You receive Satchel of Questionable Spoils from Toilmaster Verith.

Toilmaster Verith says, "Bring your spoils to the cook, Vashuk, at the inn inside the foreign quarter."

Toilmaster Verith says, "This time, do not ask or answer any questions. Simply make this delivery and then return to me when you are finished."

sections.title: The Cook
sections.text:
Cook Vashuk is a questionable character, and as such is difficult to find.

Head inside the city by crossing the bridge behind Toilmaster Verith. Once inside the main gate, turn right and walk up the stairs into the first building on your left just past the courtyard fountain.

Once you climb up the stairs, enter the small doorway in the back-right of the inn and take the stairs DOWN.

In the far back of the cellar, you will find Cook Vashuk. Hand Cook Vashuk your Satchel of Questionable Spoils.

Cook Vashuk lets out a cackle as he snatches the satchel from your hands.

Cook Vashuk says, "The scent of spores and death lingers on the exile before me!"

Cook Vashuk eagerly looks through the satchel, clawing at the note that was left by Vorith. He scans it with a crazed stare.

Cook Vashuk says, "Ah, I see, I see! Yes, yes, indeed. So it shall be."

Cook Vashuk says, "Go now, shoo! Off with you, disgraced one! Go tell your master that it shall be as he wishes."

Cook Vashuk cackles delightfully as he begins chopping the components you brought atop a grisly wooden board.

You gain experience!!

sections.title: A recommendation!
sections.text:
Return to Toilmaster Verith and hail him.

You say in Deep Common, "Hail, Toilmaster Verith."

Toilmaster Verith says, "You return, Good."

Toilmaster Verith says, "Vashuk is rather mad in the head, you see. He often pays others for near worthless monster parts, but in this case he'll be making a special meal for Jul in particular."

Toilmaster Verith smirks before his stern gaze returns.

Toilmaster Verith says, "You have proven to be at least marginally competent. Do you still wish to attempt to rejoin the Houses of Ail'vorith?"

You say in Deep Common, "Yes"

Toilmaster Verith says, "Very well. Here is a recommendation stating that you are not, entirely, without use."

You receive Vorith's Recommendation from Toilmaster Verith.

Toilmaster Verith says, "Bring this to Provost Xan'shorn within the Obsidian Academy. The entrance is the first one that you'll see when you cross the footbridge to enter for foreign quarter."

Toilmaster Verith says, "He will direct you further towards your...reintegration."

Toilmaster Verith says, "Be mindful of the shadows this time, meat. Else I find you back in my quarry barking for scraps."

You gain experience!!

sections.title: The Houses
sections.text:
Head back across the bridge and through the gate. In the courtyard, Provost Xan'shorn is to the left in the courtyard as you pass through the gate. He likes to walk in small circles around the left side of the courtyard.

Hand Provost Xan'shorn Vorith's Recommendation.

Provost Xan'shorn frowns as he looks over the letter of recommendation, eyeing you suspiciously.

Provost Xan'shorn says, "Not often does vorith send me a worthy exile. Perhaps you will be more promising?"

Provost Xan'shorn produces a shackle-like bracer that he clasps onto one of your wrists.

You receive Obsidian Shackle from Provost Xan'shorn.

Provost Xan'shorn says, "I welcome you, shadowless, to the Obsidian Academy. We are willing to instruct those of lesser station who wish to prove their worth to our Queen through blood, blade, and sacrifice."

Provost Xan'shorn says, "There are seven great Houses of Ail'vorith: Vael'xirith, Varros, Xal'tharn, Hal'kareth, Ith'vayen, Drezzorith, and Velgarrith."

Provost Xan'shorn says, "Each House has a representative that you can find here in the academy. Speak to them. Find one that resonates with the darkness in your own soul."

Provost Xan'shorn says, "Learn what you can do to pledge yourself to them to regain your own shadow. Yet know that the Houses are not in alignment. Pledging with one will earn the scorn of others, so make your choice wisely."

Quest Complete!

Follow up quest: Ail'Vorith Class Quests

sections.title: Additional Lore
sections.text:
-> -> ->

Seek out Vaslir Naiyth inside the Obsidian Academy after acquiring your Obsidian Shackle.
You say in Deep Common, "Hail, Vaslir Naiyth."

Vaslir Naiyth meets your eyes with a penetrating stare. An involuntary shiver runs through your body. There is a touch of something about her gaze that is not of this realm.
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Karzzul, young aspirant. What brings you to this vaslir of House Varros?"
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Does your ambition lead you towards the path of the vaslir?"
You say in Deep Common, "I seek the path of the vaslir"

Vaslir Naiyth says, "Vaslir is the title bestowed on those of us who have successfully bound a being from another plane. It is the signature art of our great house."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Members of our house start as junior apprentices and hope to become senior apprentices."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "From senior apprentices, if their ambition wins out, they advance to leth'vaslir."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Finally, those who survive long enough become full vaslir."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "The head of our house, Archbinder Zaelthir Varros, is the only one with the title neth'vaslir."
You say in Deep Common, "Who is Archbinder Zaelthir Varros?"

Vaslir Naiyth says, "I see how you ended up an outcast. In Ail'vorith, survival depends on knowing your rivals."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Still, it is good that you're learning."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "House Varros, the Subjugator of the Ebon Realms, has played an important role in our civilization's survival and expansion. Our necromancers and elementalists control powerful minions that serve the Queen as well as any solider of House Vael'xirith."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "While House Hal'kareth boasts of its research into the Spirals, the demons we've bound give us our own insight into Ach'aron. We know the Sixth Spiral in ways that transcend the clumsy explorations of those wizards and their Hathalian magics."
Vaslir Naiyth laughs.
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Hil dur ana zehad, Or whatever nonsense it is that they say."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Some of us have actually advanced in our understanding of magic since those days."
You say in Deep Common, "What is Ach'aron?"

Vaslir Naiyth says, "There are other planes beyond this realm. The spirals are among the most important of them. We have fought wars with them in the past, and the demons of Ach'aron, the Sixth Spiral, are now of great service to our empire."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Thanks to House Varros, of course."
Vaslir Naiyth smiles smugly.
You say in Deep Common, "What is Hathalian magic?"

Vaslir Naiyth says, "The First City. Across the sea. We were once part of that civilization long ago. Before Calafrey. Before the Shadow blessed us. But those lands are now lost. Our future is here."
You say in Deep Common, "What is Calafrey?"

Vaslir Naiyth says, "After the fall of the First City, we came here, to the continent of Aethoril. The elves were one people then, spread across many cities."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "But then we heard the Shadow's wisdom and descended. Now our empire is greater than Calafrey ever was, and our pathetic cousins struggle to hold onto the merest scrap of what they once had."
You say in Deep Common, "What is the Shadow?"

Vaslir Naiyth says, "What backwards cave was your house living in prior to its, apparently well deserved, annihilation?"
Vaslir Naiyth sighs and then continues in a patient tone.
Vaslir Naiyth says, "The Shadow is the voice that led us here, saving us from the Burning Heavens. Our glorious queen, Naliadra, was the last to hear the Shadow's voice. Thus she is the High Listener. Varsa ai Neth'xanl"
You say in Deep Common, "What is the Burning Heavens?"

Vaslir Naiyth says, "The Burning Heavens was a momentous event. It ravaged the surface while we waited below, growing strong."

fields.Related NPCs: Toilmistress Rallvessa | Toilmaster Verith | Supplier Jul | Cook Vashuk | Provost Xan'shorn

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience
Novice Scout Bracer
Weald Scout Bracer
Scout's Longbow of the Wyrdguard
Faction: +Wyrdguard, -Fellstone Orcs

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read the Rolled Leafscroll you start with as a new Archer character:

Archer,

The Wyrdguard have taken notice of your diligence and 
keen eye.

Your skills would be a welcome addition to the ranks of
Faelindral's protectors. We humbly invite you to present
this letter to Captain Keyaryn Thornshade who resides
upon Sentinels Terrace.

To reach the terrace, follow the signage past the inn and
toward the stage at the Willows Whisper. Climb the main
ascent behind the stage to reach the Traders Terrace, then
continue up the central ramp and cross the span opposite
the tanner.

The local guard can direct you further should you inquire
with them.

Your gaze shall prove to be a great asset in our upcoming
conflicts, as will the strength of your bow.

                                        Fair shades to you,
                                Commander Elydris Stormbough

Head to Sentinels Terrace, which resides above the Traders Terrace.

Details:

Take the Traveler's Lift (where you entered the game).
(You can double click on the bell and it will come. Double click again for it to go up.)
Go the the inn, then up, then right (in a right angle),
When you see Pine Brightreed go left.
(You are now at Traders Terrace)
Go toward the weapons armor sign and take the ramp at the left of Taelin Goldstem.
Take the bridge on your left, go left again and Captain Keyaryn Thornshade will be at the center of the giant trunk.

Give Rolled Leafscroll to Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade casually accepts the scroll and unfurls it, his brow raising a touch as hazel eyes quickly scan it and then you, sharp as a hawk.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "Elydris's new recruit, huh? I suppose that's not the worst news that I've gotten today.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade tosses you a small satchel that bears the weight of a number of leafscrolls.

You receive Reconnaissance Satchel.

You receive Briefing for Scout Faeweald from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

You receive Briefing for Scout Gladebow from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

You receive Briefing for Scout Stonebranch from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

You receive Briefing for Scout Amber Ward from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "You'll start off easy, new blood. Show me that those eyes of yours really do work by seeking out the scouts that I have posted around Faelindral."

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "Deliver these new briefings to each of them, then return to me with a bag full of their reports."

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "Should be easy for a sureshot like you, right? Or do you need directions?"

You say, "I could use some directions."

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade lets out a sarcastic chuckle.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "You'll find three of my scouts posted near the bottom of each of the great lifts around Faelindral. They should be easy enough to spot for any with a keen eye."

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "The fourth scout, Gladebow, has been temporarily posted to Overlook Terrace due to a recently compromised platform infested with spiders. Lucky for you, that's just one span away, past the druids."

They're all fairly easy to find. Just the one that's far off slightly leftwards of the lift, at the edge of the cliff

You say, "Infested with spiders?"

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "An entire brood of widow spiders descended from the northern cliffs not long ago. They took over a terrace and seem to be forming a nest within the great tree itself."

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "It's one sticky situation after another with those pests, so we always need to have eyes on them."

Give Briefing for Scout Gladebow to Scout Gladebow.
You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Ores got worse.

Scout Gladebow accepts the briefing and offers a curt nod, exchanging it for his report.
Scout Gladebow says, "Ah, my thanks. You must be new to the Wyrdguard. Give the captain my regards, but try not to let his quips get to you. He can be a bit wry."

You receive Gladebow's Report from Scout Gladebow.

Give Briefing for Scout Amberward to Scout Amberward.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Ores got worse.

Scout Amberward does not seem to respond to your offered briefing at first, leaving your outstretched hand hanging in the air.
Scout Amberward finally snatches the briefing and exchanges it for what must be his report, his gaze remaining fixed upon the forest floor and the ruins in the distance.

You receive Amberward's Report from Scout Amberward.

Give Briefing for Scout Faeweald to Scout Faeweald.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Scout Faeweald accepts the briefing and exchanges it for a report.
Scout Faeweald says, "Ah, new briefings? Thank you for saving me the trek, and here's my report for Captain Thornshade."

You receive Faeweald's Report from Scout Faeweald.

Give Briefing for Scout Stonebranch to Scout Stonebranch.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Scout Stonebranch accepts the briefing and exchanges it with his report.
Scout Stonebranch says, "Oh, that time already? Here you go. Nothing much to report down here, aside from some nasty wasps."

You receive Stonebranch's Report from Scout Stonebranch.

Combine the Briefings in the Reconnaissance Satchel.

You begin crafting Full Reconnaissance Satchel.
Reconnaissance Satchel is consumed while crafting
You craft Full Reconnaissance Satchel.

Give Full Reconnaissance Satchel to Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade takes the satchel and begins to leaf through the reports. His countenance hardens as he goes over Amberward's report in particular.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "That's just great. It seems the orcish threat has grown bolder of late, sending scouts into the lower reaches of Faelindral."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "You did well getting these reports, though. Take this, it'll help identify you as a novice archer for the Wyrdguard."

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade retrieves a leather wristguard and offers it to you.

You receive Novice Scout Bracer from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, I suppose there's no better way to introduce you to the ways of the scout. Care to perform a little counter-espionage?"

You say, "Yes, I love to perform counter-espionage!"

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "Aside from being a blight on the land, we're still not sure what the orcs' goal is within Evershade."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "Briefings like the ones I had you deliver are not unique to the Faelewyn, though."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "If orcish scouts have been spotted in the Weald, then there's a chance that they're writing and sending their own reports to some... higher authority."

You say, "What authority?"

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "That's what I'd like you to find out. Return to Scout Amberward and tell him that you're there to gather intelligence."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "You're to follow his orders and see if you can determine what the ores' goal is here in the Weald."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "Return with what you find. If we know what they're after, we can start taking direct action to prevent it."

You say, "Hail, Scout Amberward "

You say, "The captain wants me to gather some intelligence on the orcs."

Scout Amberward gives you a piercing look, his eyes scrutinizing your equipment and overall demeanor.
Scout Amberward says, "If you were sent here to gather intelligence, then you'll have to show me some evidence that you've been accepted as a scout."

Give Novice Scout Bracer to Scout Amberward.

Scout Amberward relaxes considerably upon recognizing your wristguard.
Scout Amberward says, "Thank the Sleepers. I've been watching the Fellstone movements for days to no avail."
Scout Amberward unstows a satchel from his belt and offers it to you, along with returning your bracer.

You receive Scout's Satchel from Scout Amberward.

You receive your items back from Scout Amberward.

Scout Amberward says, "Take this satchel. It's about time we strike back. I hope you're ready to take a more... direct approach,"

You say, "I love a direct approach, especially if it means killing!"

Scout Amberward says, "Fellstone scouts have been spotted all across the lower Weald, far closer to Faelindral than ever before."
Scout Amberward says, "Some are carrying odd reports, and I believe we may be able to learn their plans if we can translate them."
Scout Amberward says, "I've already eliminated a few myself, but we're going to need more of those strange scribbles if we're to have any chance at deciphering their horrendous language."
Scout Amberward says, "Eliminate as many scouts as it takes to fll the satchel, then return it to me. May your arrows fly true, novice,"

Hunt Fellstone Scouts until you find 6x Unintelligible Writings. Combine the 6x Unintelligible Writings into the Scout's Satchel. This produces a Full Scout Satchel.

Give Full Scout Satchel to Scout Amberward.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Scout Amberward says, "You're a keen shot, that's for sure! Well done, novice."
Scout Amberward says, "The captain won't enjoy the fact that we only have these scriblings, but it's better than nothing. Perhaps he has an idea of who can translate them..."
Scout Amberward says, "I'Il remain here and keep watch over the orc's movements. Return to the Sentinels Gaze as soon as possible."

You receive Full Scout Satchel from Scout Amberward.

Scout Amberward says, "Fair shades to you, Ianthe, and thank you."

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Give Full Scout Satchel to Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade empties the satchel onto his desk and pores over the seeming illegible writings.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "This is what they're carrying out there? Wonderful."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "I suppose I should've expected as much... trying to gathe intelligence from creatures that don't have any brains to begin with."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, You did well though, Ianthe. This at least proves that you area capable of striking a number of moving targets."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade gathers up the papers and tucks them into the satchel then offering it to you.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "You're getting the real scout experience now. How do you about even more paperwork?"

You receive Full Scout Satchel from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

sections.title: Part 2 - Req. Lvl 4
sections.text:
You say, "Ugh, I hate paperwork!"

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "There's a researcher who spends her time in the Heartwood Archives deciphering ancient texts. Fairgrove. A kind girl, but rather timid."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "She's aided the Wyrdguard in the past, so deliver these writings to her and see if she can make heads or tails of this gibberish. I'll send word ahead so that you don't spook her."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "The sooner we know their meaning the better. You have my leave to assist her in any way you can. Who knows, maybe you can shoot some books off the top shelves for her."

Give Full Scout's Satchel to Researcher Fairgrove.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Ores got worse.

Researcher Fairgrove blinks and looks up from the tome as you offer her a satchel full of orcish text
Researcher Fairgrove says, "O-oh/ Were you sent by Captain Thornshade? He sent word th w-would be arriving soon. Are these really w-written in the language of the orcs? F-fascinating!
Researcher Fairgrove trails off as she begins sorting through the writings, seemingly unperturbed about the leathery parchment they are scratched upon. She examines the crude symbols with (...) and curious gaze.
Researcher Fairgrove furrows her brow in thought as she takes a quill and circles two symbols appear on the leathery parchment, before offering it back to you.(...)

You receive Sheaf of Circled Symbols from Researcher Fairgrove.

Researcher Fairgrove says, "Tell me, do you r-recognize anything about these particular... s-symbols?"

You say, "These two symbols?"

Researcher Fairgrove says, "Y-yes, the two symbols that I've circled there on the parchment. They uhm... t-they look familiar to me, but it would be prudent if you could... v-verify something for m first."
Researcher Fairgrove says, "I believe I've seen a s-symbol just like this one etched into the bark of the smaller conifer trees near the Wyrdgate,"
Researcher Fairgrove says, "If you could t-travel to the gate and c-compare the symbols to those on this sheaf, it w-would affirm my initial suspicions."
Researcher Fairgrove says, "T'll g-go over these writings in the meantime. T-thank you, and I... I hope this isn't a bother."

Directions:
{{|Go past the Archer guild area to the Pixie lift and take it down.
Go left past the circle of glowing mushrooms to the tree near the ramp up.
Get right next to it and type /look tree}}

The smaller trees of Evershade Weald seem to be thriving, despite being overshadowed by the great elderspires. The lower bark of this particular conifer is entirely concealed in a twisting net of rich vines and ivy.
The heavy coverage of vines prevents any chance of observing what may or may not be etched onto the bark of this tree. You would have to pull the vines away to get a better view.

{{|Type /pull vines}}

You carefully pull away a section of the vines, just enough to glimpse what was hidden underneath.

Etched into the bark of the tree, you reveal a series of old, oddly symmetrical markings that have long since healed over with thick scabs of hardened sap.

You receive Handful of Ivy.

{{|Type /inspect mark}}

Closer examination of the odd marks reveals that they are not ordinary wounds, but rather an intricate series of elaborately carved symbols. These ancient signs must be the ones you came here to investigate.

After a more thorough examination, and with a little luck from your keen gaze, you locate a series of symbols that almost perfectly match the one that Researcher Fairgrove circled on the parchment. It is certain that she will want to hear about this.

You receive Sheaf of Confirmed Symbols.

Give Sheaf of Confirmed Symbols to Researcher Fairgrove.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Ores got worse.

Researcher Fairgrove widens her eyes as you explain to her how the symbols matched up.
Researcher Fairgrove says, "S-so it's true? What could it mean that the ores are r-reporting symbols that are near the Wrydgate itself? Surely they could n-not have gotten so close."
Researcher Fairgrove says, They're c-clearly using a different script than what is presented trees, but p-perhaps they're also researching something to do with the Wyrding?"
Researcher Fairgrove chews her lower lip nervously.
Researcher Fairgrove says, "H-here, take this bag. I now have an idea of what I can look for with these illegible texts, but I'll n-need you to help me once more in g-gathering some rather, uhm. morbid items."

You receive Research Assistant's Bag from Researcher Fairgrove.

You say, "Yay, morbid items!"

Researcher Fairgrove says, "It I-relates to the second symbol that I recognized in these orcish texts. imagine you've h-heard of the various undead that have risen from the ruins lately?"
Researcher Fairgrove says, "Among them are old elven skeletons from before the calamity. These skeletons are u-under the influence of a wicked magic that stinks of the... t-the Spirals."
Researcher Fairgrove says, "I need you to destroy some of the old skeletons and s-see if you can find evidence of m-magical runes etched into their bones."
Researcher Fairgrove says, "If I can c-compare those runes to the writings that you've brought me, I m-may be able to piece something t-together. Fill the bag with a-at least four examples, and I'll w-work on things here while you, umm... d-do your thing."

Kill an old elven skeleton until you get 4x Rune-Etched Bone. Add to Research Assistant's Bag and combine.

You begin crafting Full Research Assistant's Bag.
Research Assistant's Bag is consumed while crafting
You craft Full Research Assistant's Bag.

Give Full Research Assistant's Bag to Researcher Fairgrove.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Researcher Fairgrove says, "Ah, P-perfect timing! I just finished going over the o-orcish writings that you brought me. Now if my hunch is correct..."
Researcher Fairgrove runs a trained eye across the bones and runic etchings used to raise the dead from their slumber. She frowns and a nervous breath escapes her lips.
Researcher Fairgrove says, "It's as I f-feared. I cannot yet translate this orcish script, but there are c-clear correlations between the runes that were forced upon our ancestors and the s-scouting reports that were being written about the Wyrdgate."
Researcher Fairgrove takes a deep breath and pens out a hasty note. She offers it to you and meets your gaze, her timid demeanor becomes serious and all signs of her former stutter temporarily cease.
Researcher Fairgrove says, "You must bring this to your captain at once. These undead are not raising out of mere circumstance, but because of a plot by the orcs. To what end, I do not know, but the Wyrdguard must be warned not to tarry with the undead disturbance!"

You receive Hastily Written Note from Researcher Fairgrove.

Give Hastily Written Note to Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade narrows his gaze as you offer the note to him, scanning it quickly. He clicks his tongue and scowls.
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "The undead are just a distraction? Hmm..."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "She makes a bold claim, but I have a feeling Fairgrove knows what she's talking about. She's a gentle soul, and not one to get worked up over something that isn't serious."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade stows the note into his tunic and withdraws a small arrowhead token. He perches it on his thumb and flicks it toward you.

You receive Arrowhead Token from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "You earned a little upgrade to that gear of yours, scout. Take this token, along with your scout bracers, to Craftguard Vinebrow and see if he can fix you up with something sturdier."
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "You'll find him in the armory, here in the Sentinels Gaze. Once you're kitted out, return here and let me know when you're ready for the next step."

Give Arrowhead Token and Novice Scout Bracer to Craftguard Vinebrow.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Craftguard Vinebrow says, "So you're the new sharpshooter who's earned Thornshade's respect? He doesn't hand out those tokens for no good reason. Here, let me fix up that bracer for you." Craftguard Vinebrow expertly weaves a reinforcement through the bracer, then applies a protective coating. It is not long before he offers back a bracer that looks brand new.

You receive Weald Scout Bracer from Craftguard Vinebrow.

Craftguard Vinebrow says, "There you are. Now this is worthy of a true scout of the Wyrdguard!"

You say, "I am ready for the next step!"

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "Yeah? Let's take a look at your scout bracer, in that case. We'll see if you're up to the task."

Give Weald Scout Bracer to Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade says, "Hmm... still needs some working in, I think. Come back and show me again once I can see some bowstring wear on that bracer."

You receive your items back from Captain Keyaryn Thornshade.

Captain Keyaryn Thornshade: Looking good, scout. You wear that bracer well. I suppose you're ready to hear about our plan of action.

I've already sent word to the other captains about the undead distraction and how the orcs are the real threat. That doesn't mean we can simply ignore the undead presence, however.

Powerful remains from ancient Calafrey have already taken over structures outside the Ruinwatch, and if we focus all our efforts on the orcs, that still leaves the undead free to harass other citizens or travelers.

So we're the ones who are going to do clean-up duty. Shooting skeletons isn't exactly an efficient use of regular arrows, though, so I believe it's time we enlist some spiritual aid.

Take this note to Moon Dances; he's one of Whisperers of the Preservers. I've sent word ahead of your arrival, but chances are the spirits already told him as well.

He can hear things others cannot, so hopefully he's heard a trick or two we can use to eliminate the undead threat.

Moon Dances: I was expecting your arrival, young scout. From my understanding, you and the good Captain Keyaryn are searching for a means of expulsing the undead from the nearby ruins, yes?

A noble goal, and one that the spirits of the forest would gladly aid you in. 
Though the spirits are often aloof and highly independent. You will need to have them working in unison to disrupt the unnatural process that is animating the ancient dead.

For that, you will need to bring them together in the clay receptacle. You must find and take a sample of the four key elements that make up our great forest.
If you believe you know the four locations where the primordial spirits congregate, the I beseech you to seek them out. Otherwise, I can provide some clue as to where might find the samples you seek.

When you are finished, return your filled receptacle to me.

sections.title: Part 3 - Req. Lvl 8?
sections.text:
Talk to your class trainer again. May have to trade your bracer or something first. She'll send you to Moon Dances, he's in the top floor of the shaman training hut.  He'll give you a mortar and pestle to fill with 4 pure elemental samples. You can ask Moon Dances for further clues and clarification on where to find each of the 4 samples.

Moon Dances says, "There are four elemental spirits, and thus four locations where you must look for a suitable sample. Which one do you seek? The spirit of air, fire, earth, or water?"

You say, "Spirit of air"

Moon Dances says, "Unnatural things have been called upon in the Weald, Undead now roam the forest floor, and their very presence upsets the balance."

Moon Dances says, "Would you help me, Archer, in bringing an end to these creatures most foul?"

You say, "location of air elemental"

Moon Dances says, "The spirits of the air surround us daily, though it is within the boughs of the trees where they are the most rich and vibrant."
Moon Dances says, "Enter the lift to the upper tiers of Faelindral and look amongst the boughs. It is there that you shall find a sample in its purest form."

You say, "location of fire elemental"

Moon Dances says, "The spirits of flame burn brightest within the night sky, when they stand out starkly against a darkened canopy."
Moon Dances says, "You will have to capture a faefly that burns with the spirit of moonfire, and there is only one location I know of where they descend low enough to reach."
Moon Dances says, "You must travel up the cliffs to the south, high above the pass that leads to Keepers Bight. There, you will ind a small ruin where the faeflies often descend at night, basking in the open moonlight."
Moon Dances says, "Capturing one may require forceful coercion, as the flames that burn within the faeflies are both fickle and ferocious if not tamed."

You say, "location of earth elemental"

Moon Dances says, "The earthen spirits are often utilized by the druids of the Circle of Spores, who reside beneath the city of Faelindral."
Moon Dances says, "Looking in the deepest reaches of their caves should reveal a location where you can take an enriched sample for your receptacle. Perhaps you will find it in one of the many fungal circles where they perform their experiments."

You say, "location of water elemental"

Moon Dances says, "The spirits of water will always follow the flows and currents that weave their way throughout the forest." Moon Dances says, "Follow the path toward their final destination at the end of the great river, and should you look there, you will find a suitable sample of their spiritual presence."

{{|You can collect each sample by being in the proper location and inputting the MUD command /take sample.}}

Earth sample
{{|found inside a mushroom ring inside Sporehaven Karst.}}

Air Sample
{{|found in the nonfunctional lift that leads into the upper tiers. (THIS IS A TEMPORARY LOCATION. PLEASE UPDATE AFTER THE UPPER TIER IS ADDED INTO THE GAME)}}

Water Sample
{{|found at the edge of the river near the newbie lift.  Once you've reached the water fall, dive deep into the floor and take a sample.}}

Fire Sample
{{|found by killing a Faefly after using the "/take sample" MUD command near the old Calafray ruins while it is night time.}}

{{|Directions: South of town and a little bit west of the Keeper's Bight zone line you will find a ramp that leads up to the mountain wall. Follow this trail across a small bridge and continue following the wall. You will see another ramp guarded by 3 orcs not too far from there. (You can go around these orcs without aggroing them.) Go up the ramp those 3 are guarding and you will find a small ruin. A broken spire surrounded by 4 pillars. Any time after 6pm /look near the spire and you will get 2 orange texts, one mentions faeflies. use /take sample and an annoyed faefly will spawn|(cons yellow at level 8)}}

Shattered ruins mark this location as part of the old Calafrey Empire. The remains lie here, weathered and worn, their history and purpose lost to time and neglect.

A swarm of faeflies have descended here during the night, dancing among the ruins and basking in the light of the moon and stars above.

Part 4
After turning the mortar back in to Moon Dances, he'll give you back a full receptacle to take to the guard captain. Captain Keyaryn Thornshade will then give you a clicky called Blessing of the Forest Spirit which gives your auto attacks a chance to proc holy damage when the buff is applied. Caveat being it only works inside the ruins of old Calafrey. The captain will ask you to venture to the ruins and collect 10 Necrotic Ash as well as proof of a mysterious robed figure's involvement. once you collect the ash you need to head into the ruins in the evening to find the robed figure. (see video link at bottom of page)

{{|This step is virtually impossible solo at 8 so make sure you take a group with you. Estimates put these quest mobs around 13-18 with the robed figured not determined.}}

decent video walkthrough.

Reward:  Scout's Longbow of the Wyrdguard

sections.text:
Experience

Steel Talon Trainee Tunic (Archer)
Steel Talons Bowman Tunic

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read the Notice of Recruitment you start with as a new Archer character:

Recruit:

You are to deliver this note to Fedamius Steele III
in the Steel Talons Garrison to begin your training.

He can be found observing the courtyard from his 
post on the wall above.

If you get lost, ask a guard. Any guard worth their
salt will know his name.

And be quick about it.

-Steel Talons Recruitment

Head to the Steel Talons Martial Academy on the Southwest side of Night Harbor and hand in your Notice of Recruitment to Fedamius Steel III

You gain experience!!

Fedamius Steele III squints and looks at you.
Fedamius Steele III says "What do we have here?"
Fedamius Steele III takes the note from you and reads it.
Fedamius Steele III says "Ahh... another one for Jacobin to train. Well, Archer, scuttle back down the stairs and deliver this to that ridiculous brother-in-law of mine."
Fedamius Steele III says Let’s hope his aim rubs off on you more than his sense of humor.

You receive Notice of Recruitment from Fedamius Steel III.

Head down into the courtyard and hand your Notice of Recruitment to Jacobin Yeats

You gain experience!!

Jacobin Yeats quickly skewers the note with an arrow.
Jacobin Yeats says "Oh! Another one of these. Where do all of you keep wandering in from?"
Jacobin Yeats shakes his head.
Jacobin Yeats says "Well alright then, how about a wager?I'll give you one arrow. If you can hit the bullseye on your first shot, you get to stay deal?"
Jacobin Yeats laughs.
Jacobin Yeats says "Oh, stop looking at me that way. I'm just kidding. Take this and get ready to head back out."
Jacobin Yeats says "We’ll work on refining your skills later, but for now, the cost of entry involves you, your bow, and scouts."
Jacobin Yeats says "The Ashira have scouts roaming outside the gates. Fill this bag with the scouts' necklaces as proof that you can hit a large, slow moving, somewhat smelly target, and then we’ll get you started."
Jacobin Yeats says "And… don’t go bartering with the Ashira for them."

You receive Steel Talon Trainee Tunic (Archer) from Jacobin Yeats.

You receive Jacobin's Bag from Jacobin Yeats.

sections.title: Part 2 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Head out to the west gate noob yard and kill An ashira scout until you get 4 Ashira Scout Necklaces

Combine the 4 Ashira Scout Necklaces in Jacobin's Bag to receive Bag of Ashira Scout Necklaces

Hand the Bag of Ashira Scout Necklaces to Jacobin Yeats

You gain experience!!

Jacobin Yeats examines the necklaces.
Jacobin Yeats says "These are the ones, well done! What did you end up paying for them?"
Jacobin Yeats laughs.
Jacobin Yeats says "I jest, I jest. The Ashira are a constant threat to our northern and western trade routes. Though, in a way, part of me is sympathetic to any creature that's trying to survive in such a harsh environment."
Jacobin Yeats says "But we're obligated to do our part in keeping Night Harbor safe, and unfortunately, this puts us in a bit of conflict with our furry, feral friends."
Jacobin Yeats says "Let's up the stakes a little bit and move you onto bigger game. Fill this pack with Ashira warrior necklaces, and we'll officially get you onto our roster."
Jacobin Yeats says "Their warriors are no joke, so keep your guard up. You'll find them further out in the desert..'
Jacobin Yeats says "Again... no cheating!"

You receive Jacobin's Pack from Jacobin Yeats.

Head out to the west gate noob yard and kill An ashira warrior until you get 6 Ashira Warrior Necklaces

Alternatively you can head into Shaded Dunes to find small camps of An ashira lookouts and An ashira warriors
After attaining 6 Ashira Warrior Necklaces, combine them in Jacobin's Pack to receive Pack of Ashira Warrior Necklaces
Then return back to Jacobin Yates

Hand the Pack of Ashira Warrior Necklaces to Jacobin Yeats

You gain experience!!

Jacobin Yeats shakes the pack.
Jacobin Yeats says "Yeah, that sounds about right. Great work! Your efforts probably saved a couple of the plump and juicy merchants who'll be fleecing you in the market later. Be sure to let them know, that way they'll have mercy on your coin pouch."
Jacobin Yeats rolls his eyes and laughs.
Jacobin Yeats says "Now that you've risked your life repeatedly for us, maybe it's about time I give you a little information on the Steel Talons' archers. That, or you can just take this note and your tunic to the quartermaster and keep plinking away, no questions asked."

You receive Jacobin's Note from Jacobin Yeats.

Head to the north side of the courtyard and hand in your Steel Talon Trainee Tunic and Jacobin's Note to the Garrison Quartermaster

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Night Harbor Garrison got better.

Garrison Quartermaster furrows his brow as he looks at the note, his expression turning into a broad smile.
Garrison Quartermaster claps his hand against your back and lets out a hearty chuckle.
Garrison Quartermaster says "Welcome aboard! Go ahead, try it on! I've got your size."

You receive Steel Talons Bowman Tunic from Garrison Quartermaster.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
After completing The Yowling, it is discovered that certain residents of Night Harbor are more than what they appear. Slaying these residents in disguise will yield bloodied ashira heads that may be turned in to the Red Mantle Quartermaster for faction with the Red Mantles.

This quest is repeatable, but caution is advised. Slaying Mayana and Jumthem too many times will cause significant faction loss with the City of Night Harbor and the Pyrmos Mercenaries.

It is not known whether there are more disguised ashira NPCs within Night Harbor. More information is required...


Hand in either Mayana's Head or Jumthem's Head to the Red Mantle Quartermaster

Red Mantle Quartermaster says, "An ashira head? What about it?"

You receive Hidden Ashira's Head from Red Mantle Quartermaster.

Red Mantle Quartermaster looks at you suspiciously.
Red Mantle Quartermaster says, "You say this came from an ashira pretending to be human?"

Red Mantle Quartermaster says, "...Thank you for bringing this to my attention. May I keep it for our investigation?"

Red Mantle Quartermaster extends his hand as if expecting something.

Hand in Hidden Ashira's Head to the Red Mantle Quartermaster

Red Mantle Quartermaster says, "Your service does not go unnoticed."

Red Mantle Quartermaster says, "There must be more to this. Keep looking for signs of their presence, and bring them back to me immediately."

Your faction standing with Red Mantles got better.

Your faction standing with Langsdorfian League got better.

Your faction standing with Seafarers Consortium got worse.

sections.title: Reward

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Old Rankle is located in the Tannery in Night Harbor, in the second floor of a building on the north wall, above the leatherworking trainer.




Hail, Old Rankle

Old Rankle says, Whatcha want, eh? Get outta here. Begone. Scat!
Old Rankle cocks his head at you and squints.
Old Rankle says, Hmm... or did the cappin' send ya for the tails bounty?

/say tails

Old Rankle says, That's right! Tails! Ya got some? I love 'em. Make all kinds o' stuff with 'em.

/say stuff

Old Rankle says, That's none o' ya damned business!
Old Rankle eyes you suspiciously.

Give Ashira Tail to Old Rankle

Old Rankle says, "Tails, tails! More tails, more tails! I’ll take them all. Here’s something for ya."

You receive a random piece of Tattered Rawhide from Old Rankle.

You gain experience!!

This quest is repeatable.

sections.title: Reward

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Quartermaster Obaid (formerly known as Garrison Quartermaster) is located in the Garrison (near west gate) in Night Harbor, in a room adjacent to the area with soldiers hitting training dummies.




Hail, Quartermaster Obaid.

Quartermaster Obaid says, Hello there. Do you have a requisition form, or are you here for the bounty?

/say bounty

Quartermaster Obaid says, Aye! Watch Captain Badawi issued a bounty on the ashira that have been attacking travelers along the western road. I'm collecting for him.
Quartermaster Obaid says, Bring me proof in the form of an ashira bracer and I'll see that you get your reward.

Give Ashira Warrior Bracer to Quartermaster Obaid. They drop off ashira warriors.

Quartermaster Obaid says, "Great work! Another of that furry scourge vanquished. Here’s a little something for your efforts."

You receive a random piece of Tattered Rawhide from Quartermaster Obaid.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Steel Talons got better.

This quest is repeatable.

quests.relatedNpcs: Flerri Dawntender the Tailor | Laenyth Windharp | Lorinthal Skybranch | Mistress Naelira | Sersil Tangleroot | Sylphrena Starfall | Sylvosa Pineweld | Wyrdguard Mithrilvine

Lute of the Charmer

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read the Perfumed Letter you start with as a new Bard character:

<character>,


Your performances have not gone unnoticed, nor the feelings they evoke. We've an eye for those with wanderlust in their gaze and an ear for the yearning in their lyrics.

Faelindral may not be the source of all knowledge, but our Lambent Wanderers would still cultivate all that Aêthoril has to offer while spreading the storied histories of our people.

If this letter strikes a chord, please deliver it to the hands of Pine Brightreed next to the stage of the Willows Whisper, It is a mere jaunt over the span across from the Wayward Branch Inn.

Any guard within Faelindral can provide further directions if you ask.


May I be graced with your next performance,
Naerith Songbird of the Lambent Wanderers

Pine Brightreed says, "Ah, a new performer! Caught Naerith's eye, did you? Or perhaps her ears."

Pine Brightreed says, "Either way, we always welcome young talent into the Willow. Hopefully you're eager to get started, as one of our top performers just informed us that she isn't able to make the stage tonight."

Pine Brightreed lets out a whimsical sigh.

Pine Brightreed says, "This is an opportunity to get acquainted with some of our more esteemed patrons... albeit not under the best circumstances."

Pine Brightreed takes a satchel from his belt and offers it to you with a wry grin.

Pine Brightreed says, Say, so you think you could do me a little favor?

You say, "Hmm.. Ok, I will do you a favor."

Pine Brightreed says, "A lot of people were looking forward to hearing Naerith

perform tonight, but unfortunately she's been caught up in some ... other obligations."

Pine Brightreed says, "I need you to gift these vouchers to all the patrons who bought a

ticket to Naerith's performance tonight. Take this as a chance to get acquainted with
the city!"

Pine Brightreed says, "Since she won't be available, the vouchers are good for one other

free performance of their choice."

Pine Brightreed says, "You'll be looking for Sylvosa Pineweld, Wyrdguard Mithrilvine,

Listener Maplebloom, Lorinthal Skybranch, and Sersil Tangleroot,"

Pine Brightreed says, "Bring back their original tickets along with any remaining

vouchers, and I'll make sure that you get some time in the spotlight!"

Pine Brightreed says, "And if you need more information on any individual patron, just

ask. I should be able to point you in their general direction, at least."

You receive Ticket Satchel.

Ticket Satchel

You receive Bundle of Vouchers.

Bundle of Vouchers

sections.title: Part 1a (Delivery)
sections.text:
Delivery Walkthrough Summary:

Head up to the Traders Terrace.

Sylvosa Pineweld is in the smelting area.

Head over to Ranger's Rest and take the lift down.

Wyrdguard Mithrilvine is right at the bottom of the Keeper's Lift.

Head back up and over to the shaman trainers.

Listener Maplebloom is at the campfire at the Balanced Branch.

Head (back to Trader's area; up; left at druids; all the way) to (top of the) Pixie Lift.

Sersil Tangleroot is across from the lift.

Note: See Sersil description below.

Go back down to near the Traveler's Lift. Right, across the bridge at base of bank ramp and inside.

Lorinthal Skybranch is in the tree trunk on the platform south of the Traveler's lift, behind the trader's area.

Delivery Walkthrough:

You say, "Hail, Sylvosa Pineweld."

Sylvosa Pineweld wipes the sweat from his brow and grumbles, begrudgingly accepting the voucher in exchange for his ticket.

Sylvosa Pineweld says, "A real shame, that is. Naerith's voice seems to somehow soothe both my mind and aching body, but there's no helping it."

Sylvosa Pineweld says, "I'll just have to bear through it until she's next available. Here's my ticket, and thanks for letting me know."

You receive Pineweld's Ticket from Sylvosa Pineweld.

You receive your items back from Sylvosa Pineweld.

You say, "Hail, Wyrdguard Mithrilvine."

Wyrdguard Mithrilvine says, "Roots and ash! I was really looking forward to this performance after my shift was over!"

Wyrdguard Mithrilvine says, "Sorry that you have to be the bearer of this bad news, friend. Hopefully I can listen in on another good show some time soon.

Wyrdguard Mithrilvine reluctantly produces an unused ticket and hands it to you.

You receive Mithrilvine's Ticket from Wyrdguard Mithrilvine.

You receive your items back from Wyrdguard Mithrivine.

You say, "Hail, Listener Maplebloom."

Listener Maplebloom seems to snap out of a reverie as you offer her the voucher.

Listener Maplebloom tucks the voucher away and returns the ticket with a sad smile.

Listener Maplebloom nods in acceptance, then takes a deep breath and resumes her meditation.

You receive Maplebloom's Ticket from Listener Maplebloom.

You receive your items back from Listener Maplebloom.

Sersil Tangleroot says, "Listen to the wisdom of the fae! Heed the call of those who truly watch over us!"

Sersil Tangleroot sighs whimsically at the news, meeting your offer with a slow smile. He accepts the voucher, but seems to withhold his ticket for now.

Sersil Tangleroot says, "That is truly a shame. Naerith has a mesmerizing tone that elicits sensations bordering on faerie fascination. I suppose I will return this ticket to you, but in exchange, will you hear a simple message?"

You receive your items back from Sersil Tangleroot.

You say, "I will hear a simple message"

Sersil Tangleroot spreads his arms in a gesture that encompasses everything around him.

Sersil Tangleroot says, "All of Evershade Weald would not be as it is without the benevolence of our fae benefactors. It was not through the grace of any gods that our forest has thrived over the course of many cataclysms."

Sersil Tangleroot says, "It is only through the intervention of the Fae Realms that we survive here at all, so why should we imprison ourselves in a world which has so often sought to cast us out?"

Sersil Tangleroot says, "We Faelewyn should disassociate ourselves with the other races of this land, and embrace the teachings and comforts of the Seven Courts. Only then can our people finally be at peace."
