Sersil Tangleroot says, Spread this message to any kin who would hear it, so that they too can revel in the wisdom of the fae."

Sersil Tangleroot says, "Thank you for listening, young bard, and please keep my words in mind. Here is my ticket. I do hope that Naerith is able to reschedule soon."

You receive Tangleroot's Ticket from Sersil Tangleroot.

You say, "Hail, Lorinthal Skybranch."

Lorinthal Skybranch says, "What do you mean she had to cancel?! I waited until dawn for this ticket, and now you're telling me it's useless?! Blasted ash... root-rot... fel-fae... giant droppings!"

Lorinthal Skybranch continues his tirade of accusatory curses and slang as he flings his ticket at your chest, then shifts his focus to an imprisoned poacher, berating him without end.

You receive Skybranch's Ticket from Lorinthal Skybranch.

You receive your items back from Lorinthal Skybranch.

(Combine all the Tickets in the Ticket Satchel).

You receive Full Ticket Satchel.

sections.title: Part 1b (Performance)
sections.text:
Give Full Ticket Satchel to Pine Brightreed.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Pine Brightreed says, "Hey, great, you're back! I hope no one was too disappointed with the news."

Pine Brightreed says, "On the bright side, while you were off running around, I managed to land you a chance to show your stuff right here on stage!

Pine Brightreed says, "You'll want this basket for any donations you get. What do you say? Would you be willing show us your talents by means of a small performance?"

You receive Donation Basket from Pine Brightreed.

Pine Brightreed gestures toward a nearby shelf of used instruments, shooting you a playful grin.

Pine Brightreed says, "Take a look at our assortment of public instruments on the shelf next to Ilyra, then pick out one that you like! A lot of them have seen better days, but I'm sure you can find something that's at least playable."

Pine Brightreed says, "Once you have something suitable, all you need to go is go out and take the stage to start your performance! Then return to me once you have a basket full of donations along with the instrument that you borrowed."

Pine Brightreed says, "And I really do mean take the stage, <player>! Look for the rug on stage and stand there. This will be your first appearance at the Whisper, so you'll want to make it memorable."

Type "/look"

Worn and well-used instruments are stored here, many of which are in need of repair or replacement. A casual glance leaves much to be desired in the selection, but there may be something salvageable buried here should one choose to give the shelf a more thorough inspection.

Type "/inspect shelf"

Unsurprisingly, there is little of good quality found among the public instruments; however, you spot a wooden recorder behind some of the more worn pieces that looks to be in good shape. It may be worth taking.

Type "/take recorder"

You shift the used instruments aside and reach out to take the recorder.

You receive Odd Recorder.

It seems to be in respectable shape, and by taking the stage with such a piece, you are sure you can deliver a memorable performance,

Equip the recorder

Type "/take stage"

(Throughout your "performance", a Generous Donation will be thrown onto the stage. You will need 4 of them).

(Dialog varies, so just follow the prompts).

You take the stage for the first time and offer a bow to the patrons of the Willows Whisper. Pine shouts out a brief introduction as you ready the odd recorder in your grip. For a brief moment, it feels as though it wants to slide out of your hands, but you shrug it off as mere nerves.

You bring the recorder to your lips. All you need to do now is take a breath.

Type "/take breath"

You take a deep breath and blow into the recorder. A sudden slip of a finger across one of the tone holes causes a sharp, ear-piercing whistle to ring out across the stage!

That was some rotten luck, as you know you can do better. Before carrying on with your performance, you should take a moment, just enough to calm your nerves.

Type "/take breath" or maybe "/take moment"

You take a moment to center yourself, fingers now poised with precision. You blow, but no sound escapes, as though the instrument were blocked or silenced by an unseen force!

a citizen looks shocked.

a tipsy citizen says, "Ugh... Where did they find this so-called talent? Surely not in Faelindral."

Someone from the crowd throws a donation onto the stage, which thunks wetly near your feet.

You peer down the body of the recorder but see no blockage. What is going on here? If you wish to continue your performance, you may need to give the odd recorder a thorough inspection.

Type "/inspect recorder"

You give the recorder a quick inspection, but nothing about it appears overtly broken or out of place. Determined, you grip it with frustration and force a note through!

Notes flow from the recorder at last; however, they are all reversed! This leads to a cacophony of untrained sounds that billow among the patrons, prompting yet another donation of fruit to be tossed onto the stage,

Reversed tones? This must be some fae prank, Is there a pixie hiding inside the recorder? You should open it and find out.

Type "/open recorder"

You open the recorder and remove the mouthpiece, peering inside. There does not appear to be a pixie inside, and the act draws a chuckle from the crowd.

After replacing the mouthpiece, you decide to take a calm and delicate approach, blowing faintly into the instrument in hopes of eliciting a soft note. What follows is a horrendous, ear-piercing screech that nearly deafens the crowd! This results in yet another donation splattering across the stage.

This cannot be how your first performance goes. Determined to show your actual talent, you must try to push forward!

Type "/push forward"

Fed up with the instrument, you inhale deeply and blow into it with all your might... but the recorder wrenches free from your hands and clatters to the stage floor! You fumble to snatch it back, heart racing.

Suddenly, a generous donation splats against you, coating you in a fruity residue. Things are getting out of hand, quite literally. You could take a breath to center yourself and continue, or simply end this farce by taking a bow.

Type "/take bow"

You decide you have had enough of this mockery, having received plenty of so-called donations from the patrons of the Willows Whisper, Despite the crushing performance, you take an awkward bow.

Pine Brightreed seems to be beside himself with joy as be beckons you over.

Combine the Donations in the Donation Basket.

You begin crafting Full Donation Basket.
Donation Basket is consumed while crafting

You gain experience!!

You have leveled up! You are now level 2!
You can now engage in combat against other players.

sections.title: Part 1c (Finish)
sections.text:
Give Full Donation Basket and Odd Recorder to Pine Brightreed

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Pine Brightreed laughs heartily as you turn over your basket full of donations. Wiping a tear from his eye, he claps you on the shoulder while struggling to regain his breath.

Pine Brightreed says, "You should have seen your face, you looked positively baffled! That playing could have awoken the Sleepers themselves! Oh stars above, let me help you clean all this up."

Pine Brightreed continues to chuckle as he pulls out a small washcloth and wipes away the remnants of the generous donations you received from the crowd, before stuffing it into your pocket.

You receive Fruit-Stained Washcloth from Pine Brightreed.

Pine Brightreed says, "I must confess, I was just having a bit of fun. I have no doubt that you're talented, seeing as you did manage to pick out the one instrument in the pile that remained intact."

Pine Brightreed says, "What you didn't know, however, was the only viable instrument in that lot was afflicted with a terrible curse!"

You say, "A curse?"

Pine Brightreed says, "The worst curse an instrument could have, of course... a curse of cacophonia! Anything played on that recorder sounds terrible, no matter your skill!"

Pine Brightreed says, "On the bright side, you forced many patrons to buy another round of drinks. Not to mention, we won't be going hungry anytime soon."

Pine Brightreed trails off as he tests the weight of your donation basket, shooting you a playful grin.

Pine Brightreed says, "Just some innocent fun for an introduction, right? Do you forgive me?"

You say, "I forgive you"

Pine Brightreed beams a bright smile as he claps you on the shoulder once more. You can smell the sweet scent of wine on his breath.

Pine Brightreed says, "Wonderful! I can already see the beginnings of a beautiful friendship. Though, I feel it's about time that you get acquainted with the rest of our little troupe here."

Pine Brightreed says, "Go show Laenyth that washcloth and she'll know exactly who sent you. She's our resident Tale Keeper, so she might even record this event as the harrowing beginning to your own legendary adventures!"

Pine Brightreed says, "She should be just up the ascent to the Lambent Lantern, which you can spot from the front of the stage."

Head to Laenyth Windharp in the Lambent Lantern on the first floor.

Give Fruit-Stained Washcloth to Laenyth Windharp

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Laenyth Windharp takes the washcloth and exhales a short sigh, offering you a politely apologetic smile.

Laenyth Windharp says, "You really don't need to introduce yourself after that performance you had to put on. I do apologize for Pine. He's often as whimsical as the fae if he's not drowning in his cups."

Laenyth Windharp says, "I'm Laenyth Windharp, the Tale Keeper for the Lambent Wanderers. I'm gladdened by your arrival today, despite the... unfortunate introduction."

Laenyth Windharp says, "Many of Aêthoril's greatest tales are manifested through trial and tribulation. Perhaps this is simply the beginning of your own great epic."

Laenyth Windharp says, "You should take this note to Sylphrena Starfall next. She's our lead envoy and may have a task for you that, hopefully, doesn't involve fruit."

You receive Note for Sylphrena.

Sylphrena,

Pine has made yet another introduction using the cursed recorder.

Can you please see to it that he keeps it locked up this time, while also compensating the performer in some way? This is not how anyone wishes to begin their tale.

- Laenyth

You receive Note for Sylphrena.

Give Note for Sylphrena to Sylphrena Starfall, who is just upstairs from Laenyth Windharp.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Ah, I see! So you're the one Pine was just hazing out on the stage? Goodness, that oaf... and now, of all times?"

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Listen, I hope he didn't put a sour taste in your mouth, because we really could use the help of performers such as yourself!"

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Please, take this ring as a means of recompense. Also... would you be willing to hear me out?"

You receive Ring of Introduction from Sylphrena Starfall.

You say, "I am willing to hear you out."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "I'll just need a little time to sort out a plan, then we'll make sure you don't regret your decision to join us! In the meantime, I'm sure you can find a way to make a, erm... more positive name for yourself here in Faelindral."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Once you're more familiar with Evershade, show me your Ring of Introduction. By then, I should have something fun for you!"

sections.title: Part 2 - Req. Lvl 5
sections.text:
Give Ring of Introduction to Sylphrena Starfall.

Sylphrena Startall claps her hands together and beams you a bright smile before handing you the ring along with a small bag.

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Ah, it seems you've already started making a name for yourself! Pine really ought to be more forgiving toward those with such promising talent."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "He actually has his own show coming up shortly. How would you feel about turning his own performance into a bit of a comedy routine?"

You receive Ring of Introduction from Sylphrena Starfall.

You receive Ingredient Bag from Sylphrena Starfall.

sections.title: Part 2a (Gather)
sections.text:
You need to collect and then combine:

2 Royal Jelly
2 Pixie glitter
2 Wasp Worker Wax

You begin crafting Full Ingredient Bag.

Ingredient Bag is consumed while crafting.

You craft Full Ingredient Bag.

Give Full Ingredient Bag to Sylphrena Starfall.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

sections.title: Part 2b (Trickster)
sections.text:
Sylphrena Starfall says, "Oh, how devious! I hope gathering these ingredients wasn't too difficult a task. I promise that the show will be worth it, though!"

Sylphrena Starfall proceeds to combine the ingredients into a syrupy mixture, then slowly pours it into the bottom of a wineglass laced with the mysterious concoction. She offers the glass to you with a smirk.

You receive Laced Wineglass from Sylphrena Starfall.

Sylphrena Starfall says, "All that's left is to offer Pine a free glass of Cilindrine Red. Trust me, he won't be able to resist."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "I'll signal the bartender to allow you behind the bar. You'll be free to look around for the barrel of wine back there."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Then, all you have to do is pour enough wine into the glass so that Pine doesn't notice or taste the little addition we made when you offer it to him."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Well? Go on, get to it! Pine's act is coming up shortly, so he's bound to parched! Bring me back the empty glass when you're done."

Head over to barrels at the back of the bar.

Type "/pour wine"

You tilt the barrel just enough to coax a stream of Cilindrine red into your keeping. The act feels like simple theft, yet it carries a playful thrill without real consequence.

You fill the laced wineglass nearly to the rim, the syrupy mixture Sylphrena added blending seamlessly with the rich crimson color of the wine. As you glance over your shoulder, you catch the bartender's knowing wink, and a quick smirk passes between you.

You receive Laced Wine.

Give Laced Wine to Pine Brightreed.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

sections.title: Part 2c (ha ha)
sections.text:
Pine Brightreed blinks in surprise as you offer him the wineglass, though his hesitation is short lived as he accepts it with a wide grin.

Pine Brightreed says, "Hey, now this is a surprise! Who told you this was my favorite drink? Ahh, no matter. I'm glad that there aren't any hard feelings between us!"

Pine Brightreed says, "Great timing, too, as I'm just about to put on one of my great acts! Stick around and maybe you'll learn a thing or two from a master bard!"

Pine Brightreed proceeds to down the entire glass of wine in a rather uncouth display. He hands you back the empty glass and shoots you a wink before making his way to the stage.

You receive Empty Wineglass from Pine Brightreed.

Pine Brightreed says, "*Hic*"

Pine Brightreed stumbles out onto the stage, looking as though he is about to lose his balance.

Pine Brightreed says, "Hellooo, everyone! Let's give a big round of applause to our next performer! You all know and love them! It's Pine! That's me!"

a citizen says, "When I hear Naerith sing, I know it's just for me. She's so enchanting..."

Pine Brightreed says, "I have to warn you, my head is really throbbing today. It's getting to be a little Pine-ful!"

Pine Brightreed says, "Maybe it has something to do with this altitude. We're so far up in the sky, it's a wonder we aren't called High Elves!"

Pine Brightreed looks out expectantly at the crowd, who regard him with unimpressed skepticism.

Pine Brightreed says, "I've been wondering if we've spent enough time up in the elderspires. Maybe it's about time we branched out a little more!"

Pine Brightreed says, "Ahh, who am I kidding? I love this community/ We're all rooted in culture and history!"

Pine Brightreed beckons to the crowd for a reaction, but all he receives in response is a series of disturbed groans.

Pine Brightreed says, "Oh come on, that was a good one! If you think you can outdo me, I dare you to come up here and be a better treant-ertainer!"

Pine Brightreed says, "Anyway... did any of you catch that thick fog that rolled in the other night? I tried to, but I mist!"

Pine Brightreed sways so far to one side that he nearly topples over, struggling to catch his footing and right himself.

Pine Brightreed says, "Enough groaning! I might as well go join the Circle of Spores... since I'm a real fun-guy!"

Pine Brightreed outstretches his arms, expecting applause. Instead, he receives a torrent of generous, fruity donations that knock him off his unsteady feet.

Pine Brightreed says, "Alright, alright! I'm going! You'll hate to see me go, but you'll love to watch me leaf!"

sections.title: Part 2d (Finish)
sections.text:
Give Empty Wineglass to Sylphrena Starfall.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Sylphrena Starfall doubles over in laughter as the boos and jeers of the crowd fill the air from the nearby stage.

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Oh Pine, that'll teach you to treat our new members with a little more respect!"

Sylphrena Starfall says, "He can normally handle a glass of wine without issue, but those extra ingredients are more than likely making him feel as though he's performing for the fae courts themselves."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Here, you deserve a little something for going out and doing all that work."

Sylphrena Starfall unstraps a lute from her back and holds it out for you.

You receive Lambent Lute from Sylphrena Starfall.

Sylphrena Starfall says, "I promise that this one doesn't have a curse! You should go out and practice with it, then come show it to me after you earn some callouses on your fingertips."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "I'm sure that by then we'll have some actual work for someone as talented as you."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Here, you deserve a little something for going out and doing all that work."

Sylphrena Starfall unstraps a lute from her back and holds it out for you.

You receive Lambent Lute from Sylphrena Starfall.

sections.title: Part 3a (Intro)
sections.text:
Give Lambent Lute to Sylphrena Starfall.

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Ah, look at that! Calloused fingertips and a voice that could compel someone off the edge of Faelindral. I think you're ready to do some real Lambent Wanderer work!"

Sylphrena Starfall strums her fingers across your lute before turning it around and offering it back to you with a smile.

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Here, you'll need your lute as well as this letter. Tell me, <character>, have you ever done much in the way of diplomacy?"

You receive Lambent Lute from Sylphrena Starfall.

You receive Sylphrena's Note.

Laenyth,

This performer may have the talent we need to determine why and how the naiads have become so confrontational of late.

You have the most experience of us all in dealing with the water nymphs, but I still respect your decision to retire as a tale keeper.

Instead, please impart your wisdom upon this young bard and see that they are prepared for the mission ahead.


Sylphrena

You say, "I can do diplomacy."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "It's what the Wanderers excel at, I must say! Who better to spread the arts and words of our people than performers such as ourselves? Even if a little magic tends to get mixed into our lyrics from time to time."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "The job I have for you involves a dispute with the residents of the Whispering Pools. Do you know the place?"

Sylphrena Starfall says, "They're the caves behind the eastern waterfall where the naiads dwell. Supposedly they're led by a powerful water nymph who they refer to as Mistress Naelira."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "I've heard from reliable sources that the naiads are trying to spread their influence outside the pools, which goes against their pact with Queen Sylneira."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "This is obviously upsetting to a number of Faelindral's groups, one in particular being the Ardent Keepers."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "So, we're going to go in there as a happy neutral party and see if we can determine what's got them so eager to get out, and what we might be able to do to appease them."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Are you interested?"

You say, "I am interested."

Sylphrena Starfall claps her hands together excitedly!

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Oh, how lovely! Now, before you go diving head first into their caves, you should be warned... the naiads are notoriously ruthless to their guests!"

Sylphrena Starfall says, "There's a good chance that even dipping a toe into one of their pools will have a hoard of angry faeries trying to tear your mind apart from the inside out."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "That's why we're going to have to put together a little disguise before you can wander safely through the Whispering Pools and negotiate with their leader."

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Bring the letter I gave you downstairs to Laenyth. She has the most experience with those water faeries, and also knows a trick or two about illusions. She'll get you sorted for the job!"

sections.title: Part 3b (Potion)
sections.text:
Give Sylphrena's Note to Laenyth Windharp.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Your faction standing with Fellstone Ores got worse.

Laenyth Windharp offers you a pleasant smile as she dips her gaze to read over the letter, her brow aising a touch.

Laenyth Windharp says, "Sleeper's dream! You're heading into the Whispering Pools? You have quite the task ahead of you, my friend. The naiads can be a terrifying foe if you're on their bad side."

Laenyth Windharp says,".. Which I suppose is why Sylphrena has sent you to me. I have, in the past, managed to spend time among the naiads by appealing to their connection to water."

Laenyth Windharp says, "I learned much while I mingled with the water nymphs, though I dared not approach their Mistress Naelira."

Laenyth Windharp says, "She's quite powerful, and I had a suspicion that she saw straight through my magics... yet she did not raise an alarm simply for her own amusement."

Laenyth Windharp says, "That's neither here nor there, however! I'm to help you create a potion that allows you to take on an aspect of water, so that you may safely traverse the Whispering Pools."

Laenyth Windharp says, "Here's a recipe that you can follow, along with a special tear that you'll need for this particular potion. If you see anything that you don't recognize, you need only ask me."

Laenyth Windharp says, "Show me your completed potion once you've finished assembling it. Don't worry if you haven't worked with alchemy before, Simply combine these materials in a cauldron and I'll handle the rest."

You receive Laenyth's Potion Recipe from Laenyth Windharp.

You receive Siren's Tear from Laenyth Windharp,

To craft a potion of River's Allure, you must gather the following reagents and mix them within an alchemist's cauldron:
A dyad of Selstie kelp,
A pentad of river essence,
A dyad of fish oil-crude, not fine,
A single Siren's Tear,
A Tempered Vial.

You say "Where can I find Selstie kelp?"

Laenyth Windharp says, "Selstie kelp is typically found at the bottom of rivers. There should be some located here in the Weald, though you may need strong lungs in order to harvest it."

You say "What is river essence?"

Laenyth Windharp says, "You'll need to collect some of the river's essence from the manifested elementals that live in the river itself."
Laenyth Windharp says, "Though do be careful, as some of them seem rather... confused of late. It may be related to a plot of the naiads."

You say "What about Crude Fish Oil?"

Laenyth Windharp says, "Fish oil comes from, well, fish! If you cannot find any for sale, you could always take up a bit of fishing."

Laenyth Windharp says, "You'll need to find at least four fish to get any meaningful amount of oil, then extract it into a makeshift vial using an alchemist's cauldron. Do this enough to fill two vials and you should have what's needed for the potion."

You say, "Where can I get the vial?"

Laenyth Windharp says, "Tempered vials should be sold directly from the alchemists shop. The Well of Order is where you'd find them here in Faelindral; it's just across from the bank.

Note: Cauldron recipe only takes Whitefish

Give Completed Mixture to Laenyth Windharp.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Your faction standing with Fellstone Ores got worse.

Laenyth Windharp says, "Ah, well done! You've made plenty here, enough for more than one potion. Let me just apply the finishing touches..."

Laenyth Windharp pours a small amount of the mixture into a separate flask as she sings an enthralling melody, her voice causing the mixture to glow with a magical blue aura. Once finished, she offers the potion to you.

Laenyth Windharp says, "You'll need to drink this potion while you're under the waterfall concealing the naiad's home. It should temper any of their immediate hostility toward you. If you run out and require any more, bring me the empty potion and I'll refill it for you."

Laenyth Windharp says, "Hopefully this helps you in your task, <character>. The Whispering Pools are beautiful, but dangerous. Do take care, especially around Mistress Naelira.

sections.title: Part 3c (Tragedy)
sections.text:
You receive Potion of River's Allure from Laenyth Windharp,

Drink potion

You say, "Hail, Mistress Naelira."

Mistress Naelira regards you with an icy gaze that could freeze the very blood in your veins.

Despite her cold demeanor, her words sing upon your ears like the gentle lapping of waves agai a shore.

Mistress Naelira says, "Quite rare and even bold for one such as yourself to seek an audience with me. I see through that feeble magic of yours, though I admit it's rather entertaining." Mistress Naelira dips her gaze to the lute you bought, her eyes briefly lighting up with interest.

Mistress Naelira says, "Are you a performer?"

You say, "Yes, I am a performer"

Mistress Naelira says, "Is that so? Then show me that instrument of yours if you believe you're worthy to perform for the Lady of Sirens."

Give Lambent Lute to Mistress Naelira.

Mistress Naelira inspects the lute with a enchanting, sapphire gaze. Icy fingers trace down the neck of the lute and across the strings, causing them to tighten and contract due to the chill of her touch.

Mistress Naelira strums her fingers across the chilled chords. The lute offers a final, feeble note before the pressure becomes too much to bear and a string suddenly snaps. It coils up against itself after an abrupt twang.

Mistress Naelira sighs in disappointment and tosses the broken lute back to you.

Mistress Naelira says, "I'm not impressed with your instrument, bard. Certainly not now with a missing string. I'll only accept entertainment from the finest of amusements. I can't be appeased by such a meager lute that's so obviously in need of.. improvement."

You receive Broken Lambent Lute from Mistress Naelira.

You sniffle, tears in your eye.

You say, "My.. my lute!"

You glare at Mistress Naelira.

You say, "What improvement?"

Mistress Naelira says, "Eager to be my plaything, aren't you? If you're that determined to repair your so-called instrument and play for me, then perhaps you can seek out someone capable of weaving better strings."

Mistress Naelira says, "Your Faelindral is filled with artisans of all kinds, is it not? I'm sure one of them could fashion some new, stronger lute strings for you."

Mistress Naelira says, "Use that precious voice of yours and ask around for lute strings that aren't so delicate or flimsy."

Mistress Naelira says, "Now begone, lest I choose to feed you to my other pets."

To replenish the potion:

Give Potion of River's Allure to Laenyth Windharp.

Laenyth Windharp says, "Do you require more of the potion? I understand, Petanj. Diplomacy oft takes far longer than one thinks."
Laenyth Windharp proceeds to infuse another potion with an enthralling melody.
Laenyth Windharp says, "Here you are. I'l be here should you need me to refill it for you again."

You receive Potion of River's Allure from Laenyth Windharp.

sections.title: Part 3d (Remedy)
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, Flerri Dawntender the Tailor."

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "We've got the finest silks and weaves around! Take a look and let me know if anything interests you!"

You say, "Do you have any lute strings?"

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "Lute strings? Well that's an interesting request... very interesting. You know, I've been meaning to try my hand at making something that is both fine and durable."

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "This would be a good test of that, I imagine. I'd be more than happy to string something together for you!"

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor chuckles softly at her own little joke before letting out a sigh.

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "Sorry, I just got back from one of Pine's performances."

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "The thing is, I don't really have the materials in stock to make something requiring that much tension. I do have one idea, but that's... no, it's far too dangerous."

You say, "Ohh, I like it dangerous!"

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "Well, I'm sure you know that the spiders in Evershade have some fairly common and useful silk. But I've heard there are larger brown recluse spiders that hide out in Keepers Bight!"

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "Supposedly they're as large as a horse with silk of steel! That's not all, though. There's tales of a rare one.. an even larger recluse that must have silk like mithril!"

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "If you could somehow get me some of that silk, I'd surely be able to weave a set of strings that would last you a lifetime! Just... be careful if you do go out there."

sections.title: Part 3e (Spiders)
sections.text:
(Head to Keeper's Bight and find the spiders.)

They can be found inside a large hollow log north of the mill.
A deadwood matriarch will drop Bundle of Strong Silk.

Once you have the silk, give the Broken Lambent Lute and Bundle of Strong Silk to Flerri Dawntender the Tailor

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor sets to work pulling and shaping the impressively durable silk into long, glimmering threads.

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor uses her shears to cut the rare thread into suitable lengths, then guides them through the bridge of the broken lute.

She pulls the strings taut up along the neck and wraps them securely around each peg.

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "There, that should do it! What do you think? It may need a little tuning, but I'm sure these strings will last longer than the lute body will!"

Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "I hope you don't mind if I keep some of the spare silk here; I'd love to work on some new projects with it. Of course, I'll also swing by the Willow at some point to hear you play!"

You receive Silk-Strung Lute from Flerri Dawntender the Tailor.

sections.title: Part 3f (Mistress)
sections.text:
(Make sure you have a refilled potion and go back to the cave under the waterfall.)

You say, "Hail Mistress Naelira"

Mistress Naelira says, "Ah, the prospective entertainment returns. Have you procured an instrument worthy of performing for me, bard? Let me see it."

Hand the Silk-Strung Lute to Mistress Naelira

Mistress Naelira purses her lips as she regards the newly strung lute, subjecting it to the same test she performed previously.

Mistress Naelira strums her icy digits along the rare strings, eliciting a beautiful and harmonious note from the instrument.

Mistress Naelira says, "I suppose this will have to do. Very well, bard. I shall permit you to enthrall us with a dazzling performance. Here's your lute along with a token of my favor."
Mistress Naelira says, "Enter the line of my ensemble and look out from your next stage, dear bard. When you're ready to begin, be sure to take a bow."

Just stand amongst the mobs lined up in near her and type

/take bow

This will start the performance. During the performance, when given the prompts, you will use mud commands such as:

/push forward
/break rhythm
/take pause

It seems like a few different options will work and then you end it with another:

/take bow

You end your overwhelming performance with a sweeping, flourished bow. Sweat runs down your brow as you pant for some much-needed breath.

The naiads all stare incredulously at you, before looking back to their Mistress to gauge her reaction.
You also turn your gaze up to witness an overly flustered nymph, now sporting cheeks that are far deeper in hue than they once were.
Naelira's gaze leaps from you to her servants, then back to you again.
She places a hand on her hip and lets out a petulant huff, casting her gaze to the side. Her other hand extends out toward you expectantly.
Mistress Naelira says, "Your lute and my favor, bard. Return them to me. You should be rewarded for a... suitably entertaining performance."

Hand her the Silk-Strung Lute and Naelira's Favor

Mistress Naelira snatches both the favor and lute from your grasp, offering and indignant huff. The crowd of onlooking naiads softly giggle among themselves following the reaction of their mistress, which earns them a dagger-like stare from the flustered water nymph.
Mistress Naelira proceeds to turn her attention back to your lute and sings a gentle, melodious harmony upon it that infuses it with siren magic. She then offers the instrument back to you, along with an upturned nose.

Mistress Naelira says,"You performed admirably, bard, and I am...impressed. You've shown me that there's reason yet to linger in these pools, but don't think you're the only reason I'm encouraged to stay!"
Mistress Naelira says,"Now begone from my sight until I'm in need of further entertainment.

You receive Enchanted Lute from Mistress Naelira.

sections.title: Part 3g (Finally!)
sections.text:
Return to Sylphrena Starfall at the bard guildhall in Faelindral and hand her the Enchanted Lute

Sylphrena Starfall blinks in surprise as you hand her the enchanted lute.
Her hand runs down along the neck as she inspects the strings, seeming to notice the magic that has been woven into the instrument.

Sylphrena Starfall says, "Insertname, this is magnificent! An instrument blessed by the water nymphs of the Whispering Pools? You must be an incredible negotiatior!"
Sylphrena Starfall says, "I'm thrilled you managed to appease them, at least for a time. Fae can be terribly fickle and prone to whimsy that can sometimes turn violent."
Sylphrena Starfall says, "I had my full trust in you, though, and this outcome only reinforces that decision!"
Sylphrena Starfall says, "This lute belongs to you, without a doubt. Perhaps you'll try your hand at another show on the Willow's stage...No curses this time, promise!"
Sylphrena Starfall says, "Well, I'll let you make that choice. I don't have anything more for you, but check back in from time to time. I'm sure I could think of some ways to put that enchanted lute of your to good use for the Lambent Wanderers."

You receive Lute of the Charmed from Sylphrena Starfall.

Reward: Lute of the Charmed

fields.Related NPCs: Flerri Dawntender the Tailor | Laenyth Windharp | Lorinthal Skybranch | Mistress Naelira | Sersil Tangleroot | Sylphrena Starfall | Sylvosa Pineweld | Wyrdguard Mithrilvine

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Jamee's Coin
Azure Enameled Golden Bangle

Experience

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Jamee Langris is on the Azure Veils faction.
Can start quest at level 1

Placeholder until actual item names and dialogues can be added:

Give newbie note to Jamee Langris, receive a note titled "Jamee's List of Names". The note contains a list of gifts for people around Night Harbor.

NPC Positions for Gifts for our Dear Friends Quest

You say, Where is Harbormaster Daoud?

Jamee Langris says, "Old Daoud is a wonderful friend of ours. Such a truly observant man, with a fantastic memory. It's incredible how much freight and how people move through the harbor in a given day, and yet there's Daoud smoking his pip and remembering every little detail. Such a gifted man."
Jamee Langris say, "You'll likely find him in his office at the docks, or walking nearby smoking his pipe and taking in... everything."
Jamee Langris winks at you.

Hand the Pouch of Rare Tobacco to Harbormaster Daoud

Harbormaster Daoud takes the pouch of tobacco and immediately puts it to his node, breathing in a mighty breath.
Harbormaster Daoud says, "Aaahh... Master Jamee amazes me with his ability to find things that even I cannot."
Harbormaster Daoud laughs deeply.
Harbormaster Daoud slyly hands you a small metal parchment vial.
Harbormaster Daoud says, "You'll not want to tamper with that, lest the contents be dissolved. Goodbye now. Master Jamee has my many thanks!"

You receive Small Metal Parchment Vial from Harbormaster Daoud.

You say, Where is Guard Jeskal?

Jamee Langris says, "One's infatuations do make for interesting study. Our lovely guard is quite the case. Fortunately one of our dangers really seems to cool the flames our poor guard builds up standing out there in the sun all day. She's provided the perfumed silken sash to help him get through the day."
Jamee Langris puts a finger to his chin.
Jamee Langris says, "Actually, I think it'll have the opposite effect. Imagine that. What a tease."
Jamee Langris says, "Either way, he's recently lost his posting in Highport Terrace, so you'll find him at the Northern City Gate."
Jamee Langris says, "It's a shame really. He must have been bitter about losing his cushy posting in such a posh part of the city."

Hand the Perfumed Silken Sash to Guard Jeskal

Guard Jeskal takes the sash from you and immediately puts it to his face for a moment before hiding it under his breastplate.
Guard Jeskal says, "I can't wait to see her again!"
Guard Jeskal appears to look through you, while smiling and thinking of something else.
Guard Jeskal hands you a small metal parchment vial, while looking quickly to see if anyone is watching.
Guard Jeskal says, "I got this from the councilman. Please be careful in returning it to your people."

You receive Small Metal Parchment Vial from Guard Jeskal.

You say, Where is Cordellius Hollmion?

Jamee Langris says, "Cordellius is quite the character. He's a slithery one and so full of ambition. We've found what he needs, but we'll see how long it's him we're friendly with. He's playing a tricky game, and he might soon find that we're better situated by making that known."
Jamee Langris says, "Don't worry, he's harmless. You'll find him in the small library within the Spellbinder's Spire in Sageside. Don't get confused and find yourself in the larger library across the way."

Hand the Small Eye Shaped Mirror to Cordellius Hollmion

Cordellius Hollmion takes the mirror and stares at  you for a moment, scowling.
Cordellius Hollmion says, "Take this and begone."
Cordellius Hollmion looks over his shoulder for a moment and then tosses a small metal parchment vial into your hand.
Cordellius Hollmion says, "Away with you."

You receive Small Metal Parchment Vial from Cordellius Hollmion.

You say, Where is Elrind?

Jamee Langris says, "Elrind? People, including his family, do so underestimate that young man. He needs to get out more, and maybe we should see to that soon. But, in the meantime, his time spend in the Steel Talon's garrison library is proving to be quite illuminating."

Hand the Tiny Leatherbound Book to Elrind Steele

Elrind Steele takes the book and smiles broadly at it before pressing it against his chest.
Elrind Steele says, "I can't wait to read this tonight after supper! He's always so good at finding these things."
Elrind Steele smiles while shaking his head and looking at tiny leatherbound book again.
Elrind Steele holds up a small metal parchment vial proudly before handing it to you.
Elrind Steele says, "This time, I think I've found something he'll be just as excited about. But it's for his eyes only. Take care with it."

You receive Small Metal Parchment Vial from Elrind Steele.

You say, Where is Jiselle?

Jamee Langris says, "Sweet 'Gentle' Jiselle. She is a sincere and rare jewel of a person, with such an unfortunately complicated family. It weighs heavily on her, so I hope the flower will lift her spirits some, as she does so love them."
Jamee Langris says, "You will find her tending to the ill in the Wayfarer's Hospice adjacent to the Traveler's Camp."

Hand the Framed Pressed Flowers to Jiselle Heyley

Jiselle Heyley takes the framed flowers and stares at them for a moment, seeming to melt a little; looking a mix of nostalgic, joyful, and wistful.
Jiselle Heyley says, "I can't begin to think of where he found them. I haven't seen one of these flowers since my brother and I were children.
Jiselle Heyley sighs deeply, looking at the framed flowers again.
Jiselle Heyley puts her hand in yours, opening it to place a small metal parchment vial between your palm and hers.
Jiselle Heyley says, "Jamee is a good man. I hope this helps him. You should excercise extreme caution in getting it back to him."

Your receive Small Metal Parchment Vial from Jiselle Heyley.

You say, Where is Assistant Researcher Farland?

Jamee Langris says, "He's one of our newer friends... a member of that group of archaelogists from Easthymn, here to explore the various holes they keep finding in the ground in this region. Dreadful work if you ask me, but the things they discover are quite interesting. As are the people that are interesting in those interesting things."

Hand the Vial of Cloudy Liquid to Assistant Researcher Farland

Assistant Researcher Farland takes the small vial and peers through it for a moment, before deftly hiding it up his sleeve.
Assistant Researcher Farland says, "Did you tamper with this?"
Assistant Researcher Farland seems to assess you briefly.
Assistant Researcher Farland says, "I assume not, since you're still standing. You may want to wash your hands either way."
Assistant Researcher Farland pulls a small smetal parchment vial out of his belt and hands it to you.
Assistant Researcher Farland says, "If the substance does its job, I'll likely have something more for him later. Take care not to lose that note on your way back. He'll want to read of my discovery."

Your receive Small Metal Parchment Vial from Assistant Researcher Farland.

Combine the six Small Metal Parchment Vials in the provided Small Courier Bag to create the item form of the Small Courier Bag.

Head back Jamee Langris with the Small Courier Bag.

Jamee Langris takes the bag from you and pockets the handful of scrolls, then looks at you with a smile.
Jamee Langris says 'Splendid work! I hope your first jaunt around the city in service to our greater good found you well. You're probably parched. Take this coin to the barkeep at our tavern across from the stage and he'll give you a drink.'

Your faction standing with The Azure Veils got better.

You gain experience!!

sections.title: Part 2 - Req. Lvl 2 to start
sections.text:
Jamee Langris says, "So, what do we do with you next?"

Jamee Langris says, "I've got it! It's about time we send you on a real adventure!"

You say, A real adventure?

Jamee Langris says, "Oh yes, an adventure indeed! Unfortunately, you're not quite at the stage where you can live glamorously off your good looks and well-established name. But never fear, dear... you'll get there."

Jamee Langris says, "From now on, you'll live a life of danger... and utility! Just think of how much inspiration you'll gather for your great songs of gallantry. Oh, and having a scar or two makes for fascinating party conversation and pillow talk."

Jamee Langris says, "... I'll get to the point. I've promised someone a piece of information about a certain not-so-secret smuggling operation. Scout out the camp along the western coast, in the shadow of Fallen Watch."

Jamee Langris says, "While you're out there, if you happen to find a smuggler wearing a ruby-inlaid gold ring, please retrieve it... preferably with the finger still attached, if you can manage it. The ring's rightful owner will be grateful."

Jamee Langris says, "You're shaping up to be quite the jack-of-all-trades, which is certainly fortunate for me, as I also have a second task I'd like to ask of you."

You say, What task?

Jamee Langris says, "Well, this one is rather dreary, I'm afraid. A friend of ours took an amulet into the newly excavated tomb outside the city."

Jamee Langris says, "It was meant to allow communion with the dead, but apparently, it still needs some work... or at least, that's the suspicion, given reports of what happened to the person who attempted to use the amulet."

Jamee Langris says, "Ordinarily, we'd have one of the Freebooters' archaeologists find it for us, but they've been having trouble staying alive in there. The Red Mantles are out of the question, as well, since the owner isn't particularly fond of authority figures."

Jamee Langris says, "The amulet itself is silver and bears the engraving of a woman's face. Perhaps they were attempting to speak with a ghastly gal."

Jamee Langris shrugs and pats you on the shoulder, nodding kindly.

Jamee Langris says, "Would you be a dear and bring both the ruby ring and necklace back to me?"

Collect the Severed Ring Finger from smugglers / wererats from the Smugglers Camp in the Shaded Dunes.

Then collect the Engraved Amulet from High Marshal Fionna in the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane.

June 26th Update:

-Place the engraved amulet and the severed ring finger into the small leather pouch and hit combine

-Give the small leather pouch to Jamee Langris to receive:

Azure Enameled Golden Bangle

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text: Note: This quest is for Beastmasters starting in Faelindral. For the Night Harbor version, see Beastmaster Starter Quest (Night Harbor).

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Experience
Novice Claws of the Keeper from Part 1
Spirit-Blessed Shawl from Part 2

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read Request for Aid you start with as a new Beastmaster Character:

A call is put out to any Faelewyn who would heed 
it.

The balance of the Weald is threatened; the natural 
order disturbed.

Those with a connection to the lands and its 
creatures are summoned to Ranger's Rest.

The Ardent Keepers are in need of those willing to 
protect our lands from encroachment.

Seek out the Rest upon Keeper's Terrance, past 
the inn and toward the kennels. Deliver this 
pamphlet to Captain Relgen Greenblade.

From there, your talents shall benefit the 
preservation of all Faelewyn.

High Keeper Caelen Stillbranch

Hand Request for Aid to Captain Relgen Greenblade

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Ah, you seek to aid the cause? I welcome you, young one."

Captain Relgen Greenblade pauses to regard you with a keen eye, offering a nod as he returns the letter back to you.

You receive Request for Aid from Captain Relgen Greenbglade.

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "You have the scent of the wild on you. Take no offense, for we of the Ardent Keepers wish to preserve the natural order between the beasts of the Weald and Faelindral."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Take this request to Aerin Mossfang in the Quiet Den. She oversees the training of those like yourself who have a connection to bestial sprits."

Head to Aerin Mossfang in the Quiet Den and hand in the Request for Aid.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Aerin Mossfang snatches the pamphlet from your hand, then leans in close to you without regard for personal boundaries. She sniffs the air around you before leaning back with a satisfied nod.

Aerin Mossfang says, "I'm not one for paperwork, but I can tell you just came from Relgen. You have his scent on you. You've also been marked by beast spirits, which makes you more pleasant company than most."

Aerin Mossfang proceeds to fish out a small kit and tosses it into your hands
You receive Treatment Kit from Aerin Mossfang.

Aerin Mossfang says, "You must be here to learn how to bond with an animal, correct? Well, your timing is impeccable. We've recently brought in some wounded animals that could use a little attention."

Aerin Mossfang says, "So, are you ready to help?"

You say, "Yes I am ready to help."

Aerin Mossfang nods in acknowledgement as she gestures toward the various animal kennels.

Aerin Mossfang says, "We don't just treat animals of the Weald here. All beasts are a part of the natural order, and these ones were victims of poachers or other unnatural threats."

Aerin Mossfang practically spits the word poachers as Sire snarls in recognition.

Aerin Mossfang says, "We've treated their physical injuries with restorative magic, but they still need salves and remedies to help regain their former strength."

Aerin Mossfang says, "Approach an animal of your choice and offer it your treatment kit, Take a good look first, then return the used kit to me when you're done."

Turned in the Treatment Kit to a fatigued jackal. "Believe you could turn into various "hurt" animals in the kennels."

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

a fatigued jackal attempts to shuffle back into the kennel as you move to treat it, though a few calming words and an outstretched hand eventually incite the creature's curiosity. It moves closer to catch your scent, and you are able to offer a remedy that should help restore its lost vigor.
You receive Used Treatment Kit from a fatigued jackal.

Turned in the Used Treatment Kit to Aerin Mossfang.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Aerin Mossfang greets you with a feral-looking grin as you return the used treatment kit, then produces a satchel for you and offers it with an outstretched hand.
You receive Hunt Satchel from Aerin Mossfang.

Aerin Mossfang says, "Did I mention that was the first step in your bonding? I didn't? Well, now you know. You had to make the choice without an outside influence. So, which of these called out to you?"
Aerin Mossfang glances over to the kennels.
Aerin Mossfang says, "The jackal is an elusive and resourceful beast, with a spirit that some say is more ancient than the founding of Calafrey."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Their determination to survive makes them unpredictable companions, but they're as loyal as any canine and have the bite to match."
Aerin Mossfang says, "It would seem that the one you treated may already be calling to your spirit. Good. Take this scroll and learn to call out to your new companion. Then, tell me when you're ready to continue your bond."
You receive Scroll: Jackal Pet Tier 1 from Aerin Mossfang.

Aerin Mossfang says, "Good. You've sparked an animal's interest, and now you must earn its trust by hunting alongside it, as one would with any true companion."
Aerin Mossfang says, "You'll need to keep your companion well fed if you want them to perform their best.  I've given you some simple animal feed for now, but you'll have to show me that you can provide what's needed to support your partner."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Wolves or bats will be your primary meat sources here in the Weald, so choose whichever suits your palette.  Fill the hunt satchel with six portions of either meat, then seal it and return it to me."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Don't worry, little Keeper. This hunting is sanctioned, so long as it pertains to the ritual. Return to me with your filled and combined satchel and we'll complete the bond."

Hand in the Full Hunt Satchel to Aerin Mossfang.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Aerin Mossfang licks her lips in an almost predatory manner as you return from your hunt.
Aerin Mossfang takes your satchel and begins emptying the contents into a nearby cooking pot, boiling it into a rich stew.
Aerin Mossfang says, "This is what it means to hunt as one! That which were prey now serve to fuel the predator. The predator trods the land and protects if from threats unnatural."
Aerin Mossfang says, "The beastmaster is a representation of this cycle and how both man and beast are drawn to the protection of the realm."
Aerin Mossfang leans over the cook pot and inhales the scent of the stew bubbling thickly atop the fire. She hands you a spoon.
You receive Ritual Spoon from Aerin Mossfang.

Aerin Mossfang says, "Go on, have a taste. Return the spoon to me when you're finished."

Issue the mud command /taste stew and receive Used Ritual Spoon while standing near the cooking stew pot.

You taste the prepared stew, its rich and complex flavors overwhelming your senses.
You offer a second spooful to your companion, who devours it greedily.
The combined efforts of you and your partner have strengthened a bond through the primal act of shared spoils.
You receive Used Ritual Spoon.

Hand in the Used Ritual Spoon to Aerin Mossfang.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Aerin Mossfang says, "With this, the first steps toward a lifelong companionship have been taken. You've protected life, you've taken life, and now you've sustained life."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Take these claws as a symbol of your initiation. I welcome you, <yourname>, as a novice beastmaster of the Ardent Keepers."
Aerin Mossfang says, "For now, you're free to further your bond with your new partner, but don't stray far. Once those claws have witnessed a fair share of hunts, seek me out again and show them to me. I'll have more for you when I deem you ready."

You receive Novice Claws of the Keeper from Aerin Mossfang.

sections.title: Part 4 - Req. Lvl 4
sections.text:
Turn in Novice Claws of the Keeper to Aerin Mossfang.

Aerin Mossfang appraises the state of your claws and offers a grunt, followed by a nod of satisfaction. She returns the claws to you.
You receive Novice Claws of the Keeper from Aerin Mossfang.

Aerin Mossfang says, "Good! It seems that you and your new companion have had a chance to put these claws to the test."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Though I must ask you, novice... have you been hunting any of the beasts within the Weald on your travels? A simple yes or no will suffice."
Aerin Mossfang crosses her arms and regards you with a cool stare. The dire wolf at her side offers a low, warning growl.

You /say YES

Aerin Mossfang nods, her arms uncrossing as she lets out a touch of a sigh.
Aerin Mossfang says, "What, did you think I'd be disappointed? Many of us have been forced to put down more beasts of late, as their aggression grows from some sort of... sickness."

You /say What sickness?

Aerin Mossfang lets out a low growl, revealing a glimpse of her pointed canines.
Aerin Mossfang says, "Yes. Perhaps you've seen evidence of it during your hunts on the forest floor."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Man of the local wolf tribes have been afficted. We've lost two packs entirely to the strange madness, as they threw themselves at some of our patrols."
Aerin Mossfang says, "The black wolves in particular have been struggling the most, with the brown and gray packs retreating to their dens within Keepers Bight."
Aerin Mossfang says, "I hate to ask this of you, <yourname>, but we need someone to help carve out this diseased rot before it spreads any further."

You /say What diseased rot?

Aerin Mossfang nods somberly, her gaze turning to Sire, who offers a low whine. She comforts the wolf with a gentle scratch behind his ear.
Aerin Mossfang says, "Take this twine. Cull the rabid members of the black wolf pack and wrap their hides with this."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Bring me four of their hides, wrapped into a bundle. Then we shall see if we can discover the source of this affliction and end it once and for all."
You receive Hide Wrapping from Aerin Mossfang.

Combine 4 Diseased Wolf Pelt's in the Hide Wrapping and receive Bundle of Wrapped Pelts.

Hand in the Bundle of Wrapped Pelts to Aerin Mossfang.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Aerin Mossfang runs a hand along the diseased remains of the fallen wolves, looking none too pleased. She sniffs at the black fur and recoils with disgust.
Aerin Mossfang says, "These hides have the scent of orcs upon them! Are they the ones afflicting the packs with their rotten magic?"
Aerin Mossfang growls as you hear the distinct grinding of her sharpened teeth. Sire begins to growl alongside her.
Aerin Mossfang says, "These fallen packmates shall not have been culled in vain. I want you to take these diseased pelts to someone who has also heard the cry of the wolves."

You receive Bundle of Diseased Pelts from Aerin Mossfang.

You /say who to Aerin Mossfang.

Aerin Mossfang says, "Eraeldor Lowmist is the Elder Whisperer of the Preservers. You'll likely find him in their lodge, among the other shamans on Outreach Terrace."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Throw those pelts at his feet and demand to hear what he has to say about it"
Aerin Mossfang says, "He'll also be able to cure you of any afflictions you may have suffered while you were out hunting our rabid brothers and sisters."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Now go!"

Hand in the Bundle of Diseased Pelts to Eraeldor Lowmist.
You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Preservers got better.

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Eraeldor Lowmist slowly opens his eyes as you approach and deposit the diseased bundle at his feet, meeting your gaze. He offers a genuine but sorrowful smile.
Eraeldor Lowmist says, "Aerin was right to send you to me, young master. Her agitated song could be heard across Faelindral, as can the somber chorus of the wolf spirits."
Eraeldor Lowmist says, "Allow me to cleanse these skins so that their spirits may rest peacefully, knowing their sickness shall spread no further."
Eraeldor Lowmist lowers himself to the bundle of pelts and begins to sing a soft melody. Curative magic washes across the pelts, and the scent of their lingering sickness dissipates.

You receive Bundle of Cleansed Pelts from Eraeldor Lowmist.

Eraeldor Lowmist slowly returns to his feet while folding his hands politely in front of himself.
Eraeldor Lowmist says, "I can cleanse you as well, if you feel you are afflicted. Else, I believe that the Lady Aerin had wished you to make a demand of me."

Eraeldor Lowmist can CURE RABIES!!! target and /say cleanse me

Target Eraeldor Lowmist and /say I demand

Eraeldor Lowmist says, "You may inform the packmistress that her concerns are well-founded. This malady is indeed brought on by the orc tribes and their twisted use of magic."
Eraeldor Lowmist says, "To what end, I cannot say. They may merely wish to sow confusion for a greater scheme, with the fauna being a tragic casualty."
Eraeldor Lowmist says, "Though, if you wish to prove yourself to the Lady Aerin and appease a portion of her rage, I could provide you with some direction."

Target Eraeldor Lowmist and /say direction

Eraeldor Lowmist says, "The name of the one responsible for the wolves' ailment has been whispered into my ear by the spirits of vengeance... Vorkuul Blighteye."
Eraeldor Lowmist says, "There is no doubt that he is close to the wolves and the source of his crimes. Aerin would reward you for this fiend's head, alongside the cleansed pelts of the fallen."
Eraeldor Lowmist says, "The spirits, too, would be indebted to you. They are being twisted by this orc's malice and by those who follow his teachings. Hunt those who befoul our ways of preservation, and you may draw out their master."

Killing A Fellstone shaman in Evershade Weald should spawn Vorkuul Blighteye who drops Blighted Orc Head.

Hand in the Bundle of Cleansed Pelts and Blighted Orc Head to Aerin Mossfang.
You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Aerin Mossfang cackled as you show her the head. Her companion, Sire, bellows a victory howl at her side.
Aerin Mossfang says, "Eraeldor heard the name of this orc, you say? If only my own ears were as good as his, Sire and I would've hunted down this root sucker ourselves."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Still, you were given the name of elusive prey and hunted down successfully, while also making sure the pelts have been cleansed of their rot. That alone is worthy of my respect. Here."
Aerin Mossfang removes a hide shawl from her shoulders and slings it over yours.

You receive Spirit-Blessed Shawl from Aerin Mossfang.

Aerin Mossfang says, "The spirits of fallen pack members have blessed that shawl. I'd say you earned it for delivering the justice they deserve."
Aerin Mossfang says, "You deserve an improvement to those claws as well, but I must conceive a suitable hunt first. Keep them close, and in the future, I will have further instructions for you."

sections.title: Part 5 - Req. Lvl 8
sections.text:
Aerin Mossfang says, "The next stage of your training will involve making an improvement to your novice claws"

/say what improvement?

Aerin Mossfang offers you a feral grin.
Aerin Mossfang says, "Yes, you'll need more than simple novice claws if you're to continue your hunts beyond Faelindral."
Aerin Mossfang says, "you've already proven your worth by diminishing the orcish blight, but there's one last test you'll need to perform to get materials you need"
Aerin Mossfang says, "More specifically, I'll have you face off against a much larger Calafreyan beast."

/say what is a Calafreyan beast?

Aerin Mossfang says, "Have you journeyed out to Keepers Bight yet? There are reports of black bears in the region that have been straying too close to caravan roads and preying on innocent travelers"
Aerin Mossfang says, "Black bears are typically not an aggressive species, so unfortunately any who have turned hostile must be brought low. You're to set out and test yourself against their strength"
Aerin Mossfang says, "Travel the roads and find any bears that have turned violent. Put them down and return to me with three of their bloodied claws, along with any sign of what could have caused their hostility...should you come across it.""

Hand 3x Blood-Soaked Bear Claw, Poacher's Arrow, and Novice Claws of the Keeper

Aerin Mossfang lets out a feral growl, gripping the arrow so hard that she ends up snapping it like a twig. 
Aerin Mossfang says, "Humans. Why am I not surprised? Their greed has driven the beasts to madness, and the bears are not the first to suffer from human encroachment upon our lands"
Aerin Mossfang says, "We'll deal with them soon enough. At the very least you ended the creature's agony, and soon their claws will mete out justice through decisive battle."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Here, take the bear claws along with this pattern. There are, however, other components you must gather to craft yourself a weapon of vengeance"
You receive Set of Bear Claws from Aerin Mossfang.

You receive Keeper Claw Pattern from Aerin Mossfang.

You receive Novice Claws of the Keeper from Aerin Mossfang.

/say what other components?

Aerin Mossfang says, "Find a leatherworking station or use a kit, whichever is your preference. Affix the claws onto a bear pelt of at least low quality, then stich it together with two rough threads and two sets of cloth padding"
Aerin Mossfang says, "If you have any experience in tailoring or leatherworking, you may already be familiar with the components. if not, then you needn't worry. Just follow the instructions on the pattern"
Aerin Mossfang says, "The combination is simple and you aren't required to make something pretty. Simply...functional. You can buy the items from others if you lack the skill or patience to make them yourself."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Return the fashioned claws and the pattern to me for the final step in their creation"

Combine the following items in a leatherworking station or kit:

2x Rough Thread
2x Cloth Padding
Set of Bear Claws
Low-Quality Bear Pelt
Novice Claws of the keeper

Recipe will be trivial

You craft Fashioned Set of Claws.

Hand in the Fashioned Set of Claws to Aerin Mossfang.

Aerin Mossfang nods in satisfaction. 
Aerin Mossfang says, "I'll take the pattern from you as well, novice, now that it's no longer needed"
You receive your items back from Aerin Mossfang.

Hand in the Fashioned Set of Claws and Keeper Claw Pattern to Aerin Mossfang.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Poachers of Calafrey got worse.

Aerin Mossfang appraises the state of the claws and gives a satisfied node 
Aerin Mossfang says, "These will do. Now to infuse them with the a spirit of vengeance..."
Aerin Mossfang growls as she closes her eyes and focuses upon the set of claws, drawing forth a primal spirit of vengeance. You feel your blood begin to heat and your adrenaline flow as a sensation of rage threatens to overwhelm you
Aerin Mossfang manages to coax a portion of the spirit into the claws themselves, while also directing what remains into the nearby cauldron, causing it to nearly boil over. She looks at you with a fanged grin and tosses the claws into your possession
Aerin Mossfang says, "These should serve you well enough for your next task, <Player Name>. I assume you can already guess who's to be the target of your next hunt."
You receive Vengeful Claws of the Keeper from Aerin Mossfang.

DMG:7 DEL:29 STR+2 DEX+1 WIS+1 HP+5 SKILL:SLASH

sections.title: Part 6 - Req. Lvl ? Was given at Lvl 11 but could be earlier
sections.text:
/say Who is my next target?

Aerin Mossfang says, "If my duties didn't root me within the Den, I'd be more than willing to join you on this next hunt. though, my instincts tell me that the target you seek is not an expert poacher."
Aerin Mossfang says, "The human poachers in Keepers Bight are typically cunning, avoiding needless aggravation of the local wildlife. they understand they're one mistake away from being tracked down themselves."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Whoever attacked these black bears was sloppy...inexperienced. perhaps some fool wishing to prove themself to their foul brethren"
Aerin Mossfang says, "You're going to find out where this would-be poacher is camping and act the part of their prey in order to lure them out"

/say how will I act the part?

Aerin Mossfang steps over to her cauldron and fills a phial with the spirit-infused brew that had been bubbling within
Aerin Mossfang says, "Take this potion. I challenged the raging ursine spirits to infuse it with their essence, and imbibing it will allow you to take on their form...if only for a short time."
Aerin Mossfang says, "You're going to act the part of the poacher's prey in order to lure them out of hiding, only to strike  out at them with a fury they'll never suspect"
Aerin Mossfang says, "Now all that remains is to find this poacher's location"
You receive Potion of Ursine Rage from Aerin Mossfang.

Journey to Keepers Bight. When you zone drink the potion and turn into a bear. Follow the left wall and pass by the the road to Scarwood (stay in Keeper's Bight). Shortly after the road you will come to a small camp with no NPCs, tucked against the wall. 
/smell tent

You sniff at the ten fabrics, the scent of human musk and sweat now cloying at your sensitive snout. With this scent, you may now be able to smell the poacher and their location

/smell poacher

It does not take you long to recognize the scent wafting from the surrounding foliage. The very same human who bears this smell is lingering nearby in hiding, perhaps even watching you at this very moment
You will have to act the part of an oblivous bear in order to draw them out, presenting the perfect opportunity that any aspiring poacher could not pass up.
The nearby tree stands out to you as the obvious choice, as bears are known tor ub their backs against them. This may entice the poacher tor eveal themself to attack a vulnerable target

/rub tree

You stand on your hind legs and press your back up against the tree, scratching in earnest. it is a surprisingly pleasant experience until a loosed arrowhead embedsitself into the bark next to your ursine head!
a fledgling poacher says says, "This is it, my chance to finally prove I have what it takes! die, beast!"

a fledgline poacher was white con at 12
When you kill him

You gain experience!!

a fledgling poacher says says, "W-what...you're no normal...bear..."

loot Fledgling Poacher's Bow

Hand in the Fledgling Poacher's Bow and Potion of Ursine Rage to Aerin Mossfang.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Aerin Mossfang says, "Well done, Keeper!"
Aerin Mossfang takes the bow in hand and grits her teeth. She immediately snaps the weapon across her knee, tossing one half into the fire beneath the cauldron and the other to Sire as a chew toy. The dire wolf voraciously tears apart the human-scented implement.
Aerin Mossfang says, "you're proving to be a lethal hunter, <Player Name>. Good. The spirit within your claw is appeased for the time being, as is my own rage"
Aerin Mossfang says, "i'm thankful to have a Keeper such as yourself to help enforce the will of the beastial spirits. While I don't dislike my role at the Den, I often find myself wishing to hunt alongside the packs oft he Weald."
Aerin Mossfang says, "Relying on others is also not my strongest trait...Relgen can attest to that"
Aerin Mossfang scoffs
Aerin Mossfang says, "Regardless, you've shown yourself to be reliable once more. Take this as a token of my appreciation and a symbol to others that you're no longer a novice. You're a Keeper now, <Player Name>, a true protector of the

Weald."

You receive Shroud of the Ardent Keeper from Aerin Mossfang.

Slot: Back AC:3 STR+2 DEX+2 Effect: Invisibility versus Beasts (on click)

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text: Note: This quest is for Beastmasters starting in Night Harbor. For the Faelindral version, see Beastmaster Starter Quest (Faelindral).

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience

Beast Initiate's Cord
Beast Adept's Tunic

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read Hastily Scrawled Note you start with as a new Beastmaster Character:

Recollections of a feverish dream...

I found myself in a forest, running from a pack of
wolves who came close and nipped at my heels.
They would not relent until, finally, I collapsed in a
clearing.
They leapt upon me, biting and tearing at my flesh,
and as I was all but consumed, I did not die. Rather,
I was reborn within the pack, as one of their own.

What could this mean? Perhaps I should visit the
Seekers of the Lost Eye. Their shamans might be
able to help me...

If I recall correctly, their guild is located in
Saltbreeze Park, central to the city and in the
shadow of Highpoint Terrace's Great Guild Hall.

I must make haste.

Hand Hastily Scrawled Note to Leila Ghasem

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Seekers of the Lost Eye got better.

Leila Ghasem takes the note brusquely, glances over it with knitted brows, then smirks at you.
Leila Ghasem says, "You have done well to bring this note to me. Have you always felt alone among the company of men, as if an outcast? It is because the feral heart of a beast beats within your chest. I welcome you to our order as an initiate."
Leila Ghasem briefly drops her feral demeanor and smiles warmly, her sharp fangs revealing her bestial nature.
Leila Ghasem says, "Your first task is simple. You are to assemble your own necklace using teeth from the local beasts."
Leila Ghasem says, "The battlefield is the ultimate way of knowing another being. The local rats, bats, and jackals should provide sufficient test for an initiate. Take two teeth from each and tie them to this string."

You receive Worn Leather Cord from Leila Ghasem.

Head to either the North Gate or West Gate Noob Yards to hunt for a large rats, a desert bats, and a jackal pups.

We will be searching for 2 Rat Tooths, 2 Bat Tooths, and 2 Jackal Tooths. Alternatively, these can be bought from vendors.
Combine the 6 items items in the Worn Leather Cord. You will receive a Betoothed Leather Cord.

Hand Betoothed Leather Cord to Leila Ghasem

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Seekers of the Lost Eye got better.

Leila Ghasem says, "Ah, yes! This is a wonderful necklace. The spacing is good, and these teeth are fine examples. Did you learn more about the creatures you faced in battle? You ought to thank them for teaching you."
Leila Ghasem clasps the necklace in prayer before throwing her head back and letting out a hyena-like cackle.
Leila Ghasem says, "Your necklace now bears the blessing of our order. Wear it proudly, for you are now and official beastmaster of the Seekers of the Lost Eye!"
Leila Ghasem ponders for a moment.
Leila Ghasem says, "Oh! Errol was fumbling around with this pouch and dropped it. I think it would be more useful to you than him, no?"
Leila Ghasem grins broadly.
Leila Ghasem says, "Be safe, <player>. Go train with other young adventurers and return to me when you are more seasoned."

You receive Beast Initiate's Cord from Leila Ghasem.

You receive Pouch from Leila Ghasem.

You receive Simple Animal Feed from Leila Ghasem.

sections.title: Part 2 - Req. Lvl 5
sections.text:
Hand Beast Initiate's Cord to Leila Ghasem

Leila Ghasem takes the necklace from you, looks it over and gives it back to you.
Leila Ghasem says, "You are now bonded to us as a kindred spirit."
Leila Ghasem frowns.
Leila Ghasem says, "We are currently facing a small crisis and we need your help, <Player>, and it's not something you should take lightly."
Leila Ghasem says, "One of our members has gone missing. His name is Elian, an initiate like yourself, barely old enough to be a man."
Leila Ghasem tents her fingers, letting out an exasperated sigh.
Leila Ghasem says, "He went missing somewhere near Blackfeather Bazaar. If you could, I would like you to investigate. Ask the locals in the area about him, if you can, and bring back any information you can find."
Leila Ghasem quickly sketches something onto a piece of paper with a stub of charcoal, and hands it to you.

You receive Description of Elian from Leila Ghasem.

Leila Ghasem says, "Oh, and, do be safe, <Player>. Whatever happened to Elian, I would hate to see it happen to you as well."
Leila Ghasem gives you a worried smile, bid you farewell.

You receive your items back from Leila Ghasem.

Head to Blackfeather Bazaar near the Necropolis in the Northern section of Night Harbor.
There are a few people we can give the sketch to:

If you give the Description of Elian to a beggar:
a beggar takes the sketch from you, looking it over.
a beggar says, "Hm, looks kinda familiar... I think I seen him talking to one of the servant girls around here."
You receive your items back from a beggar.
If you give the Description of Elian to a servant girl:
a servant girl examines the sketch.
a servant girl says, "Hm, I don't know him, but I think I've seen him with Kilia. Why don't you ask her?"
You receive your items back from a servant girl.
If you give the Description of Elian to Kilia:
Kilia says, "Hm? What's this?"
Kilia looks over the paper, and an expression of worry crosses her face.
Kilia says, "Oh, this is Elian alright... I haven't seen him in a few days, I've been getting worried... You all at the guild haven't seen him? This can't be good."
Kilia hands back the piece of paper.
You receive Evidence of Elian from Kilia.
Kilia says, "I saw his rat scurrying around here the other night, it usually doesn't leave his side, but I haven't seen the little thing since. I don't know where it has gone, maybe the others at the guild can help? Please, let me know as soon as you find anything."
Kilia tears up slightly as she bids you farewell.

Head back to Leila Ghasem in the Seekers of the Lost Eye (Guild Hall) and give her the Evidence of Elian

Leila Ghasem says, "Oh, you've returned! Did you find out anything?"
Leila Ghasem takes the evidence from you, looking it over.
Leila Ghasem sighs to herself
Leila Ghasem says, "You say she saw his rat? What was his name again... Right, Blackwhiser!"
Leila Ghasem nods.
Leila Ghasem says, "Well, the next thing you might want to do is try to find Blackwhisker... Of course, most people in the city have no idea how to tell the rats apart in this place."
Leila Ghasem smirks at you.
Leila Ghasem says, "But we're not most people. Allow me to cast a spell on you that will allow you to converse with beasts. One day, you might be able to learn this ability yourself."
Leila Ghasem waves her hands as she closes her eyes. Suddenly, you hear a rushing sound in your ears, as your throat constricts for a brief second. Then, you feel as if wax has been pulled from your ears, and the cacophony of beast sounds turns into the dull murmur of conversation.
Leila Ghasem smiles at you.
Leila Ghasem says, "Now, go and find Blackwhisker... it will lead us to Elian."
Leila Ghasem says, "That spell will allow you to converse with the many beasts here in the city, though I would concentrate your search in the Harbor district... I'm sure you'll find Blackwhisker among his fellow rats."
Leila Ghasem says, "Oh, and if the enchantment fades before you can complete your mission, you can come back and ask for me to renew it. Just give me this evidence back, so I remember to cast the spell on you."
Leila Ghasem sighs, passing the sketch back to you.
You receive Sketch of Elian from Leila Ghasem.
Leila Ghasem says, "Good luck!"
Leila Ghasem waves goodbye to you.

Make your way to the Harbor District in Southern Night Harbor. Looking for a black rat, however if one is not available, then you will need to kill a brown rats or a fat rats until one appears. NOTE: You do not have to talk to the rats. You can skip them and just speak to Whiskey, then move on to the next step.

If you hail a brown rat
a brown rat turns to you suddenly.
a brown rat says, "You speak rat? Learn something new every day."
You say, "Have you seen Blackwhisker?"
a brown rat sniffs around.
a brown rat says, "Pathetic pet rat running around here somewhere."
If you hail a fat rat
a fat rat turns to you suddenly.
a fat rat says, "Amazing! Two-legs not stupid, know how to talk."
You say, "Have you seen Blackwhisker?"
a fat rat sniffs around.
a fat rat says, "Pathetic pet rat running around here somewhere."
a fat rat chitters loudly.
a fat rat says, "Easy to take food from, scared of me."
If you hail a black rat
a black rat sniffs up at you, recognizing your scent from the guild.
a black rat says, "Friend? Elian?"
