You say, "Where is Elian?"
a black rat stands up on his hind legs, sniffing at you.
a black rat says, "You're looking for Elian as well? Oh no... He never came back when he went with the scary men."
You say, "What scary men?"
a black rat skitters about in a circle, then stands up again, sniffing the air.
a black rat says, "Yes, scary men, smell was strange... like you, but not like you. Do not know where went, but dogs might know."
If you hail Whiskey (and possibly Patches)
Whiskey looks up at you, wagging his tail.
Whiskey says, "Hail, and well met! How can this humble hound be of service? I hope no trouble is afoot?"
You say, "Where are the scary men?"
Whiskey says, "Looking for some scary men?"
Whiskey says, "Well, there are some different types of scary people who pass through the harbor, some of them men, some of them not..."
Whiskey says, "Whom, pray tell, are you looking for, someone in particular?"
You say, "Elian"
Whiskey says, "Ah, the beastmaster... Yes, I know of him, he often gave me pets when he came by. Such a nice young man. I haven't seen him since he went with those... intimidating travelers."
Whiskey sighs like any other dog.
Whiskey says, "Oh, I do believe, I overheard one of their names... Yorias, I believe. Yes, I last smelled the man somewhere on the other side of the harbor..."
Whiskey says, "Do be careful! I must say, I do not like the cut of that particular man's jib!"

Head to the Eastern Harbor (Large Harbor) and slightly inland until you see a little creek with some a watersnakes. We will follow this path east until right after we pass the smith on the right. There should be Yorias outside of the building on the left hand side.(advice - Open the city map and find the main entrance to the “The Bends” district — you need to approach its main gate.
At the spot where the two Watchmen are standing, turn around and stand with your back to them.)

You say, "Hail, Yorias."
Yorias looks at you with disdain, spitting on the ground before speaking.
Yorias says, "Whaddayou want?!"
You say, "Elian"
Yorias shrugs at you.
Yorias says, "Who's that?! What does he look like?!"

Hand the Sketch of Elian to Yorias

Yorias takes the parchment from you, looking at it with a sneer.
Yorias says, "Haven't seen this runt, or his little rat, either."
You receive your items back from Yorias.
You say, "Rat" (Can probably say anything here to be honest)
Yorias snarls at you.
Yorias says, "Enough of your questions, runt!."
Yorias says, "I'm tired of you trying to interfere in my business! Time to die, punk!"
Yorias says, "Bet you wish you left me alone, huh?!"
After Killing Yorias, you will receive a Severed Ponytail and a Skintaker's Note. We will be taking these both to Leila Ghasem in the Seekers of the Lost Eye.

Turn in the Severed Ponytail, Skintaker's Note, and Crumpled Sketch of Elian together to Leila Ghasem

You gain experience!!

Leila Ghasem takes the ponytail from you, sniffing it.
Leila Ghasem says, "That's Elian's scent alright... The poor lad..."
Leila Ghasem says, "What did that man say to you before you killed him? Something about Skintakers?"
Leila Ghasem clasps her hands together.
Leila Ghasem says, "This isn't good. The Skintakers are a group of people who follow the teachings of the Spiral, or so it is said. They do not commune and live with beasts, as we do, but instead, they seek the fast path to power"
Leila Ghasem takes a deep breath.
Leila Ghasem says, "This is not the last we hear of them. However, you've done good work today, avenging Elian..."
Leila Ghasem says, "Here, take this as a token of our appreciation."

You receive Beast Adept's Tunic from Leila Ghasem.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience
Random cloth armor
Faction with Preservers

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Moon Dances is located near the Shaman Spell Merchant at The Balanced Branch, which is only reachable from the Ranger/Beastmaster Platform

You say, "Hail, Moon Dances."

Moon Dances offers you a serene bow.

Moon Dances says, "I greet you. I am called Moon Dances, though I am afraid that my namesake is not so true these past nights."

You say, "What namesake?"

Moon Dances says, "I would often dance along with the songs of the spirits during the moonlight. Lately, however, the nights are filled with anguished cries instead of song."

Moon Dances says, "The spirits of the Weald are distraught... Frightened even."

You say, "Why are they distraught?"

Moon Dances says, "Unnatural things have been called upon in the Weald. Undead now roam the forest floor, and their very presence upsets the balance."

Moon Dances says, "Would you help me in bringing an end to these creatures most foul?"

You say, "I will help."

Moon Dances offers you a bow once more, this one out of gratitude.

Moon Dances says, "I will perform a rite of cleansing to put the spirits of the fallen to rest, should you bring me enough of their remains."

Moon Dances says, "I can part with some small tokens of appreciation for every five bone chips you bring me."

Hand in 5 Bone Chips to Moon Dances.

Moon Dances says, "Thank you for purging the land of another undead menace. I'll dispose of these remains."

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Preservers got better.

Moon Dances accepts the offered bone chips and stores them safely away.

Moon Dances says, "You have my humble thanks. I shall see to performing the rite, so that these fallen spirits are put to proper rest."

You receive a Tattered Cloth Gorget from Moon Dances.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience
Faction with Penitent Knights of the Hospice

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Squire Ryland is located inside of the Wayfarers Hospice near the Paladin class trainers. Enter Wayfarers Hospice and take the first door on the right, then turn right.

You say, "Hail, Squire Ryland."

Squire Ryland says, "Hello there. Have you come seeking salvation?"

You say, "I have come seeking salvation."

Squire Ryland says, "Very well, stranger. If you're looking to prove yourself, I have a simple task for you. That is, unless you're too experienced."

You say, "What is your task?"

Squire Ryland says, "Excellent. We can always use some help cleaning up the weaker undead that roam the gates. They lack aggression during the day, but at night, they attack unsuspecting travelers."

Squire Ryland says, "We can't risk them being used in a more sinister plot. Bring me any of their bone chips so that we may destroy their haunted remains."

Hand in 5 Bone Chips or any multiple of 5 to Squire Ryland.

Squire Ryland says, "Thank you for purging the land of another undead menace. I'll dispose of these remains."

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Penitent Knights of the Hospice got better.

If you hand less than 5 Bone Chips:

Squire Ryland says, "While noble of you, i've requested that you turn over at least five bone chips so that I can see to their proper disposal."

Note: There may be a follow-up quest with Sir Leon Kardek or Sir Allan Fortir - more information is required

You say, "I am too experienced."

Squire Ryland says, "Too experienced, eh? Then you should speak with Sir Allan or Sir Leon. These brave paladins not only saved my life, but they are great and holy men."

sections.title: Reward
sections.text: unknown

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Bree Weatherstoll is located in the halfling camp west of the quarry.

You say, "Hail, Bree Weatherstoll."

Bree Weatherstoll says, "Hi there youngling. You seem to have wandered away from home."

Bree Weatherstoll says, "Stay with us a while if you like, eat some potato stew with blessings from the Warrenmother. Fayma provides for all of her children."

Bree Weatherstoll smiles at you warmly.

You say, "Warrenmother?"

Bree Weatherstoll says, "Fayma Warrenmother? She's an old soul. For many generations Fayma has watched over and provided for her younglings.

Bree Weatherstoll says, "She's even watching over us now."

You say, "Youngling?"

Bree Weatherstoll says, "Please take no offense by it. Fayma sees all the races of the world as her younglings."

You say, "Research?"

Bree Weatherstoll says, "We halflings have long sought out the ancient home of our people. It's our greatest hope that the desert of Szuur may have some answers."

Bree Weatherstoll says, "Recently, a passing farmer took shelter from a storm here and came across these ancient halfling bones."

In the middle of the camp a pot with cooking stew can be found.

/look will provide the following description:

Here, a small gathering of halflings scurries about the camp with excited energy.
The outer edge is lined with colorful tents, and crates and boxes are scattered haphazardly between them.
From the center of the camp, the savory aroma of stew wafts up from two cast iron pots over the fire.
Toward the eastern wall, a partially dug alcove catches your eye. Within the shadowed recesses, somethingy ivory gleams faintly.

/take stew will place Halin Hearty Stew in your inventory.

The bones can be found in the alcove nearby.

/look will provide the following description:

In the partially dug alcove, the faint glow of torchligh reveals the skeletal remains of an ancient halfling, their fragile bones cradled by the desert sand.
The skull, smaller, rounder and pronounced brow ridge, bear the markings of an ancient halfling, its jaw slightly agape as if in silent protest against time.
It seems to gaze longingly towards the pot of stew bubbling in the camp, as though the desire for one last meal lingers even in the afterlife.
The ribcage, partially buried, jugs out like the curved petals of a withered flower.

/pour stew (while holding the stew on the cursor)

'You pour the hearty stew onto the drooping jawbone of the halfling skeleton. It runs through the bones and drips onto the ground.'
'The stew is wasted, but you feel mildly satisfied with yourself.

/inspect skeleton

talk to Bree

/say research

at some point during the night she wanders over to the halfling remains and mentions something about ruins

/say ruins

Bree Weatherstoll says, "To the north, there is a quarry."

Bree Weatherstoll says, "West of the quarry is a winding path that leads up the ruins of Tel Ekir."

Bree Weatherstoll says, "It's been long suspected to have once been home to Halin people.  We intend to go there soon."

Bree Weatherstoll looks at you sternly, her eyes unmoving.

Bree Weatherstoll says, "If you go there and happen to find any artifacts of halfling make, please bring it to me."

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Reward: Scroll: Burning Bones

After completing the Necrolyte's Pouch Quest say "take the list of charred procurements" to bones. He will give you a new letter describing the items needed, Bones' List of Uncommon Necrotic Procurement.

20 Scorched Skeletal Remains (Talking to Cordellius is optional)
Hail Cordellius Hollmion in Spellbinders of the Spire
He will tell you that they are from skeletons killed via the Flameburst spell.
15 Burnt Bone Chips (Talking to Pedram is optional)
Hail Pedram at the School of the Fourfold Path
Pedram says, "Hail, Adventurer. I'm Pedram, assistant to the Tams."
You say, "burnt bone chips"
"Pedram lifts his head from a swirl of dancing cinders, his expression serene."
Pedram says, "Ah...not mere ash.Not what you find in a hearth or the pit of pyre. You seek a flame that remembers."
Pedram says, "Campfire, torchlight, forge heat...these flames are bereft of soul, fed by the spent remnants of life. But elemental fire...it's fire that lives, fire that hungers. It's not kind."
You say, "where can I find elemental fire?"
Pedram smiles faintly, more reverant than pleased.
Pedram says, "Yes. Elemental fire is not tool. It's a presence...a spirit, if you will. It speaks in crackles and sizzles, and devours without pause."
Pedram says, "Many will call upon spirits for light, war, or spectacle. Few truly understand what they bind, and fewer still survive when the bond breaks...when reverence is forgotten, and fire takes back what it's owed."
Pedram leans closer
Pedram says, "The bone chips you seek must be seared by such a fire. Not summoned, but enraged...by a fire spirit untethered."
You say, "where can i find an untethered fire spirit?"
Pedram lowers his voice, eyes reflecting a flicker of emotion.
Pedram says, "There is one. Bound long ago within an ancient crypt by rites of the dead. It was enslaved through force, not honor, and it burns still with fury unspent."
Pedram says, "Now it's surrounded by it's necromantic keepers, once masters of their craft, now minions to the very spirit they sought to command."
Pedram says, "It's flames do not simply consume, they rage...they scar. They mark bones with the burn you require."
Pedram straightens and gestures towards the school's tall shelves.
Pedram says, "Before you go stumbling through ash and wrath, learn the tale. Seek the book titled Deference to the Flame; a Tale of Ash and Sorrow. It rests amongst the southern stacks, with our other teachings."
Pedram says, "May you find what you seek...and survive the meeting."

Presumably the elemental being referred to is either a flame elemental or the Skyseer in Ancient Crypt. To be confirmed. The book is in the bookcase to the left of the door to Pedram's room as you enter.

5 Blackened Fish Bones
Hail A Fishwife in Saltbreeze Park
Eventually she will tell you to talk to Jasmerin
She will tell you to go and see Chef Violyn at the Crimson Oasis (Inn with red drapes) near the north gate. Violyn will tell you that to make blackened fish bones you need either 1x Flux (alchemy) and 1x Fish Bones, or 8x Fish Bones. Blackened Fish Bones recipe trivials at 5 Cooking.
1 Singed Skull
hail Rallin Wizentrop at the Academy of Arcane Inquiry
eventually he will mention Drazllin
Enter Sungreet Strand and make your way to the Beetle Caves near the Quarry. On a small ledge near the bottom is a pile of gnome bones. '/look' then '/take skull'. Fight Blazed Revenant, a level 18-19 undead. Loot Singed Skull.

Return all items to Bones, including the Bones' List of Uncommon Necrotic Procurement

sections.text:
This quest has a prerequisite. Player needs to complete the Wizard starter quest part 1, before Jabir will provide quest. Player must provide proof of being part of the Academy before Jabir Ilhamar will accept the burnt out lightstones.





Say What aobut Viridon?

Jabir Ilhamar says, "No We haven't found Viridon... but thank you for your concern."
Jabir Ilhamar says, "I do have another task for you, however. The Academy is in need of burnt out lightstones. If you could bring me four, it would be of great value to us."
Jabir Ilhamar says, "You'll find wisps floating about the Shaded Dunes."
Jabir Ilhamar nods to you with a worried glance.

Turn in four burnt out lightstones to Jabir Ilhamar.

Jabir Ilhamar holds the burnt out lightstones in his cupped hands.
Jabir Ilhamar says, "Oh! Very good indeed! The Academy thanks you."

You gain experience!!

This quest is repeatable.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Gatekeeper Nusder is located at the Red Mantle Keep entrance to the catacombs.

You say, "Hail, Gatekeeper Nusder"

Gatekeeper Nusder says, "Yes, what is it?"

You say, "What is behind this gate?"

Gatekeeper Nusder says, "I'm responsible for the gate to Night Harbor's cemetery and the crypts within."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "Don't get any ideas about sneaking in... diseased beasts linger beyond the main path during the day, and it gets significantly worse at night. It's a very dangerous place, not for the faint of heart."

You say, "Why are there diseased beasts here?"

Gatekeeper Nusder says, "The place is cursed. It wasn't like that years ago, but it's gotten much worse, especially after sunset."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "At night, the cemetery is full of undead creatures roaming the grounds, searching for poor souls to kill and haunt."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "They're the restless remains of our ancestors. The catacombs are filled with unnamed folk... buried alive, executed, or thrown in like bones to the dogs."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "The outdoor area beyond the bridge is the crypt. That's where the noble families are buried. All of them seem cursed to haunt the living forever, never able to find peace."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "We're powerless to stop it, and Haradrel knows we've tried. Many good men and women were lost, and we've got nothing to show for it. Such folly!"

You say, "Maybe I can help stop it?"

Gatekeeper Nusder says, "Apologies, but I don't trust you to do anything but add to our troubles."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "My duty matters to me, and without proof of your worth, I won't risk another life on this venture."



Gatekeeper Nusder may be referring to player level as 'proof of worth' here.

You say, "How can I prove my worth?"

Gatekeeper Nusder looks you over.


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "You at least look like you can hold your own."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "There's one thing we've yet to try... analyzing the source of the curse. If we could figure it out, maybe we could strike at its source and get rid of it."


Gatekeeper Nusder nods at you.


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "Fine! Go and grab the diseased flesh of the beasts during the day. Fill this sack with ten samples so there's plenty to analyze."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "If you can return to me still alive, we might be able to get the samples looked at in Sageside."


Gatekeeper Nusder looks at you sternly.


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "Let me make myself clear... do NOT linger in the cemetery after Eth has set. I don't want another death on my conscience!"



Enter the gate and kill a diseased bat or a catacombs rat and loot Chunk of Diseased Meat x10. The meat is NODROP and not guaranteed on every kill, so plan accordingly if grouping here.



After combining the meats in the satchel, you receive Fetid Satchel. Return Fetid Satchel to Gatekeeper Nusder:



Gatekeeper Nusder looks visibly relieved.


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "You had me worried. I'm glad you're still breathing!"


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "...And you've got the flesh we needed, well done."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "Now, bring the satchel to my friend Liyna in Sageside. You'll find her in the Grand Library."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "Ask her to take a closer look at the flesh and see if she can find anything."



Find Liyna Esueiruc in the second floor (teleporter puts you on floor 3) of the library (which is due east from Gatekeeper Nusder, at the Spellbinders of the Spire):

You say, "Hail, Liyna Esueiruc"

Liyna Esueiruc continues reading her book, then lifts her eyes and furrows her brow.


Liyna Esueiruc says, "What's this you're carrying? I can sense something isn't right..."



Give Liyna Esueiruc the Fetid Satchel:



Liyna Esueiruc drops the satchel out of shock.


Liyna Esueiruc looks at you, stunned, then picks the satchel back up with the tip of her fingers, handing it back to you.


Liyna Esueiruc says, "The smell... and the cursed energy emanating from this! What is Nusder getting himself into? This can't be good."


Liyna Esueiruc says, "Are you certain this is something you want to be involved in?"

You say, "Yes"

Liyna Esueiruc looks you in the eyes, finally giving you a nod.


Liyna Esueiruc says, "He must've seen something in you if he sent you to me."


Liyna Esueiruc concentrates and casts a spell.


Liyna Esueiruc says, "There, hand me the bag once more, I should be able to handle it without risk now."



Give Liyna Esueiruc the Fetid Satchel again:



Liyna Esueiruc looks at the contents with extreme focus and attention.


Liyna Esueiruc says, "An old scent... cursed magic from another generation. I'm not surprised it's coming from the graveyard."


Liyna Esueiruc murmurs something unintelligible.


Liyna Esueiruc says, "The result of an ancient form of necromancy... I'm sure of it."


Liyna Esueiruc says, "We need to dig deeper."


Liyna Esueiruc points in the direction of the cemetery.


Liyna Esueiruc says, "The diseased beasts are just a byproduct of what's really happening there. We need to find the source."


Liyna Esueiruc says, "Take this note to Nusder right away."



You receive Lightly Scented Piece of Parchment from Liyna Esueiruc.


Return to Nusder with the Lightly Scented Piece of Parchment:



Gatekeeper Nusder says, "A note? Give me a second to read through Liyna's words."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "Hmm... I feared she would say that."


You gain experience!!


Gatekeeper Nusder sighs deeply before handing you back the note.


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "Are you sure you want to keep going?"

You say, "Yes"

Gatekeeper Nusder says, "It's been a while since I've seen someone so eager to throw themselves into the maw of death."


Gatekeeper Nusder sighs with a slight grin on his face.


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "You remind me of my younger self. I'd be remiss not to give you a chance."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "When you feel ready, head back into the cemetery during the day with a valiant group of adventurers and look for any signs of necromancy."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "It won't be easy to find, but if you do, come back to me immediately with the note and proof of it."



Kill a pristine beetle, a sanguine bat, an old scarab, an ornate beetle, or other named that requires camping till it spawns, at the top and loot Bloodied Engraved Rune. Return to Gatekeeper Nusder with the rune and note:



Gatekeeper Nusder says, "What's this you've found?"


Gatekeeper Nusder looks over the bloodied note.


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "I'm not certain what it means... but then again, it's not something I've seen before. Let me quickly write to Liyna."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "Here, take this note and the rune to Liyna right away!"



You receive Simple Piece of Parchment. Return to Liyna with the note and rune:



Liyna Esueiruc snatches the note out of your hands and reads it through hurriedly.


Liyna Esueiruc looks at the bloodied rune, inspecting it from all angles.


You gain experience!!


Liyna Esueiruc says, "An even stronger remnant of cursed magic... Now I'm sure of it. There's something, or someone, hiding in the cemetery, and they're doing more than just hiding."


Liyna Esueiruc says, "We need more clues, but the cemetery's beasts won't carry them."


Liyna Esueiruc looks at you intently.


Liyna Esueiruc says, "You know what this means, don't you?"


Liyna Esueiruc scribbles something down and hands it to you.


Liyna Esueiruc says, "Please share this message with Nusder and see whether he's of a same mind."


Liyna Esueiruc says, "In the meanwhile I'll keep studying this rune and see if there's more we can figure out."



You receive Scented Piece of Parchment.


Return to Gatekeeper Nusder with the note.



Gatekeeper Nusder says, "I see how it is... so be it. We have no other choice."


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "I'm entrusting you with the task of finding more clues."


Gatekeeper Nusder hands you a tarnished old key.



You receive Key to the Night Harbor Cemetery.



Gatekeeper Nusder says, "You've earned yourself a key to the cemetery, but use it with the utmost care. Stepping foot in there at night will test your mettle, and your life will be at great risk!"


Gatekeeper Nusder stares worriedly at the cemetery gates.


Gatekeeper Nusder says, "Haradrel be with you, adventurer. We're onto something..."


To be continued, probably requires killing a noble skeleton, a bejeweled skeleton, a majestic skeleton or a crowned skeleton.

sections.text: Chompers Hide Tunic

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, Cheikho."

Cheikho says, "Hail to you, friend!"

Cheikho says, "We're hunting the nearby beach for crocodiles. If you have meat or skins for us, we're happy to purchase them. We also have some goods for sale. Take a look!"

You say, "Crocodiles?"

Cheikho says, "Yes, down along the shoreline. But take care... this area has more dangers than just the crocodiles."

You say, "More dangers?"

Cheikho says, "Look around friend! How did you make it this far without dying?"

Cheikho laughs.

Cheikho says, "There's undead just over the dunes to the northeast, smugglers to our west, and giant scouts prowling around at night... and to top it all off, there's a particularly large and hostile croc wandering about named Chompers."

Cheikho says, "You'd best take care when running around here."

You say, "Chompers?"

Cheikho says, "Yeah, Chompers. Nasty feller. I bet his hide would make one heck of a tunic, though."

Give Cheikho 1x Chomper's Hide.

Cheikho gives you Chompers' Hide Tunic.

quests.title: Cinder Beetle Armor Quests
quests.classText: Archer | Bard | Beastmaster | Cleric | Druid | Fighter | Inquisitor | Monk | Paladin | Ranger | Rogue | Shadow Knight | Shaman | Spellblade

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Cinder Beetle Shield
Cinder Beetle Boots
Cinder Beetle Helm
Cinder Beetle Greaves
Cinder Beetle Breastplate

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
As a general tip, you can often find Cinder Beetle Carapace, Cinder Beetle Legs, and Cinder Beetle Gland for sale on the Blacksmith and Cook vendors across Night Harbor.

Total materials for a full set:

7x Cinder Beetle Legs
11x Cinder Beetle Carapace
1x Cinder Beetle Mandible
1x Cinder Beetle Gland
3x Cinder Beetle Blood
1x Giant Cinder Beetle Eye
3x Cinder Beetle Serrated Mandible
2x Charcoal
1x Copper Dagger
1x Crude Fish Oil
1x Twilight Bay Rum
2x Resin

sections.title: Cinder Beetle Shield
sections.text:
Knowing Hult Beetlewrangler is a master craftsman of fine beetle parts, you inquire about crafting armor from cinder beetle shells you've encountered during your travels.

You say, "Hail, Hult Beetlewrangler"

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Woah, ho there, adventurer. Ya looking for work or wares? No matter, ol' Hul's got somethin for ya either way."

You say, "Can you make anything with cinder beetle parts?"

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Cinder beetles, boss? Ol' Hult's never had the opportunity to try his handiwork with one of them beetle shells."

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Tell ya what, hand me one of 'em cinder beetle shells and a cinder beetle leg and we'll see what ol' Hult can do with 'em."

Give Hult Beetlewrangler 1x Cinder Beetle Carapace and 1x Cinder Beetle Legs

Hult Beetlewrangler takes the shell and legs and begins to work on them.

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Well, this is gonna... oh no."

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "No wait, I can make this work. Hold yer camels. Just need ya to be a little more patient."

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "There we go. All done."

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "I'm afraid this is the limit of my beetle craftin' skills. If ya got more cinder parts to spare, ya might want to try the master blacksmith in the Night Market."

Hult Beetlewrangler gives you a Cinder Beetle Shield and recommends you speak to a master blacksmith.

sections.title: Cinder Beetle Boots
sections.text:
The master blacksmith only works at night (spawns at 6 PM in-game time). He is located in front of the Blacksmithing building in the Night Market.

You say, "Hult mentioned you could craft armor with cinder beetle parts?"

a master blacksmith says, "Cinder beetles? You must've been talking to ol' Hult."

a master blacksmith says, "There was a time when Hult and I used to make a few armor pieces from whatever was on hand, back when the iron supply was low. Cinder beetle armor was one of those."

a master blacksmith says, "If you bring me a cinder beetle shell and two beetle legs, I might be able to put together a nice pair of boots for you. No promises though."

Give a master blacksmith 1x Cinder Beetle Carapace and 2x Cinder Beetle Legs

a master blacksmith says, "Well I did say I'd give it a go, didn't I?"

a master blacksmith breaks the shell in half and rounds it out, his skilled hands shaping it masterfully.

a master blacksmith says, "Seems I've still got it. Here you go. These boots should keep you warm on cold nights in the desert."

a master blacksmith says, "If you're ever interested in more cinder armor pieces, let me know. Smiths from all over Night Harbor come by all the time. They might share recipes they've picked up out in the wilds."

You gain experience!!

You receive a pair of Cinder Beetle Boots from a master blacksmith. You can inquire if any recipes have been shared with him recently to continue the quest.

You say, "Have any other Smiths shared their recipes with you?"

a master blacksmith says, "Since you're so eager, you should go see Sielah Zefir in the Black Feather Bazaar."

a master blacksmith says, "A while back, he mentioned that he tried to make a helm once."

a master blacksmith says, "...He didn't say if he was successful or not, though."

sections.title: Cinder Beetle Helm
sections.text:
Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir is located in the Black Feather Bazaar. He tells you that he can make you a helm for 2 cinder battle shells, 2 cinder battle legs, 1 charcoal, 1 copper dagger and 1 mandible.

You say, "A master blacksmith mentioned you tried to make a cinder beetle helm?"

Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir says, "Interested in cinder beetle armor, eh?"

Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir says, "Yes, I once had a helm that I fashioned from cinder beetle pieces."

Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir says, "I sold it some time ago to one of the watchmen. I could make you one if you have the pieces I need."

You say, "What pieces do you need?"

Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir says, "If my memory serves me right, I'll need two cinder beetle carapaces, two cinder beetle legs, and a cinder beetle mandible."

Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir says, "Be careful handling the mandibles. The serrated sort are especially nasty... I prefer not to use those."

Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir says, "On top of the beetle parts, I'll need two extra pieces of charcoal for the helm. Cinder shells are fire-resistant and hard to work with, so my forge will need to be blazing hot for this to work."

Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir says, "Those are just the materials for construction... now, let's talk payment."

Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir says, "How about you throw in a copper dagger to make it worth my trouble, Deal?"

The Cinder Beetle Mandible is a rare drop off a cinder drone in Sungreet Strand

Hand Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir 2x Cinder Beetle Carapace, 2x Cinder Beetle Legs, 2x Charcoal, 1x Copper Dagger, 1x Cinder Beetle Mandible.

You gain experience!!

You receive Cinder Beetle Helm and 10x Black Feather Arrow that may be used in another quest. ((more information required))

Sielah Zefir mentions he does not like working with serrated mandibles. He recommends you visit Shipwright Benlink for the greaves. ((more information required))

sections.title: Cinder Beetle Greaves
sections.text:
Shipwright Benlink is located behind some crates on the docks in Southwest Night Harbor (located near "a first mate" and "a sailor").

You say, "Do you know anything about cinder beetles?"

Shipwright Benlink says, "Cinder beetles from out in the quarry? I've actually happened upon a method to fashion some formidable greaves from their tough hides."

Shipwright Benlink says, "Their shells even block Eth's rays when you can't escape her, like out on the high seas."

You say, "Would you fashion a pair of greaves for me?"

Shipwright Benlink says, "I suppose I could spare a moment to craft you some, so long as you're able to get me the parts required."

Shipwright Benlink says, "I'll need three cinder beetle carapaces, two cinder beetle legs, and a mandible... a serrated one. I'll also require a special tanning agent."

You say, "Can you tell me about the special tanning agent?"

Shipwright Benlink says, "Despite looking like metal, I've always found that cinder shells mold better if they're treated like hardened leather."

Shipwright Benlink says, "Dilshad Abolfazl at the tannery could mix up a tanning agent for you if you bring him a cinder beetle gland and some cinder blood."

Visit Dilshad Abolfazl, who is located at the Tannery in Night Harbor near the West Gate Bank. Hand him 1x Cinder Beetle Gland and 1x Cinder Beetle Blood.

Dilshad Abolfazl says "What's this? Heh, the last time Benlink had me make some of this was when I owed him from my gambling debts... though if you're bringing the parts, I suppose there's no harm. One moment."

Dilshad Abolfazl mixes the glad and blood with a fine powder, producing an oily liquid with a bright orange hue.

Dilshad Abolfazl says, "Here you are. Let Benlink know that fortune's going to smile upon me during our next game!"

You receive 1x Cinder Tanning Agent from Dilshad Abolfazl.

Give Shipwright Benlink 3x Cinder Beetle Carapace, 2x Cinder Beetle Legs, 1x Cinder Beetle Serrated Mandible, 1x Cinder Tanning Agent

Shipwright Benlink takes the parts and wastes no time getting to work.

Shipwright Benlink heats the resistant carapaces and forms them into plates, stretching the mandible to create a waistline of sorts. He weaves the legs between each plate to hold them together, then coats them in a tanning agent, which draws out their color and gives them a fine sheen.

Shipwright Benlink says, "There you are, one pair of cinder beetle greaves! I always enjoy working with this stuff, though, not as much as Huda. They say he could make an entire ship out of beetle shells!"

You receive Cinder Beetle Greaves from Shipwright Benlink.

sections.title: Cinder Beetle Breastplate
sections.text:
Seek out Master Shipwright Huda in the Night Harbor docks. He is located just south of the Teleporter to Sageside standing next to the hull of a ship, near the Carpentry Trainer.

You say, "Hail, Master Shipwright Huda."

Master Shipwright Huda says, "Fair winds to you, traveler. A great day for a sail at sea, don't you think?"

You say, "Do you know anything about cinder beetles?"

Master Shipwright Huda says, "Cinder beetles? Why, yes, of course! Ever since I was a young boy, I'd use beetle carapaces as makeshift toy boats and float them out on the harbor."

Master Shipwright Huda says, "I always dreamed of making a full-sized craft out of their shells... but I could never find one large enough. I did manage to make an impressive breastplate, at least."

You say, "Can you make me a breastplate?"

Master Shipwright Huda says, "Ah, that caught your attention, did it? Well, I suppose I could craft you one if you sought out all the proper pieces."

Master Shipwright Huda says, "For the breastplate, I'd need four cinder beetle carapaces, two of their serrated mandibles, a giant cinder beetle eye, as well as a special varnish."

You say, "What is the special varnish?"

Master Shipwright Huda leans in close and whispers.

Master Shipwright Huda says, "Most people try to work the shells like steel, when really they're more like the wood of a ship!"

Master Shipwright Huda says, "For that reason, I use a varnish that's made up of two parts resin, two parts cinder blood, one part fish oil, and some Twilight Bay rum!"

Master Shipwright Huda says, "Old Hult at the Sojourner camp knows how to make the varnish. Just bring him the proper ingredients."

Make a trip to Hult Beetlewrangler and hand him 2x Resin, 2x Cinder Beetle Blood, 1x Crude Fish Oil, 1x Twilight Bay Rum

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "It's been an age since I made any o' this for Huda! He's the reason I made my first bowl, he is. Gonna make his own ship one day, and ol' Hult is gonna cross the sea on a beetle's back!"

Hult Beetlewrangler proceeds to mix the resin, oil, and cinder blood together to form a rich and dark varnish. He guzzles down the rum and lets out a loud belch.

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Oof, that hits the spot! Thanks for the rum, boss. You tell Huda that his brother's makin' a big name for himself out here wit' the locals!"

You receive 1x Cinder Varnish from Hult Beetlewrangler.

Hand Master Shipwright Huda 4x Cinder Beetle Carapace, 2x Cinder Beetle Serrated Mandible, 1x Giant Cinder Beetle Eye, 1x Special Varnish

Master Shipwright Huda says, "You've gone and done it... wonderful! I'll get right to work."

Master Shipwright Huda says, "This shouldn't take long. In fact, I've been looking forward to your return!"

Master Shipwright Huda handles the carapaces masterfully, shaping them into protective plates and adorning the eye at the center of the chest. He coats the breastplate with varnish, and the color immediately pops, shining brighter than before.

Master Shipwright Huda says, "Here you are, friend. A fine piece, if I do say so myself. Thank you for allowing me to hone my skills. It's been far too long since I last dreamt of beetles."

You receive Cinder Beetle Breastplate from Master Shipwright Huda.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience

Dalinder's Tunic
Penitent Knight's Tunic

sections.title: Part 1
sections.text:
Read Formal Note you start with as a new Cleric Character:

To whom it may concern,

The Wayfarers Hospice is in need of charitable souls who are gifted with a healing touch.

Please bring this note and your interest to Thibald
Burlond at the Hospice, located in the Travelers
Ward to the north of the city's Western Gate.

Should you find yourself lost, ask one of the guards.
They have likely received our treatment before.

May your journey be blessed.

-The Penitent Knights of the Hospice

Hand Formal Note to Thibald Burlond in the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the West Gate

You gain experience!!

Thibald Burlond reads the note, then gives you a welcoming nod.
Thibald Burlond suddenly stands upright, puffing his chest slightly.
Thibald Burlond says, "Welcome to the Wayfarers Hospice. I am Grand Master Thibald Burlond of the Penitent Knights of the Hospice."
Thibald Burlond says, "We accept the assistance of all who aid the less fortunate and suffering, regardless of tehir background or beliefs."
Thibald Burlond pauses for a moment, meeting your eyes with his.
Thibald Burlond says, "We have an impeccable reputation within this city and with its leadership. All we ask is that you do not sully it."
Thibald Burlond says, "Now, take the note you've given me upstairs to Jiselle  Heyley. She will guide you from here."

You receive Formal Note from Thibald Burlond.

Hand Formal Note to Jiselle Heyley upstairs.

You gain experience!!

Jiselle Heyley takes the note and carelessly discards it.
Jiselle Heyley says, "I heard the Grand Master from here, no need for this!"
Jiselle Heyley reaches into a pouch on her belt and retrieves a coin, then hands it to you.
Jiselle Heyley says, "As Thibald said, welcome to the Hospice. It's a kindness you pay us in being here. Thank you."
Jiselle Heyley makes a sweeping gesture with an open hand.
Jiselle Heyley says, "As you look around, you'll find that we spend most of our time comforting those at their journey's end, particularly those without better means, families, or friends."
Jiselle Heyley says, "Clerics can  alleviate most ailments, but there's no cure for age... at least, none that my conscience will allow me  to pursue, lest we find ourselves consorting with the likes of necromancers!"
Jiselle Heyley says, "Well... let's focus on what we can do. Take this and show it to Dalinder. He's in his laboratory."

You receive Penitent Knight's Coin from Jiselle Heyley.

Hand Penitent Knight's Coin to Dalinder Grammanoot downstairs.

Dalinder Grammanoot briefly inspects the coin before leaning forward and sniffing you.
Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Just getting into town? We do have bathhouses here, you know. Use them if you're going to be coming  in here regularly."
Dalinder Grammanoot grabs a bag from a neatly organized pile.
Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Let's get started. Take this bag. Take your coin. Do not put the coin in the bag. Put the coin in your pocket. Fasten the bag firmly. Do not lose it."
Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Jiselle is a wonderful human, but they call her gentle for a reason. She has a soft heart... especially for critters. Unfortunately, the work that Milli and I do can occasionally call for hearts, glands, bile ducts, venom sacs, and the like. So, spare her the details, eh?"
Dalinder Grammanoot says, "For now I'm running low on snake venom sacs... but not the fully developed ones, just the immature kind. Fill the bag for me, and I'll go see if Millicent needs anything."
Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Be careful out there. I hope to see you again soon."

You receive Penitent Knight's Coin from Dalinder Grammanoot.

You receive Dalinder's Bag from Dalinder Grammanoot.

Head to the West Gate Noob Yard and kill a snakes until you receive 6 Immature Snake Venom Sacs. Alternatively you can buy them.

Combine the 6 Immature Snake Venom Sacs in Dalinder's Bag to receive a Bag of Venom Sacs

Return to Dalinder Grammanoot and hand in your Bag of Venom Sacs

You gain experience!!

Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Splendid, thank you!"
Dalinder Grammanoot sniffs the air.
Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Hmm... clearly that was hard work, given the heat and all."
Dalinder Grammanoot sizes you up, then pulls a finely folded tunic off one of the stacks.
Dalinder Grammanoot says, "You can change into this, though maybe wait until after you've bathed."
Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Millicent said she needs a few items as well. Here's her list."
Dalinder Grammanoot returns to his work.

You receive Dalinder's Tunic from Dalinder Grammanoot.

You receive Millicent's List from Dalinder Grammanoot.

sections.title: Part 2 Millicent's List
sections.text:
Read Millicent's List

Items Needed

- Moondew Moss (Often grows in or around wells and is visible at night)

Hint: Investigate the Well outside of the West gate, use the "/inspect well" command,then "/take moss" command which allows you to acquire the moss.

- Cantharadin (Just bring me 2 Blister Beetle Gland and I'll process them)

Hint: Blister Beetles only spawn during the day time hours.

- Bat Bile from a diseased bat ( Intact Diseased Bat Bile Duct )

Hint: Investigate the area behind the gate through the Red Mantle Keep.  Also may be found in the ruins outside of the West Gate, before the entrance to the Tomb of the Last Wyurmsbane.

Once all items have been gathered, return to Millicent Domaire in the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the West Gate.

Hand Millicent's List, Dalinder's Tunic, 2 Blister Beetle Gland, the Intact Diseased Bat Bile Duct, and the Moondew Moss to Millicent Domaire 

You gain experience!!

Millicent Domaire gathers everything and hands you a fresh tunic.
Millicent Domaire says, "There we go. I appreciate the assistance." 

Millicent Domaire appears distracted for a moment, her eyes fixated on empty space.
Millicent Domaire says, "I'm... I'm sorry, where are we? Ah, yes... the tunic. Don it, and keep the coin Jiselle gave you on your person. We have a lot of new people arriving these days, so you can  use it to indicate your association with the Hospice." 

Millicent Domaire says, "I'm sure I'll need your assistance again soon. In the meantime, please take the opportunity to get to know everyone here."

Millicent Domaire smiles at you and returns her work, though seemingly distracted..

You receive Penitent Knight's Tunic from Millicent Domaire.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Tattered Ephod
Splintered Servant's Buckler
Worn Servant Buckler

sections.title: Part 1 - The Offering
sections.text:
This part is the same for Cleric, Necromancer, and Shadow Knight.

Starting note in inventory:

Wake, dreamer. The Master has called you into his service. Salvage your meager ambitions and seek the Temple of Ygorath. Deliver this note to Soren Akedd and make the offering.

Hand in the note to Soren Akedd.

Soren Akedd says, "You have done well to come when called NAME. This is the House of Ygorath, which you may call home, if you are deemed worthy to carry out his work."

You gain experience!!
Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.

If you didn't hand him the note, you can still start this quest as so:

You say, "Hail, Soren Akedd."
Soren Akedd says, "You appear before me as you were in my nightmare, NAME."
You say, "Nightmare?"
Soren Akedd says, "Nightmares are visits from Ygorath, gifted upon all the fearful of this land. It was my nightmare that called you here to begin his work."

Either way, you can ask about the work.

You say, "What work?"
Soren Akedd says, "It is the work of trembling hands to raise both the living and the dead upon his altar. It is for their salvation as much as our own."
Soren Akedd says, "Many souls walk Eth-up practicing feints of valor, but Ygorath's wisdom knows bravery to be a thin sheen upon a bottomless terror. We must usher them into his kingdom with right fear in their hearts."
Soren Akedd says, "This you must do, Cleric, whether by sign or by sword. If you pass the test."
You say, "What is the test?"
Soren Akedd says, "The rabble carry fear in their blood and their bones. Ours are bourne by Ygorath. This is your test: take this effigy to the chapel and make of it an offering. Place your effigy upon the altar and receive Ygorath's blessing. Return with what remains.
You receive Strange Effigy from Soren Akedd.
Soren Akedd says, "But I must warn you... cast your gaze downward and look not upon the visage of Ygorath."

Go out the front of the building and take a left. The chapel is very close and has a red glow inside. Go inside, walk all the way up to the altar in front of the statue and /look.

A simple clay bowl rests upon the altar. You dare not raise your gaze any higher, lest you behold the statue looking over the chapel.

Pick up the Strange Effigy in your inventory so that it's on your cursor, then /place effigy.

As the effigy leaves your fingers, it turns to ash without flame.
You receive Offering Bowl.

Take the Offering Bowl back to Soren and hand it in to him.

Soren Akedd says, "Your eyes are open. Take this drape and rise a new servant of Ygorath."
You gain experience!!
Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.
Your faction standing with The Dreaming Dawn got worse.
You receive Tattered Ephod from Soren Akedd.
Soren Akedd says, "Now go, and do his work. Should you need guidance look for Sister Marwen attending her duties at the chapel.

sections.title: Part 2 - The Unworthy
sections.text:
Sister Marwen is on the porch of the chapel. She is a cleric trainer.

You say, "Hail, Sister Marwen."
Sister Marwen says, "Well met. Spreading the word of Ygorath is not for the faint of heart. Will you accept the duties required of you?"
You say, "I accept."
Sister Marwen says, "We shall see. There are those who shirk their duties."
Sister Marwen stares at you with wide, unblinking eyes.
Sister Marwen says, "Sometimes the unworthy linger, hoping to regain entry to the temple. Go to the mortuary that overlooks the water and look for those who have abandoned their calling. many still wear the drape of the temple. Reclaim no fewer than four robes and return them to me in this box."
You receive Robe Box from Sister Marwen.

If you head out the tunnel that leads to the city, the unworthy you are looking for are both high and low on the waterfront where the tunnels come out: a craven neophyte, a failed knight, an unworthy aspirant.
Kill them until you get Stained Servant's Robe x4.
Combine them in the Robe Box to get the Full Robe Box.
Hand the Full Robe Box in to Sister Marwen.

You gain experience!!
Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.
Sister Marwen says, "Our duty is to give and to take as Ygorath commands. Take this shield and bear it proudly, no matter what you are called upon to do."
You receive Splintered Servant's Buckler from Sister Marwen.

If you hail her again she says to come back later.

You say, "Hail, Sister Marwen."
Sister Marwen says, "Attend to your duties, young one. Return when you are stronger."

sections.title: Part 3
sections.text:
At level 8 Sister Marwen has the next step for you.

You say, "Hail, Sister Marwen."
Sister Marwen says, "Your faith in Ygorath strengthens your resolve, Cleric. Look for Lady Tabitha in the temple and offer her your services. She is an alchemist of some repute."

Lady Tabitha is in the morgue (same building as Soren).

You say, "Hail, Lady Tabitha."
Lady Tabitha hums to herself.
Lady Tabitha says, "Oh, here's a new on. Who sent you to me? Or have you become a nuisance of your own volition?"
You say, "Sister Marwen sent me."
Lady Tabitha says, "Indeed! Each somehow less promising than the last, it seems. No matter. If you can furnish the ingredients I require, I will endorse your aspiration.
You say, "What ingredients?"
Lady Tabitha says, "Poison and antidote are cut from the same cloth, Cleric. Go and collect as many snake venom glands as this will carry."
You receive Snake Gland Pouch from Lady Tabitha.
Lady Tabitha says, "Undamaged, if you please."

Need to fufill the Snake Gland Pouch with 8 Deepscale Venom Gland drop from Deepscale Slitherer
Hand Full Snake Gland Pouch you get after the combine

You gain experience!!
Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.

Lady Tabitha says I thank you, Cleric. The work continues. Give this letter to Sister Marwen as a sign of your progress.
You receive Alchemist's Reference Letter from Lady Tabitha.

Hand Alchemist's Reference Letter to Sister Marwen

You gain experience!!
Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.
You receive Alchemist's Reference Letter from Sister Marwen
Sister Marwen says Splendidly done. Give me the alchemist's letter along with the shield of our order to receive a blessing.

Give both : Alchemist's Reference Letter and your Splintered Servant's Buckler

You gain experience!!
Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.
Sister Marwen says Walk in fear, Cleric.
You receive Worn Servant Buckler from Sister Morwen

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Tattered Cloth
Pouch

You must put one scrap in each slot to combine!

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, a shifty gnome".

a shifty gnome says, "What can we do for each other, friend?"

You say, "What work?"

a shifty gnome says, "So... you're looking to help a gnome with something?"

a shifty gnome says, "Hmm... You know... I might have some work for you."

a shifty gnome says, "How about this... I'll give you this pack and you fill it with cloth scraps."

a shifty gnome says, "Are you interested?"

You say, "I am interested"

a shifty gnome says, "Wonderful! Bundle it up once it's full, so you don't lose any scraps."

You receive Shifty's Scrap Pack from a shifty gnome.

Put 6 Cloth Scraps within the container and combine into Bundled Scraps.

Give container of Bundled Scraps to a shifty gnome

a shifty gnome says, "Splendid! Thank you for the bundle. Here take this as a gesture of my appreciation."

You receive a random piece of Tattered Cloth or a Pouch from a shifty gnome.

You gain experience!!

This quest is repeatable.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text: Experience

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Maude is located in East Dock, at the top of the stairs opposite the raft, turn left into the casters area
You say, "Hail, Maude."

Maude Astarace says "What is it?"
Maude Astarace says "The Delvestone and Deepcut quarrel over rocks, and I wish to know why. Their petty conflict is our good fortune, since the mining company will pay us to reclaim their crystals."
Maude Astarace says "Venture into the Darrowdwell mine above the citadel and fill this box with crystals from the Deepcut miners."

"In truth, I care not how you acquire these crystals."
cackles gleefully.
this can be skipped by saying: "research next to her"
Maude will then give you a 8 slot bag
the crystals can be obtained from Darrowdwell mine up in the rafters it is a group area levels 3-5
on obtaining all 8 dull crystals, combining, and returning to Maude:

Maude Astarace opens the box and rummages through it.

Maude Astarace says "What is this?"

Maude Astarace says "These are not diamonds, nor sapphires, nor even jaspers. Lusterless rocks, all!"

Maude Astarace says "I suppose you have earned some coin for your part. The miners can have their rocks, but something is amiss. Take this to the paymaster along with your guild signet."

Maude Astarace says "I do not believe for a moment that the Delvestone would spill their blood or their coin for those worthless rocks. I require your assistance once more, <character name>."

Maude Astarace says "I must have a sample of whatever mineral lies at the heart of this territorial squabble. Deepcut, Delvestone, Darrowdwell. These are insignificant. Find the thing they fight and die for."

Maude Astarace says "Do this, and I will reward you personally."

sections.title: pt 2 - Find the thing they fight and die for
sections.text:
Handing in Faintly Glowing Crystal obtained from the Deepcut Miners to Maude Astarace she gives you a walking Stick, maybe something to do with ELE/ENC starter quest?

Maude Astarace cackles gleefully.
Maude Astarace says "Oh, yes. Something lingers within this crystal... but what? I shall find out. I thank you, <character name>. You are most useful. Run along now, for I have much work to do."

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text: You can find Fellstone orcs all over Evershade Weald.

sections.title: Quest Information
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, Wyrdguard Oakenpine"

Wyrdguard Oakenpine offers a firm nod as he greets you.

Wyrdguard Oakenpine says, "Well met, Class. Be cautious should you choose to venture into the southeastern cliffs of the Weald. There have been more and more reports of orc sightings as of late."

You say, "orcs?"

Wyrdguard Oakenpine says, "Their entry into the Weald remains a mystery, as both the Wyrdguard and Keepers work to combat the incursion."
Wyrdguard Oakenpine says, "I am prepared to offer a bounty to any who would aid in the culling of the Fellstone ranks. I will provide some spare gear from the garrison in exchange for any orcish left ear that is brought to me."

Turn in 1 Left Orc Ear!

Wyrdguard Oakenpine accepts the grisly token with a smug smile and a nod of satisfaction.

Wyrdguard Oakenpine says, "Another bounty claimed, well done. Would that I could see their entire blighted presence purged from the beauty of Evershade. Here is your reward."

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

You receive a random piece of Tattered Rawhide from Wyrdguard Oakenpine.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Experience

Njau Hansou says, "This is not all, however. Are you prepared to receive your other tasks?"

You say, "What other tasks?"

Njau Hansou says, "Wonderful."

Njau Hansou says, "I also need you to investigate an ashira camp on the way to the smugglers. I have heard reports that they are attempting to raid the smugglers' camp...  I am interested in their intentions.  Please bring me any evidence you find."

Njau Hansou glances around before continuing.

Njau Hansou says, "Again, if you see any inquisitors engaging in suspicious activities, please make note of it. I know it is unlikely, but..."

Njau Hansou says, "...Do not misunderstand, the inquisitors are our allies. We have received reports that cultists ambushed several of Petra's recruits in the city, which has caused such suspicion."

Njau Hansou says, "When you are walking about, keep an eye out for movement in the shadows. Should you discover any of these cultists, engage them immediately.  It would be of great interest if you could recover anything that might hint at their origins."

Njau Hansou says, "Keep in mind, this task is separate from your work at the camps."

Kill a cultist in the basement of The Shaded Bloom Inn and loot a Cultist's Insignia Ring

Give Cultist's Insignia Ring to Njau Hansou

You gain experience!!

Njau Hansou examines the ring, then places it in his belt pouch.

Njau Hansou says, "Excellent work. I thank you for bringing this to me. With some thorough investigation, we shall soon know of the cultists' origins."

Njau Hansou says, "The Spire thanks you."

Vial of Snaring Poison
5 Silver

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Give 2 Blacktide Orc Earings to Captain Harkan Saafir or his placeholder a landing lieutenant.

You will receive Vial of Snaring Poison and 5 silver as your reward.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Partially Translated Report
You gain experience!!
25 Copper

This quest is repeatable.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Researcher Fairgrove is located slightly above the bank (just a few meters) in the Heartwood Archives. Take the ramp just outside of the bank and use the platform that wraps around the other side of the tree.

You say, "Hail, Researcher Fairgrove."

Researcher Fairgrove seems to be heavily engrossed with a thick tome of ancient leafpress. She acknowledges you with a nervous stutter.

Researcher Fairgrove says, "Ah, h-hello, yes. You'll have to e-excuse me, I'm terribly busy with all these... w-writings!"

You say, "What writings?"

Researcher Fairgrove says, "O-oh yes, have you not heard? Fellstone scouts have been spotted roaming the Weald and... and w-writing things!"

Researcher Fairgrove says, "T-terrible things, no doubt. I'm doing what I can to a-aid the Wyrdguard by attempting to d-decipher their script, but it's so... s-so very alien."

Researcher Fairgrove says, "B-be that as it may, I w-would... still greatly appreciate any additional writings of theirs to study, should you happen to come a-across them in your journeys."

Collect Unintelligible Writings from a Fellstone scout in Evershade Weald, then hand them in one at a time to Researcher Fairgrove.

Researcher Fairgrove says, "T-thank you very much for your assistance! The m-more of these writings I can study, the... the closer I believe I am to uncovering their meanings."

Researcher Fairgrove says, "It i-isn't much, but here is a little something for going o-out of your way for me."

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Defenders of Faelindral got better.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Faelindral got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

You receive 25 copper from Researcher Fairgrove.

You receive Partially Translated Report.

The Partially Translated Report is used in Ranger Starter Quest (Faelindral).
