You gain experience!!
8 Silver

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest begins in the Underdocks eastern district inside the build directly across from the landing raft by speaking with Traven Keldress.

You say, "Hail, Traven Keldress."

Traven Keldress says, "Hello there! You look like you're capable of assisting us with some of the bounties we've posted, but choose wisely. We don't want anyone underprepared."

You say, "What bounties?"

Traven Keldress says, "There is a standing bounty for the hands of Deepcut bandits, if you are brave enough to face them. Or stupid enough to try. All are welcome!"

Traven Keldress says, "Bring me six Deepcut bandit hands to collect the bounty from our paymaster, Elara."

Turn in six Deepcut Bandit's Hand to Traven Keldress

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Underdocks got better.

Traven Keldress says, "Bravo, <<CLASS>>! Give this receipt to Elara to collect your reward."

You receive Deepcut Hand Bounty from Traven Keldress.

Turn in the Deepcut Hand Bounty to Elara Venn, located next to Traven Keldress.

Elara Venn says, "Here is your reward, <<CLASS>>. There are shops across the water if you'd like to spend it!"

You gain experience!!

You receive 8 silver from Elara Venn.

quests.title: Diseased Wolf Pelts for Baewyn Mossfang

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
You gain experience!!
75 Copper

Faction with Ardent Keepers

This quest is repeatable.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Seek out Baewyn Mossfang, located in the Beastmaster's guild in Faelindral.

You say, "Hail, Baewyn Mossfang."

Baewyn Mossfang says, "Hello, friend. Do not let the fierceness of my sister discourage you from visiting the Den. She is right to be upset as she is."

You say, "Why is she upset?"

Baewyn Mossfang says, "Many of the Weald's great wolves have fallen prey to a terrible malady, beset upon them by foul magic."

Baewyn Mossfang says, "There are many that we cannot cure in time before they throw themselves at travelers or guards."

Baewyn Mossfang says, "Their hides then rot and decay, spreading the sickness further. Would that I could descend to the forest floor myself, but my duties keep me here and there is no one to go on my behalf."

You say, "I could go on your behalf."

Baewyn Mossfang says, "Would you be willing to go? I would be indebted to you, <class>."

Baewyn Mossfang says, "If you are forced to put down any of the mad wolves, bring their infected hides to me for purification. They will be of no use to you for craft or sale otherwise."

Locate and kill a rabid wolf in Evershade Weald to obtain Diseased Wolf Pelt.

Give 1 x Diseased Wolf Pelt to Baewyn Mossfang.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Baewyn Mossfang mutters a solemn prayer to the spirits of the wild, running his palm across the disease-riddled pelt and cleansing it of its sickness.

Baewyn Mossfang says, "You have my appreciation for this, <class>. My sister is on the hunt for the source, but we must always do what we can to prevent the spread of illness."

Baewyn Mossfang says, "Please, accept this as a small measure of my gratitude. I am also able to provide cleansing to you if the illness has taken hold."

You receive 75 copper from Baewyn Mossfang.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Scroll Minor Frostbite
Fire Beetle Eye
Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper
Icon of the Gatekeeper

Experience

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read Rolled Leafscroll

CynderR,
We have sensed the draw of the Wyrdgates within your gaze, young one.
We would welcome you to join the ranks of the Wyrdguard in our mission to protect our kin from unseen threats and see them safely across the whole of Aêthoril.
Seek out High Gatekeeper Sylvarya Starviel within the Sentinel's Gaze; our garrison upon Sentinel's Terrace. You'll find it one platform over from the Fae Lift, or across from the Trader's Terrace.
Present to her this letter, and she shall begin your guidance and help you take your first steps towards navigating the penumbral paths.
Fair shades to you,
Commander Elydris Stormbough

1. Ring the bell and take the lift up and make your way to the 'Upper Tier'.

You can find Sylvarya Starveil in the un-named half house on the 'Upper Tier'

Hand Rolled Leafscroll to Sylvarya Starveil.

Sylvarya Starveil accepts the offered letter with a knowing smile and a gentle bow. Her wizened gaze does not settle on yours but instead drifts past your shoulder, as though addressing someone behind you. : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I greet you, whispered one, I am Sylvarya Starveil, the High Gatekeeper of the Wyrdguard,"
Sylvarya Starveil says, "I am delighted to be the first to welcome you into the Sentinel's Gaze."
Sylvarya Starveil takes your hand in hers and gently places a simple phial into your open palm, her fingers closing around both your hand and the phial.
Sylvarya Starveil says, "You have been summoned here by our leader, Elydris, because of your promising connection with the spirits of nature. Are you prepared to take the first steps toward becoming a gatekeeper?"

You say, "im prepared to take the first steps"

Sylvarya Starveil says, "As a gatekeeper of the Wyrdguard, your role will be to both support and transport your allies through the Wyrdgates."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "You will find one such gateway here in Evershade Weald, at the base of the northernmost lift that leads toward the caverns inhabited by fae."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Your first task will be to help nourish and maintain this gateway. Pour the contents of the phial I gave you into the very center of the circular formation of toadstools that you find there."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Once you have poured an offering from the phial, you must then exhibit a moment of patience as you await... a response."

You receive Simple Phial from Sylvarya Starveil.

2. take the lift down at the neighboring platform from where you speak to Sylvarya (Note: guard Galen is standing by the lift; this is not the newbie lift you start at. It is marked as the Pixie Lift on the Faelindral map), and stand in the center of the circle of toadstools

Note: you can see the ring of mushrooms from the platform Sylvarya Starveil is on if you run around it and look at the ground down below if you have trouble finding it

/pour toadstools (while holding the Simple Phial from Sylvarya) Note: you need to be right in the center, turn in circles and move to the center and keep trying

You receive Empty Phial.

You pull the stopper and pour out the contents of the phial. Liquid which appears to be simple spring water is swallowed up greedily by the surrounding toadstools, soil and fallen needles. Now all that remains is to await any sort of response... Nothing appears to change so far aside from the odd sensation of being tugged towards the center of this ring of toadstools. You continue to wait patiently...
Your patience is at last rewarded as the pull you feel towards the center of the Wyrdgate grows stronger. A point of light forms at the center of the Wyrdgate; what appears to be the very beginnings of a portal!
The point of light grows no larger than a coin, out of which begins to pour a slow deluge of murky water. This strange fountain must be the reaction that Sylvarya mentioned that you need to take a sample of and return to her.

3. /take water (while holding the Empty Phial)
You receive Strange Reaction Phial.

You use your now-empty phial to collect a sample of the eerie reaction and press the stopper back into the neck of the bottle.
As soon as you've collected what you need, the small portal from which the water had cascaded closes and stems the flow. The remains of the fountain seep into the forest floor, leaving the Wyrdgate in it's natural, serene state,

4. take the lift back up and return to Sylvarya Starveil. 

give the Strange Reaction Phial to Sylvarya Starveil.
You receive Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper.

Sylvarya Starveil holds the phial up to the light and swirls its murky contents. You perceive the faintest furrow of her brow before she returns her attention to something just over your shoulder,
Sylvarya Starveil says, "I thank you for this, CynderR. We must always be vigilant in our efforts regarding the Wyrdgates, for though they are undoubtedly a great asset to our people, they could also prove to be a great vulnerability if left unchecked."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "I cannot yet explain the results of your efforts to you, but you have at least taken the first step toward becoming a gatekeeper."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Only one who is capable of viewing the Wyrding could have seen this reaction take place, and thus I present to you this icon to symbolize your rank as a novice."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "I would also have you sent on another task, should you choose to accept it."

Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper

sections.title: Part 2 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
UPDATE!! Sylwine Brightspirit is not in the Inn. She is in the Well of Order. As the quests states.

You say, "what task"
You receive Strange Reaction Phial from Sylvarya Starveil.

Sylvarya Starveil says, "Maintaining the Wyrdgates is our primary responsibility, but it is also our duty to protect our fellow Wyrdguard from any who would see them harm."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "As gatekeepers, we are the ones who bring them into the fray, embolden them through our magics, mend their wounds, and call upon nature's own wrath to lash out against those who oppose us."
Sylvarya Starveil closes her fist, which briefly alights with a brilliant flame that seems to swirl with majestic faerie hues of red, blue, and violet. She snuffs out the demonstration shortly afterward.
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Take the phial that you filled earlier to an ally of ours in the Preservers, Sylwine Brightspirit is a brilliant alchemist who currently heads the Well of Order, and she may have some insight as to what it now contains,"

Head to the Well of Order, Sylwine Brightspirit is in the front room on the way to the 'Lower Tier'.

Hand Strange Reaction Phial to Sylwine Brightspirit.

You receive Reagent Bag from Sylwine Brightspirit.

Sylwine Brightspirit blinks in surprise as you hand her the strange phial,
Sylwine Brightspirit says, "From the High Gatekeeper herself? Well, I'd best take a look right away!"
Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Ah, from the looks of that symbol, you're a novice among the gatekeepers. Would you be willing to do me a small favor while I look over the phial?"
Sylwine Brightspirit hands you a small bag with various separated pockets, each for carrying different reagents.

You say, "what favor"

Sylwine Brightspirit says, "The shop is running a little low on some of the more popular reagents. Normally, I have Preservers running around doing this for me, but you have some free time, right?"
Sylwine Brightspirit says, "I need you to find me two royal jellies, two bat wings, and... maybe a couple of bone chips, just in case."
Sylwine Brightspirit says, "You can put them all in that reagent bag and secure it once you're done. I should have this phial sorted out by the time you return. Thanks in advance!"
Sylwine Brightspirit immediately turns her attention to the phial,

Kill a black bat for Bat Wing, a wasp drone for Royal Jelly and a rotting skeleton for Bone Chips.

Combine two Royal Jelly, two Bat Wing, and two Bone Chips in the Reagent Bag.

You receive Full Reagent Bag.

Hand Full Reagent Bag to Sylwine Brightspirit.

You receive Note of Results.

Sylwine Brightspirit looks to be in a dour mood when you arrive, but the sight of your full reagent bag brightens her spirits.
Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Oh, great, you're back! I thought you might have been that awful rogue who just dropped off a horrible-smelling concoction for me to sort through."
Sylwine Brightspirit says, "These are fine specimens... and all neatly organized as well! You have my thanks, and, I hope, some answers for your High Gatekeeper."
Sylwine Brightspirit offers you a rolled leafnote.
Sylwine Brightspirit says, "I put all my findings into that note, but I had to use most of the substance to get any clear results. Where did you say you found that stuff, anyway?"
Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Oh never mind, it's not important. I also included a very important reagent as a measure of thanks for your assistance. I think Sylvarya will appreciate it."
Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Stop by again if you ever need some potions"

the note reads:

High Gatekeeper,
The sample size delivered was quite small, but I was able to determine the source of thedisturbance.
Floral traces corroborate with similar samples that we've received from the Reekbog by our scouting parties. 
The magical nature is also similar to the corrupting presence of the Spiral. 
I hope that you haven't discovered this in the Weald? Please keep me advised.
Spirits preserve you.
-Sylwine

head back to Sylvarya Starveil and give her the Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper and the Note of Results.

You receive Scroll Minor Frostbite, Fire Beetle Eye and Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper.

Sylvarya Starveil says, "Another task well done. And here you thought they would not succeed."
Sylvarya Starveil gently chuckles to no one in particular. It is clear she was not addressing you with her comment.
Sylvarya Starveil says, "It appears that Sylwine thought quite highly of your assistance as well. This particular reagent is nigh impossible to find out here in the Weald."
Sylvarya Starveil opens the softly glowing pouch, retrieving what appears to be a preserved beetle eye that emits a glow akin to softly burning embers.
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Take this eye and scribe this scroll. You shall be able to call upon the embers that reside in the heart of all faeflies to both sear and hinder your foes."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "I have also taken the liberty of enhancing your icon, as you have proven to be quite resourceful. I believe that you will make a wonderful gatekeeper with the proper guidance."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "You are now free to explore the Weald for a time, but when you feel you are ready, you may present your icon to Commander Elydris Stormbough as a sign that you have gained my approval,"

Rewards:

Scroll Minor Frostbite
Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper

Experience

sections.title: Part 3 - Req. level 4+
sections.text:
Hand Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper to Commander Elydris Stormbough.

Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Sylvarya speaks highly of your potential, young Gatekeeper. I am glad to have the chance to meet and introduce myself."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "I am Elydris Stormbough, Commander of the Wyrdguard. I have the honor of being a Gatekeeper, much like yourself. Our ability to bring our allies to and from the fields of battle is an invaluable tactic."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "It is a tactic that we must ingrain into younger Gatekeepers as soon as possible. Do you believe that you are ready to learn our ways?"

You say, "I am ready."

Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Then I entrust the delivery of an important letter to you, aspirant. Return to Sylvarya and tell her that you are ready to see the paths."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "You will be guided through the Wyrding itself and witness firsthand what Gatekeepers are capable of."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Once through the paths, you shall deliver the letter to a human woman named Almina. She shall provide you the means of returning to the Weald."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Go now, aspirant, and may the shades of the Weald protect you."

She hands you Druidic Leafscroll

Say to Sylvarya Starveil "I am ready to see the paths"

You say, "I and ready to see the paths"
Sylvarya Starveil says, "The commander must have high hopes if she sent you to see the pathways so soon. So be it."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Allow me to tether your soul to this place, so that you may use it as an anchor point to return to the Weald."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "I shall then open a gateway through which you may enter the Wyrding for the first time."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Make sure that you have your letter with you. You are to return any response to me when you arrive back in the Sentinels Gaze."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Let me know when you are prepared."

Sylvarya will bind your soul.

You say, "I am prepared."

Sylvarya will teleport you to the Sungreet Strand Druid ring.

Hand the letter to Almina Weepingwind.

Almina Weepingwind says, "You're an aspirant of the Wyrdguard, yes? I'm Almina of the Circle of Scarce Rains. I welcome you to our grove here in Sungreet Strand."
Almina Weepingwind says, "Our two orders often exchange correspondence within these sacred places, as they are natural waypoints for those who traverse the penumbral paths. Was that your first time? You look a little queasy!"
Almina Weepingwind says, "You can bring this letter back to your High Gatekeeper, and that scroll should teach you how to return along the same pathways you used to get here."
Almina Weepingwind says, "Of course, you can always remain here or visit Night Harbor, though the path is quite dangerous being this close to Tel Ekir... so I'd not advise it unless you're confident."

Almina hands you a letter and the Scroll Gate.

Gate to Evershade Weald and hand the letter to Sylvarya.

Sylvarya Starveil says, "Welcome home, aspirant! Not many can navigate the paths so easily for their first time, though you seem to have had no such trouble."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "In time, you will learn to bring yourself and others through many such gateways. For now, you will only be able to use the ones that you designate for your own soul."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "I see you also made contact with the Circle of Scarce Rains. Their current leader was once a resident of Evershade Weald. She would have made a promising Gatekeeper."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "While our two groups are venturing very different paths, it always helps to have allies who share a love for the balance and the natural order."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Now then, the commander will be eager to hear of your return. Go to her and show this token as proof that I have received Almina's response."

Sylvarya hands you Druidic Token.

Hand the token to Commander Elydris Stormbough.

Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "How was your first foray through the paths, young one? It will not be long before you are able to carry entire scouting parties through the Wyrding."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "That is for a future day, however. For now, we have more pressing matters here at home that require your direct attention."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Our archers are currently out countering the orc spies, while our fighters fend off the warriors that descend from the cliffsides."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "It shall be your duty to assist our forces by countering the fell magics they utilize through shamanistic rituals."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Take this satchel and fill it with the broken idols of Fellstone shamans. They attempt to aid their forces from the back lines, but that is where our moonfire can still strike."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "I would advise you to seek out fellow Wyrdguard or other adventurers in your efforts. Return to me once you have sufficiently quelled the orcs' supporting ranks."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "And do not hesitate to utilize your newfound ability to traverse the Wyrding, should the need arise."

She hands you Vine-Strapped Satchel.

Kill a Fellstone shaman until you have x4 Broken Shaman Idol. Combine those in the satchel and receive Full Vine-Strapped Satchel.

Hand the satchel to Commander Stormbough.

Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "You have performed admirably, young gatekeeper. A force is nothing without proper support, and you have isolated the orcs from theirs."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "These idols reek with the stain of the Spirals, even when broken. Bring them to Sylvarya so that she may continue her investigations."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Thank you again, [name]. We shall call upon you again soon, I am sure."

She hands you the satchel. Take it to Sylvarya.

Sylvarya Starveil says, "The instruments of orc rituals carry with them a corruption that lingers, even after their destruction."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "I will do what I can to cleanse these idols and see if they align with the other elements we have uncovered so far, but you have done well for the Faelewyn today."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Please accept these gloves as a measure of thanks, [name]. One cannot be too careful in the handling of such dangerous idols."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "You may continue to aid those of the Weald for now. I will have one final task for you once my investigations have concluded."

She hands you Sap-Stained Gloves.

Rewards:

Scroll Gate
Sap-Stained Gloves

Experience

If you hail her, she will say the follow:

Sylvarya Starveil says, "Continue to aid those of the Weald until you feel you are ready to learn more of the Wyrding. Upon such a time, return the gloves to me so that I may gauge your progress."

sections.title: Part 4 - Req. Level 8+
sections.text:
Hand Sap-Stained Gloves to Sylvarya. She will return them.

Sylvarya Starveil says, "Your connection to the natural world has grown stronger, aspirant. Verses of your strength sing from you like wind through the reeds."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "The gloves are yours to keep, of course, though you will also need this lodestone if you are ready to assist in my investigations."

She hands you Lodestone.
You say, "I am ready to assist."

Sylvarya Starveil says, "You have been aiding me from the start, if you were not already aware."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "The reaction from the Wyrdgate due to the phial you poured, the study of its contents by Sylwine, as well as the message received from Almina of the Circle of Scarce Rains."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "All were related to a theory of mine; and, upon studying the orcish idols that you last brought me, I have finally reached a conclusion."

You say, "What conclusion?"

Sylvarya Starveil says, "I can say with confidence that there is a second Wyrdgate located within the Weald. One that is under the control of our enemies."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "This may be how a portion of their forces have entered the Weald undetected, and as Gatekeepers, it falls on us to close it."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Will you use your gifts to aid us in this endeavor, aspirant?"

You say, "I will use my gifts."

Sylvarya Starveil says, "If the orc forces have somehow opened a second gate, it means they have enlisted aid from someone capable of connecting to the Wyrding... a feat their kind is incapable of."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "First we must find the location of this gate, after which we must deal with its creator."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "I recommend camouflaging yourself with nature's embrace and scouring the areas of Evershade upon which the orcs have made their presence known. Avoid the undead if you choose to do this, as their unnatural gaze can pierce our shrouds."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Search for any signs of a circular formation. It need not be a circle of toadstools such as our own gate. Theirs could be made of flowers, stones, or any other natural phenomenon."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Once located, you are to place the lodestone within the center of the circle to attune it to its last used destination."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Return the attuned lodestone to me once you have done this, and may the shades of the Weald protect you, [name]."

Go to the orc valley and make your way to the ramps that lead up from near the spires that spawn skeletons and rabid dogs just near the road out of the zone. Go up the ramp and then turn left. Head to the end of the road on the cliff and you'll see a moss archway drawn onto the cliff face. This is the moss circle.

While standing near the moss circle and with the lodestone on your cursor, /place lodestone.

You receive Attuned Lodestone. ***After about 10 seconds three orcs will spawn - run or Gate.

Hand the attuned lodestone to Sylvarya.

Sylvarya Starveil says, "What do you think? Yes. Yes, I believe so as well."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "It is as we feared."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Not only is there a second, active Wyrdgate, but this one has made two distinct connections between the mires of the Reekbog and the shadows of the Deep."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "It would be unwise to draw a conclusion from that alone, but the fact remains that we must sever this connection if our forces are to have any hope of reclaiming the cliffs."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "I entrust this task to you, aspirant, as with your abilities, you should have no trouble temporarily sealing the gateway. You must, however, employ the proper method."

You say, "What is the proper method?"

Sylvarya Starveil says, "Any individual could simply tear away the moss, but this would only provide a short respite. The one who created the gate could return to renew it in short order."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "What we require is a solution capable of removing the moss completely from the stone and preventing its regrowth. I can create such a solution for you, but I need you to bring me the venom sac of both a wasp and a Mezzatrian widow spider."

You need to kill wasps and spiders for Wasp Venom Sac and Widow Venom Sac. Hand these to Sylvarya.
 NOTE: The venom sacs are often found on Cooking Supplies or shady merchants.

Any spider named Mezzatrian can drop it. They can be found on the platform across the broken bridge. (across the fallen log, up the ramp, behind the waterfall, follow bridges)

She hands you Searing Solution.
 NOTE: If you fail this part of the quest, simply hand Sylvarya more venom sacs for another solution.

Sylvarya Starveil says, "Here is the solution you require. Pour this upon the moss to destroy it, but be cautious. Such interference with the gateway is sure to spare the ire of the one who created it."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "That is the plan, of course. Once you have drawn out the interloper, you must subdue them to prevent them from ever conjuring another Wyrdgate."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Lastly, and most importantly, you must place the attuned lodestone once more into the center of the destroyed gateway to seal off the Wyrding completely."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Return to me with the used lodestone, as well as any evidence of your victory against the orcs' hired hand. Should you require more of the solution, you will have to fetch me another wasp and widow venom sac."

Go back to the moss circle and, with the solution on your cursor, /pour solution.

After about 10 seconds Muleda Murktoe will spawn. He is a level 13 Druid and casts Lesser Heal, Burning Embers, and Moon Ember.
 NOTE: Given that he drops a Reekbog Focus and, noted by Sylvarya's dialogue later, Muleda will likely become a Troll once they are implemented.

Kill Muleda and loot Reekbog Focus.

Stand close to the moss circle and, with the Attuned Lodestone on your cursor, /place lodestone.

You receive Used Lodestone. After 10 seconds you'll be teleported to Shallow Shoals as part of the moss gate collapsing.

Return the Used Lodestone and Reekbog Focus to Sylvarya.

Sylvarya Starveil says, "A druid of the Reekbog was aligned with the orcs? A frightening development, though not entirely surprising. The trolls are notorious survivors, and there could be dozens of reasons as to how they found themselves doing the bidding of the Fellstone Clan."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Regardless, you have proven yourself a true Gatekeeper, [name]. You have protected the Weald and safeguarded the pathways just as one should."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "Here, a token. Brind this along with your aspirant icon to Commander Elydris Stormbough."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "It is time you are recognized as a full member of the Wyrdguard."
Sylvarya Starveil says, "We thank you, Gatekeeper [name]."

She hands you Druidic Token.

Hand the Druidic Token and Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper to the Commander.

Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "The High Gatekeeper informed me of your mission, [name]. This token must mean that you have returned triumphant. Well done!"
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "We are honored to have a talent such as yourself among the ranks of the Wyrdguard."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "You have proven yourself beyond the measure of an aspirant and are hereby recognized as Gatekeeper [name]. I present you with this icon as a symbol of your status."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Faelindral sings to your accomplishment!"

She hands you Icon of the Gatekeeper.

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read An earth stained note you start with as a new Druid character:

Greetings,

The Circle of Scarce Rains is looking for
adventurers who are one with nature.
Please, make haste and bring this note to the
Circle's headquarters.
Deliver it to Rolan Talmula if you are prepared to
take on your first duty.

The Circle is located within Saltbreeze Park,
central to the city and right below the Great Guild
Hall.

If you're feeling lost out here, remember this:
our sun, Eth, rises in the East and sets to the West,
and the Twilight Bay is always to the South.
Need help beyond that? Just ask a guard. They'll
often be able to assist with directions.

Give earth stained note to Rolan Talmula.

Rolan Talmula takes the note into his hands, squinting, before looking up to you with a warm smile.

Rolan Talmula says 'Ah, must be the new initiate. Thank you for bringing this note to me. We shall begin your training at once."

Rolan Talmula sizes you up for a moment before handing you a tunic.

You receive a Worn Circle Tunic from Rolan Talmula.

Rolan Talmula says 'As you may already know, one of the duties of the Circle of Scarce Rains is to maintain the delicate balance we have created here among the gardens.'

Rolan Talmula says 'Nature is not static, but moves like a river. Our goal is not to dam the river, so to speak, but to make sure that we have a place next to it.'

Rolan Talmula says 'Your first task is to collect reagents for senior members of the guild, and to learn a little bit about the balance of nature while you are at it. Here, take this sack, and fill it with eight bat wings. Bring it back to me, along with a fire beetle eye, and that concludes your test.'

Rolan Talmula hands hands you a burlap sack.

You receive Sack for Bat Wings from Rolan Talmula.

The Sack of Bat Wings is an eight slot container. Bat Wings and Fire Beetle Eyes drop from desert bats and fire beetles, respectively, in the newbie yards of Night Harbor. Put a 8 unstacked bat wings stack of 8 bat wings in the Sack of Bat Wings and hit the combine button. Don't forget to hit combine on the bag before handing it in; if you hand in the uncombined bag and fire beetle eye to Rolan Talmula, he will return it:

You craft a Sack of Bat Wings.

You receive your items back from Rolan Talmula.

Rolan Talmula says 'It looks like you've gotten the fire beetle eye, and a fine one at that! However, where is the bag of bat wings? You were tasked with getting those, too, initiate.'

Rolan Talmula gives you a knowing smile. Rolan Talmula says 'Or perhaps they're in your bag, you just forgot to give it over?'

Hand the combined Sack of Bat Wings and fire beetle eye to Rolan Talmula:

You gain experience!!

Your faction standings with The Circle of Scarce Rains got better.

Rolan Talmula looks down, taking the burlap sack from you. He clutches the bag in his gnarled fingers, counting out the bat wings. Rolan Talmula says '...four pairs, and the eye. Very good, you have done well.'

Rolan Talmula looks to you, giving an approving nod. Rolan Talmula says 'We druids have a duty not just to life, but to death, too. You would do well not to be squeamish toward bloodshed, it is part of the natural order.'

Rolan Talmula closes his eyes in silent prayer. Rolan Talmula says 'Krivea teaches us that gratitude for all life is important. You would do well to remember to thank any creature that gives its life for you, from the tiny insect to the giant beast, be they plant or animal.'

Rolan Talmula mutters an incantation over the fire beetle eyes.

Rolan Talmula hands you a wooden token and the eye.

You receive Wooden Circle Token from Rolan Talmula.

You receive Blessed Fire Beetle Eye from Rolan Talmula.

Rolan Talmula says 'Here, I have blessed the eye, something you will learn in time. Go, present the wooden token to Calaada.'

sections.title: Part 2 - Req. Lvl 5
sections.text:
1) Once you reach level 5, hand Calaada the Wooden Circle Token, located at the top of the Druid guild.  She will give you a Notched Circle Token.

2) She will send you down one level to speak with Aaliyah. Give Aaliyah the Notched Circle Token. She will have you head out West Gate and gather offerings from the shrines along the path.

You will need to use "/look shrine" command on each of the 3 shrines followed by "/take offering" or "/take note". Afterwards, you will have 2 offerings and 1 note.

Read the note then loot 1 Raw Rat Meat from A large rat (you'll need this later).

3) Locate NPC Milham the Mad in the city located inside the Sojourner Camp and to the right of the Wayfarers Hospice (Cleric/Paladin Guild Hall) entrance.

4) Hand in the note to Milham to receive Medicine, which is a container.

Place 1 Raw Rat Meat into the Medicine container and hit combine.

BE PREPPED FOR A FIGHT (buffs, full health, etc.)

5) Hand in the combined medicine container to Willy. He will take it, and it will make him sick and attack you. (It is not necessary to kill Willy. See next step.)

6) You will receive an item Sample of Willy's Spittle after handing in the medicine to Willy (It replaces the existing vial in your inventory upon turn in. Killing Willy is not necessary.).

Give the Spittle to Milham, he will return it with 3rd offering.

Combine the 3 offerings in offerings bag.

7) Return to Aaliyah at the Druid guild and give her both the Spittle and the combined offering bag.

8) Reward Halfling-Made Boots

She will hand you back a Sample of Willy's Spittle and have you go onto next quest (DO NOT MAKE TRIP at level 5 can only turn in spittle but cannot take follow up quest).

sections.title: Part 3 - Req. Lvl 15-17
sections.text:
1) Travel to the druid rings in the south end of Sungreet Strands, same place as your level 16 teleport spell. (A bit after the quarry on your left, head right towards the coast to a copse of trees near a large boulder.)

Hand the Sample of Willy's Spittle to Almina (it is returned to you)

Almina Weepingwind looks over the bottle.
Almina Weepingwind says, "Another sick animal... and Aaliyah told you to come to me with this urgently? Hm, this is worrying indeed."
Almina Weepingwind lets out a deep sigh.
Almina Weepingwind says, "This disease isn't natural, I'm afraid."
Almina Weepingwind says, "We need to track the source of these horrific acts, or it could affect us all... and even reach the city!"
Almina Weepingwind says, "Search for clues throughout the mountain ranges and near water sources."
Almina Weepingwind says, "While you look, hold this coin in your palm.  It's imbued with a spell that makes it heat up when you're near a strong , tainted source."
Almina Weepingwind says, "If you find anything, come back to me immediately."

2) Travel to the northwest in SGS to the cliff / ramp up. Follow it past the three towers and bridge towards the garrison / fort where the Pyrmos mercenaries are. Through the fort access the aqueducts (looks like tiny bridge for carrying water) and travel it to the end where two mercenaries stand guard.

As you approach the Gateway to the aqueducts, the metal coin in your possession begins to heat up considerably! This must be what Almina wanted you to find.
You receive Searing Circle Coin.

You may wish to Souldbind here as you will be back.

3) Head back to Almina and turn in the coin.

Almina Weepingwind takes the coin in hand and flinches slightly, conjuring a sphere of water to help cool down the imbued coin.
Almina Weepingwind says, "It appears that you have successfully tracked down the source of the disease, though I cannot begin to fathom how the aqueducts could have become tainted when they are so heavily guarded."
Almina says, "Someone, or something, must be capable of slipping past the Pyrmos mercenaries unnoticed."
Almina says, "We will also be barred access, as the governor has hired the Pyrmos to keep any of the local factions away from such an important piece of Night Harbor's power struggle."
Almina Weepingwind chews her lower lip and then withdraws a sheaf of parchment, scribbling out a note and offering it back to you.
Almina says, "We will simply have to appeal to the morals of one of the mercenaries posted there. Did you encounter a guard posted at the aqueduct gates themselves?"

4) Head back to the same place, and at the end of the aqueducts two mercenaries stand guard, one named. The named is Foldja. Hand her the note and she will hand you back a note.

Mercenary Foldja says, "Uh? What's this, then?"
Mercenary Foldja unfolds the message and scans it quickly, frowning. She rolls up the parchment and returns it to you.
Mercenary Foldja says, "Sounds like your Almina friend already knows that I can't let you inside, but you're also lucky that you brought this to me instead of someone else."
Mercenary Foldja says, "The Pyrmos would take offense to any notion that we're failing in our duties, but being stationed at the gateway means I've heard the things that crawl around in the night."

/say things?

Mercenary Foldja says, "There are eerie chants and cackles from the crags here at night. Very goblin-like cackles, if you get me."
Mercenary Foldja says, "I can assure you that nothing gets through this gateway, but I wouldn't be surprised if those Muggrah scamps found a hidden passage on the other side of the mountain."
Mercenary Foldja says, "The Bloodynose clan nearby are too scrawny and occupied with their war against the ashira clans, while the Muggrah camp just beyond our keep is always under our watchful eye, so I wouldn't be worried about that one."
Mercenary Foldja says, "No, if I were a betting woman, I'd say that the goblins on the other side of the mountain in the Glass Flats were the ones scaling the cliffs and being a nuisance."
Mercenary Foldja says, "You can go tell your Almina friend that I said as much."

5) Head back to Almina. Target here and /say goblins, earn your satchel, and prepare for Glass Flats goblins.

/say goblins

Almina Weepingwind says, "Goblins? What motivation would they have to infect the city's water supply? The goblin clans are typically drawn toward acts of greed, not sheer malice."
Almina Weepingwind pauses to ponder for a moment before shaking her head and taking back the letter, handing you a leather satchel in its place.
Almina Weepingwind says, "That will have to be an investigation for another day, I suppose. If the goblin shamans truly are scaling the mountains and infecting the city's water with their magics, we'll need to create a remedy to counteract it."
Almina Weepingwind says, "The Muggrah shamans and spiritualists derive their power from covetous forces that they link to their personal possessions. You will have to relieve the shamans of a number of these possessions, so that I can develop a counteragent to deliver back to Night Harbor."
Almina Weepingwind says, "Take this satchel and do what you must to fill it with the shaman's trinkets. I am not sure what they currently use, be it beads, fetishes, or some other token, but you must fill the satchel all the same."
Almina Weepingwind says, "Return the filled satchel to me as soon as you can!"

6) Head to Glass Flats and kill goblin shamans and spiritualists.

You will want to be level 16 or so and in a full group.
From SGS, enter GF, turn immediately left, and look for goblin camps.
You need to farm 6 "Shiny Pyrite Coin".
Fill satchel with 6 coins and combine.
Hand in to Almina.

Almina Weepingwind takes a look inside the satchel and raises her eyebrows.
Almina Weepingwind says, "Coins? I suppose I should not be surprised, given the goblins' beliefs."
Almina Weepingwind says, "You did well, <player>. Allow me a moment to confer with the spirits on how to best counter this form of magical disease."
Almina Weepingwind closes her eyes as a rush of wind and sand sweeps through the circle of standing stones. Your own connection to natural forces allows you to perceived the faint whispers of Szuur conversing with the skilled druidess, who then suffuses her power into a conjured sphere of floating water and douses the satchel of coins.
Almina Weepingwind continues to concentrate as the cloying sickness that once permeated the satchel begins to abate. Almina nodes and deposits what remains of her conjured sphere into an open flask, then offers it to you.
Almina Weepingwind says, "Bring this back to Aaliyah so she can treat the waters flowing in from the aqueducts. This is only a temporary solution, but it should at least be sufficient in preventing any further spread of the disease into Night Harbor."
Almina Weepingwind says, "Thank you, <player>, and may Krivea guide your journey."

You will receive Almina's Remedy. Take this back to Aaliyah.

Aaliyah says, "You're back! What did I tell you? I knew Almina would know what to do!"
Aaliyah says, "I'll see that this remedy gets delivered straight to the aqueduct's tenders. How bizarre that the goblin clans were involved in all of this."
Aaliyah says, "We may have to look further into that another day, but for now, you're due for a reward for all your efforts."
Aaliyah says, "Take this token to Calaada just above. I believe she wants to have a word with you."

Head on up to Calaada and hand in the token.

Calaada Acaciathorn accepts the token with a warm smile.
Calaada Acaciathorn says, "I'm told you went to great lengths to seek out what was plaguing our water supplies, <player>."
Calaada Acaciathorn says, "I'm both thankful and honored to have you as a member of the Circle of Scarce Rains. Please, accept this dousing rod so you may continue to bring fresh waters to all those who require it."
Calaada Acaciathorn says, "In the future we may call upon your services once more, but until then, you're free to set out on whichever journey Krivea has laid out for you."
Calaada Acaciathorn presents you a magical dousing rod.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience

Shredded Cloak
Rotting Rootstaff

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read the Musky Note you start with as a new Druid character:

Celebrate, young one, for you will be a messenger of the Rotfather.

It is our gift to spread his joy across the wilds and the deeps.

Come to the Rotten Hollow to begin you lessons.
Seek the Rot of Gorm in the cavern west of the palace.

Luskmit

Head east to the Dry Docks. Go right once you reach the water. Run a long way, looking for a tunnel that has hanging vines. Go through there and keep veering right until you see a camp up a hill. You will find Luskmit there. Hand him your Musky Note.

You say, "Hail, Luskmit."
Luskmit says "Are you ready to spread the Rotfather's joy?"
You gain experience!!
Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better.
Luskmit says, "Rotfather's blessing! We are in great need of a new messenger. Will you spread his joy?"
You receive Shredded Cloak from Luskmit.
You say, "I will spread his joy!"
Luskmit says, "All creatures serve his purpose, young Druid. He is inevitable. Find plagued rats within the Underdocks and use this club to subdue them. Collect four rats within this satchel and deliver it to the halfling, Jumbe. You should find him lurking somewhere around the citadel."
You receive Beat Stick from Luskmit.
You receive Plaguerat Satchel from Luskmit.
Luskmit says, "Try not to mangle them too badly."

Use the Beat Stick on rats in the newbie area and around town until you get 4x Lightly Bashed Plaguerat corpses, Fill the bag, combine and turn into Jumbe (Odol).

You gain experience!!
Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better.
Jumbe Odol says, "Well done! I hope you didn't beat the rats too badly. I'll do my best to revive them, if I can. But they will find their way into the palace kitchens one way or another. Eheh! You may return to the one who sent you. Go with the Rotfather's blessing."

Go back to Luskmit and hail them.

You gain experience!!
Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better.
Luskim says, "So it is done. Even the smallest creatures have a part to play. Keep this walking staff to ease your travels. May it serve as a living reminder of your calling."
You receive Rotting Rootstaff from Luskmit.

If you hail Luskmit again she tells you to come back later.

You say, "Hail, Luskmit."
Luskmit says, "You have much to learn, Druid. Return to me when you are more seasoned in the ways of the Rotfather."

sections.title: Part 2 - Req. Lvl 5 - The Deep teems with life.
sections.text:
Head back to Luskmit in the Rotten Hollow

You say, "Hail, Luskmit"
Luskmit says, "The Deep teems with life. It is the greatest joy of the Rotfather, how we creatures writhe and squirm in our feeble attempts to survive his great, inexorable decay. We must tend to this garden."
Luskmit says, " I need an assistant to collect samples of the rot festering in the Deep."
You say, "Samples? or What Samples?"
Luskmit says, "Hunt the fauna roaming the Deep who have lived long while their ailments well from within. Many species inhabit the Deep. Bring me rotten organ smples from a shadewing bat, a myconid, a slitherscale, and a deepweb spider."
You receive Organ Sample Bag from Luskmit.
Luskmit says, "Healthy specimens may suffer in your search, but this is part of the natural order."

Extra - While you search for these items by killing the above mobs give. If you speak with Luskmit before turning in the items:

Luskmit says, "Do not dither among the rocks and the weeds, Druid. The Rotfather gives us only a short time to spread his gifts."

Information below may still be accurate but may be after the above step.

A strange rot brews in the Deep ===

Infront of Brugg Mulcher is a Rotten Mushroom /take mushroom, and hand to Brugg Mulcher
He will give you a Mushroom Basket fill the basket with other red mushrooms you can find around the zone, 2 in the zone left of the river, 1 in the right, in the spore cave(name?)
Combine the 4 mushrooms, Rotten Mushroom, Malignant Mushroom, Virulent Mushroom, Tainted Mushroom within the Mushroom Basket to create the Full Mushroom Basket
Give the Full Mushroom Basket to Brugg Mulcher.
He gives you a Brugg's Report to hand into the Druid leader Letharia Hollowgrove she takes the note, and requests you give her your "walking staff" that you currently cannot aquire...
handing in Faintly Glowing Crystal obtained from the Deepcut Miners to Maude Astarace she gives you a walking Stick, maybe something to do with caster starter quest?

More to come

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text: The Pinwheel quest is the beginner quest for elementalists, obtained after turning in their starter note to their guild master. The quest takes the player throughout Night Harbor.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
First Degree Fourfold Sash

Simple Brass Coin

Faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path
Experience

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text:
Upon turning in a humble note to Tenebrim Tam inside The School of the Fourfold Path:

Tenebrim Tam turns to you gruffly, assessing your[sic] a moment, before his expression cracks into a broad smile.

Your faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path got better.

Tenebrim Tam says, "Welcome to the School of the Fourfold Path! I take it you are here because you wish to train as an Elementalist with our school, no?"

Tenebrim Tam claps his broad hand across your shoulders as a boisterous laugh escapes his lips.

Tenebrim Tam says, "Here at the school, we learn not just about how to use the magic of the elementals, but also to find harmony in our relations with them. As a new member to our school, I would like to present you with our belt!"

You receive Fourfold Sash from Tenebrim Tam.

Tenebrim Tam says, "That belt marks you as a member of our school, and as you increase in rank, we will add emblems to it. Do our guild proud. With that out of the way, I have a task for you, as part of your training."

Tenebrim Tam claps his hands together, and suddenly, several items appear in them with a flash!

Tenebrim Tam says, "You are to go about the city and provide offerings to some of our invisible helps. Take this pinwheel, it will spin when you are in the presence of a hungry Djinn, in places of proper elemental resonance. You need not do anything with it, it will spin all on its own. Djinn are often housed inside of objects of art, such as statues, because they do not have a physical form. When you find them, place some incense for them from this box. They will offer you a token of their appreciation in the form of a pearl. Place the pearls in this bag, and return it alongside the pinwheel, your belt, and the box. There are four pearls in all to find - one for earth, water, wind, and fire."

You receive A Pinwheel from Tenebrim Tam.

You receive A Box of Elemental Incense from Tenebrim Tam.

You receive Small Velvet Bag from Tenebrim Tam.

sections.title: Part 1
sections.text:
As you approach the objects of interest you'll receive these messages in order of proximity:

Your pinwheel beings to spin...

Your pinwheel spins faster... You must be getting closer.

Your pinwheel spins very quickly. There must be something nearby.

After the third message you can use /look to get a description of the object. Then open your inventory and left-click on the box of elemental incense (it will appear on your cursor). Lastly, place the incense on the object by typing: /place incense

sections.title: Earthen Pearl
sections.text:
After turning in the humble note, turn 180° from Tenebrim Tan and make your way downstairs to the wall parallel to where he stands. Get close to the small scarab idol hanging on the wall.

Scarab idol far-way
		
		
			
			Scarab idol close-up

Upon /looking around you notice:

This cave provides a protected aera for the elementals. Along the wall, you notice a small stone idol of a scarab.

Click on your box of incense and /place scarab:

The sweet scent of incense fills the air.
As you place and light the incense in front of the idol, the ethereal being grows in size, seemingly pleased from your offering. Suddenly, it reaches into itself, pulling out a small pearl, which it unceremoniously drops into your hands.
You receive An Earthern Pearl.

Place the Earthen Pearl, and all subsequent pearls, inside your small velvet bag.

sections.title: Aqua Pearl
sections.text:
Leave the School of the Fourfold Path through the doorway directly to the right of the scarab idol. Follow the path down the ramp and turn sharp right going west, you will pass a set of stairs on your right and find a doorway on your left heading south. Your pinwheel should begin to spin again now.

You will see white columned portico covering a well with the statue of a jackal at the southern end.

Following the same procedures as before:

This covered well provides a much-needed respite for the labors of the day. Along the southern wall, an alabaster pillar displaying a small wooden idol of a jackal stands watch over the square.

Click on your box of incense and /place statue

You receive An Aqua Pearl.

sections.title: Fiery Pearl
sections.text:
Now head to the blacksmithing forge at the Night Market by going north back through the doorway you came through and head northwest until you come to the market area.

Another scarab idol is attached to the wall near the forge.

Click on your box of incense and /place scarab. After offering incense:

Ringing hammers announce the Smithy's Guild as you make your way towards it, as apprentices stoke coals in forges, quench hammered plates in water, and hone freshly forged blades on sharpening wheels. Meanwhile, masters demonstrate more advanced techniques to their students as the fires of the forges dance across the shadowed walls. on the wall, a stone fire beetle statue stands in silent vigil.

Swirling smoke rises from the offered incense, which seems to collect within the ethereal being, strengthening it. A small, fiery pearl drops from the beetle statue's pincers, which youj pocket hastily.

The smell of sweet incense wafts through the air, mingling with the scent of coal and molten metal.

You receive A Fiery Pearl.

sections.title: Airy Pearl
sections.text:
Now venture northeast to the area with the North Gate.

Once you find the North Gate, make your way east to the huge glowing mage tower and, taking the ramps and magic platforms, go to the very top of the tower. At the top, find the bird statue on one of the ledges.

Click on your box of incense and /place statue

After offering incense:

The tower stands tall above the city. A small avian statue perched along the wall, standing watch.

You light the incense, and the siwrling winds around the tower coalesce around the statue, a swirling vortex of sweet incense and sea air mingling together. After a moment, the incorporeal figure is gone, but a small, egg-like pearl remains in its place. The scent of jasmine and sandalwood permeate the area as the incense is lit.

You receive An Airy Pearl.

sections.title: Turn In
sections.text:
Open the small velvet bag and ensure all pearls are placed within. Press combine to transform the small velvet bag into a Velvet Bag of Pearls.

Return to Tenebrim Tam and give him the incense, the pinwheel, the bag of pearls, and the training belt all at once. He responds:

Tenebrim Tam takes the items from you, counting out the pearls.

Tenebrim Tam says, "Ah, wonderful! You've completed your tasks. I am very proud of you for this, <Player>. As a reward, I will be affixing the first seal to your belt, marking you as a First Degree Elementalist in the School of the Fourfold Path! Congratulations!"

You receive First Degree Fourfold Sash from Tenebrim Tam.

Your faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path got better.

Tenebrim Tam says, "Now, I urge you to go out and train with your fellow adventurers. once you have grown a bit in skill, I have another task for you. bring this imbued coin to me when you feel you are ready to being your next task."

You receive A Simple Brass Coin from Tenebrim Tam.

sections.title: Return to Tenebrim Tam
sections.text:
Turn in A Simple Brass Coin to Tenebrim Tam.

Tenebrim Tam says, "Please go through the Night Harbor gates, into the yards, and grab two fire beetle glands, two bone chips, two bat wings, and a water flask."

Turn the items in to Tenebrim Tam along with your First Degree Fourfold Sash.

Tenebrim Tam says, "Excellent!"

Tenebrim Tam says, "I've reinforced your trainee belt and we're now ready to start your elemental affinity tests."

Tenebrim Tam says, "Go speak to Pedram in the back, tell him you're there for the tests, he'll ready your elemental crystals for them."

You receive

Reinforced First Degree Fourfold Sash

sections.title: Speak with Pedram
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, Pedram."

Pedram says, "Hail, adventurer. I'm Pedram, assistant to the Tams."

You say, "I'm here for the tests."

Pedram says, "You're a trainee here for the elemental tests?"

Pedram says, "Good. I've extracted the elemental affinities from the ingredients you provided and prepared the crystals."

: Pedram beams at you.

Pedram says, "Are you ready for the first one?"

You say, "I'm ready."

Pedram hands you a small crystal. You receive Red Crystral.

Pedram says, "First comes fire."

Pedram says, "Use this crystal in the training grounds, but be prepared! Once you've overcome the challenge, come back to me with the elemental essence."

Pedram says, "If you fail the challenge, return to me with the empty crystal and I'll replenish it for you."

Go downstairs to the training grounds. Use the crystal in your inventory. A Level 5 an angry fire elemental will spawn and attack you. Kill it and loot Fiery Essence. Give the Fiery Essence to Pedram.

Pedram says, "You've bested it. Well done!"

Pedram says, "Are you ready for the next challenge? It's earth! Once you've overcome it, return to me with the elemental essence."

Repeat the process using the Brown Crystal to summon a Level 5 an angry earth elemental and loot the Earthen Essence. Give the Earthen Essence to Pedram.

Pedram says, "You're starting to get the hang of this. Splendid!"

Pedram says, "Are you ready for the water challenge? Once you overcome it, return to me with the elemental essence."

Repeat the process using the Blue Crystal to summon a Level 5 an angry water elemental and loot the Watery Essence. Give the Watery Essence to Pedram.

Pedram says, "Seems you're quite capable. Great work!"

Pedram says, "Are you ready for the final challenge, air? Once you overcome it, return to me with the elemental essence."

Repeat the process using the Translucent Crystal to summon a Level 5 an angry air elemental and loot the Airy Essence. Give the Airy Essence to Pedram.

Pedram says, "You've succeeded in your elemental affinity tests. Congratulations!"

Pedram claps his hands.

Pedram says, "Take this note back to Master Tenebrim, he'll be thrilled to hear of your success!"

You receive Note for Tenebrim.

Hand the note to Tenebrim.

Tenebrim Tam picks up the note, reads through and smiles at you.

Tenebrim Tam says, "You managed to tame the elements! I knew you'd overcome this challenge, well done."

Tenebrim Tam says, "We have a gift for you, student. Choose your eleemental affinity by handing me the corresponding essence with your trainee belt.

Hand your

Reinforced First Degree Fourfold Sash

and an Elemental Essence to Tenebrim Tam.

Tenebrim Tam fiddles with your belt and adds a second seal to it.

You will receive a Level 4 spell scroll of the element you choose. You also receive a

Second Degree Fourfold Sash

.

Tenebrim Tam says, "You are now a second degree student of the Fourfold Path, congratulations!"

Tenebrim Tam says, "Come back to me after spending some time honing your skills, I will have other things to teach you."

Tenebrim Tam salutes you.

Tenebrim Tam says, "Oh, if you have any crystals or essences left, give them to Pedram, he'll give you some crushed malachites for your summonings!"

Give your remaining essences and crystals to Pedram. He will give you one Crushed Malachite per turn in.

Pedram says, "Thank you. We'll make good use of it!"

Pedram says, "Here's my end of the bargain."

Pedram presses a crushed malachite into your palm with a smile.

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1 (both paths)
sections.text:
Read Torn Note you start with as a new Enchanter character:

Do not be startled, <character>, but you have a choice to make, and time is of the essence.

Do you register as a practitioner of mind magic, as the law requires, and then face a lifetime of scrutiny and obedience to some faceless bureaucracy?

Or do you maintain your anonymity, seek out the aid of like-minded beguilers, and chart your own course?

The choice is yours, though we advise you to pursue the latter.

Deliver this note to Master Wincog at his curious goods shop. You'll find it along the long flight of stairs that connects Sageside to Saltbreeze Park. Look for the sign.

And a word of caution: he may not look like much, but as all enchanters know - never trust your eyes.

Give Torn Note to Master Wincog.

You gain experience!!

Master Wincog adjusts his spectacles and reads the note.

Master Wincog says, "Well, it's good to meet you. Or at least I think it is."

Master Wincog says, "As a novice enchanter, you're required by law to register with the city...though, you could always choose to set your own course. You have a big decision to make."

Master Wincog says, "If you want to be a good, law-abiding citizen, seek out Registrar Vauquelin inside the Spellbinders Spire. He keeps a watchful eye on all registered enchanters."

Master Wincog says, "His office is on the ground level of the Spire, near the entrance. So, if you happen to use the wizards' teleporter, head downstairs."

Master Wincog says, "Give him his registration form. With it, you'll be properly registered."

You receive Sealed Registration Form from Master Wincog.

Master Wincog says, "Or...should you choose otherwise, you can just return it to me. The choice is yours."

sections.title: Part 2a - Req. Lvl 1 (Wincog path)
sections.text:
Master Wincog says, "Since you're handing me this, I take it you're not looking for work as an entertainer."

Master Wincog says, "You'll likely come to know that being an unregistered enchanter isn't exactly an easy life... but as long as they think you're only capable of party tricks, they tend to leave you alone."

Master Wincog says, "Now, how about you run some errands for me so that my dear friend Nerlbus can take a break? When you're done, I might let you in on a great secret!"

Master Wincog says, "Take this robe, bag, and the items to be delivered."

You receive Dusty Violet Robe from Master Wincog.

You receive Wincog's Delivery Bag from Master Wincog.

You receive Ivory Inlaid Box from Master Wincog.

You receive Smoky Glass Vial from Master Wincog.

You receive Ornately Locked Book from Master Wincog.

You receive Small Golden Cage from Master Wincog.

Master Wincog says, "Once you've got the robe and bag on and adjusted, let me know that you're ready to get started."

You say, "I'm ready for my instructions"

Master Wincog laughs deviously. You think you hear Nerlbus's laughter echoing in the distance as well.

Master Wincog says, "Oh... I'm not sure you're ready for this."

Master Wincog smiles at you with a sparkle in this eyes.

Master Wincog says, "We enchanters are feared by the authorities for a reason. We can appear as anything, or disappear altogether... and, we have the power to get inside the heads of others."

Master Wincog appears to grow slightly, his voice booming inside your head!

Master Wincog says, "IF YOU WISH TO ENTER THE HOUSE OF CANDOR, YOU MUST KNOW THE CONSEQUENCES OF BETRAYAL!"

Master Wincog says, "Well... enough of that."

Master Wincog says, "The deliveries are labeled. Take the first item to Bieito Brightsmile in the Travelers Ward."

Master Wincog says, "Don't worry I'll help you find it."

Master Wincog smiles again as your vision begin to blur...

You are mesmerized.

You are no longer mesmerized.

Master Wincog has teleported you to the Soujourner's Camp near to Bieito Brightsmile. Give Bieito Brightsmile the Ivory Inlaid Box.

You gain experience!!

Bieito Brightsmile laughs and tucks away the box.

Bieito Brightsmile says, "Here's what he requested in exchange."

You receive Large Black Stone Egg from Bieito Brightsmile.

Bieito Brightsmile says, "Tell ol' Wincog that I appre..."

Bieito Brightsmile suddenly begins to nod off and lean to one side.

Bieito Brightsmile says, "You can find Mirembe in the harbor district. She supervises a warehouse on the waterfront. Go to her at once."

Bieito Brightsmile jolts upright, looking alert.

Bieito Brightsmile says, "...ciate him finding this for us. We've been all over and inquired to no avail. Thankfully, Wincog's reputation as a procurer precedes him."

Bieito Brightsmile says, "Well, take care, and thanks again."

Mirembe Tiifu can be found South and slightly East of the Monk/Elementalist guild (Just East of the Customs Office). She can be visible on the second floor on a balcony above some arches when running down the seafront. Use the entrance on the West side to reach her. Give her the Smoky Glass Vial.

You gain experience!!

Mirembe Tiifu says, "Thanks the gods! I've been waiting for this."

Mirembe Tiifu says, "Here's what I found for the trade. I'm happy to get rid of this creepy thing."

You receive Writhing Leather Bag from Mirembe Tiifu.

Mirembe Tiifu makes a disgusted face.

Mirembe Tiifu says, "They said they found it on one of the islands off the coast, like he said they would."

Mirembe Tiifu says, "I don't know what those little ones want with such a thing..."

Mirembe Tiifu squeezes her eyes shut and shivers at the thought.

Mirembe Tiifu says, "Okay, now head north to the Concourse of Souls. It's built into the mountains that border the city. You'll find Malory in the library there."

Mirembe Tiifu shifts her eyes around for a moment, then looks at your suspiciously.

Mirembe Tiifu says, "I forget what I was saying... but thank you for the delivery, and for taking that creepy thing away from here."

Malory Moreland can be found on the second floor of the Concourse of Souls, in the same room as the Necromancer and Shadow Knight Spell Merchants. Give her the Ornately Locked Book.

You gain experience!!

Malory Moreland says, "Ah yes... I was expecting you, <character_name>."

Malory Moreland sets down the book down without opening it.

Malory Moreland says, "I look forward to reading this. It's very rare, but Master Wincog has an impeccable ability to acquire peculiar things... take you, for example."

Malory Moreland pauses to consider you for a moment.

Malory Moreland says, "Well, I'm sure you'll turn out fine."

Malory Moreland tilts her head slightly, then laughs as she straightens it.

Malory Moreland says, "Your master should know better than to try entering my mind. It's a fine parlor trick, but we're quite heavily warded here."

You receive Locked 6-fold Notebook from Malory Moreland.

Malory Moreland says, "Here's the gift I promised the gnome. After that little stunt he just pulled, I should keep it, but then you'd be unable to finish your task."

Malory Moreland says, "Oh, and he wants you to give the last package to Sexton Harding. You can find him in the old cemetery outside of the Northern Gate. There's a shortcut to it through the Black Feather Bazaar."

Malory Moreland says, "Since you're heading there, you may need this."

You receive a NODROP version of Scroll: Invisibility versus Undead from Malory Moreland.

Malory Moreland says, "Best of luck!"

Note: It's not strictly necessary to scribe, memorize and cast Invisibilty versus Undead on yourself for the next step, but for safety it's probably advised, especially when doing his at low level.

Sexton Harding can be found by turning left immediately after exiting the Night Harbour via the North Gate. He can be found in the corner by a camp fire. You will need to go round the ruins to get to him. Give him the Small Golden Cage.

You gain experience!!

Sexton Harding says, "Oh! Oh dear... this is a surprise. I'd entirely forgotten about it!"

Sexton Harding quickly hands you a skull that was sitting nearby.

You receive Engraved Human Skull from Sexton Harding.

Sexton Harding says, "Don't worry, don't worry... the skull isn't from here. I wouldn't dare defile this sacred garden. It was brought onto the grounds by some ne'er-do-wells who didn't belong here."

Sexton Harding says, "Well, they're occupying their own spaces here now. Buried proper-like. Got 'em both with my pickaxe and shovel, whilst they were neck-deep in someone else's grave."

Sexton Harding nods proudly and smiles with a toothless grin.

Sexton Harding says, "Master Wincog said that if I were ever to come across a skull with these markings, we'd have a trade to make. Sure enough, the robbers had one in their bag."

Sexton Harding rubs his chin.

Sexton Harding says, "But, I'd completely forgotten about it until now! It's lucky that you came by!"

Sexton Harding says, "Take 'im that skull, and my thanks. No idea how he knew it'd be here, but there it is... and here's my moth cage!"

Combine the Large Black Stone Egg, Writhing Leather Bag, Locked 6-fold Notebook and Engraved Human Skull in Wincog's Delivery Bag.

Give Wincog's Delivery Bag to Master Wincog.

You gain experience!!

Master Wincog places the bag under the counter.

Master Wincog says, "I appreciate the help. I hope you enjoyed yourself and made some new friends."

Master Wincog says, "You're going to meet a few more people, or at least, mostly people, as part of your next journey."

(If you registered with the enchanter guild, the above line is replaced with:)Master Wincog says," We've decided to trust you. You're going to meet a few more people, or at least,  mostly  people, as part of your next journey. You should dress accordingly."

Master Wincog says, "Take this key to the Grand Library in Sageside. It's big, so you can't miss it."

You receive Silver Key of Candor from Master Wincog.

Master Wincog says, "If you're clever, you'll find a secret lair in which your new allies reside!"

Master Wincog says, "If you're not so clever, you'll be surrounded by books for hours and hours, so maybe you'll eventually become clever enough to figure it out."

Master Wincog says, "Now, go to the library and show that key to Vaclav. He'll take care of you from here."

Go to the floating caster tower and take the portal marked Library. Take the portal in front of you to be teleported down one floor. Walk straight ahead and through a bookcase into an empty room, which should teleport you to another room with windows with Vaclav. This room is within the Enchanter guild which can be found in the harbor district. Give Vaclav the Silver Key of Candor.

You gain experience!!

Vaclav says, "Welcome to the House of Candor! We've been expecting your arrival, Master Wincog was quite eager for us to meet."

Vaclav motions to the room around him.

Vaclav says, "Night Harbor is still growing, so you may find that we'll occupy a different location in the future. For now, please enjoy our facility here."

Vaclav looks distracted for a moment.

Vaclav says, "...Oh! You gave me your key, you'll need that back."

You receive Silver Key of Candor from Vaclav.

Vaclav says, "Now... where was I? Ah, yes! The House of Candor is a distributed collective, which means you can find us throughout the realms of Aêthoril."

Vaclav says, "To preserve our order and, thereby, our personal safety, we excel at acquiring knowledge, making deals, and generally being indispensable."

You say, "What knowledge?"

Vaclav says, "We can be quite persuasive, so the House has often been called upon to assist with important negotiations... or to gather information to gain the upper hand in such matters."

Vaclav says, "Do not worry! If you have more of a taste for flash and danger, there's ample opportunity to assist bold adventurers heading into the hither or dither. Personally, though, I'll have none of that. I'd prefer to simply sit here and read."

Vaclav says, While we're on this topic. You should speak with Jaakima. He needs assistance with something or other. Just show him the key."

Head downstairs from Vaclav at the top of the tower. Jaakima can be found on the this floor. Exit the tower and turn left, Jaakima is inside the first door on the right. Give him the Silver Key of Candor.

Jaakima says, "Welcome! It's nice to see a new face."

Jaakima laughs heartily.

Jaakima says, "That's a joke. We're enchanters, we constantly see new faces... even on the same people."

Jaakima says, "If Vaclav just sent you, then you probably need more practice before you can assist us. Once you're ready, speak with the twins, Pau and Piia. They'll likely have a job for you."

Jaakima says, "Oh, and be sure to keep the key with you at all times. You never know when you'll need it."

You receive your items back from Jaakima.

Head down one flight of stairs and you will find Piia and in a room on this floor. Give Piia the Silver Key of Candor.

Piia rolls the key in her palm.

Piia says, "Very well, if you're ready to assist us, let's get to it."

Piia says, "First of all, here's your key back."

Piia says, "We've learned of a shipment arriving via some smugglers who operate from a cove west of the city."

Piia says, "Pay them a visit. Look inside their tents to see if you can find a small, ironbound crate. However, if you do find it, don't open it. It's very dangerous."

Piia says, "It's bound for a person of great importance here in the city, so it's likely to be well-hidden until they're ready to smuggle it in. Be sure to inspect anything that seems out of the ordinary within those tents."

Piia says, "Once you've retrieved it, bring it to Jamee Langris. You'll find him where the bards meet to perform in the Night Market."

Piia says, "Good luck."

You receive your items back from Piia.

This next part can be done during the day and night. It can be done while invisible, although a smuggler may come and investigate - you can easily run out whilst still invisible. Head to the Smuggler's Camp in Shaded Dunes and enter the second tent from the East. Use /look to receive the following message:

Old fishing nets lie inconspicuously piled in the corner of the tent.

Use /inspect nets to receive the following message:

As you push the nets aside, you discover an ironbound wooden box hidden beneath.

You receive Ironbound Wooden Box.

Head back to Night Harbor and go to the stage in The Night Market. Jamee Langris can be found behind the stage. Give him the Ironbound Wooden Box. (Note you must have your Silver Key of Candor on you or he will ask for identification)

Jamee Langris looks both startled and impressed by the box you have given him.

Jamee Langris says, "Oh dear, this is quite a surprise! The twins must have sent you."

Jamee Langris says, "I wasn't certain whether the rumors of its existence were true, but we'll find out soon enough."

Jamee Langris bows slightly.

Jamee Langris says, "My client will be very, very pleased. In return, please accept this gift to take to Piia."

You receive Finely Wrapped Gift from Jamee Langris.

Head back to the Enchanter guild and give Finely Wrapped Gift to Piia.

Piia claps her hands with joy.

Piia tears open the wrapping to reveal a leatherbound book.

Piia says, "Well done! Jamee said he'd be able to find this for me. It's a study of human behaviour under stress, written by the physicians of Lymian. Pau and I are quite eager to learn."

Piia says, "In exchange, I offer you this."

You receive Braided Crystal Ring from Piia.

Piia says, "Please accept it as a token of my appreciation."

Piia says, "Take care now, though do visit later. I may have another favor to ask of you."

Braided Crystal Ring

MAGIC UNIQUE NODROP
Slot: NECK FINGER
Class: ENC
Race: ALL

INT: +2 CHA: +1
HP: +5
A ring fashioned from delicate strands of crystal woven together.
Weight: 0.1
Size: TINY

sections.title: Part 2b - Req. Lvl 1 (Vauquelin path)
sections.text:
If you hand in <ITEM> to Registrar Vauquelin instead of back to Master Wincog:

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with House of Candor got worse.

You receive Rough Cut Robe from Registrar Vauquelin.

Registrar Vauquelin says, “Ah, I see…”

Registrar Vauquelin clears his throat.

Registrar Vauquelin says, “You have made the lawful choice to register as an enchanter of Night Harbor.

Registrar Vauquelin dutifully writes your name in the large book before him.

Registrar Vauquelin says, “There, now you are properly registered.”
Registrar Vauquelin says, “You are required by law to wear this robe, as it signifies your registration status with the authorities. Do not dispose of it.”
Registrar Vauquelin says, “Futhermore, you are only permitted to scribe a selection of approved spells. Should you encounter any unsanctioned spell usage, please report it to the Spellbinders at once.
(At this point you can either take the robe to Master Wincog, or keep the Rough Cut Robe robe.)

Upon handing the Rough Cut Robe to Master Wincog:
Master Wincog says, "Smart choice. As you likely know, being an unregistered enchanter isn't exactly an easy life... But as long as they think you're only capable of party tricks, they tend to leave you alone."
Master Wincog says, "Now, since you went and registered, you'll need to make an effort to regain the trust of House Candor."
Master Wincog says, "How about you run some errands for me so that my dear friend Nerlbus can take a break? When you're done, I'll put in a good word for you."
Master Wincog inspects your old robe and lets out a chuckle.

Master Wincog says, "They're still using that same old scrying spell to track registrants. It's highly inaccurate and easy to remove."
Master Wincog quietly mutters an incantation.

Master Wincog says, "Here, put on this bag along with your disenchanted robe. Also, take these items for delivery."
Master Wincog says, "Once you've got them on, let me know that you're ready to go. When you're done, return the filled bag and your robe to me."
(At this point, refer to Part 2a where you reply to Master Wincog.)
