sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest has two parts, both are dependent on the time of day within the game. 



Part 1 of the quest in Shaded Dunes starts at 6 PM game time. If you complete Part 1, the Night Harbor version of Head Researcher Aashir will spawn and remain up until 6 AM game time. He will promptly despawn in Night Harbor at 6 AM.  Requiring you to re-complete Part 1, in order to complete the reward turn in. It is recommended to complete Aashir's Journal before completing Part 1 of the quest.




Head Researcher Aashir is only up during the day time. He spawns at 6AM game time and will be attacked by the risen skeletons when they spawn at 6PM game time. Head Researcher Aashir is lower level than the risen skeletons so they will kill him, requiring you to wait until 6PM the next day. If you hail Head Researcher Aashir during the day he will dismiss you.

sections.title: Completing Aashir's Journal
sections.text:
In Shaded Dunes around the entrance to Ancient Crypt, Risen Skeletons and Cultists spawn at Night time. They spawn promptly at 6PM game time and will spawn throughout the Night Time. They are on a 7 minute respawn timer.  The Skeletons and Cultists will despawn promptly 6AM game time.

Kill a cultist until you have looted the following:

Aashir's Journal
Aashir's Journal Page 4
Aashir's Journal Page 17
Aashir's Journal Page 37
Aashir's Journal Page 42
Aashir's Journal Page 70
Aashir's Journal Page 76

Combine all 6 Journal Pages in Aashir's Journal to craeate the completed Aashir's Journal.

sections.title: Part 1
sections.text:
Promptly at 6 PM game time after the Risen Skeletons have spawned.

You say, "Hail, Head Researcher Aashir."

Head Researcher Aashir says, "Help, get me out of here!"

You say, "I will help escort you out of here."

After a brief delay, Head Researcher Aashir will start walking through the ruins towards Night Harbor. He does not provide any additional speech at this point of time.


You are to escort him to the far end of the ruins, killing anything along the way.  There can be upwards of 3-4 Risen Skeletons attacking him at once.  Plan for a small group to assist in keeping the Risen Skeletons off of Head Research Aashir.  If Head Research Aashir dies while being escorted you will need to wait until 6PM on the next night to try again.

If there are any Risen Skeletons in the area, he will rush to attack them.

When you have reached the northern end of the ruins, Head Researcher Aashir will stop moving and he will give a brief statement.

Head Researcher Aashir says, "I thank Tilustra for your assistance! I can make it alone from here. Please go check on my men, then meet me at the tent overlooking the excavation site for the old tomb near Night Harbor."

He will then depsawn in Shaded Dunes and spawn in Night Harbor, on the cliff overlooking the tunnel entrance to Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane.

sections.title: Part 2
sections.text:
Head Researcher Aashir in Night Harbor.

You will find Head Researcher Aashir on the cliff overlooking the tunnel entrance to Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane.  He is at the tent with Litutent.




You say, "Hail, Head Researcher Aashir."

Head Researcher Aashir says, "H-h-hello... M-my apologies, I'm still trying to calm down after escaping the attack on our dig site."

You say, "What Dig Site?"

Head Researcher Aashir says, "We've been researching one of the old ruins in the Shaded Dunes. The location is quite interesting, but unfortunately, I lost my journal during the attack.

You say, "What Cultists?"

Head Researcher Aashir says, "I've heard reports of cultists int he nearby hills and stories of foreign cultists making their way into Night Harbor recently. How are we supposed to work in these conditions?

You say, "What Journal?"

Head Researcher Aashir says, "Yes! I likely lost it as I fled. It contained all of my research notes... I'll pay handsomely for it's return.

Give the Completed Aashir's Jorunal to Head Researcher Aashir.




You gain experience!!


Your faction standing with SCEAS got better.

Head Researcher Aashir snatches the journal from your hands.
Head Researcher Aashir says, "You've found my journal! I can't believe this... what amazing luck!
Head Researcher Aashir says, "You have my enternal gratitude for this. It's not much, but please take this.
Head Researcher Aashir unhooks the hoop form his ear and gives it to you.

You receive Aashir's Earring from Head Researcher Aashir

sections.title: Part 1
sections.text:
Read Rolled Leafscroll you start with as a new Fighter Character:

To whom it may concern,

Your martial skill has been noted by the Wyrdguard, and we would be honored to have your strength added to our own.

New protectors are needed now more than ever in this turbulent age, when corruption abounds and shadows threaten the Weald from all sides.

We invite your to bear this letter to [[Captain Vaelric Ironbark]], who resides within the Sentinels Gaze garrison. 

To reach the garrison, follow the signage past the inn and toward the stage ar the Willows Whisper. Climb the main ascent behind the stage to reach the Traders Terrace, then continue up the central ramp and cross the span opposite the tanner.

The local guard can direct you further should you inquire with hem.

                                         Fair shades to you,
                                -Commander Elydris Stormbough

Step by step way : To reach the garrison, take the lift. You can double click on the bell and it will come down. Double click again for it to go up. Go left to the the inn, go  up right, right (in a right angle), when you see Pine Brightreed go up left. You'll be on the Traders Terrace, go toward the weapons armor sign and take the ramp on the left of Taelin Goldstem. Take the bridge on your left, go left in the Sentinels Gaze and Captain Vaelric Ironbark will be inside.

Hand Rolled Leafscroll to Captain Vaelric Ironbark in the Sentinels Gaze

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Captain Vaelric Ironbark accepts the scroll and offers you a curt nod. His gaze is stern and piercing as he seems to immediately size up your worth in a heartbeat.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "Good. The Wyrdguard are in need of strong arms. I'm glad that you've answered the call."
Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "I would induct you immediately if I could, but first, we must make sure you're capable of arming yourself before I can entrust you to the field."
Captain Vaelric Ironbark turns your note around and scrawls something on the back before handing it back to you.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "Take this note to Craftguard Vinebrow at the garrison forge. He'll instruct you further. Dismissed.."

You receive Scrawled Leafscroll from Captain Vaelric Ironbark.

Hand Scrawled Leafscroll to Craftguard Vinebrow a few meters away.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Craftguard Vinebrow snatches the note and scans the contents quickly. Nodding, he trusts a small kit into your hand while gesturing toward the nearby weapon racks.
Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Take this kit and grab yourself a used blade from the rack, recruit. The Wyrdguard don't carry rusted filth onthe the field."
Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Once you've chosen a blade, place it in the kit along with the bar of wax to bring out the blade's luster. Show it to me once you've finished."
Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I'll be here if you have any questions."

You receive Sharpening Kit from Craftguard Vinebrow.

You receive Wasp Wax Bar from Craftguard Vinebrow.

Come closer to the racks and use /look /inspect rack /take weapon

You receive Patinated Elven Blade.


Put together the Patinated Elven Blade and the Wasp Wax Bar in the Sharpening Kit.

You receive Tarnished Elven Blade.


Give the blade to Craftguard Vinebrow for the next step.

Craftguard Vinebrow holds the blade aloft and gazes down its length, inspecting your work. After a short moment, he offers a grunt of satisfaction and returns the blade to you.
Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Your bevel could use some work, but that will comme with practice. You've managed to deburr the edge, and that's the most important part."
Craftguard Vinebrow says, "A burr folding over the edge of a blade can easily form a chip. A chip can lead to a fragile blade, and a fragile blade can lead to death."
Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Now, take your weapon and show it to Captain Ironbark. Inform him that you're ready to set out... and don't forget to maintain your equipement!."

You receive Tarnished Elven Blade from Craftguard Vinebrow.

Give the blade to Captain Vaelric Ironbark for the next step.

Captain Vaelric Ironbark accepts the offered blade and gives it one crisp, precise strike through the air. The blade almost hums after being handled by the veteran captain. He then offers it back to you.

You receive Tarnished Elven Blade from Captain Vaelric Ironbark.

Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "Well done. You've chosen yourself a suitable weapon. I'm confident now that I can send you to the forest floor."
Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "Are you ready for your first assignment ?"
You says, "I am ready."

You receive Pouch for Skulls from Captain Vaelric Ironbark.

Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "Take this pouch. Descend to the forest floor and rid it of the undead that have recently made a presence there."
Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "If you can fill the bag with their shattered skulls, you'll have taken your first step toward becoming a true Wyrdguard and protecting the Weald from unnatural threats."
Captain Vaelric Ironbark briskly salutes you before offering one last piece of advice.
Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "...And don't venture into the ruins, young one. Too many have tried."

From here on, you have two choices. Go back to the starting lift (do not take the lift close to the quest npc) and drop 4 Shattered Skull from Rottings Skeletons roaming in the zone. Or buy them and fuse them in the bundle. Then, give it back to Captain Vaelric Ironbark.

Captain Vaelric sighs in relief as you return with the filled pouch of skulls. He sets it aside with a nod.

Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "I was dreading that I may have sent a young warrior to their doom, but you've shown that you can look after yourself out in the Weald."
Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "I can now confidently issue you this emblazoned chain as a sign of your induction as a novice of the Wyrdguard."

You receive Novice Chain of the Wyrdguard from Captain Vaelric Ironbark.

Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "When you have a little more experience in the field, report yourself to Commander Elydris Stormbough and display your chain shirt to her."
Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "She'll proceed with your induction and likely assign you a new task. Shades protect you. Dismissed, novice!"

sections.title: Part 2
sections.text:
(Level 4 is needed) Give your Novice Chain of the Wyrdguard to Commander Elydris Stormbough

Commander Elydris Stormbough inspects the state of your chainmail and nods approvingly. She returns it to you, alongside a rolled note.
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Allow me to introduce myself. I am Elydris Stormbough, Commander of the Wyrdguard, and I humbly thank you for adding your strength to our own."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "As you have no doubt noticed out on the field, the presence of undead and orcs has become egregious. They must be contended with."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Our scouts are already looking into their source, while the druids counter their foul magic. I am assigning all available fighters to combat this presence through force of arms."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Are you willing to participate on the front lines?"

/say yes

Commander Elydris Stormbough offers a satisfactory nod.

Commander Elydris Stormbough hands you a note.

Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Take the note I have given you to Craftguard Vinebrow. I believe you have already been acquainted, yes? He is to help you improve the weapon that you found in the armoury."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Once you have had your weapon worked on, return to me for further instruction. If you misplaced your weapon, you will have to inform Vinebrow. Though I pray you do not have to."

Give the note to Craftguard Vinebrow.

Craftguard Vinebrow accepts the note and gives it a quick glance, acknowledging the message with a firm nod.
Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I hope you've learned by now how important it is to have a proper weapon! Though it appears the commander would like to see you wielding something that isn't just a polished edge."
Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I think I know what your blade needs, but we're currently running low on ore for smelting. Would you be able to help get me some supplies?"

/say I will get supplies.

Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I'll need about four copper bars and two cloth scraps for what I have in mind. Mine it, buy it, smelt it... I don't care how you get it."
Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Just get everything into that satchel and pack it up neatly before returning to me, along with your blade."

Combine four Copper Bar and two Cloth Scraps in the satchel and hand it back to Craftguard Vinebrow with the Tarnished Elven Blade.

Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Hmm, good. This should be enough. Give me one moment while I stoke the forge."
Craftguard Vinebrow separates your blade from the hilt and begins heating the worn steel until it becomes molten. He inspects the metal curiously, then gives it a few strikes with his hammer and lets out a grunt of satisfaction.
Craftguard Vinebrow proceeds to similarly heat the copper and incorporate it into your blade, folding the two metals together into an alloy. He then quenches the revitalized blade and reassembles the hilt, wrapping it in the cloth.
Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Very interesting. You found this in the weapon racks, did you? That steel doesn't normally fuse so well with copper."
Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I'd love to experiment further with it, but I'm not about to leave one of our young fighters without a blade. Here, you can bring this back to the Commander to show her your equipped."
Craftguard Vinebrow says, "And don't lose this one! I feel like we can do more with it when the time is right."

Craftguard Vinebrow hands you the Bronzed Elven Blade.


Hand the Bronzed Elven Blade to Commander Elydris Stormbough.

Commander Elydris Stormbough examines your blade and offers a satisfied nod.
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "A curious alloy, but that is a discussion for another time. What matters now that it is able to strike at the enemy force quickly and efficiently."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Here, take your weapon back, along with this satchel."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "You will be part of this strike, fighter. Our fighters have been tasked with engaging the orcish encampments that have sprung up along the southeastern cliffs. Are you ready to participate in the assault?"

/say yes

Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Fellstone forces have hidden themselves amongst the cliffs and ruins, so we have not been able to determine their precise location from the heights of Faelindral."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "We suspect they have a talented scout leader who is helping keep their emplacements concealed. You are to locate these camps and assault them until you have drawn out this leader of theirs."

Commander Elydris Stormbough hands you a satchel.

Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Fill the satchel with the belts of their warriors, then return it to me along with the scout leader's head and your novice chain."

Combine four Fellstone Warrior's Belts in the satchel to form Full Satchel of Orc Belts and hand it to Commander Elydris Stormbough along with Scout Leader's Head and Novice Chain of the Wyrdguard.

Commander Elydris Stormbough checks the satchel's contents and confirms the orcish equipment, alongside the trophy head. She nods.
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "An impressive feat for a novice, well done. The orcs will dare not forget this strike when they attempt to match themselves against the might of the Wyrdguard."
Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "I had this prepared for you, fighter, as the news of your victory was forseen. Wear it with pride."

You receive Striker's Chain of the Wyrdguard from Commander Elydris Stormbough.

Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "You are dismissed for now; however, you should take this opportunity to practice your dance with that weapon. I am certain that Vinebrow would be interested in seeing it once it has endured a few more deployments."

sections.text:
Experience

Steel Talon Trainee Tunic (Fighter)
Steel Talon's Recruit Breastplate

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read Notice of Recruitment you start with as a new Fighter Character:

Recruit:

You are to deliver this note to Fedamius Steele III
in the Steel Talons Garrison to begin your training.

He can be found observing the courtyard from his 
post on the wall above.

If you get lost, ask a guard. Any guard worth their
salt will know his name.

And be quick about it.

-Steel Talons Recruitment

Head to the Steel Talons Martial Academy on the Southwest side of Night Harbor and hand in your Notice of Recruitment to Fedamius Steel III

You gain experience!!

Fedamius Steele III says, "Speak quickly, and don't mince your words."
Fedamius Steele III glares at you before reading the note.
Fedamius Steele III says, "So, you want to join the Fighter Corps of the Steel Talons? Hmph... you and a few hundred others. What makes you special?"
Fedamius Steele III considers you again.
Fedamius Steele III says, "We'll see if you have what it takes soon enough... Go speak to my sister, Lurinda. Give her your note."
Fedamius Steele III says, "Now get moving."

Head down to the courtyard and hand in your Notice of Recruitment to Lurinda Steele

You gain experience!!

Lurinda Steele says, "By Porbor's shriveled organ, we've got another one! You would-be recruits are stumbling in faster than copper coin falling from a drunkard's pouch!"
Lurinda Steele sizes you up.
Lurinda Steele says, "But you might not be a complete waste of time. Speaking of a waste of time, take your note to my son Elrind to file. He'll complete your registration at the academy so you can start your training."
Lurinda Steele says, "While you're at it, tell him to give you the research he's supposed to have finished for me."
Lurinda Steele says, "You'll find him in the academy's library - if he's not skulking about the entrance to the garrison's tavern again."
Lurinda Steele says, "MOVE!"
Lurinda Steele motions you away.

Head into southern entrance to the academy and hand in your Notice of Recruitment to Elrind Steele

You gain experience!!

Elrind Steele widens his eyes in awe.
Elrind Steele says, "My, don't you look mighty."
Elrind Steele quickly dons a serious expression as he scans the note deliberately.
Elrind Steele says, "You're wanting to complete your registration at the academy, then. I'm sure you're eager to start your training."
Elrind Steele says, "Unfortunately, it might be weeks before I can file your application. Mother has tasked me with important research, so I'm very busy. Unless..."
Elrind Steele says, "Maybe we can help each other. If you gather the items for my research, I can expedite your registration. How does that sound? Truth be told, I'd rather stay in the library anyway."
Elrind Steele says, "Here's the list of items, as well as some charcoal and parchment for the frottage."

You receive Elrind's List from Elrind Steele.

You receive Charcoal from Elrind Steele.

You receive Parchment from Elrind Steele.

Head out the west gate to kill a rotting skeletons, a snakes, and a fire beetles

Keep killing until you receive a Skeleton Jawbone, a Snake Fang, and a Fire Beetle Eye. Alternatively you can buy them.
Then head towards the stone pillar outside of the cave to Wyrmsbane.
/rub inscription when you are standing next to the pillar to receive Frottage of Inscriptions

Return to Elrind Steele and hand him the Frottage of Inscriptions, Skeleton Jawbone, Snake Fang, and Fire Beetle Eye

You gain experience!!

Elrind Steele accepts the items with reverence.
Elrind Steele says, "Welcome to the Steel Talons. I'll file your papers with the others under Status - Currently Alive"
Elrind Steele says, "Here is the research that my mother requested. You're also more than welcome to discard the list I previously gave you, as you'll no longer need it."
Elrind Steele says, "Come back some time, maybe we'll find a way to help each other again... unless your status changes, of course"

You receive Elrind's Research from Elrind Steele.

Return to Lurinda Steele and hand her Elrind's Research

You gain experience!!

Lurinda Steele says, "What took yo uso long? Did Elrind send you on one of his scavenger hunts? Never mind. Don't keep me waiting again."
Lurinda Steele says, "Take this tunic. It will identify you as one of our trainees."
Lurinda Steele says, "We practice in the garrison, but true training occurs in the field. And this is where the Steel Talons excel."
Lurinda Steele says, "That's why our most promising members are sought after by the Night Harbor Guard or the Red Mantles."
Lurinda Steele says, "The Ashira have been harassing the city's borders and this is as good as an opportunity as ever to support the efforts of the Night Harbor Guard and the Red Mantles, and to distinguish yourself as a competent member of the Steel Talons."
Lurinda Steele says, "Fill this pack with proof of your assistance in culling the Ashira menace. Their warriors' bracers will do. Let our archers tend to their scouts."

You receive Steel Talon Trainee Tunic from Lurinda Steele.

You receive Lurinda's Pack from Lurinda Steele.

sections.title: Part 2
sections.text:
Return to Lurinda Steele and hand her Combined 6 Ashira Warrior Bracers

You gain experience!!

Lurinda Steele says, "Things have been moving quickly in Night Harbor lately. Both the City Watch and the Red Mantles are taking recruits all recruits we can muster."
Lurinda Steele says, "You're not quite there yet, but clearly you have potential. Keep up the good work."
Lurinda Steele says, "Take this note and your tunic to Fedamius. You're getting a promotion."

Receive Lurinda's Note

Return to Fedamius Steel III and hand him Tunic and Lurinda's Note

You gain experience!!

Fedamius Steel III says, "Hmph... if Lurinda thinks you're worth promoting, then maybe there's more to you than I initially thought."

Fedamius Steel III looks genuinely pleased.

Fedamius Steel III says, "Take this and wear it with pride. You've earned it, recruit."
Fedamius Steel III says, "Now, while you've got some downtime, visit the towers along the city's western wall and make yourself known to a captain. It's good for our candidates to get to know their future leadership."

You receive Steel Talon's Recruit Breastplate from Fedamius Steel III.

It is safe to discard Elrind's List.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Delilah is located just outside the left (west) entrance to the newbie area in the Underdocks, standing next to the Guards at the gate.

You say, "Hail, Delilah."

Delilah says, "Hi!"

Delilah looks around frantically.

Delilah says, "Have you seen a small and incredibly cute turtle?"

You say, "What turtle?"

Delilah says, "I have a pet deepshell turtle named Amari."

Delilah says, "He is usually always by my side, but today, he has decided to wander off."

Delilah says, "My Pa told me that I could not go past the guards, ever!"

Delilah says, "Could you help me and go find him?"

You say, "I will help you find Amari"

Delilah says, "Thank you! Thank you!"

Delilah says, "He is very fond of mushrooms so I would start your search there. I can see a bunch from here.

Delilah says, "I would go look but I can't. It's too dangerous for me."

Exiting the left gate to newbie zone, locate the Green mushroom on the wall towards the Northwest. You will find a small pond with green mushrooms surrounding a a friendly undercap

/look

Standing beside this pool of water is a friendly-looking myconid.

You say, "Hail, a friendly undercap."

a friendly undercap smiles at you, while holding a small turtle under his arm.

You say, "May I have that turtle?"

a friendly undercap gently rubs the turtle on the head.

a friendly undercap points to a stack of bone chips near his leg.

Hand a friendly undercap 4 unstacked Bone Chips

a friendly undercap hugs the turtle.

a friendly undercap hands the turtle to you.

You receive Amari from a friendly undercap.

Hand in Amari to Delilah.

Delilah says, "Amari! I have missed you so much."

Delilah says, "Never run off like that again!"

Delilah says, "When I first found Amari as a small turtle, he was near a giant, old shell."

Delilah says, "I have no use for it."

Delilah says, "Please accept it as a token of my gratitude."

You receive Giant Turtle Shell Shield from Delilah

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Citizens of Underdocks got better.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
?

Experience

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, "Where is Dhug?"

Foreman Stonehammer says, "Dhug is one of mine. I mean, he's on the payroll, but we go a ways back."

Foreman Stonehammer says, "Findin' him shouldn't be too difficult.  He'll be easy to spot for one, he's a dwarf, and he's always wearing his lucky charm 'round his neck."

Foreman Stonehammer says, "The last thing he told me was that he wanted to check out some glint along the north side of the quarry.  Find him and send him back to me."

Foreman Stonehammer says, "If he tries to refuse, let him know I'll dock his pay!"

<Unclear resolution>

quests.title: Fizzle Screwtape's Critical Research
quests.classText: Archer | Bard | Beastmaster | Cleric | Druid | Fighter | Inquisitor | Monk | Paladin | Ranger | Rogue | Shadow Knight | Shaman | Spellblade

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Horn of the Sea

or

Sea Giant's Handkerchief

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, Fizzle Screwtape."

Fizzle Screwtape says, "Who are you, now? Did Tariq send you? I can complete this assignment without oversight, thank you very much."

Fizzle Screwtape says, "My research is critical to the future of the Silver Ledger, Dwarf. I must find... well, never you mind that."

Fizzle Screwtape says, "I do have a task that needs doing, however... if you wish to make yourself useful."

You say, "task"

Fizzle Screwtape says, "There's an island across from the harbor that's infested with basilisks. Vile creatures, and much too large. Scour the island and bring back and objects that may aid my research."

*proceed to swim to the island directly across from the docks - in the centre of the island is a giant skeleton"

*type /look at the skull"

The sun-bleached bones of a giant lie scattered in the sand.

*type /take skull"

Sand falls away from the skull's empty cavity as you lift it from the sand. It is heavy and awkward to hold.

*proceed to swim back to Fizzle Screwtape and Give Fizzle Screwtape 1x Giant Skull.

Fizzle Screwtape barely lifts the skull in his dainty hands.

Fizzle Screwtape says, "What am I to do with this? A giant's skull... adolescent, by the looks of it. You can keep it, Dwarf."

Fizzle Screwtape says, "You're still alive, at least. My previous assistants didn't fare quite as well. Now, get back out there and find something of real worth. I don't care if you have to exterminate every single basilisk to do it. In fact, that might be for the best."

*proceed to swim back to the island with the basilisks and kill until you find a rare drop artifact off of a basilisk"

*Note that basiliks cannot be slowed, stunned, charmed.*

*swim back to Fizzle Screwtape and Give Fizzle Screwtape 1x Bile-Drenched Artifact."

Fizzle Screwtape mumbles to himself as he examines the much-encrusted object.

Fizzle Screwtape says, "This might be something, Dwarf, but we can't determine its worth while it's in this condition. I need to clean it with the right implement."

Fizzle Screwtape says, "Perhaps a sea sponge will do a trick. Hold on to this for now. Find a suitable sponge so that we may continue."

Give Fizzle Screwtape 1x Pristine Sea Sponge and 1x Bile-Drenched Artifact.

Fizzle Screwtape says, "Aha! So you found one. Nevermind how you got it."

Cheikho says, "Look around friend! How did you make it this far without dying?"

Fizzle Screwtape scrubs the artifact furiously with the sea sponge. As the much and grime slough off, you begin to see strange markings upon the object.

Fizzle Screwtape says, "See these markings, Dwarf? Like whirlpools. I've seen them before, but I can't recall..."

Fizzle Screwtape says, "Please, fetch me Luum's Giant Glossary from the shelf."

*climb up the ladder to the top book shelf"

You say, "/look"

These shelves are dedicated to history books.

You say, "/take book"

You carefully retrieve the book from the shelf.

receive 1x Luum's Giant Glossary.

give Fizzle Screwtape 1x Luum's Giant Glossary.

Fizzle Screwtape mutters as he flips through the pages of the old tome.

Fizzle Screwtape sighs.

Fizzle Screwtape says, "It's as I thought. Worthless."

Fizzle Screwtape says, "I'm afraid your time has been wasted, Dwarf. This artifact is of no use to me."

Fizzle Screwtape says, "Take the artifact and this report to Tariq. Should you ever find anything of real value, you know where to find me."

receive 1x Fizzle Screwtape's Report.

receive 1x Horn of the Sea.

*go outside and upstairs to Tariq the Revealer"

Give Tariq the Revealer 1x Fizzle Screwtape's Report and 1x Horn of the Sea.

Tariq the Revealer says, "A valuable object, no doubt, but I'm afraid my underling is correct. We have no use for it. You may keep it for yourself, or return it to its rightful owner."

You say, "rightful owner"

Tariq the Revealer says, "These markings indicate that the horn belongs to those whose kingdoms once rose from the depths of the ocean... the Sealords."

Tariq the Revealer says, "Upon the island where you found this artifact stands a ruined pedestal. Place the horn upon it. If one of the Sealords wishes to claim it, you may be rewarded for your trouble."

Tariq the Revealer says, "Do keep in mind that the Sealords are creatures of the depths. They're likely to spurn the light of Eth."

*Swim back to the far side of the island where there is a ruined pedestal in the sand."

You say, "/look"

A simple pedestal emerges from the sandy shore.

This must be done at night.

You say, "/place pedestal"

The waters begin to stir...

This spawns a giant named Ngakepoto from the water.

give Ngakepoto 1x Horn of the Sea.

receive 1x Sea Giant's Handkerchief.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
For a full set of Fungal armor, you will need:

7x Strong Fungus Hyphea
5x Perfect Fungus Cap
4x Perfect Fungus Volva
3x Perfect Fungus Stem

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Change Language to Deep Common
Be sure you have set your language to Deep Common (right-click Main Chat window > Languages > Deep Common), or quest NPCs may not respond to your prompts.

You say in Deep Common, "Hail, Leatherworker Vex."

Leatherworker Vex says, "You breathe still?  Good. Most who come here are already food for what lurks in the shadows."

Leatherworker Vex says, "I am Vex. I stitch what the Deep provides into something that keeps you alive longer."

You say in Deep Common, "What is something that could keep me alive longer?"

Leatherworker Vex says, "Do you seek protection or purpose? I can give you both if you care to aim above the rest."

You say in Deep Common, "I seek protection."

Leatherworker Vex says, "In the caves of the Deep one race has thrived the most. They grow in darkness, they consume death, and they do not break. The myconids."

Leatherworker Vex says, "Bring me the intact parts of the mature ones, and I will stitch them into armor that protects your flesh."

Leatherworker Vex says, "I can fashion a coat, leggings, helm and boots."

sections.title: Fungal Coat
sections.text:
You say in Deep Common, "What Coat?"

Leatherworker Vex says, "For the coat, I require three perfect fungus caps, two strong fungus hyphea, and one perfect fungus stem."

Leatherworker Vex says, "The cap forms the plates, the hyphea binds them, and the stem reinforces the spine."

Hunt a cave myconid and loot 3x Perfect Fungus Cap, 2x Strong Fungus Hyphea and 1x Perfect Fungus Stem. Hand these items to Leatherworker Vex.

Leatherworker Vex takes the items and carefully layers the caps, weaves the hyphea through them, and reinforces the seams with the stem. The armor pulses faintly with bioluminescence.

Leatherworker Vex says, "It is done. Wear it well. The Deep recognizes its own."

You receive Fungal Coat from Leatherworker Vex.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with House Velgarrith got better.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Ail'Vorith got better.

As a Level 6 Deep Elf Archer on 2026-09-21, my faction for House Velgarrith was set to almost full Indifferent, and I gained 1 blue bar of faction with Citizens of Ail'vorith.

sections.title: Fungal Helm
sections.text:
You say in Deep Common, "What Helm?"

Leatherworker Vex says, "For the helm, I require two perfect fungus caps and one strong fungus hyphea."

Leatherworker Vex says, "The caps shield the skull, and the hyphea cushions the brow. Do not bring damaged caps; they will crack under pressure."

Hunt a cave myconid and loot 2x Perfect Fungus Cap and 1x Strong Fungus Hyphea. Hand these items to Leatherworker Vex.

Leatherworker Vex takes the items and molds the caps into a dome, lines the interior with hyphea, and seals the edges. The helm glows softly.

Leatherworker Vex says, "Your head and mind are now shielded. Do not let the whispers in."

You receive Fungal Helm from Leatherworker Vex.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with House Velgarrith got better.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Ail'Vorith got better.

As a Level 6 Deep Elf Archer on 2026-09-21, I gained one full bar plus one blue bar from Indifferent to Amicably with House Velgarrith, and I gained a tenth of a blue bar of faction with Citizens of Ail'vorith.

sections.title: Fungal Leggings
sections.text:
You say in Deep Common, "What Leggings?"

Leatherworker Vex says, "For the leggings, I require two perfect fungus stems, two strong fungus hyphea, and two perfect fungus volva."

Leatherworker Vex says, "The stems form the greaves, the hyphea allows movement, and the volva protects the knee."

Hunt a cave myconid and loot 2x Perfect Fungus Volva, 2x Strong Fungus Hyphea and 2x Perfect Fungus Stem. Hand these items to Leatherworker Vex.

Leatherworker Vex accepts the items and shapes the stems into greaves, binds them with hyphea, and caps the knee with the volva. The leggings flex silently.

Leatherworker Vex says, "This should allow you some protection while still being able to move quietly."

You receive Fungal Leggings from Leatherworker Vex.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with House Velgarrith got better.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Ail'Vorith got better.

As a Level 6 Deep Elf Archer on 2026-09-21, I gained one full bar plus one blue bar from Indifferent to Amicably with House Velgarrith, and I gained a tenth of a blue bar of faction with Citizens of Ail'vorith.

sections.title: Fungal Boots
sections.text:
You say in Deep Common, "What Boots?"

Leatherworker Vex says, "For the boots, I require two perfect fungus volva and two strong fungus hyphea."

Leatherworker Vex says, "The volva forms the sole, and the hyphea wraps the ankles. Silent tread is the gift of the fungus."

Hunt a cave myconid and loot 2x Perfect Fungus Volva and 2x Strong Fungus Hyphea. Hand these items to Leatherworker Vex.

Leatherworker Vex takes the items from you and flattens the volva into soles, then wraps the hyphea around the ankles, and stitches the seams. The boots make almost no sound when set down.

Leatherworker Vex says, "Tread softly, the Deep rewards silence."

You receive Fungal Boots from Leatherworker Vex.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with House Velgarrith got better.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Ail'Vorith got better.

Any further breadcrumbs when a full set is acquired...?

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Barkeep Glior says,"Blast and bother, another shipment's gone missing!"
Barkeep Glior says, "Twas supposed to be a regular run from here to the Wreck of the Wanderer. Word is, it just vanished outta thin air..."
Barkeep Glior says, "Duval's got his cutlasses out over it. If you can find out what happened, he'll owe you a favor. Just Tell him I sent you and ask about the Ghost Haul."


Go speak to Crowne Duval, up in Captain Jonas Cossa's tent. 




Crowne Duval says, "Hand over your finest treasures and the Cossa pirates will let you sail under our protection."

You say, "Glinor told me to ask you about the Ghost Haul."

Crowne Duval says, "Ah, so you know that damn haul disappeared?! Captain will have my skin if I don't find out what happened quickly."

Crowne Duval says, "Care to lend a hand?"

You say, "I'll lend a hand."

Crowne Duval Says, "I can't leave my post right now, so please travel to the Wreck of the Wanderer, straight north of here beyond the Landing. You can't miss the shipwreck, it has a very high mast still rising from the waters. It's where the deal was to take place."

Crowne Duval says, "Find what's happened there!"




Head out to Zaedin's Landing. Head north and there will be a shipwreck near a cluster of rocks. 




/Look reveals - This shipwreck appears quite recent. The area is littered with broken crates and bottles, telltale signs of a struggle. Could not figure out a prompt that worked to give more information.




Nearby is Castaway Island. Enforcer Gritjaw spawns within the bungalow on the island. Kill him and loot Crate of Stolen Spices.




Take Crate of Stolen Spices back to Crowne Duval.




Crowne Duval says, "Excellent, it still smells fresh!"

Crown Duval says, "So some new guys are out there thinkin' they can steal our stuff? Captain needs to hear about it."

Work in progress

6/21/26 - no follow-up noted with any prompts used. Appears to be a faction reward only.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest needs detailed dialogue for each step and turn in, along with xp, faction hits, coin.

Acquire Warped Scale from a warped fae near druid mushroom circle in Evershade Weald. This item doesn't always drop. a warped fae always spawns at 2AM game time. It will path to the Glinting Hollow zoneline and despawn if left untouched.

Acquire Twisted Scale from a twisted fae up the ramp near the broken undead ruins by the Keeper's Bight zoneline. This item doesn't always drop. a twisted fae always spawns at 3AM game time. It will path to the Glinting Hollow zoneline and despawn if left untouched.

Turn in a Spark of Magic (via  Disenchanting) to Sporeweaver Underveil in the mushroom cave to receive Ancient Mushroom Powder.

Turn in Twisted Scale and Warped Scale to Lilac Latespring to get Bundle of Scales.

Turn in Bundle of Scales and Ancient Mushroom Powder to Sersil Tangleroot to receive Glowing Fae Scale.

Turn in Glowing Fae Scale to Lilac Latespring to receive a 2nd version of it with a different tooltip which is the final key.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
2026-09-11 - Possible unfinished or breadcrumb quest. More information is required.

Innkeeper Farda has recently expanded her business by acquiring the building next door from some Deep Gnomes. Farda's employees mention these gnomes may have met an unfortunate demise attempting to sell Mushroom Wood to denizens in Night Harbor.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest begins in the Underdocks western district inside an inn on the southern rise by speaking with Innkeeper Farda.

You say, "Hail, Innkeeper Farda."

Innkeeper Farda says, "I have good food and safe rooms. Coins are paid up front for a stay or a meal. And keep your animals outside."

Innkeeper Farda says, "That includes Goblins."

You say, "Why do you dislike Goblins?"

Innkeeper Farda says, "They make a mess and only cause trouble. I don't work to lose money."

You say, "I want some food"

Innkeeper Farda says, "The dining room is on the second floor. Just head up those stairs behind me and you will smell the food at the top."

You say, "I want a room"

Innkeeper Farda says, "Take a look for yourself. Downstairs rooms if you have fewer coin and upstairs if you have more."

Innkeeper Farda says, "And do not mind the current layout. The building next door was a... recent acquisition"

You say, "Tell me about your recent acquisition"

Innkeeper Farda says, "The tenants next door fell on hard times. I took on their debt and now this entire building is mine."

Innkeeper Farda doesn't have much else to share. Head upstairs and chat with Barkeeper Tull.

You say, "Hail, Barkeeper Tull."

Barkeeper Tull says, "Yes, hail to you too. I haven't much time since I'm ferrying plates up and down these stairs all day."

You say, "Why are you ferrying plates up and down these stairs all day?"

Barkeeper Tull says, "It wasn't so bad before Farda kicked those gnomes out of the unit next door. The kitchen used to be so close, but more rooms to sleep means more coins to keep, so now I'm burning my legs going up and down all day."

You say, "Who were the gnomes?"

Barkeeper Tull says, "Bad business that. But Farda had her eye on that unit for a while."

Barkeeper Tull says, "They always thought they could make it big bringing shroom wood above ground but... well, we see how that went."

Tull does not provide much more information, but he does respond to inquiries about his colleagues.

You say, "Who is Farda?"

Barkeeper Tull says, "She owns this inn. Not much humor in her, but she keeps me well employed."

Head outside into the adjacent building and speak with Chef Brigit

You say, "Hail, Chef Brigit."

Chef Brigit says, "Are you lost? You don't look like a new server. This is my kitchen and I don't need you sneaking a taste of my meals."

You say, "I am a new server"

Chef Brigit looks you up and down, unimpressed.

Chef Brigit says, "Why don't you go in the other entrance and talk to Farda. She can help you."

Chef Brigit says, "She runs this place. If you need a room, go speak with her. And don't try to bargain with her or she'll raise the prices on you."

Chef Brigit waves her hands at you in an impatient gesture.

Chef Brigit says, "Off with you now, shoo!"

You say, "Tell me about Barkeeper Tull"

Chef Brigit says, "Where is that rascal? I have three meals waiting to go upstairs."

You can return to Barkeeper Tull and he responds to an inquiry about Brigit, but doesn't share anything else.

You say, "Who is Brigit?"

Barkeeper Tull says, "You'll find her in the kitchen. I try not to spend much time there. It gets too hot for me."

More information is required

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Find Takalea Scaletender, located at the tannery in Faelindral.

You say, "Hail, Takalea Scaletender."

Takalea Scaletender says, "Fair shades to you, friend! Have you come to explore the ways of tanning and hide? It's rewarding trade that will have you learning about every facet of Aethoril's beasts."

You say, "I have come to explore the ways of tanning and hide."

Takalea Scaletender says, "Everything you need to learn the basics of leatherworking should be here at the tannery, from workstations to supplies. Just don't inhale too many fumes from the tanning vats!"

You say, "Tell me about Aethoril's beasts."

Takalea Scaletender says, "Oh yes! From the thick hide of a monstrous grizzly, to the supple skin of a desert serpent; leatherworkers are capable of taking nature's protection and making it our own."

Takalea Scaletender says, "Why, even my own attire was fashioned from the scales of young drakelings."

You say, "What drakelings?"

Takalea Scaletender says, "Caught your attention, did it?"

Takalea Scaletender says, "I've found that drakeling scales have a remarkable protective qualities for their size. I imagine it has to do with their inherent magical nature."

How do we know to ask about materials here?

You say, "What materials are required?"

Takalea Scaletender says, "That depends... which piece are you interested in? I can fashion boots, a cloak, pants, or a coat for you out of green drakeling parts."

How do we know to ask about the Poison Ducts here?

You say, "ducts"

Takalea Scaletender says, "The ducts can be rather rare, but they're also quite important for the larger pieces I can make. The poisonous secretions can be turned into a lacquer that gives the scales a real luster!"

sections.title: Green Drakeling Scale Coat
sections.text:
You say, "What Coat?"

Need dialogue from Takalea here.

Turn in 6 x Green Drakeling Scale, 2 x Green Drakeling Wing, 4 x Green Drakeling Hide, 1 x Green Drakeling Poison Duct to Takalea Scaletender.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Defenders of Faelindral got better.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Faelindral got better.

Takalea Scaletender says, "Incredible! You really must have put a dent in the drakeling population down there, huh? Let me get to work right away."

Takalea Scaletender expertly fashions the drakeling parts into a beautiful coat that glistens with green scales.

Takalea Scaletender says, "Here you are friend! I hope it protects you as much as it does me."

You receive Green Drakeling Scale Coat from Takalea Scaletender.

sections.title: Green Drakeling Scale Cloak

Need dialogue from Takalea here.

Turn in 3 x Green Drakeling Scale, 2 x Green Drakeling Wing, 1 x Green Drakeling Hide to Takalea Scaletender.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Defenders of Faelindral got better.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Faelindral got better.

Takalea Scaletender says, "Ah, this should be just enough! One moment friend, while I get to work."

Takalea Scaletender carefully fashions the hide and scales into a sturdy green cloak.

Takalea Scaletender says, "There all done! No adventurer should go without a reliable cloak on their shoulders. It's all yours friend."

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Defenders of Faelindral got better.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Faelindral got better.

Takalea Scaletender says, "Wonderful! It's rare to come across and intact poison duct, so you must be rather fortunate! I'll get to work straight away."

Takalea Scaletender carefully fashions the drakeling parts into a set of durable pants.

Takalea Scaletender says, "There, one set of drakeling scale pants! May they serve you well friend."

sections.title: Green Drakeling Scale Boots

Your faction standing with Defenders of Faelindral got better.

Takalea Scaletender says, "Great work! I should be able to make some nice sturdy boots with this. One moment..."

Takalea Scaletender quickly stitches together a pair of rugged boots that glint with green scales.

Takalea Scaletender says, "Here you are, friend! A good solid pair of boots can never be underestimated."

quests.title: Growing Threat of the Sangrel Fist

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Sigil of Inquiry
Sigil of Honor

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, Reeve Thurston Winter"

Ree says, "Greeting. I am Reeve Thurston Winter, charged with keeping order in Penshaw."


Re says, "These are hard times, and what peace we have left is easilyt broken. We have opened our doors to capale outsiders willing to help us face a growing threat."

You say, "What outside threat?"

Re says, "The Sangrel Fist has become a scourge on our roads and farms. They are ruthless thieves emboldened by their numbers, who prey on honest folk who can scarcely defend themselves."


Re says, "We cannot allow this to continue. Seek them out and then their ranks. They wear red wraps upon their hands. Bring me four as proof."

Collect 4 Sangrel Fist Wraps

Turn in to Reeve Thurston Winter in Penshaw

Receive Sigil of Inquiry

Re says, "You certainly did your part. Well done. The Sangrel Fist has brought enough fear to this village. Perhaps they'll think twice before entering our gates."


Re says, "Every bandit brought down is one less threat to oue farms and homes."


Re says, "Take this sigil. Carrying it authorizes you to privileged information, should be needed to defend Penshaw."


You receive Sigil of Inquiry from Reeve Thurston Winter.

Detective Brunsworth continues the quest line.

You say, "Hail, Detective Brunsworth."

De says, "Hail, Adventurer, and well met. I have heard good things about your services in Penshaw."


De says, "I was sent here to investigate the growing threat of the Sangrel. Their numbers have sharply increased as of late. Perhaps you would be willing to dig a little further for us?"

You say, "I will dig a little further."

De says, "Very good. We know little of what binds these cult bandits together."


De says, "This type of organization requires leadership. Go to their camps and search for clues. Whether found among their belongings or taken from those who carry them matters little."


Collect the 4 rites

Sangrel Rite I is found off Sangrels at the small sangrel camp next to the poachers.
Sangrel Rite II is found of shady farmers at the shady farm.
Sangrel Rite III is found in a tent in the large sangrel camp, you will need to use mud commands. /inspect crate inside the tent with the crate, then /take scroll to place Sangrel Rite III in your inventory.
Sangrel Rite IV is found off sangrels at the large sangrel camp.

Turn in all 4 rites to Detective Brunsworth

Re says, "How interesting... This text seems to be written in an old tongue."

Re says, "We will need an expert to translate its meaning. The abbey outside of Penshaw is home to scribes versed in fortgotten tongues. Seek their aid, and when you return with their translation, present your sigil as well so you may be properly rewarded."

You receive Sangrel Rites: Volume I - IV from a scribe of Detective Brunsworth.

Brunsworth will direct you to a scribe of Tilustra in the large church to the south of Penshaw.

a scribe of Tilustra says, "This... is not a devotional text of any tradition we preserve here. I dare not read such things aloud."

You receive Sangrel Rites: Volume I - IV (Translated) from a scribe of Tilustra.

a says, "Tilustra teaches us that knowledge is meant to illuminate, not corrupt. This text ties selfish desire to divinity... a disturbing teaching, indeed. Take care with whom you share it. There are many easily drawn to such doctrine."

Turn in the Sigil of Inquiry and Sangrel Rites: Volume I - IV (Translated) to Brunsworth.

De says, "This appears to be doctrine... a structure set of rites meant to be memorized by initiates of this cult. It attracts the sort who would rather blame fate than earn an honest living."

De says, "This is no reason to assume any truth in it. If Eyzin has followers, it is because he is persuasive, or because he understands how to manipulate desperate men."

De says, "Their success is far more likely to be practical than divine. Spies within the town, watches along the roads, or a vantage point over our docks. That is where we find answers, not in fire and ash."

De says, "I will gather further intelligence. This investigation is not concluded."

De says, "For now, you have proven capable. Take this. It is a sigil for one worthy of your skill, granted in recognition of your diligence."

You receive Sigil of Honor from Detective Brunsworth.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Boiled Beetle Legs

Experience

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Foreman Stonehammer says, "The miners are already grumbling that there's not enough chow."

Foreman Stonehammer says, "Hmmm, I think I have an idea that will solve one of our problems and fill our bellies at the same time."

You say, "What food?"

Foreman Stonehammer says, "Yes, we need more food.  I've had to portion out our rations since the shipment is late... but I think I've got an idea that could help us out..."

You say, "What idea?"

Foreman Stonehammer says, "Have ya ever had steam crab legs fresh out of the harbor?  Delicious aren't they?"

Foreman Stonehammer says, "Well, I've been think'... maybe, just maybe, these cinder beetles are kinda like those crabs."

Foreman Stonehammer says, "Bring me six tender beetle legs and I'll try cookin' them up for the crew."

Foreman Stonehammer says, "You know how to tell if the legs will be tender, don't ya?"

You say, "How will I tell if they'll be tender?"

Foreman Stonehammer says, "Yes, Yes, it must be tender meat.  Old meat is too tough."

Foreman Stonehammer says, "I'd look for cinder beetles that are younger... smaller... the hardest workers in the swarm.  Their legs will have plenty of meat on 'em."

Give Foreman Stonehammer six Tender Beetle Legs. They drop off a cinder worker.

Foreman Stonehammer says, "Yes, this will do perfectly.  Wait here a moment."

Foreman Stonehammer tosses the tender beetle legs into a pot of water.

Foreman Stonehammer stires the pot as the water begins to boil.

Foreman Stonehammer pulls a bright red beetle leg from the pot, cracks it open, and...

Foreman Stonehammer begins to eat the succulent white meat.

Foreman Stonehammer says, "This is delicious! Ya ought t' try it.  Here, and a few copper for your troubles."

You gain experience!

You receive 2x Boiled Beetle Legs from Foreman Stonehammer.

Experience

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
On the Dock's of Keeper's Blight, in the last ship, you'll find Captain Hale.

You say, "Hail, Captain Hale."

Captain Hale says, "You've picked a fine day to be poking around. You might be able to help me, though. We're in a bit of a bind."

You say, "I can help."

Captain Hale says, "The storm that blew through last night shook part of the cargo load loose, and the Harbormaster's already been warning us that if we don't recover it, it'll be a disaster."

Captain Hale says, "We're waiting on our equipment to arrive to we can retrieve it, but my crew feels uneasy about what's been lurking down there.  I can't blame them.  We all saw their shadows gliding through the waves."

You say, "What is lurking?"

Captain Hale says, "There's no mistaking it.  Great bight sharks have been circling the shallows.  Regardless, the cargo was heavy and wouldn't have floated too far.  Whatever went over would've settled on the seabed just offshore."

Captain Hale says, "We estimate we've lost at least five creates.  If you're willing to brave the water and bring them back, I'll see you paid for the trouble."

He gives you a quest to collect 5 crates lost off shore in the recent storm.

You can collect the 5 Crates using the mud commands (/look, /inspect crate, /take crate) you collect 5 Salvaged Cargo Crates to return to him. True to his word, there are Great Bight Sharks (level 20ish) which are hostile.  They're relatively easy to avoid even at much lower levels.  Once you have 5 crates, return to Captain Hale.

Captain Hale says, "Good work, Almond!  Anything left out there will be split or dragged out by tomorrow.  You saved what could be saved.  Here, as promised, take this for doing us a solid favor.  My crew already looks relieved."

You receive 20 silver from Captain Hale.

You faction standing with Langsdorfian League got better.

You faction standing with Red Mantles got better.

You faction standing with Village of Penshaw got better.

This quest is repeatable.

sections.title: House Acceptance
sections.text:
Zalethra Drezzorith is located in the Obsidian Academy upper floor. From the bridge and gate into the Foreign Quarter, enter the building straight ahead with caster trainers and go upstairs.

You say in Deep Common, "Hail, Zalethra Drezzorith."

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "Power and strength, directly leads to standing."

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "We may be here serving the Shadow and Gods, but it's politics that moves this place."

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "Our House is the one that unites Ail'vorith with its beliefs. While we follow the Queen, our dedication lies with the dark gods."

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "Your shadow is dim, all but extinguished, exiled from a lesser house that was like a flea on a dog's back. Show me your mettle. Solve a minor problem I am dealing with and I will look upon you favorably."

You say in Deep Common, "What problem?"

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "Some castaways, like yourself, deemed themselves important."

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "Started assembling and gathering arms. Chanting throughout the day and night, praying to lost gods."

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "To find them, cross the bridge to exit the Foreign Quarter."

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "From there, turn right and head down the shoreline."

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "Head past the sporelings and you will find a cave. And within that cave these miscreants."

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "Strike down these upstart cultists. Show no mercy.  Bring me their flesh. Fill this bag with their eyes.  You can keep their tears."

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "Do this or die trying. It matters not to me or my House."

You receive Small Burlap Pouch from Zalethra Drezzorith.

Cross the bridge and turn right at the Toilmaster. Follow the water's edge until your reach a cave full of cultists.  Kill an angry cultist, an agitated cultist, a cultist priestess to collect 7 Cultist Eye to fill the bag.

Combine the container into Filled Burlap Pouch and return it to Zalethra Drezzorith.

Zalethra Drezzorith cackles wickedly with delight.

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "Not bad for an outcast."

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "You are new in your faith so I would like to present this book to you for further study."

Zalethra Drezzorith says, "Take this letter and scurry along to House Drezzorith. May the gods provide strength and ruthlessness to your actions."

You gain experience!!

You receive Lexicon of Mysteries from Zalethra Drezzorith.

You receive Letter for Alarys from Zalethra Drezzorith.

Your faction standing with House of Drezzorith got better.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Ail'vorith got better.

Faction with House of Drezzorith increased to High Indifferent

Faction with Citizens of Ail'vorith increased to High Amicably

sections.title: Goblin Samples
sections.text:
Alarys Drezzorith is located in a building in the main city of Ail'Vorith, 4th floor, south side... just southeast of the high level Paladin and Cleric trainers.  You can see it on the left side standing on the main bridge leading into the city.

Hand Alarys Drezzorith your Letter to Alarys.

Alarys Drezzorith says, "You've seem to have impressed Zalethra with your dealings against the cultist uprising."

Alarys Drezzorith looks at you coldly.

Alarys Drezzorith says, "Our house and it's members are of high value in this city."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "We help and heal the militia, lead the masses to their gods, and coax others on their journey to the Shadow."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "My lord holds dominion over subjugation. The act of bending others to your will."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "I have a task. Are you interested?"

You say in Deep Common, "I am interested!"

Alarys Drezzorith says, "There is a band of Deep Gnomes, across the bridge, conducting experiments on goblins."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "Reports indicate that they are utilizing secretions from the fungus men on goblin suubjects."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "This leads to hallucinations, weakening of will, and eventual domination."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "Seek them out. Gather samples of this concoction."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "Bring them back to me in this box that will hold the samples."

You receive Empty Sample Box from Alarys Drezzorith.

Alarys Drezzorith says, "I do not care how you acquire them."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "Through guile, deception or outright violence. It matters not to me or our house."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "Go and remember who your serve."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "For in remembering, you may yet survive for a time longer."

Kill a Deepgulp warrior, a Deepgulp scavenger, a Deepgulp hunter, a Deepgulp berserker to collect 6 Sample of Mind Control Substance and combine them to create Full Sample Box.

(Alternately, you can complete the Thanetal's Samples quest handing in 1 Deep Ale and 10 silver to acquire 6 Sample of Mind Control Substance.)

Hand Full Sample Box to Alarys Drezzorith.

Any faction hits? EXP?

Alarys Drezzorith looks at you intently.

Alarys Drezzorith says, "I am surprised that you have returned. And so soon."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "Excellent. Our alchemists can now analyze this mixture and improve upon it."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "You have done well for a small, insignificant thing."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "Continue to work hard and your standing may improve."

Alarys Drezzorith calls for a runner. He hands them a box and you hear him whisper something about House Xal'tharn into their ear.

Alarys Drezzorith nods in your direction.

Alarys Drezzorith says, "Hand me your prayer book so that I may update it."

Hand Lexicon of Mysteries to Alarys Drezzorith.

You receive Intermediate Lexicon of Mysteries from Alarys Drezzorith.

Any faction hits? EXP?

Alarys Drezzorith says, "I'd like to introduce you to our benefactor. His name is Tal Drezzorith."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "If you offend him in any way, he will snuff you like a fly."

Alarys Drezzorith says, "Seek him out and make yourself known."

sections.title: Continuation - Part 2
sections.text:

You receive Advanced Lexicon of Mysteries ?? from Tal Drezzorith.

sections.text:
Myal Vehear is located in the Obsidian Academy. (Where?)

You say in Deep Common, "Hail, Myal Vehear."

Myal Vehear closes the ebon colored book that she is reading and slowley turns her gaze to you.

Myal Vehear says, "And who do we have here?  A fresh and eager mind, ready to explore the mysteries of the Planes?"

Myal Vehear says, "The world is but one connected through space to the Planes and Spirals."

Myal Vehear gazes through you, as if peering into the void beyond.

Myal Vehear says, "I have been taked with seeking out knowledge of the Spirals.  Would you like to assist?"

You say in Deep Common, "assist"

Myal Vehear says, "I would like to supplement my research with that of the Deep gnomes dwelling outside of Ail'vorith."

Myal Vehear says, "Take this binder.  Seek them out and retrieve six of their research pages for me to consider."

Myal Vehear says, "Consider your actions wisely.  By completing this assignment you will pledge yourself to House Hal'kareth."

More information is required...

sections.title: Part 1 - A Letter of Recommendation - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Amarah Ith'vayen is located in the front left corner of the first floor of the caster hall in the Obsidian Academy.

You say in Deep Common, "Hail, Amarah Ith'vayen."

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "House Ith'vayen gathers bits and bobs from all over to provide intelligence to our Queen and the Great Houses."

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "If an upstart group of exiles needs to be spied upon, we are called."

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "When a minor House needs to blackmailed to comply, we are up to the task."

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "Need someone dead and buried, never to be seen again?  That's us."

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "Just don't expect to be able to prove it was us."

Amarah Ith'vayen  laughs loudly.

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "So my pretty kulzzann, do you want to complete a task for me and start earning a seat at our fine table?"

You say in Deep Common, "what task"

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "Go out and gather myconid parts for us.  We use them in various alchemical concoctions and our supply is running low."

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "Bring me back eight of these and I might think about you for more than a fleeting moment in time."

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "OH! Tell me when you are ready to go, because I've been dying to try out my new wand."

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "It is probably safe."

You say in Deep Common, "ready"

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "And just like that you are there."

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "Or a pile of goo!"

You do not have to use the teleport to complete the quest.

You are teleported out of the city and to the left across the bridge, up the ramp and to the right (most of the way to the zone safe point).

Upon turning in eight Myconid Parts:

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "Delightful, just delightful."

Amarah Ith'vayen places the myconic parts on the table behind her.

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "You're going places.  Where those places are is for you to decide.  I'm going to provide you with a letter of introduction to House Ith'vayen."

Amarah Ith'vayen says, "Go see my brother, his name is Aleyz Ith'vayen.  Tell him his sister said hello and to watch his back."

Amarah Ith'vayen grins ominously.

You receive a Letter to Aleyz.

EnchanterRogueYou receive a Cloth Belt of Runes.You receive a Leather Belt of Runes.

You gain experience!!

sections.title: Part 2 - A Letter of Recommendation - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Begins when you turn in a Letter to Aleyz to Aleyz Ith'vayen inside the main city.

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "Hah!  The nerve of that woman."

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "I should have strangled her while she was in the crib as a babe."

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "Let me have a look at you."

Aleyz Ith'vayen looks at $n closely.

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "There is not much to work with but I shall try."

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "I need you to gather some ingredients for one of my projects."

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "Bring me one fire elemental stone, three samples of ooze and one whitefish."

Aleyz Ith'vayen makes a sweeping motion.

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "Go now and be quick about it."

Bring one Fire Elemental Stone, three Sample of Tainted Water and one Whitefish to Aleyz.

Aleyz Ith'vayen takes the items and approaches his workbench.

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "I will mix the ooze you gathered with equal parts water and ammonia."

Aleyz Ith'vayen mixes the items together in a large decanter.

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "Next I will heat the mixture in a fire stoked with the fire elemental stone."

Aleyz Ith'vayen places the decanter on top of a large burner and reinforces the flame with the stone.

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "Give it a few minutes to heat and combine."

Aleyz Ith'vayen waits several moments and then removes the heated mixture.

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "I need most of this for a project that the House assigned me, but I can spare a bit for a personal errand."

Aleyz Ith'vayen fillets the fish and then slathers it in the mixture.  He begins to roast it on the burner.

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "It smells delightful."

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "Are you ready for one more mission?"

You say in Deep Common, "I am ready"

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "Take this cooked fish back to my sweet sister"

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "Place it nearby without being noticed."

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "She never could pass up a meal."

Aleyz Ith'vayen says, "Return to me once the mission is complete and let me know that the fish has been delivered."

You receive a Roasted and Poisoned Fish.

More information is required...

sections.title: Part 1 - Goblin Scalps
sections.text:
Laren is located in the Military Outpost with the melee class instructors. From the bridge and gate into the Foreign Quarter, enter the building across, second on the left (not the bank tunnel). He is on the right, near back of the room.

You say in Deep Common, "Hail, Laren Drin'dar."

Laren Drin'dar says, "Few may join the ranks of the Eternal Martyrs. Have you some skill with blade or bow?"

You say in Deep Common, "I definitely have skill with bow!"

Laren Drin'dar says, "Every soldier must be ready for the day when all the Ail'trist are called to war."

Laren Drin'dar considers you for a moment.

Laren Drin'dar says, "The lesser houses diminish our people by clinging to their fruitless names and petty holdings. If you can prove yourself a true Archer of the Ail'trist once more, I will grant you leave to enter the city as a conscript of House Vael'xirith."

You say in Deep Common, "I will prove myself!"

Laren Drin'dar says, "I would not take you into battle today, were the Enemy at the gate. But every capable soldier will be needed in the days to come."

Laren Drin'dar says, "Goblins infest the reaches of the Deep. Look for their breeding grounds in the east. Bring me the scalps of their young, enough to fill this pouch."

You receive Scalp Pouch from Laren Drin'dar.

Laren Drin'dar says, "Do not underestimate them."

Faction hits? Follow-up? Reward? Related NPCs?

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text: This quest starts at the conclusion of the Ail'Vorith Starter Quest after you receive your Obsidian Shackle.

sections.title: Part 1
sections.text:
Vaslir Naiyth is located in the Obsidian Academy. As you enter the academy, she is located near the stairs in the back of the room on the right.

Vaslir Naiyth meets your eyes with a penetrating stare. An involuntary shiver runs through your body. There is a touch of something about her gaze that is not of this realm.

Vaslir Naiyth says, "[Player], young aspirant. What brings you to this vaslir of House Varros?"
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Does your ambition lead you towards the path of the vaslir?"
Vaslir Naiyth says, "All Airtrist must have ambition if they wish to survive, let alone thrive. We are not like zor'thez cousins, content to frolic in their woods or sit pompously on their mountain."

Vaslir Naiyth shows you a macabre smile.

Vaslir Naiyth says, "As you have yourself, it is kill or be killed."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "The work of House Varros can break a lesser mind. Let's put to a little test."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "There are many species of fungi here in the Deep. I seek a specific kind. Do you think you could find a patch for me? Or is that task beneath you?"

You say, 'I can find a patch'

Your faction standing with House Varros got better.

Vaslir Naiyth says, "Excellent. Those oafs in House Vael'Xirith might care only about your prowess in battle, but in House Varros, we value mental strength."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Those with weak minds soon find themselves unraveled by the dark realms that we explore."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Here's a test of your perspicacity. There's a book on the shelves next to me, Thelyen's Encyclopaedia. It is the most complete compendium of the flora of the Deep. Find the page on Vhelzzil's Vow and tell me what power causes these mushrooms to grow."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Go on—look at the bookshelf and open the encyclopedia."

You page through to the entry for Vhelzzil's Vow. It contains a sketch of the mushroom and a detailed description of its appearance. The passage also explains that these mushrooms feed on the remains of beings that were once animated by necromancy. The mushrooms take about a week to appear on the remains of the undead.

You say, 'necromancy'

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with House Varros got better.

Vaslir Naiyth gives you the first genuinely warm smile you have seen from her.

Vaslir Naiyth says, "Indeed. This particular species is nourished by the necromantic energies that linger after an undead body has been disanimated."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "The anarchic wilds beyond the walls of the Foreign Quarter are rife with walking skeletons that have been dispatched by ambitious young Airtrist such as yourself."
Vaslir Naiyth says, "Go there and find remains old enough for Vhelzzil's Vow to have sprouted. Put a handful of the mushrooms in this pouch and bring it back to me."

You receive Naiyth's Mushroom Pouch from Vaslir Naiyth.

sections.title: Rewards

You gain experience!!
25 Copper

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Change Language to Deep Common
Be sure you have set your language to Deep Common (right-click Main Chat window > Languages > Deep Common), or quest NPCs may not respond to your prompts.

This quest begins in Ail'Vorith in the Obsidian Academy courtyard by talking with Apprentice Esveth. Esveth is located directly across from the academy under a light post.

You say in Deep Common, "Hail, Apprentice Esveth."

Apprentice Esveth says, "Karzzul, I am Apprentice Esveth. My master, Vaslir Naiyth, has tasked me with acquiring raw materials for House Varros."

Apprentice Esveth says, "I will pay you for ghoul skin, stacks of bone chips, and, of course, corpses."

sections.title: Bone Chips
sections.text:
Upon handing 1x Bone Chips to Apprentice Esveth...

Apprentice Esveth inspects the bone chip.

Apprentice Esveth says, "It is of usable quality. However, I only pay for entire stacks. That means 20."

Upon handing 20x Bone Chips to Apprentice Esveth...

Apprentice Esveth inspects the bone chips.

Apprentice Esveth says, "Yes, we can make use of these. Here is your reward!"

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with House Varros got better.

You receive 25 copper from Apprentice Esveth.

As a level 6 Deep Elf Archer, I received an eighth of a blue bar of experience and 1.25 blue bars of faction with House Varros, setting me to 'indifferent' with House Varros.

sections.title: Corpses
sections.text:
The corpses Apprentice Esveth is referring to are the Sullen corpse and Mournful Corpse from the deep elf exiles.

Upon handing in either 1x Sullen corpse or 1x Mournful Corpse to Apprentice Esveth...

Apprentice Esveth inspects the corpse.

Apprentice Esveth says, "This is suitable for our work. Here is your pay"

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with House Varros got better.

You receive xx copper from Apprentice Esveth.

sections.title: Walkthrough

sections.title: Part 1 - ?
sections.text:
Klavel Sul is located in the Obsidian Academy with the melee class instructors. From the bridge and gate into the Foreign Quarter, enter the building on the left and head to the back of the room.

Klavel's introduction text varies depending on your class, but the conversation is identical after the introduction line.

You say in Deep Common, "Hail, Klavel Sul."

Klavel Sul says, "Exiles sing of lost houses and pray to dead gods. Whom would you call master?"

You say in Deep Common, "The Queen"

Klavel Sul says, "The cenobites of House Xal'tharn serve the Dark Queen above all else. Her wrath and her pleasure are our only desires."

You say in Deep Common, "I would be a cenobite"

Klavel Sul says, "The monks of House Xal’tharn carry out the Queen's will with iron staves and iron hearts."

You say in Deep Common, "Do you have a task for me?"

Klavel Sul says, "Fragments of the dead roam the western shore of the city. They are the accursed remnants of lesser houses who dared betray their Queen. Destroy them and fill this satchel with six of their skulls."

You receive Remnant Satchel from Klavel Sul.

Klavel Sul says, "Boats pass the west shore of Ail'vorith on their course to the sea.  Cross the bridge into the city at your peril, for the guards will not suffer an exile to pass the gates. You must take a different path."

This part requires level 10+

Swim around the west of the city where elementals and various skulls patrol the west island shores. Kill a separated skull and a spectral remnant to collect 6 Lost Skull to fill the bag.

Combine the container and return it to Klavel Sul.

Klavel Sul says, "So it is done. Pity not the dead who chose the path of desolation. The Dark Queen's rule is absolute. Those who waver shall be cast into the pits of the Shol'tar, and those who challenge her sovereignty shall be cast into oblivion."

You gain experience!!

Klavel Sul says, "Swear your allegiance to the Queen, and you may be permitted to enter the city as a servant of House Xal'tharn."

You say in Deep Common, "I swear allegiance to the Queen!"

You gain experience!!

InquisitorMonkYou receive Xal'tharn Pendant from Klavel Sul.You receive Simple Chestwrap from Klavel Sul.

Klavel Sul says, "You have entered into the service of the Avatar of Barbhaal, Naliadra the Eternal. House Xal'tharn may call upon you to carry out her will, and you must answer under pain of death."

Faction hits? Any follow-up breadcrumbs?

sections.title: Dialogue & Turn-ins
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, Hult Beetlewrangler"

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Woah, ho there, adventurer. Ya lookin for work or wares? No matter, ol' Hult's got somethin for ya either way."

You say, "I am looking for work."

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Well, if ya were from 'round here, ya'd know Hult's got the best bowls all 'long the Twilight Coast. Though, if ya ain't from 'round here, or either way I reckon, what ya need to know is I need me some beetle shells."

You say, "Beetle shells?"
Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Yep, beetle shells make dang fine bowls, they do. See, a beetle shell's got the most perfectly natural shape and sturdiness for makin' bowls, and Porbor knows ol' Hult can make somethin' outta anythin'."
Hult Beetlewrangler says, "So, go out in them dunes over yonder and wrangle me at least two of 'em! When ya get back, ol' Hult'll see 'bout gettin' ya somethin' nice for yer troubles."
Upon turning in 2x Fire Beetle Carapace:
You gain experience!!

You receive Hult's Beetle Bowl from Hult Beetlewrangler.

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Ho, welcome back, friend. Seems yer a dang fine beetle wrangler. Ya've done good by Hult, so take one o' these here beetle bowls. It ain't much, but I reckon it'll serve ya well.
