sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Spellbinder's Inquisitor Talisman
Tarnished Spellbinder Cuirass
You gain experience!!

sections.title: Part 1
sections.text:
Read Rune-Etched Note you start with as a new Inquisitor character:

Hail, apprentice.

Master Jaffar Jhaym awaits your arrival at the Spellbinders Spire in Sageside. You'll know you're close when you see the wizard tower looming overhead.

Use the translocation devices beneath the tower to reach the academy grounds. Once there, you'll likely find Jaffar atop the Spire.

Your desire for advancement is well-served by Jaffar's tutelage. The academy he has built is highly regarded within Night Harbor, and he employs only the finest instructors.

If you lose your way, consult the nearest guard and inquire about the Spire's location.

Godspeed!

Head to the wizard tower east of the North Gate. Take the teleporter to the first floor and go through the portal labeled "Spellbinders Spire". Head to the top of the tower with spellbinder guards around it to find Jaffar Jhaym. He is at the very top of the Spellbinders Spire.

Hand Rune-Etched Note to Jaffar Jhaym.

You gain experience!!
Jaffar Jhaym examines your note and then smiles broadly at you.

Jaffar Jhaym says, "Very well met! You have arrived safely, and I am indeed who you seek. Welcome to the Spellbinders Spire!"
Jaffar Jhaym says, "The desert grows more dangerous by the day, so you have arrived none too soon."
Jaffar Jhaym says, "I am sure we will get better acquainted in the days to come, but you must be tired, so I’ll delay your introduction to your trainer no longer."
Jaffar Jhaym says, "As an aspiring inquisitor, you will be under the tutelage of Petra Gyle."
Jaffar Jhaym says, "Deliver your note to her, and she will get you started."

Jaffar Jhaym bows slightly and smiles at you.

You receive Rune-Etched Note from Jaffar Jhaym.

Head down the spire and hand your Rune-Etched Note to Petra Gyle.

You gain experience!!
Petra Gyle takes the note.

Petra Gyle says, "Hmm..."

Petra Gyle snatches the note form your hands and skims it briefly, her fierce gaze peering over top of the parchment as she appraises you.

Petra Gyle says, "So you wish to be an inquisitor of the spire, do you? You'll have to prove to me you have the mettle to take on such a responsibility."
Petra Gyle says, "Magic is a powerful, yet extremely dangerous talent. Especially when used by those who collude with, or seek to benefit from, corrupted forces."
Petra Gyle says, "Our role as inquisitors is to protect our colleagues from such forces, while also routing out corruption before it has a chance to take hold."

Petra Gyle pulls out a small key and offers it to you, while also posing a simple question.

You receive Spellbinder's Cell Key from Petra Gyle.

Petra Gyle says, "Are you prepared to take on this role?"

You say, 'Yes I am.'

Petra Gyle says, "We shall see if there's truth to your words, or if they ring hollow."
Petra Gyle says, "Descend to the bottom floor of the Spire and use the key I've given you to enter the confinement cells. We've captured a number of cultists that have yet to reveal to us their intentions."

Petra Gyle scowls and practically spits at the word cultists.

Petra Gyle says, "Even a novice like yourself should have the aptitude to force them to talk."
Petra Gyle says, "Speak to the Inquisitor Selpha outside the cells should you have any questions regarding interrogation, then return to me with anything you uncover, along with the key to the cells."

Head down to the confinement cells, hold your Spellbinder's Cell Key, and click the cell door next to Inquisitor Selpha.

Cast Torment on one of the prisoners three times; they will then tell you about a secret pocket in their cloaks.

There will be a table with some knives on it in the room outside. Use /look at the table, then /inspect cloak, then /inspect seam, then /take note. Give it to Inquisitor Selpha.

Inquisitor Selpha says, "What's this? You found this hidden within one of their cloaks? Hmm..."
Inquisitor Selpha says, "You'd best show these to Petra right away. The spike carries a malevolent aura that she may be able to unravel, along with the meaning behind that blank note."

Return to Petra Gyle, and give her the Mysterious Rolled Note, the Mysterious Iron Spike, and the Spellbinder's Cell Key.

Petra Gyle pockets the key and gives the spike an intense stare. She then retrieves a strangely glowing stone from her possession and runs it across the spike's surface, causing the image of the object to shift and waver like a mirage.
Petra Gyle mutters a curse under her breath as she shifts the stone across the surface of the parchment next. She clicks her tongue before returning her attention to you.

Petra Gyle says, "You did well to bring these finds to me, [Player], while also proving that you have the resolve to be a true inquisitor."
Petra Gyle says, "Take this, it will serve as a symbol that you're now a member of our order. You'll need it, along with this seer stone, if you're to look further into these matters."
Petra Gyle says, "Tell me, [Player], are you familiar with the Tarellian Seer Stones?"

You say, 'What Seer Stones?'

Petra Gyle says, "The seer stone that I've given you is magically imbued. It enables us to see through minor illusions and masking spells, which is how you'll use it to thwart the cultists."
Petra Gyle says, "These so-called spikes have been revealed to scrying anchors. They would allow anyone attuned to them to view, and potentially overhear, anything in their vicinity."
Petra Gyle says, "I've also used the power of the Tarellian Seer Stone to dispel the illusion concealing what information the note contained."
Petra Gyle says, "It appears that out Easthymnite guests have been directed to discreetly affix these spikes at various locations throughout Night Harbor, likely in an effort to spy and sow discord."
Petra Gyle says, "So now, [Player], to continue your investigations you must make a choice."

You say, 'What choice?'

Petra Gyle says, "Your first option is to pursue the cultists that have been sent to plant these spikes, either by following them or discerning the clues revealed in the note about their intended locations. For this, you'll need the note."
Petra Gyle says, "The second option is to track down and eliminate the individual who is attuned to the spikes, so that even if they're planted, they'll remain nothing more than a potential snag on someone's clothing. To do this, you'll require the spike."
Petra Gyle says, "As this is your first investigation, I leave the choice to you, [Player]."
Petra Gyle says, "Note or spike?"

Choose the Note Path
Choose the Spike Path

sections.title: Note Path
sections.text:
You say, 'Give me the note.'

Petra Gyle says, "Very well, the note is yours."

You receive Revealed Cultist Note.

Petra Gyle says, "There are three travelers from Easthymn who've caught our eye at the Shaded Bloom Inn. You'll recognize them by their black garb and the thin silver chains they wear around their waists. Identify them and follow them."
Petra Gyle says, "Two of them have been reported to wander the streets, making brief stops at nondescript locations. With the seer stone, look closely at the areas where they stop. You're to pull out any spikes they affix to these locations."
Petra Gyle says, "You may be able to use the note to discern the locations yourself without having to following them, if you're keen enough."
Petra Gyle says, "The third traveler never leaves the inn, but we're not sure why. Follow him as well, but if he doesn't affix the spikes anywhere... take them from him. The spire authorizes the use of force, once he is out of sight of the locals."
Petra Gyle says, "Fill the bag with each unique spike, combine it, and then return it to me, along with the seer stone."

You receive Tarellian Seer Stone from Petra Gyle.

You receive Small Leather Bag from Petra Gyle.

Head to the Shaded Bloom Inn near the west gate.

Make sure you equip the Tarellian Seer Stone before you begin these steps.
The three an Easthymnite travelers that you are meant to follow/assassinate spawn near the side street entrance door of the inn.
One of them will walk to the basement behind the bar. Follow him to the basement and kill him for 2 unique Ornately Carved Iron Spikes. Keep in mind that you need all 6 unique spikes so you cannot pick up more than one of the same type.
You DO NOT need to follow the remaining two Easthymnites—go to each of the four locations shown below and type /pull spike. You can use /look to make sure you're in the right location first if you desire.
An an Easthymnite traveler will walk towards the Blacksmith in Night Market.
Follow this one to an alley.
When he inspects the wall, /look.
A small iron spike is embedded in the wall. It looks like you could pull it free.
/pull spike
You pull the iron spike from the wall.
This map indicates all three locations with red circles:

Location of Spikes for Inquisitor Class Quest

The second an Easthymnite traveler will head towards the Night Market and stop at two of the locations:
In Night Market Between Baker and Butcher 1: 
In Night Market Between Baker and Butcher 2 (Spike Location): 
Night Market Gilded Claw Brazier: 
Like the second, a third an Easthymnite traveler will walk out the main entrance of the inn. They will once again visit two of the spike locations:
Brazier at crossroads behind western bank: 
Brazier at right side of entrance to Saltbreeze Park: 
Combine the 6 Ornately Carved Iron Spikes in your Small Leather Bag to receive a Small Bag of Spikes.
Head back to Petra Gyle.

Hand the Tarellian Seer Stone and Small Bag of Spikes to Petra Gyle.

You gain experience!!

Petra Gyle says, "Well done. You've returned, so I must assume you were able to trail them safely."

Petra Gyle pauses for a moment and squints at you.

Petra Gyle says, "Oh, did you get into a tussle?."

Petra Gyle laughs.

Petra Gyle says, "Seems you can handle a more direct challenge then."

Petra Gyle hands you two small bags.

Petra Gyle says, "We're tasked with tracking down and dealing with mages, wizards, and other arcane filth. However, we are also charged, at times, to deal with adversaries of a more spiritual nature."
Petra Gyle says, "Seek out two camps in the desert to the west. There are shamans amongst the Ashira. Gather medicinal herbs from them to replenish the first pouch."
Petra Gyle says, "You'll find a group of smugglers along the coast. They work for Jens Vermahn, so take care to engage them during the day. Gather whatever leafy filth they're using to heal themselves in the second bag."
Petra Gyle says, "Now go."

You receive Ashira Herb Pouch from Petra Gyle.

You receive Filthy Leather Herb Pouch from Petra Gyle.

You receive Tarnished Spellbinder Cuirass from Petra Gyle.

sections.title: Spike Path
sections.text:
You say, 'Spike'
Petra Gyle nods, handing you the spike.

Petra Gyle says, "The spike is yours, then."
Petra Gyle says, "If you're going to find out who has attuned themselves to the spike, you'll need the assistance of another member of our order."
Petra Gyle says, "Bring the spike to Spellbinder Kharash. I imagine he'll be in the archives on the bottom floor, opposite the hallway where you found the containment cells."
Petra Gyle says, "He's an expert at unraveling divination magics and will be able to help you trace its origin."
Petra Gyle says, "Good hunting, [Player]."

You receive Cultist's Iron Spike from Petra Gyle.

You receive Tarellian Seer Stone from Petra Gyle.

Give the Cultist's Iron Spike to Spellbinder Kharash.

Spellbinder Kharash inspects the spike and quickly frowns.

Spellbinder Kharash says, "You bring me a cursed object, inquisitor. I sense foul magics tied to it... divine in origin. Likely a dark gift granted by a malevolent benefactor."
Spellbinder Kharash says, "Let us not waste time with further details. I will retain the spike here and prevent those who are attuned to it from scrying its location, or potentially, overhearing our plans."
Spellbinder Kharash says, "In the meanwhile, take this bag. You must fill it With the components I need to trace the magic of the spike back to its source."

You receive Spellbinder's Bag from Spellbinder Kharash.

You gain experience!!

You say, 'What components?'

Spellbinder Kharash says, "Good of you to ask."
Spellbinder Kharash says, "The components I need to seek this foe rely on the vision of those who scour the sands. You must acquire the eye of a bat, a fire beetle, a dune scarab, a spiderling, and a crypt scarab."
Spellbinder Kharash says, "I will also need a mirror to reflect the gaze back to its source. I believe Haredi sells such trinkets to other students of the academy in the Grand Library."
Spellbinder Kharash says, "Once you have an of the eyes and the mirror, combine them in the bag and return it to me. I Will then conduct the ritual to reverse the attunement Of the spike."

Haredi is in the library. Once in the library, take the teleportation platform in front of you. You'll see Haredi to the left. Buy a Pocket Mirror from him.

Combine a Fire Beetle Eye, Bat Eye, Spiderling Eye, Scarab Eye, Crypt Scarab Eye, and Pocket Mirror in the Spellbinder's Bag to craft Full Spellbinder's Bag.

Give the Full Spellbinder's Bag to Spellbinder Kharash.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Spellbinders of the Spire got better.

Spellbinder Kharash says, "Well done, recruit With this, I can refocus the vision of the desert creatures and reflect the sinister gaze on this scrying device back to its source. Allow me a moment to redirect this foul magic."

Spellbinder Kharash withdraws the spike he had been safeguarding and begins his ritual.
Spellbinder Kharash takes the spike and pierces it through one of the eyes, then another, and another, until an four are speared upon the nail like a grotesque form of street
Spellbinder Kharash then murmurs out a low, guttural chant as he points the skewered set of eyes toward the mirror, invoking his magic upon them. A bright flash fills the corner of the archives and temporarily blinds you!
Spellbinder Kharash stands before you as your vision readjusts, offering you the spike.

Spellbinder Kharash says, "Take it, [Player]. I have reversed the attunement of the object and directed the eyes to assist you in locating the cultist leader."
Spellbinder Kharash says, "There is now one final thing you must do."

You receive Revealing Iron Spike from Spellbinder Kharash.

You say, 'What must I do?'

Spellbinder Kharash says, "Before you depart, you must be sure to bring your Tarellian Seer Stone with you."
Spellbinder Kharash says, "It is capable Of removing illusions and can be used to unmask those attempting to hide their true selves. They must simply touch the stone."
Spellbinder Kharash says, "When you are ready, proceed down to the Northern Gate. While standing beneath it, focus your will into the spike and it shall conjure an eye that will lead you to the cultist scryer."
Spellbinder Kharash says, "If an eye does not immediately appear, the villain may be momentarily out of sight. Simply wait a short moment before trying once again."
Spellbinder Kharash says, "When an eye appears, follow it. After that, you must use your own judgment on how best to deliver the Spellbinder's justice to your foe."
Spellbinder Kharash says, "Bring anything you find from you investigation back to Petra, as my part here has concluded. May Tilustra illuminate path, inquisitor."

While standing just outside the Northern Gate, right-click your Revealing Iron Spike to summon an Eye of Kharash.

The Eye of Kharash will spawn and run towards Farmer Lubern. Be prepared to fight a level 5 encounter.

Follow the eye or just make your way to Farmer Lubern. He is in the second enclosed area of farms on the right as you leave the north gate.

Give Tarellian Seer Stone to Farmer Lubern and he will transform into Lubern the Heretic.

Lubern the Heretic says, "No! How did you...?"

You receive Tarellian Seer Stone from Farmer Lubern.

Lubern the Heretic says, "Your blood will serve as a sacrifice for Kravvin!"

Kill Lubern the Heretic and loot Lubern's Scrying Orb.

Return to Petra Gyle.

Give Petra Gyle Lubern's Scrying Orb, Tarellian Seer Stone, and Revealing Iron Spike.

Your faction standing with Spellbinders of the Spire got better.

Petra Gyle says, "Well done. It seems you may have what it takes to be a real inquisitor after all."

Petra Gyle pauses for a moment and squints at you.

Petra Gyle says, "Oh, did you get into a tussle?."

Petra Gyle laughs.

Petra Gyle says, "Seems you can handle a more direct challenge then."

Petra Gyle hands you two small bags.

Petra Gyle says, "We're tasked with tracking down and dealing with mages, wizards, and other arcane filth. However, we are also charged, at times, to deal with adversaries of a more spiritual nature."
Petra Gyle says, "Seek out two camps in the desert to the west. There are shamans amongst the Ashira. Gather medicinal herbs from them to replenish the first pouch."
Petra Gyle says, "You'll find a group of smugglers along the coast. They work for Jens Vermahn, so take care to engage them during the day. Gather whatever leafy filth they're using to heal themselves in the second bag."
Petra Gyle says, "Now go."

You receive Ashira Herb Pouch from Petra Gyle.

You receive Filthy Leather Herb Pouch from Petra Gyle.

You receive Tarnished Spellbinder Cuirass from Petra Gyle.

sections.title: Part 2
sections.text:
Combine six Ashira Medicinal Herbs in the Ashira Herb Pouch. Ashira Medicinal Herbs do not stack, but they can be traded.

Combine six Pungent Healing Herbs in the Filthy Leather Herb Pouch. Pungent Healing Herbs do not stack, but they can be traded.

Hand the filled Ashira Herb Pouch and Filthy Leather Herb Pouch to Petra Gyle.

You gain experience!!

Petra Gyle says, "Fantastic Work. We've been using these herbs to formulate a better understanding of how to disrupt the enemy's healing magics."
Petra Gyle says, "The spiritual nature of Ashira magic is more challenging to understand, but Jens' rats appear to be using simple alchemy. We'll know soon enough."
Petra Gyle says, "Well, young recruit, you're proving to be quite the find. I've got one last task, then we'll let you get some rest."
Petra Gyle says, "I've just been made aware of a powerful, yet still up-in-coming wizard, in league with Jens. He can occasionally be found in a small house in the Bends."
Petra Gyle says, "You're to kill him and bring me his head. Pack it in this bag so you don't draw any unwanted attention."

You receive Rune Covered Black Silk Bag from Petra Gyle.

sections.title: Part 3
sections.text:
Head to the Bends part of Night Harbor. There is a teleporter just before the north bank that will take you to the shipyard area. Take the teleporter and go left to get to the Bends.

Look for Sahir Muzalal (level 16); a possible spawn location is the ground floor of the first building cluster on the left. A mercenary magus is the placeholder.

Kill Sahir Muzalal and loot his Bloodied Wizard Head.

Place his Bloodied Wizard Head into Rune Covered Black Silk Bag and click on combine.

Head back to Petra Gyle and hand her the filled Rune Covered Black Silk Bag.

You gain experience!!
Petra Gyle takes the bag from you, looking at it with disgust.

Petra Gyle says, "Good work. He was on his way to becoming a powerful adversary, so it benefits us to be rid of him."
Petra Gyle says, "For now, consider yourself well on your way down the proper path. Continue to explore the city and familiarize yourself with the people here. If you run into anything suspicious, come back to me. Otherwise, get some rest."

Petra Gyle plucks a small talisman from her waistband and hands it to you.

Petra Gyle says, "And keep this with you."

You receive Spellbinder's Inquisitor Talisman from Petra Gyle.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Restored Mandolin

Experience

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest starts with hailing Rais Alyssum.

You say, 'Hail, Rais Alyssum.'

Rais Alyssum says 'Hello, may I interest you in one of my fine handcrafted instruments? I carry everything that a young instrumentalist might need to enhance his beginnings as a performer.'

You say, 'Performer?'

Rais Alyssum clears his throat and puffs out his chest.

Rais Alyssum says 'Everything in life is a performance. Eth-ur is our stage. Now you have to ask yourself, will you play the lead? Or are you content to continue as supporting cast?

You say, 'I will play the lead."

Rais Alyssum says 'Excellent! A vibrant storyteller needs purpose, humility, and of course; experience. Why don't we start with something a little.. philanthropic? First you can start by bringing light to those in the dark of Night Harbor. Return to me when you feel you've brightened the spirits of the less fortunate.'

Scattered across Night Harbor are A beggar. Purchase 3 Weak Beer from A barkeep and trade one individually to each a beggar and /Play Lute to brighten the spirits of the less fortunate.

***You must have an instrument equipped to use the /Play feature***

You say, 'Hail, a beggar.'

a beggar says, 'Alms for the poor?'

Hand a beggar 1 Weak Beer and use the /Play lute command.

a_beggar_1 says, 'Thank you for the drink, but can you keep it down you're scaring the tourists away!'

a_beggar_2 says, 'Ahhh my ears! I've heard better music coming from the stables at the Sojourner camp!'

a_beggar_3 says, 'Wow, I cannot tell you how long it has been since I have felt kindness and compassion. What a beautiful melody, bless you kind stranger. I found this while rummaging through the Night Market and something compelled me to hold onto it, just give me a moment to find it.

a_beggar_3 pats his pockets and then anxiously searches through his bags. A_beggar_3 says 'Now where did I put that, oh here it is!'

You receive a Broken Mandolin from a_beggar_3.

a_beggar_3 says, 'Now it may not be in the best condition, but please take this as a token of my gratitude. I'm sure a bright young Bard like yourself can find a way to restore it back to a working condition.'

Return to Rais Alyssum and hand him the Broken Mandolin.

Upon turning in the Broken Mandolin:

Rais Alyssum holds the broken mandolin in his hands and studies it intently.

Rais Alyssum says, 'Well would you look at that! Sometimes kindness really does pay off! Let's see what we have here.. Ah yes, a polished mahogany body, with beautiful trim work on the headstock. A shame the condition that it's in. I could repair it for you, but I would need some additional materials and of course a fee.'

You say, 'What additional materials?'

Rais Alyssum looks you up and down with a mischievous gleam in his eye.

Rais Alyssum says, 'Come closer and take a look at these three strings. They are salvageable, but I will need five more. The silk of a large spider should do the trick. Now for the tailpiece.. we could use stone, but lets try for something a little more elegant and special. I've heard the performers outside talk of a translucent beetle roaming the dunes to the west. A piece of his carapace will work perfectly.

Rais Alyssum says, 'Oh and don't forget about the fee. After all, this is a lesson in helping the less fortunate. Ten silver pieces sounds fair, don't you think?'

Head to the Shaded Dunes and kill Large Spiders until you have 5 Large Spider Silk. Obtain a Piece of Translucent Beetle Shell from a giant translucent beetle. Return with them to Rais Alyssum.

Upon turning in 5 Large Spider Silk and Piece of Translucent Beetle Shell and 10 silver pieces:

You gain experience!!

Rais Alyssum excitedly fashions together the tailpiece and tightens the strings.

You receive a Restored Mandolin from Rais Alyssum.

Rais Alyssum says, 'I knew you had the heart of a performer in you. As promised here is the restored mandolin. Now go and set the stage for your adventure! Oh and before I forget.. when another Bard becomes envious of my artwork, send him my way. Just don't mention the fee.

Rais Alyssum winks at you.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text: Small Mur'Hua Trinket

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest starts with hailing Mar'Tem.

Where is the quest giver located in the zone?

You say, "Hail, Mar'Tem."

Mar'Tem says, "Hail, Yes, I speak your language, though I am the only one in our gathering who does."

Mar'Tem says, "We mean no harm to your kind. In fact, we are the ones who fear harm. We have fled to this shelter to escape the hunters tracking us."

Mar'Tem says, "The undead here have done well to keep them in the tunnel but it is only a matter of time before they come for us."

You say, "What hunters?"

Mar'Tem says, "A group of us were able to flee the Skri'Var taskmasters before they could cause us to degenerate."

Mar'Tem says, "We escaped here, but if the hunters leave, we will eventually make our way out of this place and return to our village."

Mar'Tem says, "Or, if you can force them away, we would also be grateful. Just bring me proof that you have dealt with them."

You say, "Degenerate?"

Mar'Tem says, "The Skri'Var were once like us Mur'Hua. But those with bad spirits wander away from our people and devolve into what you see here. We take care of each other, and we love to explore and create. They are selfish and kill and steal."

Mar'Tem says, "They can force us to become like them by isolating us from each other, torturing us, and making us cannibals like them."

Mar'Tem says, "Once this process beings, our spirits change and our minds give way. We serve them, protect them, and become like them. So, take care if you see any Mur'Hua among them. They are already likely lost."

You say, "What Village?"

Mar'Tem says, "We come from a small village on a lake deep below the surface... but I do not know you well enough to tell you more."

You say, "What proof?"

Need more information regarding dialogue here

Venture out and kill Tora'Galdo.

Loot his Head of Tora'Galdo and return to Mar'Tem.

Upon turning in the Head of Tora'Galdo Mar'Tem responds:

Mar'Tem says, "It is a shame that one of our own can cause so much death and hardship. We are immensely grateful for this act of kindness."

Mar'Tem says, "Please take this as a small token of my gratitude. It may help you, should you encounter more of my people."

You receive Small Mur'Hua Trinket.

More information needed. Faction hits? EXP? Coin?

Suspected to be a second quest available once you have completed the first.

quests.title: Landing Loop Quest
quests.classText: Elementalist | Enchanter | Inquisitor | Necromancer | Shadow Knight | Spellblade | Wizard
quests.relatedNpcs: Captain Harkan Saafir | A landing lieutenant | Tariq the Revealer

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Landing Loop
10 Gold

sections.title: Part 1 - Raging Elements Investigation
sections.text:
Go to the top of the lighthouse of Zaedin's Landing in Shallow Shoals to find Nadim Al-Saraf.

To get to him you need to get past the locked gate. Go to the inn and say [I am here to help] to Barkeep Zahra to get Zaedin's Landing Fort Key when you have enough faction of Zaedin's Corsairs.

If you can't  get the key, there are several rooms beside the locked gate along the ramp, go up the ramp and jump through the window to bypass the gate. You need to be a small-sized race to do that, or you need to find someone to shrink you twice.

If Nadim is not up, kill A Syndicate channeler that roams on the top of the lighthouse to spawn him.

Ask Nadim about the [lighthouse], then tell him [I can help]. He will ask you to find out why elements around this island are growing unstable.

Go to the back of the island and kill A raging elemental until you get 4 Tainted Elemental Core,  turn in those to Nadim, he will give you Note from Nadim and tell you to go find Captain Harkan Saafir.

sections.title: Part 2 - Goblin Raids
sections.text:
Captain Harkan Saafir is halfway to the lighthouse where you reach the first iron gate. Turn left and go upstairs to find him in the room.

A landing lieutenant is his PH and also accepts quest items.

Turn in the note and he mentions that there are goblins raiding Zaedin's Landing.

Every 9 pm, several goblins spawn on a small island which lies south of Zaedin's Landing and will head to attack the islanders. And if rain falls at the time, Skizzak Darkrain also spawns.

Kill Skizzak and loot Command Scroll.

Turn in the scroll to Captain Harkan Saafir / a Landing lieutenant, he'll instruct you to take the scroll to Tariq the Revealer who roams in south side of the buildings on the 2nd floor.

Give him both the Command Scroll and Note from Nadim, then go back to Nadim with the Command scroll.

To turn in the scroll to Nadim you'll receive a new Note from Nadim. Take it to Captain Harkan Saafir /  a Landing lieutenant , and you are tasked to scout the goblin island for clues.

sections.title: Part 3 - Goblins in the Ruins
sections.text:
Now go to the goblin island, it's to the northeast of Zaedin's Landing.

You will spot a river inside the island once you get there.

Take left to the tunnel, find an entrance underwater on your left . It leads you to a cave with two houses.

Enter the house that with no door by climbing up or jumping through the window (if small-sized race) and get to the room stacked with crates.

There is a book behind them. Get close and use /take paper to get Hidden Note.

sections.title: Part 4 - Ritual of the Orcs
sections.text:
Hand the Hidden Note to Captain Harkan Saafir /  a Landing lieutenant, he then wants you to decrypt the note with Tariq's help.

Go to Tariq and give him the Hidden Note to receive the Decrypted Note.

Give Decrypted Note to Captain Harkan Saafir /  a Landing lieutenant, then give it to Nadim.

Nadim will refresh Note from Nadim in your inventory and task you with killing Witchlord Kruurgal to disrupt the rituals.

Kruurgal spawns in a tower within Black Shoals Fortress,  north of Zaedin's Landing. A Witchguard corruptor is PH

Kill Kruurgal and bring Head of Kruurgal the Witchlord to Nadim along with Note from Nadim.

You receive 10 gold from Nadim Al-Saraf.

You receive Landing Loop from Nadim Al-Saraf.

Dyed shirt or robe

Red Crude Silk Shirt

sections.title: Part 1 - Clothes Delivery
sections.text:
Find a wash maiden (during daytime hours only) in Night Harbor inside the Bath house which is west of Night Market near the West Gate.



You say, "Hail, a wash maiden."

a wash maiden stops folding laundry to consider you a moment with tired eyes.

a wash maiden says, "Hail to you, lily. Forgive me if I don't stop. Laundry waits for no one, and it's piled high today."
a wash maiden says, "It's an endless job and few offer to help. I suppose I can't complain, though. Trust in Trem they say."

You say, "help"

a wash maiden says, "Help? Oh... no, no. I manage. Always have. That's kind of you to offer, lily. Truly kind."
a wash maiden pauses for a moment, glancing up at you.
a wash maiden says, "But... if you truly mean it..."

You say, "mean"

a wash maiden looks away from you shyly.
a wash maiden says, "I'm unaccustomed to asking strangers for favors. But lily, if you're offering..."

You say, "offering"

a wash maiden finally meets your eyes.
a wash maiden says, "I don't want to be a bother, but I could use the help. So let's make this deal..."
a wash maiden says, "Could you get these deliveries to my customers? They tend to pay extra to get their clothing delivered to them, as they're quite busy with their own jobs. You can keep any extra coin they hand you."
a wash maiden says, "And bring me their laundry. They always have more laundry to do."
a wash maiden says, "Do this for me, and though I have little in the way of coin, I can at least give you a clean shirt or robe. I'll even dye it in your favorite color."
a wash maiden says, "Are we in agreement, lily?"

You say, "agree"

a wash maiden says, "Great! Take this basket and these clean clothes."
a wash maiden says, "There's three deliveries to be made..."
a wash maiden says, "Steinn the stonemason is awaiting the arrival of his work shirt."
a wash maiden says, "Layith the troubadour wants her favorite cloak to use in the play."
a wash maiden says, "And Iskandar, who's still on guard duty, will need his pantaloons."
a wash maiden pauses, almost apologetically.
a wash maiden says, "Just... take the clothes to where they belong. When you come back with their laundry, we'll settle our deal."
a wash maiden smiles.
a wash maiden says, "Byrthia remembers kindness. Always does."

You receive Byrthia's Laundry Basket from a wash maiden.

You receive Stonemason's Shirt from a wash maiden.

You receive Damsel's Cloak from a wash maiden.

You receive Patrol Pantaloons from a wash maiden.



Find Mason Steinn in Night Harbor in the temple against the cliff between Sojourner's Camp and the Tannery. Follow the road north until you reach the temple.



You say, "Hail, Mason Steinn."

Mason Steinn turns to you, a cloud of stone dust following him. He is bare-chested beneath a heavy leather apron, his arms crossed more out of habit than comfort.
Mason Steinn says, "What're you after? Block, lime, chisels? If it's stonework, say it plain."
Mason Steinn shifts slightly, clearly aware of the draft.
Mason Steinn says, "And make it quick, if you can. Temple wind's got no respect for old bones."

Give Mason Steinn the Stonemason's Shirt:

Mason Steinn blinks when he sees the shirt, then lets out a relieved huff as he takes it.
Mason Steinn says, "By the stone! That's sight for sore eyes."
Mason Steinn puts it on immediately, rolling his shoulders as if settling armor.
Mason Steinn says, "You've my thanks. Truly."
Mason Steinn reaches under the workbench, producing a bundled sack of grimy clothes and presses it into your hands along with a few coins.
Mason Steinn says, "Five copper there. Give her this and my thanks."
Mason Steinn lowers his voice just a touch.
Mason Steinn says, "And do me a kindness... tell Byrthia to go lighter on the wheat paste next wash. It keeps the seams stiff, but itches like a nest of ants once I start sweating."
Mason Steinn tugs at his beard.
Mason Steinn says, "She's a good washer, though. Best in the city. I'll not hear otherwise."

You gain experience!!



Your faction standing with Citizens of Night Harbor got better.

Your faction standing with Merchants of Night Harbor got better.

Your faction standing with Smallfolk Alliance got better.



You receive Steinn' Dirty Laundry from Mason Steinn.

You receive 5 copper from Mason Steinn.



Find Layith Kharem in Night Harbor up a ladder in Glimmermoon Hall behind the performance stage in Night Market.



You say, "Hail, Layith Kharem."

Layith Kharem says, "Oh! Hi there."
Layith Kharem turns with practiced grace, already smiling as if she is on stage.
Layith Kharem says, "Yes, yes, of course. One moment."
Layith Kharem produces a small parchment and signs it with an elaborate flourish.
Layith Kharem says, "There you are. Do spell my name correctly if you tell the story later."
Layith Kharem studies you, chin lifted.
Layith Kharem says, "Were you hoping to catch tonight's performance, or have you come to simply admire?"

You receive Layith's Autograph from Layith Kharem. (Unknown if related to Laundry Day quest)



Give Layith Kharem the Damsel's Cloak:

Layith Kharem gasps softly as she see the cloak, her hands dramatically pressed to her chest.
Layith Kharem says, "Thank the stars!"
Layith Kharem takes it at once, inspecting the fabric with sharp, practiced eyes. A beat passes, then she smiles radiantly.
Layith Kharem says, "Perfect. Absolutely perfect."
Layith Kharem softens a little, looking at you anew.
Layith Kharem says, "You're a dear. Truly."
Layith Kharem presses a silver coin into your hand without hesistation.
Layith Kharem says, "For your trouble... and your timing."
Layith Kharem tilts her head in a conspiratorial manner and produces a small, neatly tied bundle.
Layith Kharem says, "And if you'd be so kind... you may return these to the washer maiden."
Layith Kharem says, "The one and only Layith's bespoke stockings! Handle them with care and use unscented oils only, understand?"
Layith Kharem pauses briefly before donning a smile that suggests she has already forgotten the inconvenience.
Layith Kharem says, "Now, if you'll excuse me, my audience awaits!"

You gain experience!!



Your faction standing with Citizens of Night Harbor got better.

Your faction standing with Merchants of Night Harbor got better.

Your faction standing with Azure Veils got better.



You receive 1 copper from Layith Kharem.

You receive Layith's Soiled Stockings from Layith Kharem.



Find Guard Iskandar in Night Harbor in front of the large palace gate at the east end of Saltbreeze Park.



You say, "Hail, Guard Iskandar."

Guard Iskandar inclines his head slightly, eyes never fully leaving the park grounds.
Guard Iskandar says, "State your business, if you please. Only government officials are permitted beyond this point."
Guard Iskandar remains vigilant. A bead of sweat runs down his temple, but his stance never wavers.
Guard Iskandar says, "No trouble today, I trust."
Guard Iskandar allows himself a small, polite smile.
Guard Iskandar says, "If you're lost, I can point you the right way."

Give Guard Iskandar the Patrol Pantaloons:

Guard Iskandar sees the pantaloons and takes them swiftly, folding them once and sliding them into his pack as if they were part of his kit all along.
Guard Iskandar quickly produces a wrapped piece of gear, along with two coins.
Guard Iskandar says, "You have my thanks."
Guard Iskandar leans in to you, his voice dropping just enough to speak words only for your ears.
Guard Iskandar says, "Please... my padded loin guard... needs washing."
Guard Iskandar pauses as a faint, sheepish breath can be heard through his nose.
Guard Iskandar says, "If you would... see it back to Byrthia."
Guard Iskandar straightens at once, his gaze forward again.
Guard Iskandar says, "Now... move along citizen, if you please."

You gain experience!!



Your faction standing with Citizens of Night Harbor got better.

Your faction standing with Merchants of Night Harbor got better.

Your faction standing with City Watch of Night Harbor got better.



You receive Iskandar's Padded Loin Guard from Guard Iskandar.

You receive 2 copper from Guard Iskandar.

In Byrthia's Laundry Basket: Combine Steinn's Dirty Laundry, Layith's Soiled Stockings, and Iskandar's Padded Loin Guard create a finished laundry basket. Give it to Byrthia.

A wash maiden sets the basked down with a heavy thump, then looks at you with tired eyes and a grateful smile. 
A wash maiden says "You've done more than carry cloth today. You helped an old ogre keep her promises."
A wash maiden nods. 
A wash maiden says "That matters. Words matter. Keeping your word matters a lot in cities like this one. A few words from the right person can change lives."

A wash maiden rummages beneath the wash table and produces a small rolled parchment sakk, worn smooth from handling.
A wash maiden says "Speaking of words and promises...this here's a sakk. Good as tender with merchants in Night Harbor. This one is for tailoring services."

A wash maiden turns it over in her palm.
A wash maiden says "I was going to choose something for myself. Thought I might need it."

A wash maiden presses it into your hands instead.
A wash maiden says "But I think it'll suit you better than it ever would me."

You receive a note, Crude Tailoring Saak

It reads 'Upon receipt of this sakk, the Bank of Night Harbor commands the tradesman recipient to award the sum of five silver to the bearer for acts of service in the tailoring trade. This sakk is valid only within Night Harbor.'

A wash maiden pauses.
A wash maiden says "Now there's a choice you have to make, lily."

A wash maiden crinkles her eyes with a knowing look.
A wash maiden says "Do you want a shirt or a robe?"

<say "shirt" or "robe" and the wash maiden will give you a Crude Tailoring Sakk>

Part 2A, if you want a shirt

Go to the tailor's shop with the loom in Night Harbor. Give Noura the Tailor the Crude Tailoring Sakk that you got from the wash woman.

Noura the Tailor says 'Oh! Well now. I haven't seen one of these in a while.
Noura the Tailor says 'Aye, this is good. It's a tradesman sakk endorsed by the Bank of Night Harbor. It covers the labor for a shirt commission just fine.

Noura the Tailor says 'Hmm,that's a shame.
Noura the Tailor says 'The sakk pays for my hands and my time and I'll honor that gladly. But the materials...you might as well hang on to that sakk until I can get more in.

She gives you back the note.

Noura the Tailor says 'You see, I'll need six crude silk scraps. I don't know when I'll get more in the shop. Maybe come back later.'

(I went back later and gave her the note again.)

Noura the Tailor glances at the sakk and gives a small approving nod.

Noura the Tailor says 'Aye, this is good. It's a tradesman sakk endorsed by the Bank of Night Harbor. It covers the labor for a shirt commission just fine.'

Noura the Tailor folds it neatly and hands it back to you rather than taking it.

Noura the Tailor says 'But hold on for it now. A shirt is not stitched from promises along. I will need six crude silk scraps for the cloth, the backstrap loom to work them proper, and...'

Noura the Tailor's expression softens.

Noura the Tailor says '...and my uncle's house key returned to me. Bring me those, along with the sakk, and I will see the shirt made.
Noura the Tailor says 'Come back when you have them all together. Then we shall make something worthy of the trouble.'

You receive your items back from Noura the Tailor. 
You say 'crude silk scraps.'

Noura the Tailor lets her gaze drift for a moment.
Noura the Tailor says 'I used to gather it from cobweavers when I was a girl. My uncle was a boatwright. He had a place down my the harbor with old beams, salt in the air...and tiny spiders everywhere.'

Noura the Tailor slowly drops her smile. 
Noura the Tailor says 'He passed a few years back. I've not had the heart to go rooting through the place since.

Noura the Tailor looks back at you with a hopeful glint in her eyes.
Noura the Tailor says 'If you're willing to check the old house for crude silk, let me know. Six crude silk scraps is all I need.'

You say 'I will check the old house.

Noura the Tailor gives you a reassuring nod while handing you a bronze key from behing the fabric rack.

You receive Bronze Boatwright's Key from Noura the Tailor.

Noura the Tailor says 'Head out of the market and go east until you get to the entrance of Saltbreeze Park, but don't enter the park. Instead, head south toward the harbor.
Noura the Tailor says 'Once you get to the harbor, bear just a little right, and my uncle's house will be on the left at the small dry dock. There should be no one living there, but if a vagrant has moved in, grab a watchman.
Noura the Tailor says 'Remember, I need six crude silk scrap. Bring them back with your sakk, and I'll have your shirt stiched soon thereafter. Oh, you will need this also.'

Noura the Tailor gives you a small loom.

You receive Backstrap Loom from Noura the Tailor.

Noura the Tailor says 'Use this to combine four crude silk webs to make the scraps Give this back to me when you have them made.'

To find her uncle's house, go left from Saltbreeze Park, following the sign. When you get to the end of the road, you'll be facing some barrels and boxes. Go to the right of that building. Just around the corner on the left is a door with anchors on either side. Hold the key on your cursor and click on the door.


<note> There is a child's diary which can be picked up, which is on the bench next to the stove.  Use the /take book command.  It is unrelated to the Laundry Day quest.

You will find 4 cobweaver hatchlings and a cobweaver spider. They are lvl 1 (?), not KoS but social. Loot 24 Crude Spider Silk. Combine 4 at a time in the loom until you have 6 Crude Silk Scraps.

Return to Noura the Tailor and give her the Bronze Boatwright's Key, the Backstrap Loom, the original note, and the silks (stacked).

You gain experience!!


Your faction standing with Citizens of Night Harbor got better.

Your faction standing with Merchants of Night Harbor got better.

Noura the Tailor takes in the bundle of material with wide eyes, already testing the crude silk's strength between her nimble fingers.
Noura the Tailor says "Well now! You truly went and found them. Excellent!"
Noura the Tailor drops her gaze briefly to the old key. She hesitates, then clears her throat.
Noura the Tailor says "Thank you for returning this to me. My uncle was a kind man. I was very young when he passed away. My aunt passed not too long after that."
Noura the Tailor says "I was brought to the Wayfarers Hospice and raised by Sojourners. The key was given to me later by the priests of Relle."
Noura the Tailor sets the key aside carefully, before clapping her hands once with renewed brightness.
Noura the Tailor says "Right then! The sakk covers my labor and you've brought the materials. Stand back just a moment. Let me see what we can make of this."
Noura the Tailor mounts the silk upon the backstrap loom, working the threads with suprising speed. The soft rasp of fiber sliding through fiber fills the shop. After a short while, she lifts a freshly sewn garment from her work table.
Noura the Tailor says "There we are. One crude silk shirt. It's dirty and won't turn any heads in Highpoint Terrace, but it'll serve you well enough."
Noura the Tailor folds it neatly and hands it to you.
Noura the Tailor says "All you need to do now is wash it. Head down to the water in the harbor, near my uncle's house. There are some scullery maidens washing and drying the clothes. Tell them Noura sent you, and they'll show you what you need to do next."

You receive Dirty Crude Silk Shirt from Noura the Tailor

Part 2B if you want a robe:

Go to Mira Gables, who is in a building near the north gate. Hail her.

Mira Gables says "Yes? How may I help you?"

Give Mira Gables the Crude Tailoring Sakk note.

Mira Gables takes the sakk and weighs it in her palm, assessing it with sharp eyes. She nods once, satisfied.
Mira Gables says "I will honor it."
Mira Gables turns and glides her fingers over the hanging robes and folded bolts, considering the fabrics. After a moment, she stops.
Mira Gables says "No."
Mira Gables says "The sakk, of course, is for the work, not the weave."
Mira Gables says "Crude silk, not the fine kind scholars preen over, mind you. Common silk. Resourceful, durable, and resilient, much like those priests of Porbor."

Mira Gables searches through her materials and produces a small stack of crude silk.
Mira Gables says " I have six crude silk scraps here, but will need twelve to finish a robe."

Mira Gables places the sakk in your hand.
Mira Gables says "Keep the sakk for now. Since my crude silk stock is low, you will have to wait until I find more."

<She stops talking and turns away. You must prompt her by saying 'crude silk'.>

Mira Gables lifts her brown slightly at the word.
Mira Gables says "Yes. Crude. Specifically, crude silk scraps."
Mira Gables says "Crude silk comes from cobweavers. You know, the tiny spiders no bigger than my thumb. Hardly a challenge for a slayer such as yourself."

Mira Gables rolls her eyes, her gaze then drifting toward the distant harbor.
Mira Gables says "There is an old house where you might find some. It is abandoned now. The owner passed long ago, and no one has been there in years. It is likely crawling with cobweavers, though, it was locked the last time I passed by."
Mira Gables says " I knew the family once...well, I was a friend of the girl who lived there."

Mira Gables pauses, then shakes her head slightly.
Mira Gables says "Never mind. That was long ago."
Mira Gables says "If you wish to check out the house, let me know. Otherwise, just return later when I have more crude silk in stock."

<You say "I will check out the house.>

Mira Gables briefly hesitates at your words.
Mira Gables says "Oh...you want to check out the house?"
Mira Gables says "When I was a girl, I stayed there often with my friend. We used to gather cobweaver silk from the attic. We made clothes for our dolls from it. Poor sticthes, but we were proud of them."

Mira Gables pauses a moment, as if debating whether she should go on.
Mira Gables says "...But there is a curious barrel along the side of the building, under a torn awning. Always was."

Mira Gables meets your eyes.
Mira Gables says "The lid hides a small door we used to sneak through. I think they put it there as a way to cover the hole in the wall without pinching he purse."
Mira Gables says "We would slip inside at night, then head down to the water to swim in the harbor. If her uncle caught us...well, he never did.  He slept like a Scarwood bear in winter and we were quiet as mice."

Mira Gables allows herself a faint, fleeting smile.
Mira Gables says "Good luck. I will see you when you get back. Oh, I almost forgot! You will need this."

Mira Gables hands you a small loom.

You receive a Backstrap Loom

Mira Gables says "Use this to combine four crude silk webs to make the scraps, then return it to me when you have them made."

(Follow the directions in Part 2A to find the house.)
There are several crates and barrels along the side of the house. One is on its side. If you /inspect the barrel, it say [insert text, I don't remember.] Then /push lid.  Then crouch in front of the barrel to be teleported into the house. Kill cobweavers and combine the crude silk thread they drop in the backstrap loom until you have 6 crude silk scraps. Return to Mira Gables.

Give Mira Gables the six crude silk scraps, the note, and the backstrap loom.

Mira Gables gathers the crude silk scraps in her hands.
Mira Gables says, "Yes...these will do nicely. Strong fibers."

Mira Gables accepts the sakk, the six crude silk scraps, and the backstrap loom without ceremony, her expression steady and unreadable
Mira Gables says, "Good. Everything is in order."

Mira Gables wastes no time, mounting the crude silk upon the loom with swift, efficient movements.
Mira Gables says "This will only take a minute or two."

Mira Gables gets to work. The soft pull and snap of tightened threads fills the room. After some time, she cuts the finished garment free and gives it a brisk shake.

"Mira Gables says "There. A crude silk robe,"

Mira Gables folds it and hands it over to you.

You receive Dirty Crude Silk Robe

Mira Gables says "It is dirty and will not turn heads in Highpoint Terracce, but it will server you well, I think."

Mira Gables folds it neatly and presses it into your hands.
Mira Gables says "All you need to do is wash it. Down by the water in the harbor, near the boatwright's house, there are some scullery maids working, washing and dying the clothes. Tell them Mira sent you. They will show you what you need to do next."

Part 3 for either robe or shirt

Go back to the uncle's house, turn left at the water and follow it around until you get to Riham.

Riham leaves her store at 6PM in-game time.

Noura the Tailor/Mira Gables sends you to see Riham to get your Dirty Silk Shirt/Robe cleaned. 
Riham is on the dock, to the left of the uncle's house along the waterfront. She is there only during the day.

Hail Riham.

Riham says 'Hail. Mind the dye and speak your purpose.'

<You say 'Noura/Mira sent me...The dialogue is slightly different based on whether Norua or Mira sent you but it ends up the same.>

Riham says 'Noura sent you? Good. Kind of her to remember us. 
Riham says 'I have known her since she was a child. She, since then, has grown into a fine seamstress.
Riham says 'If she sent you, then you've cloth that needs color. But dye will not take to dirt.
Riham says 'Wash the silk first. I have soap for sale, and you may use the basins there.
Riham says 'When it is clean, bring it back to me and I will show you how to set the dye proper.'

Buy a <bar of soap> from Riham. /Inspect the basin until you find one that emotes:
'The wash basin is filled with fresh, sudsy water, carrying the rich scent of tallow soap softened by crushed oils and dried desert flowers.'

/Place soap    in the basin. (with the soap on your cursor type /place basin)

'You lower the block of tallow soap into the basin, and it begins to soften at once, releasing a clean, fatty scent as pale suds bloom across the surface.'

/Rub shirt (or robe)
'You scrub the shirt/robe in the murky basin, but the fouled water only spreads the grime in dull streaks across the crude silk. When you lift it out, it is no cleaner than before and perhaps, worse. This shirt will still need of a proper washing come morning.'
<game time is 7pm. I went back at 9am. I tried to use the original basin and it wouldn't work so I inspected the other basins until I found one that had the same emote>

/Rub shirt/robe
'You kneel at the basin and work the shirt against the soap-slick stone, beating and rinsing until the grime loosens and slips away in cloudy swirls.
'When you lift it free, the crude silk hangs clean and damp in your hands, ready at last for dye.'

Give the wet robe/shirt to Riham and she tells you it's clean and that you can pick a basin of dye to use next.

Stand in front of the desired <color> basin and type ( /rub robe/shirt).

After dying the robe/shirt, hand it to Riham.

'Riham takes the damp shirt'

Riham says 'You have done well. The dye has taken true.'

'Riham steps toward the open side of the dye house where the sea breeze rolls in. With practiced movements, she lifts the garment high, letting the coastal wind snap through the silk while the desert sun beats down upon it. Steam rises faintly as she turns it in her hands.'

Riham says 'Honor the earth from which the silk is drawn, the water that cleanses it, the fire of the sun that strengthened it, and the air...the faithful winds that set the work. These elements are the tools of the Tradesman.'

'Riham lowers the now-dry garment, its color rich and even across the weave. She folds it once and places it back into your hands.' 
Riham says,'Here, your shirt is ready to server you. Wear it well.'

You receive <Red> Crude Silk Shirt.

Black, orange, yellow, blue, red, green, and white are available.

Debtcarver

Vest of Shattered Duty

Leggings of Reckoning

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Locate an undead poacher inside the bear cave near the Tree House.


 an undead poacher says, "Betrayed... cowards..."

You say, "Who betrayed you?"

 an undead poacher says, "My memory has faded... even my name is lost to me. Yet I remmeber the two men whose names were known by all... simply for surviving. Cowards. They left me to die"



Loot Torn Leather Bracer from a cave bear



Give Torn Leather Bracer to an undead poacher

an undead poacher transforms as his memory returns to him. The bracer falls to the ground and you pick it back up.

You receive your items back from an undead poacher.



Torn Leather Bracer is handed back to you


Hail, Fendris the Forsaken.

 Fendris the Forsaken says, "I linger here, shackled by vengeance. When the bears descended upon our camp, my companions ran and left me to die."

 Fendris the Forsaken says, "This corpse cannot hunt them down... but you can. Bring me proof of their deaths, as well as my bracer, and I will see you rewarded before my spirit is free."

Old Mother Roshan is located inside the Seekers of the Lost Eye on ground level.

You say, "Hail, Old Mother Roshan."

Old Mother Roshan staightens up, her old bones creaking, yet there's a youthful energy in her movements.

Old Mother Roshan says, "Oh, hello, dear. The Seekers of the Lost Eye welcome you. Are you looking for some work, perhaps?"

You say, "Work?"

Old Mother Roshan says, "Ah, wonderful. I have a small task for you."

Old Mother Roshan says, "Little Tamsah is hungry and needs some meat. Her favorite is rat meat, though she'd be more than happy with jackal or bat meat. Really, as long as it's not gator meat, I'm sure she'll be satisfied!"

Old Mother Roshan says, "Just watch your fingers when you give it to her, she doesn't discriminate."

Old Mother Roshan cackles.

Little Tamsah is a crocodile located inside the Seekers of the Lost Eye on ground level.

Give a Raw Rat Meat, Raw Jackal Meat or Raw Bat Meat to Little Tamsah.

Little Tamsah snaps up the meat greedily with her strong jaws, her body almost twisting it from your hand. Within a second, the meat is gone. Little Tamsah watches you in anticipation.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Seekers of the Lost Eye got better.

This quest is repeatable.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Mierra Willowshade is located inside the building adjacent to the Inn next to the Newbie Lift.

You say, "Hail, Mierra Willowshade."

Mierra Willowshade says, "Fair shades to you! We have plenty of delicious goods for sale if you're looking for something scrumptious. Though, I'm unfortunately out of my famed jelly cupcakes."

You say, "What famed jelly cupcakes?"

Mierra Willowshade says, "They're sold out faster than I can whip them up! You look like a capable sort, though. Tell you what... could you gather more of my special ingredient? I'll make it worth your while!"

You say, "What special ingredient?"

Mierra Willowshade lowers her voice to a whisper and leans in close to you.

Mierra Willowshade says, "Shh, not so loud! It's special, but also secret! You'll need to gather some royal jelly from the wasps down on the forest floor."

Mierra Willowshade says, "Bring me four helpings of that precious jelly and I'll bake a special batch of my jelly cupcakes, just for you! You'll be the talk of the terrace!"

Collect 4 Royal Jelly from a wasp drone or a wasp worker in Evershade Weald, then return to Mierra Willowshade and hand them to her.

Mierra Willowshade says, "Oh, this is perfect! You wait right there while I get these prepared for you!"

Mierra Willowshade hums a tune as she sets to work preparing a batch of freshly baked jelly cupcakes. The aroma is sweet and delectable as she pulls them from the oven and wraps them in paper for you.

Mierra Willowshade says, "Here you are, <player>! Thank you so much for your help. I'll use the extra jelly to bake cupcakes for tomorrow's batch. If you ever come across more, you know where to find me!"

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Citizens of Faelindral got better.

You receive Jelly Cupcake from Mierra Willowshade.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest begins in the Underdocks upper city district by talking with Hull Orbel. Hull is located near the Delvestone miners on the northeast side of the upper city.

You say, "Hail, Hull Orbel."

Hull Orbel says, "Bandits! Blaggards! Mold-eating malefactors!"

You say, "What bandits?"

Hull Orbel says, "Aye! The Deepcut are murderers and thieves. Indeed!"

You say, "Who are the deepcut?"

Hull Orbel says, "Reptiles! Ruffians! Every last one of 'em. Darrowdwell is ours to mine by right."

Hull Orbel shakes his head.

Hull Orbel says, "Say, whip the rascals and I'll pay you handsomely for four reclaimed mining picks!"

You say, "Where is Darrowdwell?"

Hull Orbel says, "Aye, the mine is just beneath yer feet. Full of precious gems and ores, if it weren't for those profiteers. Parasites!"

Hull Orbel is looking for Delvestone Mining Pick from the Deepcut miners, which can be found in the mines on the rafters level. Take the elevator directly across from Hull Orbel on the southeast side of the wooden bridge.

Note that Broken Mining Pick will NOT work for this quest.

Upon handing in 4 Delvestone Mining Pick to Hull Orbel...

You gain experience!!

Hull Orbel laughs heartily.

Hull Orbel says, "Ye've done it! Curse the assassins! Earthworms! Take this as a token of our appreciation."

Your faction standing with Delvestone Mining Company got better.

Your faction standing with The Underwatch got better.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Underdocks got better.

Your faction standing with Deepcut Bandits got worse.

You receive Patched Rawhide or Patched Cloth from Hull Orbel.

You receive 3 silver, 18 copper from Hull Orbel.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience

First Degree Fourfold Sash (Monk)

sections.title: Part 1: First Degree
sections.text:
Read Humble Note you start with as a new Monk Character:

Dear <Player>,

You are invited to come train at the School of the
Fourfold Path.

If you're not afraid to push your body to the brink
and test the limits of your endurance, deliver this
note to Chahaya Tam, one of the masters of our
school.

Bring nothing more than the clothes on your back
and your bare fists. The more calloused, the better.

The school is located in Twilight Harbor, directly
south of Saltbreeze Park. If you see elementals
floating about, you'll know you're close.

Train and Fight! Seek discipline! Always pursue
your highest self!

Hand Humble Note to Chahaya Tam

You gain experience!!

Chahaya Tam takes the note from you, furrowing her brow.
Chahaya Tam says, "You wish to train with our order?"
Chahaya Tam bows deeply.
Chahaya Tam says, "Welcome to the School of the Fourfold Path, where one can refine their body and mind, and seek a connection with the four elements. I am Master Chahaya Tam, I lead this order, alongside my husband, Tenebrim. You have done well to seek us out, as there are no greater adepts of the pugilist arts within this city than us."
Chahaya Tam reaches out, and clasps your shoulder, her grip tight, yet you can tell she is holding back some of her strength within her corded muscles.
Chahaya Tam says, "Let's get started. For your initial training, I would like you to approach and challenge some of our students to a sparring match. They will not hold back, and I do not expect you to, either. If they know you down, the match will be over, but you can return to spar later when you have honed your skill. If you have further questions about the matches, just ask about them. All of us in the order have had to pass through this trial by fire, so to speak."
Chahaya Tam says, "Wear your belt, so they know you as a fellow student, and speak to them to start sparring. Recover a training emblem from them. When you have bested three of our students, return to me, along with your belt. Tran and fight!"
Chahaya Tam bows to you once again, clasping her fist in her open hand.

You receive Fourfold Sash from Chahaya Tam.

Hail a strong sparring monk and say "let's spar", then proceed to defeat 3 of them.

Loot Training Emblem from each corpse.

Hand all 3 Training Emblem and your Fourfold Sash to Chahaya Tam

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path got better.

Chahaya Tam says, "Wonderful! Wasn't it an exhilarating experience? Do not worry, your bruises will heal in time."
Chahaya Tam clasps her hand against your back.
Chahaya Tam says, "Your first victories! I am proud of you and present you with your new belt, marking you as a member of the First Degree."
Chahaya Tam ties the sash around your waist, affixing a single seal to it.
Chahaya Tam says, "Wear it with pride, <player>"
Chahaya Tam says, "Now, go and get some training. Once you have a few more matches under your belt, and have spent time with your fellow adventurers, come to me for your next task."

You receive First Degree Fourfold Sash from Chahaya Tam.

sections.title: Part 2 : Second Degree - Req. Lvl 3
sections.text:
Hail Chahaya Tam once you've completed part 1. Chahaya will tell you that you must adventure outside and retrieve 3  Ashira Scout Necklaces by defeating  Ashira Scouts. Once retrieved, hand these in to Chahaya Tam and your belt for quest completion.

You receive Second Degree Fourfold Sash from Chahaya Tam.

sections.title: Part 3 : Third Degree - Req. Lvl 5
sections.text:
Chahaya Tam says, "<character>! There you are."
Chahaya Tam says, "I see a few additional scars... you must have been out training. Good!"
Chahaya Tam says, "We've been honing your physical prowess, but today, you're going to work on another side of yourself. Your mind needs to be one with your body."
Chahaya Tam says, "We need you to head into the sweltering heat of the Shaded Dunes and find the refreshing Waterfall of Serenity."
Chahaya Tam says, "Do you feel up to the task? Hand me your belt if so. I'll check it for wear and tear."

Hand your belt to Chahaya Tam.

Chahaya Tam smiles at you.
Chahaya Tam says, "I can see you've taken good care of it."
Chahaya Tam pats you on the shoulder and hands it back to you.
You receive Second Degree Fourfold Sash from Chahaya Tam.
Chahaya Tam says, "Take this elixir and be on your way. Remember, this is a test of the mind, not the body."
You receive Elixir of Mental Focus from Chahaya Tam.

Where to go:

Shaded Dunes is the next zone west of Night Harbor.
The waterfall is in an oasis looking area at the western side of the zone.
The easiest way to find it, is to follow the road from the zone almost to the next zone (Fallen Pass). You'll see the oasis on your left.

When you get to the right place alongside the water:

The serene waterfall gently flows down the dune into the oasis below. It seems to match Chahaya's description.

Drink the Elixir.

Note: You must stand on solid ground, if you are swimming the attacks will kill you.

Do not attack! Simply stand there. All damage will be "absorbed" and not hurt you.

a familiar shadow says, "Come on, hit me. You know you want to."
a familiar shadow offers a vague smile as it coalesces into the shape of a medallion, resting into the hand of the monk who passed their trial.
Your mind clears.
You are blinded.
You can see again.
You are blinded.
You can see again.
You are blinded.
Your clarity fades.
You can see again.

Go back and hand the medallion together with your belt to Chahaya Tam.

Chahaya Tam beams with pride.
Chahaya Tam says, "Wonderful, trainee. You've manage to overcome your fears and focus your mind to the limit of its current capabilities!"
Chahaya Tam says, "I'm truly delighted to award yo with the rank of third-degree monk!"
You gain experience!!
You receive Third Degree Fourfold Sash from Chahaya Tam.
Your faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path got better.
Chahaya Tam says, "It's no small feat for a trainee to have such control, you should be proud of yourself."
Chahaya Tam says, "Now, be on your way... and keep training!

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest begins in the Underdocks citadel district by talking with a meat vendor, Munk.

You say, "Hail, Munk."

Munk says, "Welcome to Munk's Meats! Big food for big appetites!"

Munk looks around and raises his voice to a boom.

Munk says, "Small butchers won't cut you portions to fill, only portions to sit on a scale!"

Munk slaps his belly with both hands.

Munk says, "If you're hungry, I'll cook you a slab you can feed your whole family with! And no brick-sitting butcher can tell you otherwise!"

You say, "What is in your meat?"

Munk says, "It's good meat! Tasty with spices and enough to fill you up for your adventures. The contents are my... secret family recipe."

You say, "How can I learn your secret family recipe?"

Munk says, "Buy something or step aside for other customers. I have meat to sell!"

Munk sells Munk's Meat for 5 copper each.

Around the corner is another meat shop staffed by Apprentice Millen and Ebba Dungor.

You say, "Hail, Apprentice Millen."

Apprentice Millen says, "Welcome to my master's shop. She trained for two decades in Darra Nor, learning the cut, handling, and presentation of delicate meats. The nobility and common folk alike come to her for her skills."

Apprentice Millen frowns slightly.

Apprentice Millen says, "Well, not as many common folk anymore..."

You say, "What is Darra Nor?"

Apprentice Millen says, "It's rather far off. I've never been there myself but the stories my Master told me make it sound like a welcoming place."

You say, "What nobility?"

Apprentice Millen says, "Oh yes, most of our orders come from the nobility. They, at least, have a discerning taste for quality."

Apprentice Millen frowns slightly.

Apprentice Millen says, "Well, not as many common folk anymore..."

You say, "Who is your master?"

Apprentice Millen points towards Ebba Dungor.

Apprentice Millen says, "She's right over there. She can help you if you need anything more."

Speak with Ebba Dungor.

You say, "Hail, Ebba Dungor."

Ebba Dungor says, "You'll find no cleaner cuts in the Underdocks! And I don't pad my wares with... dubious meats like other butchers."

Handing Ebba or Millen a piece of Munk's Meat does not yield any further text. This may just be flavor conversations between two rival butchers.

More information is required

This quest is repeatable.

This quest begins in the Underdocks eastern district inside the build directly across from the landing raft by speaking with Mikra Velrane.

You say, "Hail, Mikra Velrane."

Mikra Velrane says, "Hello. I am the contract clerk for the Descendian guild. If you have a problem you think the guild can take care of, please feel free to submit a request."

You say, "What problems?"

Mikra Velrane says, "There's no end to the number of problems that occur in the Underdocks. Right now, we are tasked with helping the Thieves Guild and the Mushroom Farmers."

You say, "I would like to help the Mushroom Farmers."

Mikra Velrane says, "The beetles keep eating their mushrooms. Go out and kill six of them to reduce their numbers and the amount of destruction to the crops."

Mikra Velrane says, "Show me six of their legs as proof of their demise."

Head out the northern gate and hunt a deep beetle and its variants to loot 6 Severed Deep Beetle Leg.

Hand 6 Severed Deep Beetle Leg to Mikra Velrane.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

Your faction standing with Citizens of Underdocks got better.

Mikra Velrane says, "Nice work, <<CLASS>>! Bring this receipt to Elara to collect your reward."

Note: The Bounty reward item appears to be mismatched as of 2026-09-21. You will receive the Thieves Guild Bounty despite aiding the Mushroom Farmers...

Turn in the Thieves Guild Bounty to Elara Venn, located next to Mikra Velrane.

Elara Venn says, "Here is your reward, <<CLASS>>. There are shops across the water if you'd like to spend it!"

You gain experience!!

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Sporeweaver Underveil is located in the mushroom cave close to Faelindral.

You say, "Hail, Sporeweaver Underveil."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "I welcome you to the depths of Sporehaven Karst, <class>. Our myconids are of no threat under normal circumstances, though it appears something has tampered with the latest strain."

You say, "What latest strain?"

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "I cannot say for certain what is causing the aggression in our latest strain, but I do have my suspicion. They seem to get riled when the sun sets and a mysterious foam builds along the riverbanks of the Karst."

You say, "What mysterious foam?"

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "I have discovered traces of the mysterious foam caught in the gills of some of our myconid children, though I have not yet procured enough to get an understanding of what it truly is."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "Should a myconid become enthralled by the substance, they soon begin sending out messages of warning through the nerve structures  of their surrounding kin, riling them into a defensive frenzy."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "I am loathe to ask this of you, stranger, but I am not strong enough to bring low any of my children. Would you be able to take a stand against my beguiled creations?"

You say, "I will take a stand."

Sporeweaver Underveil lets out a sad breath, nodding in understanding.

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "Then I entrust the deed to you. Seek out my beguiled children here in the Karst; the bluecaps appear to be the most susceptible at night."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "Cull what you must to procure a section of their gills that shimmers with traces of the prismatic foam. Bring what you find to me, so I can save what remains of our latest strain."

Sporeweaver Underveil lowers his head somberly.

Collect Prismatic Gills from a beguiled bluecap during the night and deliver them to Sporeweaver Underveil.

Need item verification along with quantity required for turn-in.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Circle of Spores got better.

Your faction standing with Naelira's Court got worse.

Sporeweaver Underveil accepts the gills with a frown.

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "Such a waste of a beautiful strain. I understand why it had to be done, but this goes against the balance of the Weald. My poor children were never meant to be enthralled by something not of this world."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "Which is precisely what this magic resembles... the machinations of the naiads. I had my suspicions, but this evidence you brought me confirms them."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "They have tainted the river with their influence. To what end, I care not. I only ask, will you provide me the opportunity to avenge my fallen kin?"

Sporeweaver Underveil clasps his hands to yours, placing a small glass phial into your palm as he stares intently at you.

You say, "I will avenge your fallen kin."

You receive Underveil's Phial from Sporeweaver Underveil.

Sporeweaver Underveil lets out a sigh of relief.

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "Thank you, stranger. Enter the domain of the naiads and use what force or guile is necessary to reach the pools that dwell within."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "Rumors tell of their ability to enthrall beings of pure water. If these rumors hold true, I need you to collect at least four samples of this enchanted water so that I can study it and develop a countermeasure for my own creations."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "Do this for me, and you will have the eternal gratitude of the Circle of Spores. I wish you luck, stranger."

Collect 4 Enchanted Water from a beguiled water elemental in the naiad cave upstream and combine them in Underveil's Phial.

After handing Sporeweaver Underveil the completed sample you receive Staff of Spores.

You receive Staff of Spores from Sporeweaver Underveil.

Need combined item name, along with relevant dialogue, exp, money, faction hits.

links.label: Symbol of the Concourse of Souls
links.title: Symbol of the Concourse of Souls

sections.title: Part 1
sections.text:
Read Weathered Note you start with as a new Necromancer character:

You have been summoned to the Concourse of Souls.

Show this note to Marvion Hallows in the Concourse's library to begin your training.

The Concourse is carved into the mountainside of the necropolis. It is accessible through Sageside; simply head north before you enter Saltbreeze Park.

Or, if you're feeling daring, take the shortcut through the old cemetery outside the Black Feather Bazaar.

You may speak with a guard if you get lost; however, exercise caution, as some do not agree with our practices.

And try not to die. We have enough undead in the desert already.

Give Weathered Note to Marvion Hallows.

Marvion Hallows says, "Oh, a new student!  This is worth the interruption, well, as long as you don't make a habit of it.  I assume you'll be dealing primarily with Buckmarr, Sekhmet, or one of Exavius's people, as I am quite busy."

Marvion Hallows says, "Given the influx of new students, Sekhmet should be prepared for your arrival.  Take your note to him.  You'll find him below in the morgue."

Receive Weathered Note from Marvion Hallows.

You gain experience!!

sections.title: Part 2
sections.text:
Give Weathered Note to Sekhmet who is also in the Concourse of Souls.

Sekhmet smiles at you awkwardly, yet seems genuinely happy to meet you.

Sekhmet says, "Welcome to the Concourse of Souls!  As the professor may have mentioned, I am Sekhmet.  I will assist you in your studies."

Sekhmet says, "As you can see, we try to keep the morgues well-stocked to accommodate a broad varied range of study.  Fortunately, Night Harbor is generous in its donations to our cause... the city produces a lot of dead."

Sekhmet sighs, and then perks up again.

Sekhmet says, "Buckmarr, our alchemist, asked me to gather some materials for him. I genuinely do not enjoy the outdoors, so perhaps you could assist with this?  Take this jar and fill it with Incarnal Residue.  Eight should do. Then bring it to Buckmarr."

Sekhmet squints and leans forward, as if expecting a question from you.

Sekhmet says, "You do know what incarnal residue is, do you not?"

Receive Small Clay Jar from Sekhmet.

You gain experience!!

You say, "No. What is incarnal residue?"

Sekhmet says, "Excellent question! Incarnal residue is the name that Buckmarr has given a fascinating substance he is researching. He is very fond of giving things new names."

Sekhmet says, "The residue can be found on the bones of reanimated skeletons. Though Buckt disagrees, I believe it manifests most commonly when the skeleton's life, or more accurately, animating energy is drained from its corporeal form through necromantic magic."

Sekhmet says, "Keep that in mind."

Sekhmet says, "Good hunting, and do not forget to give the jar to Buckmarr once it has been filled!"

sections.title: Part 3
sections.text:
Combine 8 Incarnal Residue in Small Clay Jar to get a filled Small Clay Jar.  Hand it to Buckmarr Gorstagg in the Concourse of Souls.

Newbie Note: if the jar is missing after hitting combine, check your tradeskill containers

Buckmarr Gorstagg stares at you with a puzzled expression.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Ahh, you're new. I bet Sekhmet sent you out so he could continue to hide inside. Did he tell you that this was my discovery?"

Buckmarr Gorstagg holds up the jar proudly.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Well, it was.  It's just one of many. I have a knack for alchemical advancement. One day, our modest college will be quite renowned at the rate I'm going."

Buckmarr Gorstagg fetches a simple robe with the guild's cred embroidered on its collar.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Speaking of renown, you may wear this to formalize your association with our fine school."

Receive Black and Gold Robe from Buckmarr Gorstagg

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Now, if you'd like to assist me with another matter, read this list and return it to me along with the materials it describes.  These items are vital to my research."

Receive Buckmarr's List from Buckmarr Gorstagg

Buckmarr Gorstagg pauses to stare at you in a more serious manner.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Except for the pelt, that's a personal matter.  I loathe wererats."

You gain experience!!

sections.title: Part 4
sections.text:
Turn in Buckmarr's List along with Wererat Pelt, Corrupted Heart, Ghostly Cloth Scrap, Vibroplasmic Residue

Buckmarr Gorstagg examines the pelt for a moment before throwing it over a collection of wererat heads.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Well, I hope that one suffered."

Buckmarr Gorstagg returns his attention to you.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Thank you for the materials.  I'll likely need more assistance in the future, but in the meantime, familiarize yourself with the others you'll find here."

Receive Symbol of the Concourse of Souls from Buckmarr Gorstagg

You gain experience!!
