sections.title: Overview
sections.text: The introductory class quest line for Necromancers starting in the Underdocks under the banner of Ygorath.

sections.title: Part 1
sections.text:
Find the tunnel in the South East corner of Underdocks. Soren Akedd is in the first room inside the temple. You say, 'Hail, Soren Akedd'

Soren Akedd says, "You appear before me as you were in my nightmare, [Player]."

You say, 'What nightmare?'

Soren Akedd says, "Nightmares are visits from Ygorath, gifted upon the fearful of this land. It was my nightmare that called you here to begin his work."

You say, 'Ygorath'

Soren Akedd says, "He is the fear and the terror that opens our eyes."

A black bat screeches as it swoops in to attack Soren Akedd!

You say, 'What work?'

Soren Akedd says, "It is the work of trembling hands to raise both the living and the dead upon his altar. It is for their salvation as much as our own."
Soren Akedd says, "Many souls walk Eth-ur practicing feints of valor, but Ygorath's wisdom knows bravery to be a thin sheen upon a bottomless terror. We must usher them into his kingdom with right fear in their hearts."
Soren Akedd says, "This you must do, Necromancer, whether by sign or by sword. If you pass the test."

You say, 'What test?'

Soren Akedd says, "The rabble fear in their blood and their bones. Ours are borne by Ygorath. This is your test: take this Effigy to the chapel and make of it an offering. Place your effigy upon the altar and receive Ygorath's blessing. Return with what remains."
Soren Akedd gives you Strange Effigy.
Soren Akedd says, "But I must warn you... cast your gaze downward and look not upon the visage of Ygorath."

Go to the chapel and type `/place effigy` near the altar.

As the effigy leaves your fingers, it turns to ash without flame.

You receive Offering Bowl.

Return to Soren Akedd and turn in the Offering Bowl.

Soren Akedd says, "Your eyes are open. Take this drape and rise a new servant of Ygorath."

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.

Your faction standing with The Dreaming Dawn got worse.

You receive Ragged Robe from Soren Akedd.

Soren Akedd says, "Now go, and do his work. I believe Abbot Harrow has tasks suited to an aspirant such as yourself. You may find him below."

sections.title: Part 2
sections.text:
Head to the lower level of the building and locate Abbot Harrow. You say, 'Hail, Abbot Harrow'

Abbot Harrow rifles through a stack of manuscripts.

Abbot Harrow says, "Are you the new aspirant?"

You say, 'I am the new aspirant'

Abbot Harrow says, "Yes, you have that look about you. Like a beaten dog. You might even be commended for tucking tail in the master's temple, but you must learn to stand upright if you are to walk the path."
Abbot Harrow says, "Fortunate for you, I have a task suitable for a pup."

You say, 'What task?'

Abbot Harrow says, "Our work requires material. Test yourself against the risen dead outside the temple."
Abbot Harrow says, "Take this satchel and collect four femurs. Combine and deliver them to my pupil, Vryar."

You receive Femur Satchel from Abbot Harrow.

You say, 'Where is Vryar?'

Abbot Harrow says, "He should be in the cemetery, where he communes with the dead."

sections.title: Part 3
sections.text:
Kill risen skeletons outside the temple to collect 4 femurs. Place all 4 inside the Femur Satchel and combine them to create a Full Femur Satchel.

Find Acolyte Vryar in the cemetery and hand him the Full Femur Satchel.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.

Acolyte Vryar says, "Ah, a delivery. Sister Morvea and I will put these to good use."

Acolyte Vryar scrawls a note in his journal and tears out the page.

Acolyte Vryar says, "Take this receipt and thank the Abbot for giving you this opportunity. Our paths will cross again."

You receive Delivery Receipt.

Return to Abbot Harrow and give him the Delivery Receipt.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better.

Abbot Harrow says, "I am glad to see you did not embarrass yourself today. There will be future opportunities."
Abbot Harrow says, "Until that day comes, heed the word of Ygorath."

Abbot Harrow sighs and hands you a book

You receive Beaten Tome.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience

Simple Penitent Knight's Tunic
Penitent Knight's Tunic

sections.title: Part 1
sections.text:
Read Formal Note you start with as a new Paladin Character:

To whom it may concern,

The Wayfarers Hospice is in need of charitable souls who are gifted with a healing touch.

Please bring this note and your interest to Thibald
Burlond at the Hospice, located in the Travelers
Ward to the north of the city's Western Gate.

Should you find yourself lost, ask one of the guards.
They have likely received our treatment before.

May your journey be blessed.

-The Penitent Knights of the Hospice

Hand Formal Note to Thibald Burlond in the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the West Gate

You gain experience!!

Thibald Burlond reads the note, then gives you a generous nod.
Thibald Burlond suddenly stands upright and straightens his tunic.
Thibald Burlond says, "Welcome to the Wayfarers Hospice. I am Grand Master Thibald Burdlond of the Penitent Knights of the Hospice."
Thibald Burlond says, "We accept all paladins who come to aid and maintain our order, no matter their background or faith."
Thibald Burlond pauses for a moment to assess you.
Thibald Burlond says, "This hospice is known to Night Harbor's citizens and authorities alike as a place of order and charity. Your faith and your history are of no concern, but do not besmirch our good name."
Thibald Burlond says, "Now, please deliver the note you just gave me to Master Fulton. You will serve his needs."

You receive Formal Note from Thibald Burlond.

Hand Formal Note to Trey Fulton

You gain experience!!

Trey Fulton takes the note without reading it and wave you closer.
Trey Fulton says, "Our Grand Master is a loud enough fella, isn't he?"
Trey Fulton says, "It's a pleasure to meet you and all that, but let's cut right to it, eh? We've got a lot of work ahead of us."
Trey Fulton says, "An increasing number of travelers are coming through our city gates having been wounded or worse. Most tell tales of Ashira ambushes or hordes of undead appearing in the night."
Trey Fulton leans closer to you and places something in your hand.
Trey Fulton says, "But before we send you to take on the night, I need you to show this coin to Ol' Grimsul at the inn just across the street. This will be your first big mission."
Trey Fulton winks at you.

You receive Penitent Knight's Coin from Trey Fulton.

Head to the Inn near the West Gate and hand your Penitent Knight's Coin to Halrinn Grimsul

You gain experience!!

Halrinn Grimsul looks at the coin, then returns it.
Halrinn Grimsul says, "Well, it's good to see that the old cuss finally found his appetite."
Halrinn Grimsul says, "It looks like you've become his courier, brave knight."
Halrinn Grimsul says, "But first, you'll need to do the other thing he sent you here for."
Halrinn Grimsul smiles at you and places a filthy bag on the bar.
Halrinn Grimsul says, "As a brave defender of whatever faith you claim to follow, I'm sure my task is a trivial endeavor. I'll need you to kill two birds with one stone, so to speak."
Halrinn Grimsul says, "We're short on staff, so I'm stuck up here for a bit while grain beetles gnaw away at our supplies in the cellar. Also, our cook is running low on ingredients for the stew..."
Halrinn Grimsul says, "You get it, right? Fill the bag with their legs and return it to me. Then you can go back to whatever brave deeds you thought you'd be doing. Just make sure those legs are intact and juicy looking."
Halrinn Grimsul laughs to himself as he wipes down the bar.

You receive Halrinn's Bag from Halrinn Grimsul.

Head behind the bar and head to the basement and kill a grain beetles until you receive 6 of them. Alternatively you can buy them.

Combine 6 of them in Halrinn's Bag ensuring they are not stacked. You will receive Bag of Intact Beetle Legs

Hand Bag of Intact Beetle Legs to Halrinn Grimsul

You gain experience!!

Halrinn Grimsul whistles appreciatively and mock bows.
Halrinn Grimsul says, "Everyone, my brave defender has returned!"
Halrinn Grimsul says, "I may jest, but... I do truly appreciate the assistance. Master Fulton's food is wrapped up and ready to go. Deliver it to my dear sir, before it gets cold."
Halrinn Grimsul says, "And no, don't worry, it's not the stew."
Halrinn Grimsul winks at you.
Halrinn Grimsul leans towards you, taking on a more serious disposition.
Halrinn Grimsul says, "Do see that he gets this and eats it. I'm glad he finally sent for something. I'll not have him waste away from worry."
Halrinn Grimsul says, "The situation with his son is unfortunate, and he's a good man. There's no telling what happened to his son. He was a paladin, like yourself."
Halrinn Grimsul says, "I'll not have him starve while waiting on word in the meantime."

You receive Food for Trey Fulton from Halrinn Grimsul.

Hand Food for Trey Fulton to Trey Fulton

You gain experience!!

Trey Fulton takes the bundled food and sets it aside.
Trey Fulton says, "Thank you for this. I assume Halrinn put you to work for it."
Trey Fulton hands you a simple tunic bearing the guild's insignia.
Trey Fulton says, "Take this for your efforts."
Trey Fulton says, "It was good for you to meet, Halrinn. He may tend bar now, but he was formidable in his day. As were many of the people you'll serve here in the hospice and as part of our guild."
Trey Fulton says, "This place and our duty, is a constant reminder that time moves swiftly, eluding even the most fastidious grasp."
Trey Fulton shakes his head and looks up to meet your gaze.
Trey Fulton says, "Ah, look at me getting all morose. Don your tunic and explore the city. I have nothing for you now, but come back soon and we'll put you to work."

You receive Simple Penitent Knight's Tunic from Trey Fulton.

sections.title: Part 2
sections.text:
Return to the Shaded Bloom Inn near West Gate and ask Halrinn Grimsul about Trey's son

Halrinn Grimsul says, "Master Fulton's son, Troy, went on an expedition to investigate the origins of the undead in our area and has yet to return. His son is an experienced paladin, but he's been missing for weeks."
Halrinn Grimsul sighs.
Halrinn Grimsul says, "Given all the kindness they showed my brother during his last days in the hospice, I'm compelled to assist however I can... But here I am, my adventuring days behind me."
Halrinn Grimsul pauses for a moment, then smacks the bar.
Halrinn Grimsul says, "I overheard a conversation last week between a few inebriated archaeologists from the Wyrmsbane site."
Halrinn Grimsul says, "They've been unable to explore the site too deeply due to increased undead activity, but they mentioned seeing what looked like signs of a recent and significant skirmish."
Halrinn Grimsul says, "It's not much to go on, so I haven't passed it along. I'd hate to worry Master Fulton without real cause. Please keep this between us, and deliver that food before it gets cold."

Head to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane to search for clues regarding the whereabouts of Trey Fulton's son.

To complete this quest, you will need to gather three items and combine them:

Obtain the Tattered Field Pack from Dario Numas. (Note: This is a 2-slot container).
Obtain the Torn Cloak, a rare drop from a skeletal Archer or Skeletal Marksman.
Obtain the Engraved Coin located upstairs in the Tomb. Stand between the two blue-flamed braziers in the "Skull Wall" room until you see the message: "You notice a glimmer from a crack in the floor." Use the command /take coin to retrieve it.

Combine the Torn Cloak and Engraved Coin inside the Tattered Field Pack to create Troy's Field Pack.

Hand Troy's Field Pack to Trey Fulton
You gain experience!!

Trey Fulton abruptly straightens his posture, looking shocked.
Trey Fulton says, "By the Gods! This is my son's field pack. These items belong to Troy!"
Trey Fulton says, "I'd heard rumors that he and his men entered the tomb, but now we have confirmation!"
Trey Fulton says, "The initiative you've shown is only outdone by your heroism. Remove that trainee tunic and take this with my gratitude. You're clearly deserving of a more permanent role here."
Trey Fulton looks at his son's field pack.
Trey Fulton says, "He may have lost his gear, but he's still alive. I can feel it."
Trey Fulton says, "I'm going to speak with Grand Master Burlond about the appropriate course of action. In the meantime, please let me know if you see any signs of my son while you're beyond the gates."

You receive Penitent Knight's Tunic from Trey Fulton.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Farmer Ammar is located at the farm just northeast of the caster tower outside of the North Gate of Night Harbor.

You say, "Hail, Farmer Ammar."

Farmer Ammar says, "Hello! It's good to see you."
Farmer Ammar says, "As you can see, we've been overrun by pests. Our loyal farmhand and I can barely keep up with these filthy interlopers."
Farmer Ammar says, "Care to help us out?"

You say, "I will help."

Farmer Ammar says, "Oh, Krivea's blessings upon you, friend!"
Farmer Ammar says, "My wife, Fadila, is in the house. Bring her proof you've slain these pests... preferably something we can cook up."
Farmer Ammar says, "We'll reward you with what we can. We don't have much, but perhaps some of our supplies could help you on your journey."

You say, "What sort of proof do you require?"

Farmer Ammar says, "Ah, looking for specifics? Fair enough."
Farmer Ammar says, "How about meat from the four-legged ones, eggs from the snakes, and legs from the beetles?"

You are looking for any of the following drops:

Snake Egg
Scarab Leg
Fire Beetle Legs
Raw Rat Meat
Raw Jackal Meat

When you have acquired some proof, turn them in to Fadila back at the farm. She is located in the house behind Farmer Ammar.

You gain experience!!

Fadila says, "Krivea's blessings for your assistance!"
Fadila says, "It's not much, but please accept this gift in return."

You receive, at random[1], a Torch, a Water Flask or a Ration from Fadila.

sections.text:
To receive the quest from Lieutenant Jarovik Holt you'll need Kindly + 1 yellows (20%) Bends Garrison faction.

You can raise the Bends Garrison faction via the quest: Riverbend Gang Wars Quest which requires turning in:

Bloodied_Allegiance_Cuffs

You can also raise Bends Garrison faction though killing within the bends.

sections.title: Part 1 - Getting Ahead of the Problem
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, Lieutenant Jarovik Holt"

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "You have gained my attention, Elementalist, I have a task that must be done, if you have the courage to see it through."

You say "What task?"

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "The Ten Hooks and the Waterdogs have been a thorn in my side for far too long.  Bring me the heads of the Brask brothers and Cormac Renshaw."

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt gives you a small bag with 3 slots, put the three heads in the bag then combine and hand over the bag.

Kill Vikar Brask and get the Head of Vikar Brask

Location 1 in the image above. He spawns in a small hut on top of the building.

Kill Darius Brask and get the Head of Darius Brask

Location 2 in the image above. He spawns in the top most building in the area above the book-cases.

Kill Cormac Renshaw and get the Head of Cormac

Location 3 in the image above. He spawns inside the boat.

Combine into Sack of Heads

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt reaches into the bloodstained satch and examines it's contents.
You receive 1 gold, and 50 silver from Lieutenant Jarovik Holt.

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "You have done hte people of Night Harbor a great service on this, Maev, and you have earned my respect.  Take this badge as proof of your bravery.

You receive Iron Badge of the City

sections.title: Part 2 - The one that got away
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, Lieutenant Jarovik Holt."

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt nods at you.

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "You have proven yourself, Name.  Are you prepared for one final mission?"

You say, "What mission?"

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "I do not ask this lightly, but it must be done.  Bring me the viper's head, Name.  Bring me the head of Eamon Kassir."

Kill Eamon Kassir and loot Head of Eamon Kassir.

Location 4 in the image above. He spawns in a room at the very top of the structure near a table that has potions on it. Deceptive Trickster is PH

Return the head to Lieutenant Jarovik Holt

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt takes the head of Eamon Kassir and holds it aloft in the light.

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt drops the head on the ground.

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "So it is done.  I will have that thing piked on the gate for all to see.  On my honor Name, we will finally purge Riverbend of these scum."

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "You have my thanks.  Present this commendation and your badge to Theodora."

You receive Jarovik's Commendation from Lieutenant Jarovik Holt.

Take your Iron Badge of the City and the Jarovik's Commendation to Corporal Theodora.

Corporal Theodora says, "You're one of us now, soldier.  I know we'll do great things together."

You receive 2 gold from Corporal Theodora.

You receive Platinum Badge of the Living City from Corporal Theodora.

Ranger Rylin is located in the large treehouse in Keeper's Bight, located next to one of the internal stairwells.




Hail, Ranger Rylin

Ranger Rylin says, "Greetings, Druid. I am Rylin of the Ardent Keepers, sworn warden of Evershade Weald's ancient forests and surrounding lands.  I have been sent here to root out the poachers who scar this land with their blatant disregard of the natural order.  If you are willing to aid our cause, I have a reward selected by the High Keeper himself for your efforts."

You say, "Willing to aid your cause"

Ranger Rylin says, "Your resolve honors our cause, Druid.  The poachers wield skinning knives etched with their foul mark. Bring me four of them as proof of your deed, and I shall reward your service.  May the forests' will guide you."

Give 4x Poacher's Skinner to Ranger Rylin

Ranger Rylin says, "You have done a great service for the Ardent Keepers and the Keepers Blight, Cilantro!  The forest breathes easier thanks to your efforts.  Now, take this bracer as a symbol of our gratitude and your bond to our cause."

You receive High Keeper's Vambrace from Ranger Rylin.

sections.title: Part 1 - Quality Samples
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, Tust Brookturner."

Tust Brookturner glances up past his worn, dusty spectacles.

Tust Brookturner says, "Ah! You're finally here. This is great news, great news indeed! You brought the quarry samples, I presume?"

You say, "samples"

Tust Brookturner pushes his spectacles up the bridge of his nose.

Tust Brookturner says, "Oh, my mistake. I thought you were the laborer assigned to collect quarry samples for me."
Tust Brookturner says, "You'll do, though! All you need is a mining pick. You're familiar with mining, yes?"
Tust Brookturner says, "Here, take this ack, fill it with quality samples, and bring it back to me for inspection. In return, you'll receive coin!"

You receive Tust's Burlap Sack from Tust Brookturner.

Fill the sack with 8 pieces of Quarry Stone from mining in quarry., combine (creates "Full Burlap Sack") and turn back in.

Tust Brookturner says, "Yes, yes! This will do quite nicely. Here's the coin that was promised."

You receive 3 copper from Tust Brookturner.

sections.title: Part 2 - Ample Samples
sections.text:
Tust Brookturner says, "You seem quite skilled with a pickaxe. Some of the workers here mentioned seeing traces of exceptional minerals at the site. If you're interested in a bit of a challenge, I could use your help."

You say, "interested"

Tust Brookturner says, "Good, good! Now, let me see... where did I put that list? Mrs. Pebblebank! Do you have the list of minerals I jotted down earlier?"
Tust Brookturner says, "Ah, nevermind! Here it is."
Tust Brookturner says, "The ample sample list is as follows... four pieces of pyrite ore, three clear crystal shards, two smoky shards, and a flawless clear quartz."
Tust Brookturner says, "Place the minerals in this case and seal it, then bring the case and note back to me. A full case of minerals means a full payout in coin! Good luck!"

Receive paper with ingredient list and Tust's Display Case.

Ample-mineral-samples

From the Quality Quarry Stone nodes, mine 4x Pyrite Ore, 3x Clear Quartz Shard, 2x Smoky Quartz, 1x Flawless Clear Quartz.

Combine and turn in.

Tust Brookturner says, "Good... no, splendid work!"
Tust Brookturner says, "Well then, a reward is in order. Take this as a token of appreciation from the Church of Trem."

You receive

One of Tust's Copper Earring, Rope, Blessed, 50 Length, Wand of Heal, Survey Pack

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read Request for Aid you start with as a new Ranger Character:

The balance of the Weald is threatened and the natural
order disturbed.

Those with a connection to the lands and its creatures
are summoned to Rangers Rest upon Keepers Terrace.

To reach us, set out from the top of the Travelers Lift 
and venture past the inn, toward the Willows Whisper.
Ascend the ramp on the left to Traders Terrace, where
you will find the Rangers Rest across the span.

Any of the Defenders of Faelindral can offer directions if
asked.

When you arrive, deliver this pamphlet to Captain
Relgen Greenblade.

From there, your talents shall benefit the preservation of
all who call the Weald their home.

- High Keeper Caelen Stillbranch

You say, "Hail, Captain Relgen Greenblade."

Captain Relgen Greenblade waves you off with a dismissive gesture.

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "I have no mind for idle talk, unless you've something important to share."

Hand in 1 x Request for Aid to Captain Relgen Greenblade.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Ardent Keepers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Ah, a new volunteer? Let me get a look at you, then."

Captain Relgen Greenblade regards you with the emerald gaze of a veteran ranger, his rugged features stern and sharp. He nods after a quick appraisal and produces a small book for you to take.

You receive Ranger's Logbook from Captain Relgen Greenblade.

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "You look like you'll do. I am Relgen Greenblade, Regional Captain of the Ardent Keepers, and it's my duty to safeguard our borders from all threats within and without."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "As the request mentioned, we're in need of fresh rangers who are willing to maintain a presence in Evershade Weald, and to that end, I would see that you're put to work immediately."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Are you prepared, ranger?"

You say, "I am prepared."

Captain Relgen Greenblade nods curtly.

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Good. Being as fresh as you are, I'll not yet have you engage priority threats. Your first mission will be one of reconnaissance and familiarizing yourself with the forest's layout. Our rangers need to know their way around, after all."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "You'll investigate three locations within the Weald, then report your findings and any evidence you find in the logbook."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "If you can return with a full logbook of useful information, you'll have proven that you're worthy of being inducted into the Ardent Keepers as a formal initiate."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "As for the locations, you'll be reporting on the Whispering Pools, Sporehaven Karst, and a ruined archway that spans the border of Keepers Bight. You need only ask if you require further details on each of these locations."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "I'll remind you that you are to look closely at each site and report your findings. You are not there to take action. These places are still dangerous for a prospective ranger."

You say, "What are the Whispering Pools?"

Captain Relgen Greenblade grimaces in disgust at the name, as though merely describing it is enough to revolt him.

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Devious naiads make the Whispering Pools their home. They reside behind the great falls of the river that splits the Weald in two."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Be warned, the Fossergrim you'll encounter may be peaceful enough, but the nymphs who dwell further inside are known to possess travelers and keep them as playthings."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Don't venture too deep inside. In fact, make your report from inside the cave's mouth, just past the threshold of the falls. I must know if there are any signs that they're attempting to breach their pact and leave the caves."

You say, "Their pact?"

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "It's my opinion that the fae in general cannot be trusted, even if bound to a pact. The naiads are no exception. Their mistress, Naelira, is bound to the pools of that cave, but I fear she wishes to expand her influence."

You say, "Who is Naelira?"

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Enough of the fae! Just speaking of them makes my ears burn. If you want to learn more about them, you should consult the Heartwood Archives."

You say, "Where are the Heartwood Archives?"

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "The Heartwood Archives is Faelindral's great library, kept by the Preservers. It's located just above the city bank. There's plenty to learn there for those who are so inclined."

You say, "What is Sporehaven Karst?"

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Sporehaven Karst is home to the Circle of Spores. They're a group of reclusive druids who dedicate themselves to the research and proliferation of fungi."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Though normally quite harmless, their fungal research has a history of spreading infestations up into Faelindral, which we are then forced to cleanse."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Venture beneath the city to the caves that have been carved out by the river's passage, and pray that there's no sign of their latest experiments growing out of control."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "If you do come across dangerous fungus, avoid it to the best of your ability while you search for evidence of the Circle's actions from the entrance of their domain."

You say, "And the ruined archway?"

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Disturbing rumors of the risen dead have made their way to Faelindral, particularly from the caravan route to the neighboring Keepers Bight."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Venture south, away from the river, and follow the main road toward the Bight. Just before you reach the border, you should see the ancient archway of Calafrey beneath a foot bridge."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "See if you can find any evidence of an undead presence in the ruins, but don't engage them if the rumors prove true. Remember, you're only there to look this time around."

sections.title: Evidence of Orcs
sections.text:
Look around the road near the ruined archway right before the zone-line for Keepers Bight using the MUD action "/look".

These great and ruined arches belonged to an ancient empire and served as a form of boundary that has long since fallen.
There are signs of caravans having crossed this threshold many times over, however a peculiar set of footprints catch your eye and warrant inspection.

Inspect the peculiar set of footprints using the MUD action "/inspect footprints".

These footprints bear no resemblance to any hoof nor animal you’ve seen before, and follow an unorthodox step pattern that you cannot place.
They appear to lead back toward Faelindral before veering to the right, following a small path toward another set of ruins up the hill.
There is a large elderspire tree only a few steps away, between this location and the ruins, where you might get a safe view of what could be occupying the ancient, toppled structure.

Head to the elderspire tree to get a safe view using the MUD action "/look".

You hunker down near the roots of the elderspire and begin searching for the source of the footprints...
The trail leads to indications of undead infesting the ruins, their bone chips littering the ruin floor alongside numerous signs of adult wolves in the area.
Yet what draws your eye most is a second series of strange, alien footprints. These heavy prints stand out in stark contrast to the others.

Inspect the alien footprints using the MUD action "/inspect footprints".

This second set of footprints was clearly made by a creature with significant bulk who stands on two feet. 
They do not appear to be wearing any sort of fashioned footwear, though you observe that they are supported by a set of only three toes. 
You know of only one creature that strides on two three-toed feet and could have made these impressions... orcs.

You receive Evidence of Orcs.

sections.title: Evidence of the Nymphs
sections.text:
/look

Behind the waterfall, at the entrance of the Fossergrim cave.

The continuous, thundering roar of the waterfall overwhelms all other sounds as it echoes back from deep within the cave that the naiads have claimed as their home.

Your eye catches sight of a series of wet, childlike footprints along the dampened stone... footprints that seem to beckon further inspection.

/inspect footprints

The footprints were freshly made, and nowhere near large enough to belong to one of the Fossergrim guarding the entrance.

It seems at least one nymph has recently been wandering out past the waterfall barrier, defying their bond. You decide to take this as evidence for your logbook.

You receive Evidence of Nymphs.

sections.title: Evidence of Sporehaven
sections.text:
/look

On the banks of the river that flows into the myconid cave

This damp and humid cave system proves to be the perfect breeding ground for fungus as made evident by its thriving myconid population. 
Along the banks of the gently flowing river you spy an odd, multicolored foam accumulating against the stone.

/inspect foam

Closer examination of the foam reveals that it flows from further upstream before clinging to the edges of the rocky embankment. This could be a clue as to what's causing the local myconids to be acting so aggressively.
Touching the foam directly would not be wise, but perhaps you could rub a sample onto a page of your logbook.

/rub foam

You carefully rub a blank page of your logbook against the foam, smearing a small sample along it.The strange foam leaves a scintillating, multihued pattern across one of the blank pages.

It is so beautifully mesmerizing, and you find your gaze to be transfixed for a short time upon that single page...

Such an exquisite pattern...

You suddenly blink and snap back to your senses, tearing your gaze away from the page and quickly closing your logbook.

You receive Evidence of Sporehaven.

You receive Scintillating Page.

Combine Evidence of Orcs Evidence of Nymphs Evidence of Sporehaven Scintillating Page

Captain Relgen Greenblade accepts the logbook with a nod of gratitude. He flips through your reports, his brow arching slightly at the mesmerizing pattern splayed across one of the pages, though it seems to have no effect on him.

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "An interesting method of procuring evidence, but I'll not scorn success. It seems my fears were not unfounded. I was right to send you to scout these locations."

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "You've shown that you can traverse the Weald and return with useful information, and that's what we need in our rangers. Here, you've earned this."

Captain Relgen Greenblade unfurls a cloak fashioned from an enormous leaf and swoops it over your shoulders.

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "A good cloak on your shoulders is one of the basic tenants of wilderness survival. As an initiate of the Ardent Keepers, you'll be outdoors rather often."

You receive Initiate Keepers Cloak.

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Which leads us to your next assignment, initiate. You've seen the state of things in the Weald. Are you ready to help clean it up?"

You say, "i am ready"

Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "I'm glad to hear it. Take some time to familiarize yourself more with the forest, then check back and I'll have something for you."

sections.title: Part 2 === Req. Lvl 3
sections.text:
Captain Greenblade says, "Greetings initiate, how fares the state of your cloak?"
Captain Greenblade says, "Im glad to hear it. You look as though you're familiar with the forest's trails by now. Allow me to see your initiate cloak one last time to make sure it's donned properly."
Captain Greenblade regards the state of the cloak and gives a satisfied nod before draping it back over your shoulders.
Captain Greenblade says, "Excellent. Your next task begins immediately, initiate. Take this satchel."
Captain Greenblade procures a small bag and tosses it into your hands.
Captain Greenblade says, "Carry yourself down to the forest floor and eliminate some of the threats that you witnessed, particularly the undead, the roaming fae, and the orcish threat."
"Gather two shattered skulls of the undead, two samples of dryad sap, and two belts from the Fellstone warriors. That should be sufficient evidence."
"Importantly, once you've gathered these items and combined them in the satchel, you will not bring them back to me."
"There is another captain that I want you to meet."

You receive a ranger's satchel.

You say, "What Captain?"

Captain Greenblade says " You're to venture south to Keepers Blight with your full satchel, and head toward the village of Penshaw. Follow the edge of the forest and cross the river, you should come upon one of our camps."

"Once there, I want you to show the evidence of your encounters to the Keepers Blight regional captain, Syllisian Shadedglade."

"If he happens to be out on patrol when you arrive, perhaps one of the other rangers there can provide more information, should you present evidence to them."

"We need to know if there has been any sign of these threats spreading into, or coming out of, the Bight. Report back to me with any of your findings, and safe travels, initiate. Make sure to wear your initiate cloak so they know you're with the Ardent Keepers."

Collect, place in bag, combine, and turn in:

2x Shattered Skull
2x Fellstone Warrior's Belt
2x Dryad Sap

Go to Keeper's Blight, keep down the road until you cross a wooden bridge.

Shortly past the bridge is a small ranger camp.

Give Full Ranger's Satchel to Ranger Valegazer.

Ranger Valegazer regards your cloak with a nod and a smile.

Ranger Valegazer says, "Ah, what brings you to Keepers Bight, initiate? Do you carry news from the Weald?"

Give Full Ranger's Satchel to Ranger Valegazer.

a Trunk Key

Ranger Valegazer inspects the evidence of your encounters and frowns, her long and thin ears drooping in response.

Ranger Valegazer says, "Undead of our ancestors in the Weald, as well as fae venturing out of their domain? This is disheartening news, but I can assure you they're not crossing the boundary from Keepers Bight, at least."

"In fact, the captain patrolled there recently. There should be some paperwork about it in his trunk. I imagine that's what Captain Relgen is looking for."

Behind him there is another tent with a "trunk" (it's like a crate)
 Pick up the key and type /insert key
Type /inspect paper
Type /inspect report
Type /take report

You receive Lone Point Report.

Hand the key back to Ranger Valegazer

You receive Keepers Bight Report.

Return to Captain Relgen Greenblade in the Ranger's Rest

Give Lone Point Report and Keepers Bight Report. to Captain Relgen Greenblade.

You receive a Verdant Waistguard from Captain Relgen Greenblade.(belt).

Captain Greenblade says, "Return the belt to me after you've worked it in and I've had a time to speak with Caelen. Until then, you're free to explore the Weald and cull any threats. Be sure to keep that cloak as well, so others will recognize you as a Keeper."

sections.title: Part 3 - Req. Lvl 5
sections.text:
Captain Greenblade says, "Good. It seems you're looking more comfortable in the garb of a Keeper."

Captain Greenblade says, "You'll require something with more protection than what an initiate cloak and a mere waistguard can afford you, if I'm to send you on your next task."

You say, "What task are you sending me on next?"

Captain Greenblade says, "The first thing you're required to do is reinforce the initiate cloak you were given.  An initiate keeps their cloak for life, but the standard variation will only serve you for so long."

Captain Greenblade says, "Bring your cloak to one of our senior trackers, Gareth Ashenpath.  He should be outside the Rangers Rest and can guide you maintaining and improving your own equipment."

Step outside the Ranger's Rest and go to Gaereth Ashenpath.

Hand your cloak to Gaereth Ashenpath.

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Let me guess, Relgen is delegating his responsibilities again? Doesn't surprise me."

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "The old man needs to spend more time down in the actual forest and less time berating potential rangers from the safety of the city, of you ask me."

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Still, that doesn't mean I'm going to runaway an initiate like yourself.  You're going to need to know how to enhance your cloak one way or another."

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Yours in particular is in need of some real improvement."

You say, "Oh jeepers, what improvement can we do?"

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "The flora of the Weald have been infused with magic over the course of many years. The preserved leaves we used aren't just protective, they're capable of adaption under the right circumstances."

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "The best way to improve your cloak, at least initially is to purposefully expose it to the same environmental effects that you wish it to protect you from.  Make sense, right?"

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "While you'll have to find ways of subverting every element at some point, for now, we'll focus on venom and poisons.  The mountain snakes in the Bight and the vipers of Szuur can be deadly foes if they manage to inject you with some of their lethal venom."

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "You probably don't want to march all the way to the desert, though.  Lucky for you, we have a critter on the forest floor than can you the proper... exposure."

You say, "By golly, what critter is that?"

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "You've probably noticed out issue with the local drakeling population."

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "If left unchecked, they can overwhelm most of the Weald's younger fauna using their magical poison breath."

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "So what better way to expose you to poison than by having it breathe all over you, eh?"

Gaereth Ashenpath grins.

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Go cull some of the drakelings and expose that cloak of yours to their poisonous breath."

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Bring me back at least two of their hides and four drakeling scales as proof that you've been out there fighting the good fight.  Oh, and your initiate cloak of course.  We'll see then if you've exposed it to enough poison for it to adapt."

You will need to collect 2 Green Drakeling Hide and 4 Green Drakeling Scale then return to Gaereth Ashenpath.

Hand to Gaereth your cloak, and the Drakeling parts.

Gaereth Ashenpath takes the drakeling parts and gauges the state of your cloak.

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Granted the poison of a young drakeling is only so strong, but you also don't want to expose the cloak to too much and overwhelm it.  You have to nurture it, just as you would an other plant of the forest."

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "I'll provide you with a salve that you can use to speed up the recovery process and lock in the magic of the drakeling's breath."

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "You can bring your cloak to a tanning vat to apply the salve.  Make sure it's coated fully before returning it to me for inspection.  You don't need to have any actual tanning skill, so don't worry about ruining your cloak."

He will give to you a Cultivating Salve and return your cloak.

Head to the tannery above the Blacksmith

Place the salve and your cloak in the tanning vat and press craft.

Return your cloak to Gaereth.

Gaereth Ashenpath checks over the cloak and offers a nod.

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Good, see here? The fivers of your cloak are starrting to weave together stronger than they once were.  It should be more resilient to poison in general."

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "This is just one of the many gifts that we've been given by the forests of Evershade, and why its so important that we protect our home.  We help the land and it helps us in turn."

Gaereth Ashenpath returns the cloak to you, which looks to be developing a series of reinforced vines.

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "I'll teach you more about creating you own salve at a later time.  For now, you should return to Captain Relgen and show him the cloak so he knows you're prepared for the next assignment.  The salve should be set fully by the time you show him.

Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Oh, and here.  Take this as a gift from me.  A lot of rangers like yourself might find it useful out in the Weald."

Gaereth Ashenpath tosses you a small, glowing orb.

He gives you a Fire Beetle Eye (useful for Burning Embers spell if you don't have one already).

He gives you a Coated Keeper's Cloak.

sections.title: Part 4 - Req. Lvl 8
sections.text:
Return your cloak to Captain Relgan Greenblade.

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "With this you may be capable of an important assignment, initiate."

You say, "What assignment?"

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "We've recently received reports from the Wyrdguard scouts that orcs have encroached further into our territory than previously expected. As the protectors of our borders, this is an offense that we cannot ignore."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "The Wyrdguard have already involved themselves in the effort to cull the orcish presence, and the Keepers will not be far behind.  We know they have trackers which they employ to hunt innocent caravans on the route to Faelindral."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "You're to hunt down their orc trackers before they manage to lay a finger upon an innocents.  Eliminate as many as it takes to uncover who or what they might be reporting to, then bring back any evidence you find to me."

Kill Fellstone Trackers and bring him any Unintelligible Reports you find.  You need bring only one.

Captain Relgan Greenblade frowns as he tries to make sense of the brutish orc script.

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "This is utter nonsense to my eyes.  Thankfully, there's a researcher who's currently attempting to decipher the orcish language."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Bring the report to Researcher Fairgrove, who's likely poring over texts at the Heartwood Archives."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Find out if she can glean any meaning from these accursed scribbles."

Researcher Fairgrove is found above the bank.  Give her the report.

Researcher Fairgrove says, "O-oh, what's this? From an... o-orc tracker?  Let me s-see what I can make out for you, K-Keeper."

Researcher Fairgrove produces a blank parchment and begins to cross-reference the orc report with a number of symbols she has mapped out across a series of leafscrolls.

Researcher Fairgrove murmurs softly to herself, her stutter seeming to vanish when caught in a moment of heavy concentration.

Researcher Fairgrove says, "Time... attack... orders.  Foot-no, toes? Four.  Four feet?  Hmm... this is quite curious."

Researcher Fairgrove turns her attention back to you, blinking owlishly as her stutter resumes from where it left off.

Researcher Fairgrove says, "I, u-umm... I b-believe the report mentions something about an... an a-attack , and orders coming from s-someone names Fourth Feet?  Or Four Toes."

Researcher Fairgrove says, "I think that F-four Toes makes the most sense, but then again... w-we're talking about orcs.

Researcher Fairgrove says, "Unfortunately that's a-all I can manage to decipher for now, but I... I hope that I was at least able to help in some regard, Keeper!"

You receive Partially Translated Report from Researcher Fairgrove.

Return to Captain Relgan Greenblade and give him the Partially Translated Report.

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Hmm, four toes, you say? It's not much, but it does give me an idea."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "If they're taking orders from someone named Four Toes, that might be all the information we need to track them down."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "This would also serve a s good test of your abilities, Keeper.  There can't be too many orcs within Evershade who have four toes, after all.  Let's hope their naming conventions are as literal as they sound."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "You'll need this for your important mission, Keeper."

Captain Relgan Greenblade retrieves a small pouch and tosses it to you.

You receive Pouch of Scintillating Dust from Captain Relgan Greenblade.

You say, "What important mission?"

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "While eliminating orc leaders is always warranted, there are times when capturing an enemy alive is more beneficial in a prolonged battle."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "That powder I've given you was made from the mysterious foam you brought me during your initiation.  You did well to bring me a sample.  It has powerful hypnotic properties that we should be able to use to subdue the orc leader."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "The only snag will be searching for the right... opportunity."

You say, "What opportunity?"

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Even orcs must sleep, so I propose you uncover the location of this leader's camp and wait until nightfall to subdue the four-toed beast while it slumbers."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Once within their territory, use your tracking skills to search for signs of an orc that has four toes.  If you locate any such tracks, follow them to their source and inspect the region for any evidence of where they've made camp.

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "It'd be wise to shroud yourself if you're to infiltrate the orc-controlled regions, though you'll have to avoid the undead presence if that the route you choose.  They have sight for the soul rather than what's truly visible."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Approach the camp during the night to catch the leader while they sleep.  Pour the dust onto them, and with any luck, you should be able to silently haul them back here for questioning."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "If you lose or misplace the dust, you can ask me for more.  If the orc proves to be resistant to the effects of the foam... you have my leave to eliminate them.  Your life before theirs, Keeper."

Take the lift down to the middle of the map.

Go past the ruins, across the bridge, across the Elder Spire tree platform, down another bridge. Finally, turn right and go down until you encounter orcs.  Once there, use Track to follow a trial of curious footprints to its end point.  Once there, /inspect footprints.

These footprints differ from those of a typical orc, appearing to have four distinct toes instead of the usual three.

Now that you are able to distinguish them from the others, you see that they lead toward the base of the nearby ramp, ascending the cliffside.

Continue up the cliff side, turning to the right, and find an empty tent eventually.  /Look around.

This simple campsite appears deserted, bearing remnants of a crude fire long since extinguished.

Wait until nighttime, then /look around again.

Though well concealed atop the cliffs, you have managed to locate this crude campsite under cover of darkness.

You notice a slight stirring from beneath the a heavy pile of furs.  It seems to be a slumbering orc who is not yet aware of your presence.

The wretched creature twitches beneath the furs as you examine it closer.  It does not awaken, though you see it begin to grimace through clenched tusks.  One of its feet emerges from beneath the furs, revealing a detail of great interest... four-toes.

Put the Pouch of Scintillating Dust on your cursor and /pour it on the /orc.

You carefully sprinkle the contents of the scintillating pouch over the orc's face.  It recoils its snout as it unconsciously inhales the hypnotic dust.

Bewildered Gorakk Four-Toes seethes at you, ready to strike -- Would you like to die?  You would almost certainly be defeated in battle.

The orc's eyes open groggily as it battles the effects of the dust, letting out a garbled groan as it gets to its feet and begins blindly swinging its arms!

Cons red to a level 8 ranger, unknown level, estimated at level 11 by others.  Immune to snare.  Kill it anyway.

Collect the Orc Commander's Head and return it to Captain Relgen Greenblade.

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "It's unfortunate that you were unable to capture the commander alive, but this is still a great victory all the same."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "We'll have more opportunities to question the orc leadership and discover their true intentions in the future.  For now, I award with this spear as a sign of your accomplishment."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Carry it well, Almond, for you are an initiate no longer."

Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "You are a full and true Ardent Keeper!"

You receive Reach of the Ardent Keeper from Captain Relgen Greenblade.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience

Steel Talon Trainee Tunic

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read Notice of Recruitment you start with as a new Ranger Character:

Recruit:

You are to deliver this note to Fedamius Steele III
in the Steel Talons Garrison to begin your training.

He can be found observing the courtyard from his 
post on the wall above.

If you get lost, ask a guard. Any guard worth their
salt will know his name.

And be quick about it.

-Steel Talons Recruitment

Head to the Steel Talons Martial Academy on the Southwest side of Night Harbor and hand in your Notice of Recruitment to Fedamius Steel III

You gain experience!!

Fedamius Steele III says, "What is it?"
Fedamius Steele III stares at you for a moment before reading the note.
Fedamius Steele III chuckles.
Fedamius Steele III says, "Well, well... Foss has another aspiring Ranger on his hands. I wonder how long it'll be before he's out pulling you out of the sand?"
Fedamius Steele III says, "The Rangers trained by the Steel Talons are the finest in the land, so you'll either become one of them or the next of your lot will use your corpse as a tracking exercise."
Fedamius Steele III says, "Now, take your note to Mister Dunestrider."
Fedamius Steele III says, "A skilled ranger needs no directions, so... you'll find him in one of the towers along the wall."
Fedamius Steele III gives you a smug look.

Bold textYou receive Notice of Recruitment from Fedamius Steel III.

Head to the top of the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the west gate and follow the top of the wall south until you find Foss Dunestrider above the west gate.

Hand him the Notice of Recruitment

You gain experience!!

Foss Dunstrider takes the note without breaking his gaze on some figure in the distance. 
Foss Dunstrider says, "A new recruit, splendid. I know you're new to Night Harbor, but I'm sure you'll come to love this city as I do."
Foss Dunstrider says, "I've got some time, and I know you have at least a little skill from your experience outside these walls. So, let's see you in action. Take this tunic and head back down there."
Foss Dunstrider picks up a dusty tunic from a small pile at his feet.
Foss Dunstrider says, "As a test of your fieldcraft, I want you to collect the following..."
Foss Dunstrider says, "a natural light source, butchered from a proximal creature..."
Foss Dunstrider says, "a reagent harvested from a bat that might help you avoid a fall..."
Foss Dunstrider says, "a venom gland, carefully removed from one of the younger snakes below..."
Foss Dunstrider says, "and a Multhele Root."
Foss Dunstrider says, "You'll find all of these just outside our gates, with the exception of the root."

You receive Steel Talon Trainee Tunic from Foss Dunestrider.

sections.title: Part 2
sections.text:
Head down to the noob yard below and kill a snakes, a fire beetles, and a desert bats

Keep killing until you receive an Immature Snake Venom Sac, a Fire Beetle Eye, and a Bat Wing. Alternatively you can buy these.
Then, head to the docks just east of the garrison and pick up a bag of Multhele Root under one of the docks.
Then, return to Foss Dunestrider

Hand Foss Dunestrider the Multhele Root, Immature Snake Venom Sac, Fire Beetle Eye, and Bat Wing

You gain experience!!

Foss Dunstrider says, "You looked good out there. And don't look surprised. Given that tunic, you weren't hard to track."
Foss Dunstrider looks at you and smiles.
Foss Dunstrider he looks at the items you handed him.
Foss Dunstrider says, "Excellent fieldcraft. A ranger's tricks of the trade mean the difference between life and death down range."
Foss Dunstrider says, "After watching you move around out there, you seem experienced or at least capable enough to assist me with a matter of personal interest."
Foss Dunstrider says, "The consensus in the garrison is that the Ashira are bothersome, but I think there's more to them than most assume. I think there's a sickness in them, but we've been unable to gather specifics. Maybe we can learn more by gathering information from other afflicted c reatures in the area."
Foss Dunstrider says, "I'd like you to carefully gather the blood of a diseased bat, rat, snake, and jackl. Seal the vials in this pack and return it to me when you're done."

You receive Small Test Kit from Foss Dunestrider.

Head to the cave entrance towards Wyrmsbane and kill a diseased bat, a diseased rat, a diseased snake, and a diseased jackal.

Keep killing until you receive: Diseased Bat Blood, Diseased Rat Blood, Diseased Snake Blood, and Diseased Jackal Blood

Combine the four bloods in the small test kit you will get a sealed pouch, take the sealed pouch to Foss Dunestrider and you will receive a note. Take that note and your Steel Talon Trainee Tunic to Quartermaster Obaid to hand in and receive Steel Talons Scout Tunic (3ac/5hp/1dex) as well as some exp.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This quest appears to be a precursor to the Platinum Badge of the Living City Quest.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Before entering the Bends portion of Night Harbor, climb the nearby gate stairs to find Lieutenant Jarovik Holt and Corporal Theodora. Holt is visibly distressed and requests you speak with Theodora.

You say, "Hail, Lieutenant Jarovik Holt."

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt frowns at you.

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "Leave me be, citizen. Speak to my corporal, Theodora, if you want to make yourself useful."

You say, "Who is Theodora?"

Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "You will find the corporal in yonder hall. Move along now."

You say, "Hail, Corporal Theodora."

Corporal Theodora says, "Mind how you go, citizen. I cannot guarantee your safety if you enter the Bends."

You say, "What are the Bends?"

Corporal Theodora says, "Riverbend is one of Night Harbor's oldest districts. It was once a vibrant fishing village and port of commerce, before the gangs took over."

You say, "What gangs?"

Corporal Theodora says, "There are three rival gangs in the Bends... the Ten Hooks, the Waterdogs, and the Serpent Sashes. We've contained the worst of them within these walls, but I'm afraid Night Harbor won't know peace until we've exterminated their kind."

Corporal Theodora sighs.

Corporal Theodora says, "Now leave me to my work, citizen, unless you wish to aid our great city."

You say, "I wish to aid our great city."

Corporal Theodora says, "Know this, citizen, should you enter the Bends, you'll be met with violence. Meet with the Ten Hooks and Waterdogs in the dirty hovels they inhabit, and bring me proof of your valor. You'll be well rewarded."

Enter the Bends and begin killing the gang members residing there. These mobs will start non-KOS but will quickly become aggressive due to negative faction hits when killed.

Eventually, you will loot a Bloodied Allegiance Cuffs. Return to Corporal Theodora and hand her the cuffs.

Your faction standing with Bends Garrison got better.
Your faction standing with Cult of the Living City got better. " 1 full blue "
Your faction standing with Ten Hooks got worse. " 1 full blue "
Your faction standing with Waterdogs got worse. " 1 full blue "

Corporal Theodora says, "The streets are safer for your efforts, citizen."

You gain experience!!

You receive 3 silver.

This can also be done with Dirty Pirate Earring which also drops from the local mobs and gives a small faction boost and 35 silver.

sections.title: Sub-Quests
sections.text:
There are other notable named gang members directly inside the first area of the Bends, Karif Jamah, Tinka Roofstrider, Vikar Brask and Ratan. It is unclear if they have dialogue to continue this quest...

WATERDOGS

You say, "Hail, Ratan."

Ratan says, "Hail yerself, mate. Standin' around... have you not got a job to do?"

You say, "What job?"

Ratan says, "Ten Hooks are takin' liberties lately and we've given 'em enough chances. People don't learn if you don't explain it to 'em."

You say "Who are the Ten Hooks?"

Ratan says, "Honest fishermen, so they say! As likely hook a fish as hook yer eyes out."

Ratan smirks.

Ratan says, "Those uppity thugs wear fancy cuffs like they're in a gentlemen's club or something. Bring me a pair and I'll give you a pretty penny."

Give Ratan two Bloodied Allegiance Cuffs

Ratan says, "It ain't pretty, but it does the job. Here you go, mate."

You gain experience!
You receive 45 silver from Ratan.
Your faction standing with Waterdogs got better.
Your faction standing with Ten Hooks got worse.
Your faction with Cult of the Living City got worse.

TEN HOOKS

You say, "Hail, Karif Jamah."

Karif Jamah grins.

Karif Jamah says, "Speak up, Human. These streets belong to the Ten Hooks. What's your business?"

You say, "Business?"

Karif Jamah says, "If your hands are idle, there's work that needs doing."

You say, "Work?"

Karif Jamah says, "The Waterdogs have been useful to us, but they've become too bold."
Karif Jamah says, "Those pirates are fond of their jewelry. Collect four of their earrings and return them to me. Go now, remind them of their place."

Give Karif Jamah 4 Dirty Pirate Earring

Karif Jamah counts out each earring in the palm of his hand.

Karif Jamah says, "Four coins for four souls. Our family thanks you."

You gain experience!
You receive 50 silver from Karif Jamah. (Bugged? This is not "four coins" and very much not worth doing 50/4=12.5 silver per ring, whereas turning into the watch grants 35 silver each...)
Your faction standing with Ten Hooks got better.
Your faction standing with Waterdogs got worse.
Your faction standing with Cult of the Living City got worse.

((more information is required))

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience

Lambent Prospect Dagger
Lambent Prospect Blade
Mask of the Forest Walker
Lambent Stiletto

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read Anonymous Letter you start with as a new Rogue character:

This letter reaches you not of insignificant reason. We have witnessed your ability to blend into the shadows and become as a leaf on a branch to those who tread past.

It was fated chance that you were noticed at all, and that is precisely why this missive finds you now. Your talents would be indispensable to Faelindral, so I would propose a meeting with Elyndiir Nightshade to discuss an opportunity to put said talents to the test.

Should this letter spark your interest, deliver it into the hands of the aforementioned within the Lambent Lantern. You can find it behind the bank, or by climbing the ascent opposite the Willows Whisper stage.

You can ask a guard for direction to the Lambent Lantern if required, but do not inform them of the reason.

Yours,
An Admirer

Give Anonymous Letter to Elyndiir Nightshade in the Lambent Lantern Inn.  (behind Bank).

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Elyndiir Nightshade perks a brow as she accepts the letter. While reading its contents, the corner of her mouth curls upward into a small smirk.
Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Looks like you were found out by Naery. Still, you seem to had made an impression on her, and that in itself is an accomplishment."
Elyndiir Nightshade says, "And now I'm to offer you a chance to prove yourself? I wish that girl would at least discuss things with me before sending prospects backstage. Here, take this."
Elyndiir Nightshade produces a sealed leaf scroll and holds it out for you with a dull expression.
Elyndiir Nightsade says, "You're really looking for an opportunity?"

You say, "I'm always looking to exploit an opportunity!"

You receive note for Myrielle Softglade (Head to Traders District, Weapons and armor, inside on first level)

Elyndiir Nightshade says, "You can start by making your way to the Traders Terrace and handing this letter to Myrielle Softglade."
Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Foreign trade has slowed lately and that makes for bad business. If Myrielle has an idea of what might be wrong, you're going to help her get to the bottom of it."
Elyndiir Nightshade says, "When you're done, come fill me in on what you find. And avoid stepping onto the stage when you leave, or the bards will start giving me a headache."

You receive "Note for Myrielle Softglade" from Elyndiir Nightshade.

sections.title: Part 1a - Find ingredients
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, Myrielle Softglade"

Myrielle Softglade says, "Fair shades to you, Rogue. How did I know you were a Rogue? Ha, don't worry, I just have an eye for these things."

Hand her the note.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Myrielle Softglade accepts the letter with interest, giving you a polite smile before unsealing it and looking over the contents. She clears her throat and immediately lowers her voice.
Myrielle Softglade says, "Elyn sent you? No offense, but I was hoping she'd send one of her more experienced agents."
Myrielle Softglade says, "Ah, it's no matter. Here, take this. Maybe you'd be able to help with a little... experiment?"
Myrielle Softglade offers you a small, nondescript jar with a corked lid.

You receive "Sample Jar" from Myrielle Softglade.

Combine the following in the Sample Jar:

2 Raw Bat Meat
2 Wasp Venom Sacks
2 Raw Wolf Meat

You craft Gruesome Sample Jar.

Sample Jar is consumed while crafting.

sections.title: Part 1b - Ewww!
sections.text:
Hand Myrielle the jar.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Myrielle Softglade takes the jar, then immediately seems to regret her decision as she sharply turns her face away, holding the jar out and as far from herself as possible.
Myrielle Softglade says, "Wyrd's way, this is revolting! Quick, take it! Take it back!"

Myrielle Softglade fumbles the sample jar back to you, nearly dropping it in the process.

Myrielle Softglade says, "Ugh! I'm just going to take your word for it that all the proper samples were inside the jar. Are you ready to meet my contact now?

You receive Gruesome Sample Jar from Myrielle Softglade.

You say, "Yes. Who is your contact?"

Myrielle Softglade says, "Sylwine Brightspirit is a good friend of mine who's always looking for new reagents for her potions at the Well of Order. She said she'd be willing to take a look at anything that I brought her."

Myrielle Softglade says, "Of course, we don't really need any potions, but that's beside the point. If anything is wrong with those samples, she should be able to figure it out!"

Myrielle Softglade says, "I just hope she doesn't mind the foul stench..."

Bring to Sylwine Brightspirit located at Well of Order (inside Herbalism/First aid house)

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Sylwine Brightspirit accepts the jar with an arched brow, holding it up and swirling the contents. She inhales a sharp breath before turning back to you with a forced smile.
Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Myrielle sent you here with this, did she? Here, take it back for a moment. I'd like you to do something for me first."

Sylwine Brightspirit hands back the sample jar.

You receive Gruesome Sample Jar from Sylwine Brightspirit.

Sylwine Brightspirit says, "I want you to open that jar for me and take a good whiff. Really let is invade your nasal passage. Then, tell me what you think it smells like."

Sylwine Brightspirit folds her arms over her chest and watches you.

While holding the jar (on the cursor), type:

/open jar

You open the jar with a delicate pop of the corked lid. An ominous odor wafts from the mixture of fauna samples, and Sylwine nods at you expectantly.

You receive Foul-Smelling Jar.

Give the jar back to Sylwine Brightspirit

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Preservers got worse.

Sylwine Brightspirit grimaces as she eyes the jar, involuntarily rolling her eyes. She reseals the lid and writes out a small receipt, which she slides over the counter to you.
Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Here's the receipt for the job. You can bring it back to Myrielle. This is going to take me a while, because of the contamination. That foolish girl..."

You receive Gruesome Sample Receipt from Sylwine Brightspirit

Sylwine Brightspirit says, "She may be pretty and knows all the right words, but she's still two flowers short of a bouquet, if you catch my meaning."

Sylwine Brightspirit says, "In fact, you can tell her I said as much when you return to her!"

sections.title: Part 1c - Finishing up
sections.text:
Upon giving the receipt back to Myrielle Softglade

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Myrielle Softglade turns pale as she reads the obviously strong-worded language that was included in the receipt.
Myrielle Softglade says, "A-ah, I... I see. Ahem. Well, it seems that we may have to wait a while to find out the results. You've proven that you're capable of some simple tasks, at least!"

Myrielle Softglade says, "Here's a note for Elyn at the Willows Whisper. I'm sure that she can find something to keep you busy while we wait on Sylwine's tests."

You receive Note for Elyndiir Nightshade from Myrielle Softglade.

Myrielle Softglade says, "I hope that she isn't too upset..."

Upon giving Note to Elyndiir Nightshade

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Elyndiir Nightshade skims over the note with a sharp eye, looking somewhat skeptical.
Elyndiir Nightshade says, "So Myrielle is having Sylwine run tests on some animal parts? I suppose that's one angle we hadn't considered."

Elyndiir Nightshade says, "We had you tailed during your journey to see how you'd perform. You're a little dull around the edges, but I feel like we could hone you into a fine agent."

Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Speaking of..."

Elyndiir Nightshade extends her hand, then, with a quick flourish, reveals a small elven dagger seemingly pulled from nowhere. She offers it to you, hilt first.

You receive Lambent Prospect Dagger from Elyndiir Nightshade.

Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Any prospect of ours needs to be able to defend themselves. You earned it, but you could also earn a lot more. You interested?"

You receive Lambent Prospect Dagger from Elyndiir Nightshade.

You say, "Of course, I'm interested!"

Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Hmm, not so fast. Why don't you get a little more practice with that dagger first? Come back and show me the blade once you've had a chance to put it through its paces."

sections.title: Part 2 - Req. Lvl 4+
sections.text:
You say, "I'm still interested."

Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Glad to hear it. Though let me get a look at that prospect dagger of yours first to make sure that it's been properly worked in."

Give Lambent Prospect Dagger to Elyndiir Nightshade.

Elyndiir Nightshade grins knowingly beneath her cowl as she twirls the dagger expertly between her fingers, then offers it back to you, handle first.

You receive Lambent Prospect Dagger from Elyndiir Nightshade.

Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Looks sufficiently worked-in to me, prospect. Good."

Elyndiir Nightshade says,

I imagine this next task is going to require a lot more subtlety than the last, though. Another of our group, Ereldian Brambleshade, is keeping tabs on the faerie population to the north."

It's a difficult job to discern any sort of sense from such a chaotic group, but we have many who rely on us to piece that chaos into something more... comprehensible. Digestible, even."

I want you to head down the northern lift that leads into fae territory and meet with Ereldian. He should be posted in the area, and you're going to help him gather some information."

Keep in mind that we don't want to harm any of them if we can help it. Just show him your dagger to let him know that you're one of us."

sections.title: Part 2a - Loud and Clear
sections.text:
Give Lambent Prospect Dagger to Ereldian Brambleshade. (He is at the base of the Pixie lift)

Ereldian Brambleshade nods thoughtfully, looking you up and down taking note of the dagger you carry.

Ereldian Brambleshade says "Ah, so Elyndir finally found time to send me an assistant? I've been requesting aid for weeks and I'm at my wits end when it comes to these capricious creatures!"

Ereldian Brambleshade sighs softly as he runs a hand through his long auburn hair. Somehow, he suddenly produces an item that resembles a small pipe and offers it to you.

You receive Eavesdropper Earring from Ereldian Brambleshade.

You receive Lambent Prospect Dagger from Ereldian Brambleshade.




Ereldian Brambleshade says,

If you're going to help me, you're going to need this. It's called an eavesdropper. It should allow you to listen : in on conversations that you otherwise wouldn't be able to.

Be sure not to lose it! If you do somehow misplace it, return to me and ask for a new one.

Go ahead and stick it in your ear... not too far, mind you, then activate it.

Once that's done, let me know when you're ready to hear the plan.

Right-click the earring (equip first if necessary).

You say, "What is the plan, then?"

Ereldian Brambleshade nods and takes a deep breath.

Ereldian Brambleshade says "IS IT WORKING? CAN YOU HEAR ME?"

Ereldian Brambleshade clears his throat, but to your ears, it sounds like thunder clapping inside your brain. Thankfully, he then lowers his voice to a whisper, yet you are able to hear him as though he spoke plain.

Ereldian Brambleshade says,

I shall take that as a yes. Apologies, I fear that some of the fae's... whimsical nature may be rubbing off on me due to my prolonged station here.

It is precisely for that reason that I have an offer for you, if you are interested.

You say, "Of course, I'm interested!"

Ereldian Brambleshade says,

There are two prominent fae in the area who Elyndiir wants you to spy on... Two fae who've been tormenting me for what feels like an entire age.

Lilika and Luonu Thinsticks are their names. They're a pair of vicious pranksters whose careless antics have taken the lives of more than a few travelers.

You're to find their dwelling along the cliffside, across the footbridge and past the ruins to the west. Then, wait until the cover of nightfall when the pair return home and use stealth with the eavesdropper to find out what they're plotting next.

Though, you could also find a more... permanent solution to their meddling, if you're willing?"

You say, "I'm willing. Sounds like fun!"

Ereldian Brambleshade says,

After you've listened in on their plans, if you manage to catch one of them alone, yo can always end their pathetic little life. I'll make it worth your while if you bring me one if their ridiculous acorn hats.

Otherwise, you can simply listen in on them and take your findings to Elyndiir at the Whisper. Though I promise you, no one would mourn the loss of either of those two scoundrels.

Think on it before yo depart, assistant. Oh, and be sure to keep this just between us. Elyndiir has too soft a heart for this sort of business.

sections.title: Part 2b - Mischief
sections.text:
Go as directed, all the way to the circle of mushrooms at the end./look

(If you do not have the earring activated:)

Muffled voices can be heard from within this tilted toadstool home. You make out what sounds like laughter and childish giggles, but the voices are otherwise too faint to understand.

(If you are not in stealth:)

Muffled voices can be heard from within this tilted toadstool home. They quiet as you approach, suspicious of lumbering footsteps nearby.

Otherwise:

You approach the toadstool home under the cover of darkness, coming close enough to make out what they are saying. The eavesdropper earring is working!

Lilika Thinsticks says, "Someone was out there... wasn't there?"
Luonu Thinsticks says, "There's no one there, Lilika, look! Now tell me your idea!"
Lilika Thinsticks says, "We can't be too careful with that Ereldian guy snooping around! You know he's just itching to punish us."
Luonu Thinsticks says, "You mean he isn't just itching from the glitter you slipped into his pants?"

Lilika Thinsticks and her brother Luonu snicker to themselves.

Luonu Thinsticks says, "Now out with it! I'm dying to hear your plan!"
Lilika Thinsticks says, "You won't be the only one dying! I noticed a weak spot in the cliffside near the road. Wouldn't it be funny if a whole caravan got trapped under a landslide?"
Luonu Thinsticks says, "Oh, wow! Would they know it was us?"
Lilika Thinsticks says, "They'd probably just blame those dumb orcs! They hate them a lot more than they hate us."
Luonu Thinsticks says, "It'd be even better if we could drop rocks on that Ereldian."
Lilika Thinsticks says, "You mean Smelldian?"

Luonu Thinsticks snickers.

Lilika Thinsticks says, "Now take a nap! You spent the whole day drinking mushroom dew. I'm going to take a walk and check on that cliff."
Luonu Thinsticks grumbles and obeys his sister's wishes.

You quickly scribble down what you managed to overhear.

You receive Thinsticks Prank Plan.

sections.title: Part 2d - Murder she wrote?
sections.text:
If you decide to kill Lilika Thinsticks:

Lilika Thinsticks says, "HEY, WHO ARE YOU?!"

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Citizens of Faelindral got worse.

Your faction standing with Court of Summer got worse.

Your faction standing with Court of Winter got better.

Lilika Thinsticks says, "I didn't... mean to..."

--You loot Acorn Hat from Lilika Thinstick's corpse.--

Give the helmet to Ereldian Brambleshade.
You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Court of Summer got worse.

Ereldian Brambleshade lets out a loud guffaw as you show him the acorn hat, then breaks down into a fit of laughter that borders on maniacal.
Ereldian Brambleshade says "Haha-ha! You've done all of the Weald a fantastic service for this!"

Ereldian Brambleshade says "That creature was nothing more than a conniving murderer. You've done the right thing. Perhaps I'll finally be able to sleep in peach tonight."

Ereldian Brambleshade says "My thanks, friend. You'll go far if you keep this up. Here, take this."

Ereldian Brambleshade leans in close and presses a small ring into your palm.
Ereldian Brambleshade says "You've earned it. Keep it close by. It may be of use to you in the future, should we require more of your... services."

You receive Loop of Shaded Vine from Ereldian Brambleshade.

sections.title: Part 2e - Finishing up
sections.text:
Before running back:

Give Thinsticks Prank Plan to Ereldian Brambleshade.



Ereldian Brambleshade says,

Such a vile prank.
The fae ought to be purged from this world, and this is even more proof of that. Bring this information back to Elyndiir.
Perhaps it'll be enough to show her that we should be taking a more... direct stance against their antics.

You receive your items back from Ereldian Brambleshade.

Give Thinsticks Prank Plan, Eavesdropper Earring and Lambent Prospect Dagger to Elyndiir Nightshade.

If you just hand in the note:
Elyndiir Nightshade says,

I see you've got some information, but how did you come about it? Ereldian should have provided you with the tool necessary to obtain this.

If you hand in the note and earring:
Elyndiir Nightshade says,

Good, good. It looks like you did some excellent snooping out there.
 Show me your prospect dagger as well, so that you can be properly compensated.

Otherwise:

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Elyndiir Nightshade says,

They're planning on causing a rock slide? Those Thinsticks are going too far this time. I'll send word to the Keepers to watch the hills for any trouble. You did good today, prospect.
We keep a tenuous peach with the fae, but their so-called pranks are growing more and more dangerous. It's why we have to keep one step ahead of them like this.
Elyndiir Nightshade draws a short blade, examining it closely before offering it to you alongside a sheaf of paper.

You receive List of Results from Elyndiir Nightshade.

Elyndiir Nightshade says,

In the meantime, you should take this opportunity to check in with Myrielle. Hopefully she's found something out about that slop she had you put together earlier.
You know the drill by now, yeah? Give her the note and return to me once you have something to show for it.
Also, don't lose the edge I've given you. You'll need it if you want to become a full Wanderer.

You receive Lambent Prospect Blade from Elyndiir Nightshade.

sections.title: Part 3 - Req. Lvl 4
sections.text:
Give List of Results to Myrielle Softglade.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

sections.title: Part 3a - Wolves
sections.text:
Myrielle Softglade says,

Oh! Welcome back, prospect. Are you as excited as I am to read over these results? You and I make a great team, uncovering the mysteries of the perilous roads!
Now, let's see here...

Myrielle Softglade unseals the note; a wide smile quickly spreads across her face as her gaze darts back and forth across the page, absorbing its contents.

Myrielle Softglade says, "Myrielle, concerning the samples you had delivered... blah, blah, blah... clear signs of contamination... ooh, that sounds ominous! ...Resulted in a failure on your part due to..."

Myrielle Softglade slowly trails off as an embarrassed flush creeps up her cheeks. She clears her throat and immediately rolls up the note, sliding it behind her back.

Myrielle Softglade says,

You know what? Never mind those results! The animals you collected parts from were clearly not any real threat to merchant caravans.
Bats, wasp drones, and little wolf pups? Why, even I could handle creatures such as those! I've heard rumors of much stronger beasts that have been prowling the roadways.

You say, "What beasts?"



Myrielle Softglade says,
