The mature wolves in particular seem to be in a frenzy of late. I've been speaking to some of my trade partners, and apparently some rabid wolves have been causing an uproar along the road to Keepers Bight
Not only that, but there's also a large den of wolves near the Wyrdgate to the west that has been assaulting travelers!
I'm not sure which is worse, diseased animals or made ones, but we're going to have to do something about the wolves if we're to maintain our current trade routes.
Meaning, we're left with only one option...

You say, "And the option is?"



Myrielle Softglade says,

I've heard Aerin Mossfang is particularly upset about the rabid wolves. She's sent a number of her beastmasters to sort out that particular issue.
That still leaves the made den of wolves to the west, however.
I'm sure the Ardent Keepers wouldn't like what I'm proposing, but we need a more immediate resolution to the current trade dilemma!
Wolf packs normally follow an alpha leader, right? It could be that the pack is simply following the whim of a mad leader to randomly attack traveleres.
So... I suggest you seek out the den and eliminate the pack's alpha. At the very least, it'll keep the wolves contained to the den until a more permanent solution can be discovered.
Bring me the alpha's fang when it's been dealt with.

Go to the wolf den on the west side of Evershade Weld and kill beguiled wolves to spawn A beguiled alpha wolf and loot its Alpha Wolf Fang.

Note that it is a rare drop off a fairly rare mob.

Give Alpha Wolf Fang to Myrielle Softglade.

Myrielle Softglade gazes down at the fang as her bottom lip begins to quiver.
Myrielle Softglade says, What a horrible thing we had to do... you had to do. I'm so sorry, Villette."
Myrielle Softglade says, "May I see your blade as well as the fang? I want to offer a prayer to poor creature that lost its mind to madness."

You receive your items back from Myrielle Softlade.

You say, "Yes, the madness was unsettling!"

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Your faction standing with Naelira's Court got worse.

Myrielle Softglade runs the fang along the edge of your blade as she closes her eyes, offering a s prayer.
Myrielle Softglade says, "Alashore, forgive us for being unable to protect one of the forest's mas souls. Their life had to be cut short in exchange for the lives of your servants."
Myrielle Softlade says, "The wasps, also."
Myrielle Softglade says, "Then there were those pups, too..."
Myrielle Softglade clears her throat softly.
Myrielle Softlade says, "I, umm... I'm not particularly reverent. Are you? I'm sure the gods don't mind, since they're all sleeping anyway!"
Myrielle Softglade quickly scribbles out a note and hands it to you, alongside your blade.
Myrielle Softglade says, "Take this note back to Elyn for me. We should hopefully be seeing a bit more trade with the roads kept clear. Thanks again for all your work, Villette!"

You receive Lambent Prospect Blade from Myrielle Softglade.

You receive Scribbled Note from Myrielle Softglade.

sections.title: Part 3b - Finishing up
sections.text:
Give Scribbled Note to Elyndiir Nightshade

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Elyndiir Nightshade takes the scribbled note and looks over it, then lets out a soft sigh.
Elyndiir Nightshade says, "I don't really agree with Myrielle's choice of action, but hopefully this sorts out our trade problem. Well done."
Elyndir Nightshade says, "I feel like you've dealt with enough of our more... interesting members, Villette. If you've stuck around with us for this long, then you can probably be trusted with some more involved work."

Elyndir Nightshade says, "Here, take this."
Elyndiir Nightshade retrieves a mask made of leaves and offers it to you.
Elyndir Nightshade says, "This may help you keep some anonymity during your next mission, though you may need to work on your skills before then."
Elyndir Nightshade says, "Return to me and show me that blade of yours once you've strengthened your technique enough to incapacitate a foe,"

You receive Mask of the Forest Walker from Elyndiir Nightshade.

sections.title: Part 4 - Req. Lvl 10+
sections.text:
Give Lambent Prospect Blade to Elyndiir Nightshade

Elyndiir Nightshade twirls the blade around her dexterous fingers and offers it back to you.
Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Looking good, prospect. Keep that blade close, as you'll be needing it.

You'll also want this parchment, assuming you think you have what it takes to look into a little quarrel we've been having with the humans."

You receive Blank Parchment from Elyndiir Nightshade.

You receive Lambent Prospect Blade from Elyndiir Nightshade.

sections.title: Part 4a - Road Trip
sections.text:
You say, "A quarrel?"

Elyndir Nightshade says, "You may be familiar with the human village out in Keepers Bight known as Penshaw."
Elyndir Nightshade says, "They call it one of their kontors, or trade posts, which means there hav been a number of new trade deals offered by the factions of Night Harbor in recent days."
Elyndir Nightshade says, While many of our dealings with the humans have been beneficial, there are still bad actors that have clearly tried to swindle us into abusive deals or find ways to take advantage of our natural resources."
Elyndir Nightshade says, "The Iron Emissaries in particular are an arm of the human race that is notorious for their greed. What I need you to do is travel to Penshaw and determine whether one of their latest trade envoys is legitimate."
Elyndiir Nightshade says, "There's one sure way that you'll be able to make that determination."

You say, "What way will I determine that?"

Elyndir Nightshade grins, brushing an errant strand of her ebon hair back behind a long ear.
Elyndir Nightshade says, "You'll do what we do best, prospect. Spy."
Elyndir Nightshade says, "Rather than rouse suspicion by hailing every person you come across, I want you to venture into the village undetected and try to overhear any conversations regarding a new trade envoy from Night Harbor."
Elyndir Nightshade says, "The tavern might be your best bet, as that's where gossip can get a little more candid."
Elyndir Nightshade says, "If you manage to sniff out where this envoy is staying, you'll want to sneak into their dwelling and politely browse through their belongings without anyone noticing. It might be wise to wait until nightfall when they're asleep to do so."
Elyndir Nightshade says, "You're looking for any sort of paper trail. Ledgers, receipts, or anything of the sort to verify their trade dealings, Copy anything you find onto the blank parchment I gave you, then return it to me."
Elyndir Nightshade says, "Oh, and no violence, prospect. Not unless I determine that a message needs to be sent."

Travel to Keeper's Bight and go to the inn on the north side of town. You will find a sleeping emissary there at night and they despawn at 6am in the morning. Next to the sleeping emissary there is a chest.
Type /open trunk

You quietly open the envoy's trunk. Within are a set of folded traveler's clothes and a leather-bound merchant's ledger.

Type /inspect ledger

You quietly and carefully begin to peruse the contents of the merchant's ledger. Much of the documentation seems insignificant to you, but perhaps Elyndiir would be able to make more sense of it if you were to take a copy.

Type /take copy

You copy down as much information as you can onto the blank parchment. Once finished, you tuck the copy into your belongings and quietly close the trunk. The envoy continues to snore soundly, unaware of your presence.

You receive Copy of a Merchant's Ledger.

sections.title: Part 4b - Reporting In
sections.text:
Give Copy of a Merchant's Ledger & Lambent Prospect Blade to Elyndiir Nightshade

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Elyndiir Nightshade takes a look over your blade before nodding in satisfaction and returning it to you.

Elyndiir Nightshade says,

Well done. You're becoming quite the asset, prospect. Let's take a look at what manner of trade this envoy was involved in...
Elyndiir Nightshade begins poring over the copy that was brought to her. Her sharp gaze narrows as it passes over a series of names you had copied from within the merchant's ledger.
Tsk... just wonderful. See these names here? Garrus and Wilna. They're known to be part of the group of poachers that have been giving the Ardent Keepers the run-around for quite some time.
It appears that our envoy friend has already been in touch with, and made deals with these scoundrels, and now they have the gall to bring trade offers to our doorstep?
I won't have it. Faelindral does not negotiate with poachers, nor those that profit from their murderous gains. I believe it's time we taught these Iron Emissaries a lesson.

You receive Lambent Prospect Blade from Elyndiir Nightshade.

You say, “Oh good, a lesson!”

Elyndiir Nightshade says,

That blade of yours will be the lesson, prospect. Perform this next task and I'll see that you're made into a full-fledged Wanderer.
Are you ready to hear the plan?

sections.title: Part 4c - The Plan
sections.text:
You say, “Of course, I'm ready to hear the plan!”

Elyndiir Nightshade says,

By now, the envoy has already left Penshaw and made their way to the Hanging Gardens; that's the name of the treetop inn located on the eastern side of the Bight, past the valley that leads to Scarwood.
They'll be heading toward Evershade sometime during the early morning hours. It's on that route where you'll strike.
Be careful, though. There's a good chance the envoy will have strong escorts. If you wait for the right opportunity, you should be able to separate them from their guards using a well-timed sap or blow to the back of the head with the pommel of your blade.
Once your target is alone, strike hard and fast. Eliminate the scoundrel and bring me their full ledger so we can show the council just how untrustworthy these humans can be.

The emissary is level 15. They spawn by the treehouse in Keeper's Bight around 7am and walk to the Evershade Weald zone line. They are accompanied by two guards of higher level.

Give Bloodied Merchant Ledger & Lambent Prospect Blade to Elyndiir Nightshade

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.

Elyndiir Nightshade nods as she accepts the ledger and conceals the bloodied object inside of a ledger satchel. She then extends her hand toward you with a flourish and presents the hilt of an elegant elven stiletto.

Elyndiir Nightshade says,

You're proven and now blooded. In my eyes, you're a prospect no longer.
The Lambent Wanderers are an eclectic group, but we put the interests of Faelindral first and foremost, just as you did today.
This stiletto marks you as one of our agents. There may come a time when you're call upon for more assignments, but for now, you're free to make your own story.
Shades of the Weald watch over you. Thanks again.

You receive Lambent Stiletto from Elyndiir Nightshade.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience

Irfan's Dagger
Mark of the Lamplighters
Roofstrider's Ring

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Read Torn Note you start with as a new Rogue character:

Deliver this note to Sinastin Aspinleaf in Night
Harbor to begin your association with the
Lamplighters.

You will find him in the City Illuminators' Guild,
which is located on the edge of the Night Market.
The City Illuminators' Guild serves as a front fro
his operation there.

To find the market, enter the city and then keep
an eye out for a large archway containing what
appears to be a massive red gemstone.

If you can't spot what looks like the largest ruby
in the world, odds are you're not going to make a
good rogue.

If you get lost, ask a guard for directions to the
City Illuminators' Guild. But, it's prolly not wise
to ask where all the rogues are hiding. And it's
time for you to be wise. Otherwise Irfan will
leave you floating in the harbor.

Good luck with Sinastin's Crew.

You're going to need it.

Give Torn Note to Sinastin Aspenleaf.

You gain experience!!

Sinastin Aspenleaf examines the note.

Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Ah yes... welcome to my humble organization. The Lamplighters are honored to add such a..."

Sinastin Aspenleaf looks at you for a moment and appears to think.

Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "...wonderful find, such as yourself, to our roster."

Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "The note you just handed me means that, while you may be new, you're already trusted enough to start earning your keep."

Sinastin Aspenleaf snickered to himself when he said the word trusted.

Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "The courier I was going to send out today is no longer with us. So, please take list and read the names written therein. Let me know if you have any questions about these people."

Sinastin Aspenleaf smiles at you with a perfect, but unpleasant smile.

You receive Sinastin's List of Names Sinastin Aspenleaf.

Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Now, show that note to Albrecht on the way out. He'll give you what you need."

Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Once you have gathered all of our gifts, take the bag to Albrecht to inventory and bring the receipt to me when he's finished."

You are tasked with retrieving items from six NPCs across Night Harbor. Read Sinastin's List of Names and then give it to Albrecht in the next room.

Albrecht looks at the note and hands over a bag and several seal notes.

You receive Small Courier Bag from Albrecht.

You receive Sealed Note for Bakari from Albrecht.

You receive Sealed Note for Mafeed from Albrecht.

You receive Sealed Note for Dilshad from Albrecht.

You receive Sealed Note for Nerida from Albrecht.

You receive Sealed Note for Eilionoir from Albrecht.

You receive Sealed Note for Andreu from Albrecht.

Albrecht says, "Toss those sealed notes into the bag I gave you and don't try to open them. Nor should you open the packages you get in return. Nosey people don't fare well here."

Albrecht says, "Well, my new friend. I wish you the best of luck."

Albrecht says, "I hope you last longer than the last guy."

Albrecht says, "Oh, and here's your list of names back."

You receive Sinastin's List of Names from Albrecht.

Go and locate the following NPCs and retrieve the requested items.

Customs Inspector Bakari

Located in the Harbor by the Harbormaster Daoud.

Captain Eilionoir

Located in "The Changing of the Guard".  A bar on the ramp down when leaving Sageside heading towards west gate.  An off duty guard is outside.

You gain experience!!

Captain Eilionoir takes the note and quickly places it out of sight under the bar.
Captain Eilionoir sighs with a frown.
Captain Eilionoir glances around before speaking.
Captain Eilionoir says, "There are a lot of new faces since my time in the City Watch. Some of them are taking a little longer to warm up to me, but soon I'll have another roster ready to go."

You receive Sealed Scroll from Captain Eilionoir

Captain Eilionoir says, "Now drink this and get out of here before anyone gets suspicious."

You receive Twilight Bay Rum from Captain Eilionoir

Nerida Thinblade

Located in the "Spirit Tap," a bar in the Black Feather Bazaar (in the Necropolis area).

Hand Nerida Thinblade the Sealed Note for Nerida.

You gain experience!!

Nerida Thinblade reads through the note, then tosses it under the bar.
Nerida Thinblade smiles at you wickedly, her eyes briefly wide with amusement.
Nerida Thinblade says, "Well, that contained an interesting enough proposition."
Nerida Thinblade says, "Give this to your master, he'll be happy I got it back in one piece. Make sure it arrives that way."

You receive Small Wrapped Box from Nerida Thinblade

Nerida Thinblade says, "And, my new friend, here's a drunk for the walk back."

You receive Black Feather Whiskey from Nerida Thinblade

Dilshad Abolfazl

Located in the Tannery.

Guard Andreu

Overlooking the Naval Shipyard (near the garrison) during the day.

Hand Guard Andreu the Sealed Note for Andreu.

You gain experience!!

Guard Andreu glances around and quickly tucks the note into his tunic.
Guard Andreu motions for you to lean closer.
Guard Andreu stubly slips you a key.

You receive Small Iron Key from Guard Andreu

Guard Andreu says, "Now piss off."

Maheed the Butcher

Located in the Night Market.

When you have collected all six items combine them inside the Small Courier Bag. Turn in the combined Small Courier Bag to Albrecht.

You gain experience!!

Albrecht dumps the bag's contents on the table and opens the packages.
Albrecht says, "One hand. Check. Wait.. is the tattoo.."
Albrecht turns the hand over.
Albrecht says, "Oh! There it is. Check."
Albrecht says, "A bar of gold..."
Albrecht weighs the gold.
Albrecht says, "Check."
Albrecht examines Nerida's package.
Albrecht says, "Umbral transducer. Good to see you again. Check."
Albrecht scans Eilionoir's scroll.
Albrecht says, "Well that means a change of plans, but... guard schedule. Check."
Albrecht dumps the contents of  Bakari's pouch.
Albrecht says, "Oh my!"
Albrecht holds a red gem up to the light.
Albrecht says, "Rubies, Check."
Albrecht reaches for the key, but appears to swap it with a key he had hidden in his palm.
Albrecht shifts his eyes to you for a moment, before looking back to his ledger.
Albrecht says, "The tower key. Check."
Albrecht says, "Well, it looks like everything is accounted for. Take the receipt to Sinastin... and keep your mouth shut."

You receive Albrecht's Receipt from Albrecht.

Give the receipt to Sinastin

Sinastin takes the receipt and reads it carefully.
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Well it looks like we've received everything we expected. I trust that everything went smoothly."
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "I'd like for you to deliver the list to Irfan. You probably saw him on the way in."

You receive Sinastan's Note from Sinastin Aspenleaf

Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "If you're unfamiliar with our formidable friend... well, to put it simply, he's an avatar of violence. He may not be as sneaky as some of the others, but he is absolute in his loyalty."
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Irfan is not 'sneaky peaky' like you and many others within our organization. Irfan is an avatar of violence. But, he is absolute in his loyalty."
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "...And loyalty is a good trait to have around here. I'd advise against crossing me."
Sinastin Aspenleaf stares at you coldly for a moment, then suddenly smiles.
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Off with you, then! You don't want to keep Irfan waiting... he isn't known for his patience."

Give the note to Irfan Raz, located right outside the Illuminators' Guild.

Irfan Raz glances at the list and then tucks it away.
Irfan Raz says, "You'll need this, so hang on to it."

You receive Irfan's Dagger from Irfan Raz

Irfan Raz says, "Sinastin needs you to do three things for him."
Irfan Raz says, "If you are caught by the guards, you'll not speak of this work. If you do, we will know. Understand?"
Irfan Raz looks at you with a vaguely threatening expression.
Irfan Raz says, "I'll take that as a yes. Bring this parchment to Stumpy at one of his posts in the market. He has the first job for you."

You receive Irfan's Parchment from Irfan Raz.

Irfan Raz says, "When you're done, return to me my dagger to me, along with proof you have completed the task."

Give Irfan's Parchment to Stumpy the Whistler, standing by the cobbler in the Night Market.  He can also be in the left stall when entering Night Market from the west bank.  Rumor is he roams at times.  Be sure to look around the bridge to Twilight Harbor as you leave the South East corner of Night Market.

stumpy by night market

Stumpy the Whistler looks at the writing on the parchment, then shakes his head with a sigh.
Stumpy the Whistler pulls out his quill and begins to sketch something.
Stumpy the Whistler shows you a crude drawing of the god Haradrel and a dagger prying a gem from its face.
Stumpy the Whistler points at the drawing, then to you.
Stumpy the Whistler scribbles a new image of a small tower on top of what looks like the Steel Talons Garrison.
Stumpy the Whistler continues drawing, this time of a building with the words Sproggets' Adventuring Goods.
Stumpy the Whistler finally jots down a picture of a grappling hook on the parchment's corner, then tears it off.
Stumpy the Whistler hands it to you and motions for you to give it to Sproggets.

You receive a Piece of Parchment from Stumpy the Whistler.






Give the Piece of Parchment to Sproggets Bedsprings, located in the shop next to the northwest entrance to the Night Market.

Sproggets Bedsprings glances over the illustration of the piece of parchment.
Sproggets Bedsprings purses his lips, then sighs deeply.

You receive Worn Grappling Hook from Sproggets Bedsprings.

Sproggets Bedsprings says, "Okay, I'll give you the goods. But you didn't get it from me."
Sproggets Bedsprings says, "I'm neutral in all of this... just an innocent gnome trying to earn some coin."
Sproggets Bedsprings says, "Do you even know how to use this thing? Look for a good place to climb, throw the grappling hook, then climb. That's all there is to it. Look, throw, and away you go."
Sproggets Bedsprings says, "Now, out with ya! ...But maybe bring it back when you're done with it."

Go to the Steel Talons Garrison onto the roof of the southern structure overlooking the west gate newbie yard. There is a small tower-like section with no roof.

Steel Talons Garrison roof tower, where you use the grappling hook.

/Look at the base of the tower for the message,
You feel you could climb this wall with the proper equipment.
While holding the grappling hook "/throw wall"
You begin to ascend the wall...
After a few brief seconds you will see
You reached the top of the wall.
Drop down into the tower.(DONT drop into room below until you /pry eye)  You will see a statue below you. While holding your [[Irfan's Dagger] type "/pry eye"
You pry the bloodstone free from the statue.

You receive Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye

Your faction standing with the Priests of Haradrel got worse.

Give the Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye and Irfan's Dagger to Irfan Raz.

Irfan Raz rolls the gem around in his hand and almost appears to smirk.
Irfan Raz says, "Let's hope you didn't just catch notice of the God of War."
Irfan Raz says, "For your next job, pay a visit to Whispering Wallace at the Shaded Bloom Inn. He'll be drinking there at night. Show him my dagger so he knows I sent you."

You receive Irfan's Dagger from Irfan Raz.

Irfan Raz says, "And like before, return with my dagger and proof of your deed."

Give Irfan's Dagger  to Whispering Wallace.

Whispering Wallace looks around quickly and motions for you to speak softly.
Whispering Wallace says, "I've gathered word that Pasha Patrice has a special guest at her compound. The guest is an emissary from Tarellon who's travelling through Night Harbor under Patrice's protection."
Whispering Wallace says, "Let's just say it would be very embarrassing to her and her operation if this guest winds up dead."
Whispering Wallace says, "They've given the emissary a room for the night on the second floor of the compound, just past the room where our fake 'Pasha' likes to hold court toward the end of the day."
Whispering Wallace pauses for a moment and looks at you, as though realizing something.
Whispering Wallace says, "You're new, so you may not know about the compound. It's in the eastern corner of the market. On the right as you're leaving, just before the bridge. Sometimes Stumpy posts up across from it."
Whispering Wallace says, "The boss is pissed that she set up shop so close to us, so he'll be happy when you pull this off."
Whispering Wallace says, "You'll probably want this dagger back. When the job's done, return it to Irfan with proof of the deed."
Whispering Wallace says, "Good hunting."

You receive Irfan's Dagger from Whispering Wallace

Go to the compound described to survey the area and plan your attack. On the west side of the building, you will see a fountain.  The attack must happen at night ( between 3a.m. and 6a.m.) when the emissary is in her room.  You will need to jump across from a nearby 2nd floor building to get access. You can get on top of the city wall from behind the bathhouse.  Run on the wall towards Night Market.  When you see the fountain on your left, the building you're looking for will be next.  Jump down from the wall on to the closest building.  Jump the gap over to the 2nd floor of the Claw Compound. Find the emissary's room behind a closed door.  Kill an emissary and loot her Fine Leather Courier Bag and return it along with the dagger to Irfan Raz.

Irfan Raz takes the bag and almost seems to chuckle.
Irfan Raz says, "The last job is from me. There's a camp of smugglers along the coast to the west of here."
Irfan Raz says, "You'll find a man named Toma there. He's in charge. He needs to die. I want the ring he wears as proof."
Irfan Raz deftly flips his dagger back to you.
Irfan Raz says, "You might find this handy once again."

You receive Irfan's Dagger from Irfan Raz.

Recommended level: 7-8 - Go to Shaded Dunes along the coast to the smuggler/wererat camp and kill Toma the Two-Faced and loot Toma's Signet Ring. Turn ring and Irfan's Dagger into Irfan Raz.

Irfan Raz says, "You got the rat man's ring! His death will show the rest of Vermahn's crew whose territory they're in... not that his thrall has much choice in the matter."
 Irfan Raz spits.
Irfan Raz says, "Take these to our little bookkeeper upstairs."
Irfan Raz says, "Don't neglect to slide him my dagger... point first."
 Irfan Raz laughs.
Irfan Raz says, "So he knows I sent you."

You receive Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye, Toma's Signet Ring, and Fine Leather Courier Bag from Irfan Raz..

Take these to Albrecht who is just upstairs from Irfan Raz. 




Turn in Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye, Toma's Signet Ring, Irfan's Dagger, and Fine Leather Courier Bag to Albrecht.

You gain experience!!

Albrecht looks over the items as you set them on the table.
Albrecht says, "You can have this one back. I don't know where he finds all of them..."

You receive Irfan's Dagger from Albrecht.

Albrecht picks up the bloodstone with a pair of jeweler's tongs.
Albrecht says, "You can never be too careful with defiling the likeness of a god."
 Albrecht drops the bloodstone into a black box and tucks it away.
 Albrecht unlocks the emissary's bag with a small key, then looks inside.
Albrecht says, "Well, several people will be upset to see the emissary dead... including our little pretend Pasha. But that's her problem to deal with now."
Albrecht says, "Good work. She's almost as hideous as some other people I know."
 Albrecht stiffens up, realizing what he just said out loud.
 Albrecht quickly glances over toward Sinastin's room.
 Albrecht shakes his head, refocusing on his task, then picks up the ring.
Albrecht says, "Filthy business, this lot. Like a nest of vipers and rats, constantly biting each other."
Albrecht says, "Well, here you are. Take this receipt to Sinastin."

You receive Ring Receipt from Albrecht.

Albrecht motions for you to lean close.
Albrecht says, "You seem decent enough. Take this note to Elmswood at the Spirit Tap. If I'm not wrong about you, you might want to hear what he's got to say. If I'm wrong, we never spoke."

You receive Albrecht's Note from Albrecht.

Albrecht says, "Wrap things up with Sinastin first, then go to the Spirit Tasp before you do anything more for him. You'll understand more when you speak to Elmswood."

First, take the Ring Receipt to Sinastin Aspenleaf in the next room. It gets you experience and Lamplighter's Ring. 

Second, take the Albrecht's Note to Elmswood at the Spirit Tap in the Dark Bazaar.




You gain experience!!

Sinastin Aspenleaf scans the receipt, then looks at you.
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Very well done. I see you brought back one of the rat's rings, too."
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Did you keep the finger you found it on? ...Actually, never mind that. Here's a nicer ring for your troubles. It would seem that you're a Lamplighter after all."

You receive Lamplighter's Ring from Sinastin Aspenleaf.

Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Which means... I've got another job for you. Take this bag. There are a few things I'd like you to retrieve for me."

You receive a Black Leather Courier Bag.

You say, "What things?"
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "The tomb just outside of town is said to contain a wealth of interesting artifacts. I've learned that one of our rivals, Jamee Langris, is attempting to recover an amulet for a client of his. It supposedly allows the wearer to commune with spirits."
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "The previous amulet bearer entered the tomb to speak with a certain female spirit... but she put a quick end to him. Find her, and I bet you'll find the amulet."
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "The other thing I need can be found at the archaeological site in Shaded Dunes. I'm very curious about the activities of the head researcher there... a fellow named Aashir."
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Sneak into the site after dark and see if you can find his documentation. He's bound to have a journal or something similar to log their findings."
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "On that note, I've heard that a group of cultists has been poking around there lately. Don't let them get to it first."
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Place both items in the bag and bring it directly to me. Don't involve Albrecht this time."

Elmswood can be found at the Spirit Tap in the Dark Bazaar just to the left of Nerida.

Elmswood rubs his thumb across the surface of the note and smiles.
Elmswood says, "Well then... the dwarf has finally gathered some courage."
Elmswood says, "He sent you to me... to betray his master. How do you feel about that?
Elmswood squints at you for a moment.
Elmswood says, "If you don't like it, you'd be wise to keep your mouth shut. Sure, you could rat the dwarf out to Sinastin, but you'd be a food to think he won't suspect you too.
Elmswood says, "But... if you're interested in running with a less 'despicable' crew, then take this note to the fishing camp just outside the city. Someone will meet you there at midnight."

You receive Albrecht's Note from Elmswood. 




Take Albrecht's Note to the fishing village inside the Shaded Dunes near the young crocodiles. The village is south of Night Harbor, along the waters edge. Give the note to Selyst Surecoin when she spawns exactly at 12am game time.

Selyst Surecoin rubs the tips of her fingers across the note.
Selyst Surecoin says, "Elmswood said he was sending someone... and the note is real enough."
Selyst Surecoin says, "We run with Tinka Roofstrider's crew. She despises Sinastin, so the bag he gave you and the items he wanted in it... we want them."
Selyst Surecoin says, "That pointy dung pile of an elf won't be too pleased if you do this for us, so you'd better think carefully about it."
Selyst Surecoin says, "If you choose to run with us, you'll have a bounty on your head as well... and I'm sure you've seen what Irfan and the other Lamplighters are capable of. Hells, you've likely had to do some of it yourself."
Selyst Surecoin says, "So, ask your questions now. If you decide to move forward with us, fetch the items and bring me the bag."
Selyst Surecoin says, "You know when and where to find me."

Need more information. Split factions and possibly KoS to Rogue's guild if this path is followed?

Recommended level: 15 - Enter Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane and head down to High Marshal Fionna.  Fionna is the spirit that Sinastin Aspenleaf references. Kill Fionna and obtain the Engraved Amulet.  The amulet is an occasional dropped item and it is the first item needed. For the second item, you will need to kill a cultist and collect a 6-slot Aashir's Journal, and 6 Aashir journal pages:

Aashir's Journal Page 4
Aashir's Journal Page 17
Aashir's Journal Page 37
Aashir's Journal Page 42
Aashir's Journal Page 70
Aashir's Journal Page 76

The cultist can be found at night near the Ancient Crypt entrance or under a hidden tunnel beyond the farm just outside of North Gate Night's Harbor. 




 Combine the 6 Aashir Journal pages in the Aashir's Journal. It will turn into a completed Aashir's Journal. 




 Combine both the completed Aashir's Journal and the Engraved Amulet into the Black Leather Courier Bag and it'll turn into a completed Black Leather Courier Bag. 




Turn in combined Black Leather Courier Bag to Sinastin Aspenleaf

Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Fantastic Work."
Sinastin Aspenleaf smiles broadly while looking at the amulet.
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "This will certanly leave Langris in a bind. It's not often that he fails to fulfill a request... pity."
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "As for the journal, I look forward to seeing what opportunities it has for us."
Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "For now, take some time off. You've earned it, and... you've pleased me."

You receive Mark of the Lamplighters from Sinastin Aspenleaf.

Alternate Hand combined black leather bag to Selyst Surecoin.

Selyst Surecoin says, "Well, well... for better or worse, it looks like you've got a new crew to meet! We've got a couple of safehouses in the Bends."

Selyst Surecoin shrugs.

Selyst Surecoin says, "Sure, it's a little dangerous there for outsiders, but it's fun once you know your way around."

Selyst Surecoin says, "Take the bag to Tinka. She'll be expecting you. You'll find her observing the courtyard, just inside the main gate to Riverbend."

You receive Black Leather Courier Bag from Selyst Surecoin.

Selyst Surecoin says, "Oh, and just so you know, you made the right choice."

Take Black Leather Courier Bag to Tinka Roofstrider.

Tinka Roofstrider says, "We were hoping you'd make the right choice. Welcome to the crew!"

Tinka Roofstrider says, "I'll have something you can help with soon. In the meantime, if Sinastin gave you one of his gaudy rings, hand it over and we'll give you something classy."

Tinka Roofstrider says, "Otherwise, feel free to poke around and meet the crew."

Hand Tinka Roofstrider Lamplighter's Ring

Tinka Roofstrider says, "Yep, that's the one. Trashy, isn't it?"

Tinka Roofstrider pockets the ring.

Tinka Roofstrider says, "Here, this is much better."

You receive Roofstrider's Ring from Tinka Roofstrider.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Scarab Breastplate
Scarab Greaves
Scarab Helm
Scarab Boots
Scarab Shell Shield

sections.title: Dialogue & Turn-ins
sections.text:
You say, "Hail, Hult Beetlewrangler"

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Woah, ho there, adventurer. Ya lookin for work or wares? No matter, ol' Hult's got somethin for ya either way."

You say, "What wares?"

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Well, well... maybe Hult's got the things ya need. Nanny Shrew always said, 'Hult, of all the Shrewfolk, ya've got to be the most industrious an' entrepreneurial of the lot... and most handsome too.'

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Well maybe not that last past anyway. Maybe not any of it."

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Anyhow, ya musn't leave town in just yer drawers. How would ya like ol' Hult to make ya some fine accessories?"

You say, "I would like you to make me some fine accessories."

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Them ugly green scarabs out there in the dunes have mighty tough shells, they do. I can make ya a breastplate, greaves, helm, boots, and shield. Just ask ol' Hult how."

You say, "Breastplate?"
Hult Beetlewrangler says, "For the breastplate, Hult'll need three scarab shells, three scarab legs, and a scarab thorax plate."
Upon turning in 3x Scarab Carapace and 3x Scarab Leg and 1x Scarab Thorax Plate:
You gain experience!!

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Here ya go, boss."
You receive Scarab Breastplate from Hult Beetlewrangler.

You say, "Greaves?"
Hult Beetlewrangler says, "For the greaves, Hult'll need two scarab shells and two scarab legs, and a scarab elytron plate."
Upon turning in 2x Scarab Carapace and 2x Scarab Leg and 1x Scarab Elytron Plate:
You gain experience!!

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Here ya go, boss."
You receive Scarab Greaves from Hult Beetlewrangler.

You say, "Helm?"
Hult Beetlewrangler says, "For the helm, Hult'll need two scarab shells and one scarab leg.
Upon turning in 2x Scarab Carapace and 1x Scarab Leg
You gain experience!!

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Here ya go, boss."
You receive Scarab Helm from Hult Beetlewrangler.

You say, "Boots?"
Hult Beetlewrangler says, "For the boots, Hult'll need one scarab shell and two scarab legs."
Upon turning in 1x Scarab Carapace and 2x Scarab Leg:
You gain experience!!

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Here ya go, boss."
You receive Scarab Boots from Hult Beetlewrangler.

You say, "Shield?"
Hult Beetlewrangler says, "For the shield, Hult'll need one scarab shell and one scarab leg."
Upon turning in 1x Scarab Carapace and 1x Scarab Leg:
You gain experience!!

Hult Beetlewrangler says, "Here ya go, boss."
You receive Scarab Shell Shield from Hult Beetlewrangler.

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read Weathered Note you start with as a new Shadow Knight character:

Take this note to Exavius Deathwhisper in the
Concourse of Souls to begin your training.

The guild hall can be found within the Necropolis
District.

You'll find it if you proceed through the Sageside
District towards Saltbreeze Park. If you get to the
Tannery, you've gone too far.

Or if you are very daring, there's a shortcut 
through the old cemetery outside of the Black
Feather Bazaar. This will lead into the Necropolis
District.

If you get lost, ask a guard. They are often helpful
with directions.

And try not to die. We have enough undead in the
desert already.

Give Weathered Note to Exavius Deathwhisper.

Exavius Deathwhisper says, "Welcome. We are looking to expand our ranks, but expect to be vetted."

Exavius Deathwhisper says, "You'll need to prove to be a value beyond just your capability to survive the desert and deliver notes. Your loyalty will be tested."

Exavius Deathwhisper says, "Night Harbor is far more than what shows on her surface. You'll see in due time and we'll learn the durability of your resolve."

Exavius Deathwhisper says, "Take your note to Brazzic, downstairs in the sleeping quarters. He'll get you started."

You gain experience!!

You receive Weathered Note from Exavius Deathwhisper.

Brazzic Durraim says, "Well? Out with it."

Brazzic Durraim says, "... and if you think I mean your tongue, my response will be painful."

Give Weathered Note Note to Brazzic Durraim who is also in the Concourse of Souls.

Brazzic Durraim says, "Well, you made it. Our people have been watching you. Appears you're more "knight" than "shadow" for the time being. And to be fair, friend, you don't look like much of a knight."

Brazzic Durraim says, "But at least you arrived, and I guess that counts for something."

Brazzic Durraim says, "We're going to get straight to business. Let's see how you operate."

Brazzic Durraim says, "Deliver the note to a gentleman named Noel Klares. Bring back whatever he gives you."

Brazzic Durraim says, "The bag is to be filled with shattered femurs from the bone piles you saw stumbling around out in the desert. Do you have questions?"

You gain experience!!

You receive Sealed Scroll from Brazzic Durraim.

You receive Black Leather Bag from Brazzic Durraim.

Go out into the yard in front of the Concourse of Souls and hunt a rotting skeleton until you have 6 Shattered Skeleton Femur. Combine them inside the Black Leather Bag from Brazzic and receive a Bag of Femurs.

Locate Noel Klares in the Wayfarers Hospice in Night Harbor and give him the Sealed Scroll. (find guard tower, go up, back inside 2nd floor, find ramp, go up, he's on the roof). *** Warning. The guards will assist him if they are nearby. It is recommended to pull him to a safer area where guards will not patrol.

Noel Klares says, "Who sent you?! What do you know of us? No matter, I'll deal with you myself!" He Will attack, Kill him.

Noel Klares says, "You've come to confront me? Don't you know who I work for?"

Noel Klares says, "... they ... they will ... find you."

Loot Noel Klares' Ring from Noel Klares.

Return to Brazzic Durraim and give him Bag of Femurs and Noel Klares' Ring.

Brazzic Durraim says, "Bravo! Our people say you performed well. And the fact that you're here now and not locked in prison, means that you've got a bit of a shadow to your knight after all."

Brazzic Durraim says, "Feels good to do bad things to bad people sometimes, eh?"

Brazzic Durraim says, "As master Hallows was kind enough to establish this wonderful college from which we now operate, we in return, provide services to his necromancers and faculty."

Brazzic Durraim says, "Please take the bag over to Buckmarr Gorstagg, the head alchemist. He'll make use of it's contents."

Brazzic Durraim says, "Your next task will involve his favorite abomination. Return to me after you've assisted him with it. Then, maybe you can take a little break and peruse some of this fair city's night life."

You receive Bag of Femurs from Brazzic Durraim.

sections.title: Part 2 - Req. Lvl 8 or 5 if you have a group for Wererats
sections.text:
You say, "Hail Buckmarr Gorstagg."

Buckmarr Gorstagg looks up from his work.

Buckmarrgorstagg says, "It's extremely important that my work not be disturbed. What is it?"

Hand him the Bag of Femurs

You gain experience!!

Buckmarr Gorstagg opens the bag and examines the contents.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Yes, this will do. Thank you."

Buckmarr Gorstagg removes a bladed weapon from a black silk bag.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Please take this weapon. I'm experimenting with coating in an attempt to see if it will cauterize certain wounds in a manner suitable for my needs."

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "There's rumored to be a camp deep along the coast of Shaded Dunes that's utilized by wererats posing as smugglers. Or wererat smugglers. Or some such nonsense."

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Use the blade to sever their whiskered heads and return them to me. Bring me at least four.:

Buckmarr Gorstagg pauses for a moment.

You receive Silver Edged Blade from Buckmarr Gorstagg.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "If you feel like they should be made to suffer, please by all means, but do take care not to mention this to Master Hallows. He worries about the attention your people draw to our work here."

Buckmarr Gorstagg returns to his work.

sections.title: Part 3 - Req. Lvl none(?) just a turn in for part 2 above
sections.text:
Hand Buckmarr Gorstagg 4 Wererat Head and the Silver Edged Blade.

You gain experience!!

Buckmarr Gorstagg lines the heads up and stares at them.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Well, I do hope they suffered.  I would have taken my time with them."

Buckmarr Gorstagg pokes one of the heads.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "The wounds look promising.  I'll need to examine them more in detail, but I'm sure my blade performed as planned."

Buckmarr Gorstagg hands you a concoction filled vial.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Please give this to Brazzic for me.  I'm sure Master Deathwhisper is awaiting its delivery."

You receive Small Brown Vial from Buckmarr Gorstagg.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "I may have other work for you later.  But for now, that is all"

Buckmarr Gorstagg returns to poking at one of the heads.

sections.title: Part 4 - Req. Lvl none(?) just a turn in for the tunic reward
sections.text:
Hand Brazzic Durraim the Small Brown Vial

You gain experience!!

Brazzic Durraim looks at the vial and frowns for a moment.

Brazzic Durraim says, "Buckmarr should know better than to give this to just anyone, but you seem to be ingratiating yourself well enough.  I assume he refrained from describing its contents, yes?"

Brazzic Durraim appears to scan your face for clues.

Brazzic Durraim says, "I'll take that as a "no." Good."

Brazzic Durraim says, "You're doing good work so far.  I think you'll fit in just fine here.  Take this and then take some time to go explore the city.  It's more of a hunting ground than it looks."

Brazzic Durraim says, "Just be careful of some of the darker corners.  You've still got some learning to do yet, "shadow knight.""

Brazzic Durraim hands you a tunic.

You receive Gold Trimmed Black Tunic from Brazzic Durraim.

Brazzic Durraim winks at you.

Brazzic Durraim says, "Come back later and I'll likely have some new work for you."

Apprentice Hoop of the Listener

Robes of the Listener
