sections.title: Part 1 - First steps of being a Shaman
sections.text:
Read the Folded Leafscroll that you start with as a new Shaman Character:
Reading the Leafscroll:

Do you hear the whispers through the boughs?
Yes, this is because you Listen.

Do you hear the whimsy hidden in the fae's wisdom?
Yes, this is because you Listen.

Do you hear songs of our history yearning to be told?
Yes, this is because you Listen.

We invite you to learn from these whispers at the Balanced Branch lodge.

To reach us, set out toward the Willows Whisper and ascend the ramp on the left to Traders Terrace. Once there, traverse the lone bridge and you will find us across from our Ranger cousins. Any of the city guard can provide further direction if required.

When you arrive, present this note to our Listener mentor, Varilis Thornvine.

Eraeldor Lowmist
Elder Whisperer of the Preservers

Give Folded Leafscroll to Varilis Thornvine.

Varilis Thornvine cracks open a well-wizened gaze as you offer him the scroll, which he accepts at the pace of an old treant.

"The whispers of your arrival have reached my ears well before this scroll ever did, young shaman."

"I have been preparing for you. Here, please accept this mortar and pestle. You will need it for your first task."

You receive Old Mortar and Pestle from Varilis Thornvine.

You say, "What task?"

"Old forces threaten the balance of the Weald and beyond. The fae grow restless and resentful. The spirits of the dead find no rest."

"We must do what needs be done to preserve the balance, young one. My old bones are not up to this task, but perhaps a young listener such as yourself could quell some of these... disturbances."

You say. "What disturbances?"

Varilis Thornvine says, "You should start with the undead that have begun to crawl out from long forgotten places."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Gather four chips of their bones, along with two of their skulls. Crush them within your mortar and return the dust to me."

Go to the newbie area and kill a rotting skeleton until you get 4 Bone Chips and two Shattered Skulls. Combine these in the Old Mortar and Pestle.

Upon combining 4 unstacked Bone Chips and 2 Shattered Skulls in the container, it becomes a Mortar of Bone Dust.

Return to Varilis Thornvine and hand in the dust.

Varilis Thornvine carefully reaches out to collect the mortar of ground up, chalky bone dust. He carefully pours the dust into a small pouch, whispering out soft unheard words as he does.

You receive Novice Hoop of the Listener from Varilis Thornvine. 

You receive Scroll: Invisibility versus Beasts from Varilis Thornvine. 

You receive Pouch of Bone Dust from Varilis Thornvine.

sections.title: Part 2 - Solving the problem
sections.text:
Varilis Thornvine says, "You shall take what remains of those who were scorned and have them reveal the source of the wolves' agony. Can you hear their cries?"

You say, "I cannot hear their cries."

Varilis Thornvine says, "The mournful howls of the Weald's wolves haunt my dreams of late. More of their number fall to savagery and madness by the day."

Varilis Thornvine says, "I have altered the bone dust that you collected, so that it may cling to the dismal agonies of woeful spirits."

Varilis Thornvine says, "There is a wolf pack amongst the western cliffs whose cries concern me most. Locate and scatter the dust at the entrance of their den to reveal the source of this dismay."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Throw, or simply pour out the contents of the pouch. It should make no difference. Once revealed, you must confront the spirit and, if need be, cleanse it. Do you understand?"

You say, "I understand."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Learn from the scroll I have given you to conceal yourself from the gaze of any wolves who have fallen to madness."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Return to me with anything that you uncover, along with your novice hoop. You may also return and ask me for more dust, should you lose what you have."

Go down the fungal lift and past the druid ring, fungal ring, and ruins. The wolf caves are there, in the entrance. Pick up the dust on your cursor and use /throw dust.

a mischievous faerie that looks like a small drake will spawn. It is light blue to a level 3, and casts. Kill it and loot a strange toadstool. Return this and your Novice Hoop of the Listener to Varilis.

You gain experience!

Your faction standing with Preservers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Varilis Thornvine furrows his already well-weathered brow as you present the toadstool to him, alongside your novice hoop.

Varilis Thornvine says,"So the fae have had a hand in this? Their antics grow bolder by the day, despite our tenuous agreement."

Varilis Thornvine says,"You were not wrong to mete out punishment for the imbalance they caused. I would say you deserve this."

Varilis Thornvine proceeds to whisper something into the small hoop, as though it were an ear yearning to hear one of his tales. He smiles softly and offers the hoop back to you, now empowered further by the spirits.

You receive Apprentice Hoop of the Listener from Varilis Tornvine.

Varilis Thornvine says,"Well done Listener. Though now we must see about this strange toadstool. Perhaps it can tell us a clue."

You say,"What clue?"

Varilis Thornvine slowly brings the toadstool up toward his elongated ear, as though listening to murmurs that only he could hear.

Varilis Thornvine says,"Tell me, young Listener, do you hear the whispers?"

You say,"What whispers?"

Varilis Thornvine says,"I believe you will be capable of hearing a great many things before long, young one. Not just from toadstools, but from all manner of objects in which the spirits reside."

Varilis Thornvine says,"Even from objects that have been with you from the near beginning. Please, allow me to see your apprentice hoop so that I may listen to all it has experienced in your journey thus far."

sections.title: Part 3 - Spore Druids
sections.text:
Hand Varilis Thornvine your Apprentice Hoop of the Listener.

Your faction standing with Preservers got better.

Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse.

Varilis Thornvine takes your hoop and brings it close to his own ear. He nods along with it thoughtfully, as it seemingly tells the Elder Whisperer of your travels.

Varilis Thornvine says," An interesting journey you have taken to get here. Your hoop is excited to experience more, so I shall return it to you. Be sure to hold onto it so it can take in more of your continued story."

You receive Apprentice Hoop of the Listener from Varilis Thornvine.

Varilis Thornvine says, "You will also need to bring this toadstool with you for your next task. We are now being whispered toward a group who lives reclusively among the roots of Faelindral."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Tell me, young Listener, do you know of the Circle of Spores?"

You receive Toadstool Box from Varilis Thornvine.

You say, "What circle of spores?"

Varilis Thornvine says, "They are a cloistered cult of druids who have a strong connection to fungus and mushrooms. If there are any within the Weal who would be able to tell us the source of this strange toadstool, it would be them."

Varilis Thornvine says, "I have safely packed the toadstool within the box I provided you. Deliver it to a member of the Circle of Spores, who seclude themselves beneath Faelindral in Sporehave Karts."

Varilis Thornvine says, "I know not the name of the particular druid who may be able to help us, but the Circle are not unwelcoming of guests. Their experiments on the other hand..."

Varilis Thornvine says, "You should be strong enough to call upon the spirits to conceal yourself. If the Circle's experiments have gone awry, as they are known to, it may be prudent to learn such a spell before departing."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Spirits watch over you, young Listener."

Travel under Faelrindal into the Spore Caves along the stream. If going at night, make sure to invis, or else the sporelings will gank you, then find Sporeweaver Underviel.

BEWARE A NUMBER OF SPORELINGS PATH RIGHT PAST THE NPC, DO NOT RISK CONVERSATION WITHOUT INVIS/HIDE HANDY!!!

Hand in the Toadstool Box.

You gain experience!

Your faction standing with Preservers got better.

Your faction standing with Circle of Spores got better.

Spreweaver Underviel carefully examines the contents of the box you offer him, pursing his lips in thought. He meticulously removes the toadstool before returning the empty box to you.

You receive Empty Box from Sporeweaver Underveil.

Sporeweaver Underveils says, "Hmm... this is quite the interesting specimen that you have brought me, shaman. I can tell at a glance that is has been manipulated by a magical force, not unlike our own myconids."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "Though I could not tell you much more without a thorough examination. Perhaps we could come to an agreement?"

Sporeweaver Underviel looks at you expectantly.

You say, "What agreement?"

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "I am looking to produce a new strain of fungus that is far more robust than previous generations."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "To further my research, I need some components from out in the Weald. If you can gather them for me, I will look further into the origins of this toadstool for you."

Sporeweaver Underviel says, "Does that sound acceptable?"

You say, "It is acceptable."

Sporeweaver Underveil bows his head politely, a faint glimmer reflecting from his shaven scalp.

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "Then we have an agreement. You can use the empty box that you brought the toadstool in as a container. It seems sturdy enough."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "All I require are the scales of green drakelings, along with some wax from wasp workers. Five of each should suffice for my needs."

Sporeweaver Underviel says, "By the time you return with the box filled and sealed, I should have some more answers for you regarding this mysterious toadstool."

Go collect 5 Green Drakeling Scales from a green drakeling, and 5 Wasp Worker Wax from a wasp worker.

Combine 5 stacked scales and 5 stacked wax in the Empty Box to create the Box of Scales and Wax. Then return to our friend Underveil.

Upon handing in the box:

You gain experience!

Your faction standing with Preservers got better.

Your faction standing with Circle of Spores got better.

Sporeweaver Underveil examines the contents of the box with a satisfied nod, retrieving the strange toadstool and exchanging it for the materials you collected. He then returns the box to you.

You receive Resealed Toadstool Box from Sporeweaver Underveil.

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "You return at a most fortuitous moment, young shaman. I have just finished my examination of the toadstool and I must say, the results are quite intriguing."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "You also have my gratitude for your efforts in procuring these components. Drake scales and wax are notoriously resistant to fungus, which shall aid my endeavors to strengthen our strains."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "Though I imagine you must be curious to hear the results?"

You say, "What results?"

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "The toadstool by itself is not so significant; rather, it is the odd hex that seems to be afflicting all of its contained moisture."

Sporeweaver underveil says, "This hexed moisture makes its way into the numerous spores released by the toadstool, and once a great number of these spores are taken into the lungs... well..."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "The victim is afflicted with a terrible malady that assaults the mind directly, causing hallucinations, emotional strain, and potentially even madness."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, " I daresay that whoever conjured such a hex has a sinister imagination. Though, it would appear the moisture is the key to all this, as it is what drips with malice. A malice that feels all too familiar to me..."

Sporeweaver Underveil says, "I hope this was as much help to you as your efforts were to the Circle of Spores. Thank you once more, friend."

sections.title: Part 4 -
sections.text:
Return to Varilis Thornvine and hand him the resealed box.

You gain experience.

Your faction standing with Preservers got better.

Varilis Thornvine says, "Your return was whispered to me, young Listener. As was the conversation you had with the Sporeweaver."

Varilis Thornvine says, "It seems that moisture is the key to what has been ailing the great bears, yes? If our clues are to be the fae and moisture, then there is only one possible direction to look toward next."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Though that direction must wait for now. I must confer with the spirits on this matter, but you have the thanks of the forest, along with my own, for all that you have uncovered."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Take this headdress so that you might be protected from any intrusions into your own mind. It may prove useful, should this path lead us toward those capable of causing madness and grief."

You receive Spirit-Blessed Headdress from Varilis Thornvine.

Varilis Thornvine says, "When you feel you are ready to confront this threat to the Weald, bring me your apprentice hoop while donning the spirit-blessed headdress. I would hear from them both to gauge your capabilities regarding our next task."

Hand Varilis your earring while wearing the new headpiece.

Varilis Thornvine carefully cradles the hoop next to his own ear, closing his eyes and nodding along wordlessly to silent whispers.

(At level 4)

Varilis Thornvine says, "It appears you have more to learn before I can entrust you with your next task, young Listender."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Return and present me your hoop once you have learned how to effectively dispel harmful magics, and the next task is yours."

You receive your items back from Varilis Thornvine.
(At level 8)

Varilis Thornvine carefully cradles the hoop next to his own ear, closing his eyes and nodding along wordlessly to silent whispers. He smiles and presents it back to you.

Varilis Thornvine says,"It appears the spirits vouch for your capabilities, young Listener. As such, I am confident I can entrust you with the next task.".

You receive Apprentice Hoop of the Listener from Varilis Thornvine.

You say, "What next task?"

Varilis Thornvine says, "As you already know, spirits of the Weald are succumbing to a terrible malady of the mind."

Varilis Thornvine says, "From the myconid creatures of the Circle of Spores to the bestial spirits of the great wolf packs, it seems any who settle themselves close to the banks of the river are prone to bouts of inexplicable madness."

Varilis Thornvine says, "This, I believe, is being perpetrated by the naiads of the Whispering Pools."

You say, "What Whispering Pools?"

Varilis Thornvine says, "The naiads have long since been bound to the Whispering Pools. They are forbidden from leaving, due to a pact with the Queen of the Winter Court herself."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Though being bound does not mean the naiads are without their own ambitions."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Many of them yearn to be free of the Whispering Pools, and this latest act of whimsy is likely an attempt to expand their means without breaking the terms of their pact."

Varilis Thornvine says, "If we are to do something to counteract the ploys of the naiads, we must first understand what sort of enchantments they are dispersing into the Weald's waters."

Varilis Thornvine says, "I advise you to seek out Laenyth Windharp of the Lambent Wanderers. She is their tale keeper, and the bards are known to study and even conduct performances that mimic the alluring call of a siren."

Varilis Thornvine says, "If any in Faelindral would know of water nymph enchantments, it would be them. Show her your hoop to present yourself as a Preserver, then glean what you can about the magics of the naiads. Return to me with anything you manage to uncover."

Off we go to the bard guild (Aka the Lambent Lantern)!

You will find our gal on the first floor in the bard side of the lantern. Hand your hoop to Laenyth Windharp.

Laenyth Windharp regards the hoop with a smile before offering it back to you.

Laenyth Windharp says, "Ah, to what do I owe the pleasure of this visit, apprentice? I'm fond of Listeners joining me for a tale. You lot are remarkably attentive to our stories."

Laenyth Windharp says, "Is there anything in particular that you wish to hear about?"

You say, "Naiads."

Laenyth Windharps says, "The naiads? I'm quite familiar with their tale, as young bards are often stricken by their songs... competitively or otherwise."

Laenyth Windharps says, "They're a beautiful people, if not prone to wickedness and uncaring whimsy. Their songs can flow as gently as a stream or crash with the cacophonous roar of a waterfall, as befits their mood."

Laenyth Windharp says, "Do you wish to hear what's known of their Mistress Naelira, or are you more interested in their siren's song?"

You say, "What siren's song?"

Laenyth Windharp says, "The siren's call... it's a popular and powerful technique capable of fully capturing a person's attention. They're also prone to suggestion while captivated, turning a once alluring song into a dangerous one if used with ill intent."

Laenyth Windharp says, "Many of the faerie courts are impressive singers in their own right, though the naiads' sirens occupy a league of their own. Did you know a voice can carry over great distances when delivered across a span of calm water?"

Laenyth Windharp says, "The sirens utilize their affinity with water to naturally enhance their own voices, so a mere conversation can cause one to become enraptured if they're not careful."

Laenyth Windharp says, "Some also believe the naiad sirens are capable of singing into the currents of flowing water, so their voices can reach those downstream. I personally don't believe such a thing is possible... unless you believe the old rumors."

You say, "What old rumors?"

Laenyth Windharp says, "The naiads have remarkable voices, though even with their affinity for water, they cannot sing with their full cadence while submerged in the very pools they call home."

Laenyth Windharp says, "A voice, no matter how strong, would be drowned out by the flow of a river as it crashes against the banks and weaves its way through rock and reed."

Laenyth Windharp says, "However, there were rumors of a technique one could use to protect a song on its journey through a perilous river. Something to enshroud it is a pocket of air, such as... a bubble or river foam."

Laenyth Windharp says, "I've made notes on such a theory before. Now where did I..."

Laenyth Windharp searches through her belongings before a moment of recognition strikes her. She then withdraws a section of leafscroll.

Laenyth Windharp says, "Ah, here they are! These notes cover the methods one might use to enhance a siren's call. You're more than welcome to them, should the Perservers have use of my old theories."

You receive Laenyth's Theories from Laenyth Windharp.

Return to Varilis and hand him the theories.

Varilis Thornvine says, "I see that you do not return empty-handed, young Listener. Let us see what knowledge Laenyth has documented regarding the magic of naiads..."

Varilis Thornvine carefully and slowly peruses Laenyth's notes. His elderly lips purse in interest at some points while frowning at others, accentuating his already weathered features.

Varilis Thornvine says, "Voices carried through bubbles or foam... quite curious, indeed. Could the naiads be sending their very voices through the currents of the river using this method?"

Varilis Thornvine says, "You must investigate this for us, <name>. Your talents should allow you the means to sense magical influences upon the world, if you have studied your scrolls."

Varilis Thornvine says, "I bid you venture out to the very end of the river, furthest from the Whispering Pools, to the crest of the mighty waterfall that spills out into the Twilight Sea."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Use your spell to sense magical flows and determine whether the naiads' enchantments have extended so far out from their domain. Should you discover enchanments at the falls, take a sample of the water using this flask and return it to me."

You receive an Empty Water Flask from Varilis Thornvine.

Run to the place where the river falls into Keeper's Blight (southwest of the cave with the wolves for the dust earlier). Use /inspect water on the north side of the river right before the edge of the river, and you should see a message about the enchantment. Then pick up the flask on your cursor and use /take water. You might need to be using 'Sense Magic' as well. Return to Varilis with the newly filled flask.

sections.title: Part 5 -
sections.text:
Return to Varilis Thronvine and hand him Filled Water Flask

Varilis Thronvine says, "A curious thing, this sample you have brought me. Even while contained, I can hear the intrusive melodies that are bound within."

Varilis Thornvine says, "This is a disturbing revelation. If the naiads have somehow found a way to carry their voices down the span of the entire river, it threatens the very balance of the Weald."

Varilis Thornvine says, "We must take action to purge this enchantment before more minds are drawn into madness."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Take this sigil. young Listener. You will need it to fashion a totem that can be used to cleanse the waters of the naiad's influence. It is but one component of this specific recipe."

You receive Sigil of Purging from Varilis Thornvine.

You say, "What recipe?"

Varilis Thornvine says, "To fashion the totem, you will need to acquire some fine wood for the base. Four timber should be enough. If you have a talent for logging, you may find some in Keeper's Blight."

Varilis Thornvine says, "While in the Blight, you will also need the skins of four serpents that roam the fields. The serpent's flesh is well suited for warding away moisture."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Lastly, you will need something from the river water that is both born from it, but also immune to a siren's song. I believe Selstie Kelp will serve the purpose well."

Varilis Thornvine says," Scour the river's floor here in Evershade for at least two strands of kelp, then fashion everything together along with the sigil of purging at one of the carpentry tables on Traders Terrace.

Varilis Thornvine says, "Worry not if you are unskilled with such labors, the totem need not be a masterpiece. Return to me with your crafted totem, and I shall guide you further."

Go collect 2 Selstie Kelp, 4 Fine Wood, and 4 Bight Serpent Skin.

Combine the 10 items above along with your Sigil of Purging at a carpentry table to create Fashioned Totem of Purging. Then return to Varilis Thornvine and hand Fashioned Totem of Purging to him.

You gain experience!
Your faction standing with Preservers got better.

Varilis Thornvine looks over your work with a pleased, serene smile. He raises the totem into the air and beseeches the spirits of the forest to empower your creation. This time, you begin to hear the murmurings of a response through the boughs of the trees, and your totem takes on weathered appearance.

Varilis Thornvine offers the empowered totem to you.

Varilis Thornvine says, "Take this totem to the top of the falls, which cascade over the Whispering Pools the water nymphs call their home."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Invoke the totem's powers to purge the waters of the enchantment. But be warned, the naiads will not appreciate us denying them their amusement."

Varilis Thornvine says, "If you are challenged, then do what you must to restore balance to the Weald. Should your totem lose its potency, return it to me and I will do my best to empower it once more."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Spirits watch over you, young Listener."

You receive Empowered Totem of Purging from Varilis Thornvine.

sections.title: Part 6 -
sections.text:
(The enemies for this part of the quest con red and yellow at level 8)

Head over to the Kennel Lift and ride it down. Walk east through the ruins and across two bridges, then make an immediate left to the waterfall. Stand at the edge of it and right-click your Empowered Totem of Purging to start the event.

Delugia Coldsong emerges from the waterfall as if stepping through a doorway.

Delugia Coldsong says, "You will not defile our waters with your horrid magics, mortal! Our voices shall spread across all rivers, in the name of Mistress Naelira!!"

Delugia Coldsong (click for fight details) will spawn and immediately start attacking you. She was stuck in the wall when I fought her and I had to move away to get her to out.

Your faction standing with Circle of Spores got better.
Your faction standing with Fossergrim got worse.
Your faction standing with Naelira's Court got worse.
You gain experience!

Delugia Coldsong says, "H-how could you... a mere mortal..."
Delugia Coldsong falls to the ground, her body slowly dissipating back into the waters.

Once you defeat her, loot the Coldstone Shard and return it to Varilis Thornvine.

Varilis Thornvine shivers visibly as you offer him the coldstone, though he refuses to accept it alone.

Varilis Thornvine says, "It seems that you have had to confront a particularly vile spirit, young Listener. Your efforts are already being felt throughout the Weald."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Return to me the expended totem, the coldstone, and your apprentice hoop. I would hear all three of their tales of your triumph this day."

You receive you items back from Varilis Thornvine.

Hand Varilis all 3 items.

You gain experience!
Your faction standing with Preservers got better.
Your faction standing with Naelira's Court got worse.

Varilis Thornvine carefully clutches the coldstone with one hand, while your hoop remains in the other. He brings both items up to either elongated ear and soon begins nodding along with their supposed tales, which you feel you may begin to perceive.

Varilis Thornvine says, "It appears that this Delugia Coldsong was driven by a desire to appease her Mistress Naelira. So much so, that she would risk breaking the pact they made with the fae courts."

Varilis Thornvine says, "It did not matter which minds she was forced to break, so long as her voice could reach out to someone capable of freeing them from their bond. A tragic tale, if also misguided and malevolent."

Varilis Thornvine says, "Already the spirits of the river and those surrounding it sigh out in relief at her passing. You have restored balance to the Weals, and for that I recognize you as an accomplished Listener, Chamois."

Varilis Thornvine offers you a simple leaf pulled from his silvered hair.

Varilis Thornvine says, "Bring this to the Elder Whisperer, Eraeldor Lowmist. He shall already know its meaning."

You receive Weathered Leaf Token from Varilis Thornvine.

Turn around and go in the building. Give your Weathered Leaf Token to Eraeldor Lowmist.

You gain experience!
Your faction standing with Preservers got better.

Eraeldor Lowmist says, "The promising apprentice makes their appearance at last. It was heard, and it is now known."

Eraeldor Lowmist says, "We have you to thank for calming the spirits of the waters and all those who are fed by its life."

Eraeldor Lowmist says, "Only one who truly listens could have heard the cries and comforted the daunted."

Eraeldor Lowmist says, "You are a true preserver of the balance, deserving to bear the symbol of such."

Eraeldor Lowmist says, "My gift to you, Listener Chamois."

Eraeldor Lowmist produces a folded bundle of fine cloth and leaf, offering it to you with a serene smile.

You receive Robes of the Listener from Eraeldor Lowmist.
You receive Hoop of the Listener from Eraeldor Lowmist.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Awakened Spirit Pouch
Dusty Spiritist Tunic
Experience

sections.title: Part 1 - First steps of being a Shaman
sections.text:
Read Hastily Scrawled Note you start with as a new Shaman Character:

On a sheet of parchment, you hastily wrote down the fading vestiges of a disturbing dream, as follows:

I found myself standing in a vast, open field, the sky as golden as the endless wheat around me. The setting sun gave way to an unblinking eye, which blinded me, yet allowed me to see more than I could before. What could it all mean?

Make haste to the Seekers of the Lost Eye, there, they will help you make sense of this unusual dream.

The Seekers are located within Saltbreeze Park, central to the city and right below the Great Guild Hall.

If you're feeling lost out there, remember this:
our sun, Eth, rises in the East and sets to the West, and the Twilight Bay is always to the South. Need help beyond that? Just ask a guard. They'll often be able to assist with directions.

Give 'Hastily Scrawled Note' to Errol Shrewtender.

Errol Shrewtender pauses, taking the note into his hands.

" A strange dream you've had and you've been sent here? Hmmm."

Errol Shrewtender studies the note carefully, before looking up to you.

"Yes, this is quite an unusual dream. However, it is not something to be afraid of."

"You have a gift, <name>."

"You possess the ability to peer into the looming darkness, a power not known by many, and fewer still learn to harness it. Do you wish to harness your power, <name>? It is a grueling path, but one which will bring you insight into the true nature of Eth-ur."

Errol Shrewtender produces a small pouch and tunic, before handing them to you.

"It's not much, but here is your guild tunic, marking you as an Initiate in the Seekers of the Lost Eye. And here is a spirit pouch. I was given one as an initiate myself, many years ago. Bring it to Masoumeh, and she will give you your first task."

You receive Uncured Spirit Pouch from Errol Shrewtender.

You receive Seekers of the Lost Eye Tunic from Errol Shrewtender.

Errol Shrewtender smiles, before turning away, ignoring you.

Stop here to keep the Pouch as a free four slot bag.  Once you do the next step it becomes unusable as a bag.

Give the Uncured Spirt Pouch to Masoumeh Akhtar.

Masoumeh Akhtar looks down at the pouch in your hands, before gasping.

"Oh! You must be <name>, the one with the strange dreams. Yes, welcome to our order!"

Masoumeh Akhtar gives you a warm smile, though something is clearly on the young woman's mind.

"It is custom for all shamans inducted into the order to begin preparations for their Becoming Ritual."

"That pouch of yours contains some very special magic, and with the proper reagents, you can begin to prepare for your ritual."

"You will need to collect some moondew moss, a fire beetle gland, and two chips of bone from an animated undead. Place them inside your pouch and crush them together to combine them, and then bring it back to me."

"If you have any trouble finding any of the items, don't hesitate to ask. Good luck, <name>."

Masoumeh Akhtar smiles at you, bidding farewell.

Collect 2 Bone Chips from skeletons, 1 Fire Beetle Gland from fire beetles, and 1 Moondew Moss. 
The Moondew Moss is found at a well outside the West gate of Night Harbor (during the night cycle).

Finding the Well:

Leave Night Harbor from the West Gate.
Continue walking forward and slightly to the left.
Once you locate the small ruins with the Shifty Gnome, continue further West (towards the green tower in the distance.)
The well is behind a ruined wall nearby to the Shifty Gnome.

Once near the well, type "/look" the well will respond: "You see an old well. Its crumbling exterior betrays its age, and it appears to be as old as the rest of the ruins nearby."

Type "/take moss" and you will receive Moondew Moss.

Single stack those four items into the Uncured Spirit Pouch, it will turn into Shaman's Fiery Base.

Turn into Masoumeh Akhtar.

"Oh! Wonderful, it looks like you've successfully made the base for your ritual."

Masoumeh Akhtar smiles at you fondly.

"I remember when I was preparing for my ritual... anyhow, there's a little something else that needs to be done before the base is ready."

Masoumeh Akhtar takes out a small bottle, uncorking it and letting out a few drops of a strange, crimson liquid. Upon contact with the acidic base, it begins to foam, and she hands your pouch back to you. You notice the leather is somehow sturdier because of the trial it has just endured.

You receive Cured Spirit Pouch from Masoumeh Akhtar.

"Take this pouch over to my father, Eskander. He will tell you what to do next. Good luck, initiate. May the spirits bless you.

Masoumeh Akhtar bows towards you respectfully.

sections.title: Part 2 - Craft the Potion
sections.text:
Requires Level 4

Go two levels upstairs and find Eskander Akhtar.

At level 4 you can hand him the Cured Spirit Pouch and continue the quest.

Eskander Ahktar says, "...Ah, a new initiate, I see. You need a task from me?"

Eskander Akhtar frowns, before suddenly letting out an exasperated sigh.

Eskander Akhtar says, "Very well. Harvallen Root, gather one and bring it back to me."

Eskander Akhtar waves his hand dismissively turning his gaze back to the city.

Harvallen Root drops off An ashira shaman in Shaded Dunes. They do not drop in Sungreet Strand, but can also be obtained from A shady peddler in the Night Market at night or by saying "root" to Herbmonger Nabiah and completing her task.

Hand him the Harvallen Root and he responds (this step may not be necessary):

Eskander Akhtar says, "You have the root? Good, now hand me your pouch as well."

You receive your items back from Eskander Akhtar.

Hand the Harvallen Root and Cured Spirit Pouch to him together and you receive Purified Entheogenic Powder and he responds:

Eskander Ahktar says, "Hm, you've done well initiate. It has been ground to a powder and purified. You are now almost ready for your Becoming Ritual. There are a few more components needed."
Eskander Akhtar says, "I'll keep your pouch for now and prepare it for the Becoming Ritual."
Eskander Akhtar says, "The ritual is a harrowing experience, and I am ill to suggest it to an unseasoned shaman such as yourself."
Eskander Akhtar says, "If you believe yourself ready, bring your powder back to me and we'll discuss next steps."

Requires Level 8

At level 8 hand him the Purified Entheogenic Powder and he responds;

Eskander Akhtar says, "Ah yes. The final step of your becoming ritual."
Eskander Akhtar crosses his arms.
Eskander Akhtar says, "I suppose you're ready. Take your powder to Errol, he will tell you what to do next."
Eskander Akhtar says, "What are you standing around for? Begone already!"

Hand the Purified Entheogenic Powder to Errol Shrewtender and he responds:

Errol Shrewtender Takes your powder from you, holding it in his hands gingerly. He unfolds the package, taking a sniff. After a moment, he nods.

Errol Shrewtender says, "This is good. Very good, I expect nothing less from Eskander's teachings."
Errol Shrewtender takes a breath, giving you a single nod.
Errol Shrewtender says, "Very well."
Errol Shrewtender says, "For your final task, you must prepare the last of the materials needed for your Becoming Ritual."

Errol Shrewtender closes his eyes, taking another deep breath.

Errol Shrewtender says, "Your Becoming Ritual signifies the final rite of passage, and completes the last step of your initiation. However, the materials for the ritual are difficult to come by, and you will face many dangers.
Errol Shrewtender says, "We need you to acquire a Duskglow pod, grave dust, and a deepgloom mushroom." Errol Shrewtender says, "Masoumeh can help you find those, ask her for the details."

Errol Shrewtender fishes around in his pocket.

You receive Order for Selenite from Errol Shrewtender.

Errol Shrewtender says, "Take this order to her, we need this fulfilled for the last material, the selenite crystal powder."
Errol Shrewtender says, "Once you have acquired all the ingredients, return them all to me and I will mix them for you."
Errol Shrewtender says, "Good luck!"

You receive your items back from Eskander Akhtar.

Hand the Order of Selenite to Masoumeh Akhtar (next to Errol Shrewtender) and she responds:

Masoumeh Akhtar takes the note from you.

Masoumeh Akhtar says, "Ah! Yes, please go speak with Foreman Stonehammer at the old Quarry in Sungreet Strand. He can provide you with the selenite powder."

Masoumeh Akhtar purses her lips.

Masoumeh Akhtar says, "He's kind of an ass, though, so if he gives you a hard time..."

Masoumeh Akhtar sighs.

Masoumeh Akhtar says "Just do what he asks."

You receive your items back from Eskander Akhtar.

Asking Masoumeh Akhtar about the ingredients Errol Shrewtender mentioned  gives clues to their whereabouts.

You say, "duskglow pod"

Masoumeh Akhtar says, "Duskglow pods are aquatic plants that thrive in heat, they can be found in the Shaded Dunes, but only at night. You should look for them where there's an oasis with glowing water and nobody around to disturb them."

You say, "grave dust"

Masoumeh Akhtar says, "Grave Dust... you can find something like that deep in the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane."

Masoumeh Akhtar looks over to you.

Masoumeh Akhtar says, "Please be careful. It is a dangerous place. I would look for the dust in a room where revered skeletons are interred."
Masoumeh Akhtar says, "Good luck!"

You say, "deepgloom mushroom"

Masoumeh Akhtar says, "The Ashira are known for harvesting the deepgloom mushroom deep in Tel Ekir, but I can't imagine them wanting to trade it to you..."
Masoumeh Akhtar says, "They enjoy a lot of humidity, maybe they'd sprout next to a waterfall?"

Details:

Duskglow Pod (say /take pod at the oasis north of the Caves of Irem (There WAS NOT a sound of a bard song or chimes))  Can't be collected before lvl 8

Deepgloom Mushroom (say /take Mushroom in the cave behind the waterfall (There is a sound of a bard song or chimes))

Grave Dust (say /take dust in one of the side cutouts leading up to the bone construct (There is a sound of a bard song or chimes))

Foreman Stonehammer

Location Details:

In Sungreet Strand, at the Quarry, on a platform in the North west corner, with Sister Elara.

Foreman Stonehammer says, "Aye, I see ya there traveler. What buisness do ya have at the quarry? Make it quick, I don't have all day."

Pass him the Order for Selenite

Foreman Stonehammer says, "I'd be glad t' give ya yer powder... but first ya gotta do somethin' for me."
Foreman Stonehammer says, "One of those damn goblin sneaks made off with my favorite canteen! If ya get it back for me, I'll give ya yer powder."
Foreman Stonehammer says, "Oh, don't look at me like that! Yer lucky I'm even handin' it over!"

Battered Canteen Can be found as a drop from a goblin sneak nearby (level 8-10)

Handing in just the Battered Canteen:

Foreman Stonehammer snatches the canteen from your hands.
Foreman Stonehammer says, "Wait a sec! Didn't you have an order to give me?"

Handing in the Battered Canteen and the Order for Selenite:

Foreman Stonehammer snatches the canteen from your hands while the order falls to the ground.
Foreman Stonehammer says, "Hot damn! You just saved me from gettin' an earful from the missus!"
Foreman Stonehammer fishes through his pockets for a moment, discarding a wad of lint, an unidentifiable hairball, and a few pieces of paper. Finally, he retreives a small cloth bag and wipes away a greasy substance from it onto his sleeve.
Foreman Stonehammer says, "Here ya go! No takebacks!"
Foreman Stonehammer grins broadly.

You gain experience!!

You receive Powdered Selenite from Foreman Stonehammer

Once you've acquired all the ingredients hand them back to Errol Shrewtender and he responds:

Errol Shrewtender says, "This is very good progress."

Errol Shrewtender combines the material in a pouch, creating a slurry of sorts.

Errol Shrewtender says, "Here, take the slurry I just made out of the ingredients you gave me and mix it inside your pouch with the purified powder, this'll be the base of your elixir."

Errol Shrewtender shakes his head, his expression sullen.

Errol Shrewtender says, "Unfortunately, there isn't anything we can do beyond this for now."
Errol Shrewtender says, "Not until we get our Ancient Urn back that is. It's been a part of the guild since before it's founding, you see, and it's necessary for the final preparation step of your Becoming Ritual."
Errol Shrewtender says, "Once you feel ready, show me or Masoumeh your elixir and we will share more details with you."

You gain experience!!

You receive Shimmering Slurry and Blessed Spirit Pouch.

Combine: Shimmering Slurry and Purified Entheogenic Powder inside the Blessed Spirit Pouch to create Muddy Elixir of Becoming

sections.title: Part 3 - Retrieve the Urn
sections.text:
Hand Muddy Elixir of Becoming to Errol Shrewtender

Errol Shrewtender says, "To move forward with the Becoming Ritual, we must find the urn. Our members have been searching desperately for it, investigating thieves and the like, but I have a feeling you might have better luck."
Errol Shrewtender says, "Please speak to Masoumeh and ask her about the urn, she should have further details."

Hand Muddy Elixir of Becoming to Masoumeh Akhtar

Masoumeh Akhtar says, "Oh, yes, you have the elixir but our ancient urn is gone..."

Masoumeh Akhtar presses her fingers together, fidgeting slightly.

Masoumeh Akhtar says, "It was unfortunately stolen a few nights ago. Old Mother Roshan overheard the name of one of the thieves - a graverobber by the name of 'Ariblast' - but that is all we have to go on. Perhaps if you poked around in the yards surrounding the city, you might be able to find out more."

Masoumeh Akhtar frowns.

Masoumeh Akhtar says, "I wish I had more to go on... Good luck."

Spoiler Details:

Ariblast the Wicked in Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane drops the Ancient Painted Urn

Handing Errol Shrewtender just the Ancient Painted Urn.

Errol Shrewtender holds the urn joyfully, as a smile emerges on his lips.

Errol Shrewtender says, "You got it back! We owe you a great debt!"

Errol Shrewtender bows to you.

Errol Shrewtender says, "I require the elixir as well. Please hand me both items and I will proceed."

Handing Errol Shrewtender the Ancient Painted Urn and the Muddy Elixir of Becoming.

Errol Shrewtender holds the urn joyfully, as a smile emerges on his lips.

Errol Shrewtender says, "Most excellent indeed! Now we can proceed with the ritual."

Errol Shrewtender carefully places the urn on the ground and pours the elixir into it. He begins to mutter what sounds like a hymn, and the faintest tingle runs up your spine.
Errol Shrewtender hands the elixir back to you with a beaming smile.

Errol Shrewtender says, "Now you're almost ready to walk your waking dream."
Errol Shrewtender says, "The final step involves your elixir and your pouch. Hand them to me, and I will finalize the ritual preparations!"

You receive Bubbling Elixir of Becoming from Errol Shrewtender.

Handing Errol Shrewtender the Blessed Spirit Pouch and the Bubbling Elixir of Becoming.

Errol Shrewtender pours a mysterious liquid onto the spirit pouch, which flows down it and drips into the eilxir.

Errol Shrewtender says, "Now your pouch is cleansed and your elixir is purified!"

Errol Shrewtender smiles at you warmly.

Errol Shrewtender says, "Walk your waking dream by drinking the elixir, then the Becoming Ritual will be complete! Don't be scared now... stand proud and tall!"

You receive Awakened Spirit Pouch from Errol Shrewtender.

You receive Purified Elixir of Becoming from Errol Shrewtender.

You gain experience!!
Your faction standing wiht the Seekers of the Lost Eye got better.

Upon consuming the Purified Elixir of Becoming

A burning surge floods your chest. Fear, fire, and the weight of past failures crash over you. It feels as though you are teetering on the edge of an abyss, consumed by everything you have tried to forget.

A voice stirs from within, urging you not to be afraid. Pain and failure are your teachers. You push forward, and the haze lifts. Your feet move again, and the salty sea breeze fills your nostrils.

Entering Shaded Dunes.

Loading, please wait...

You have entered Shaded Dunes.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Shredded Cloak
Petrified Undercap Stem
Mycelial Staff
Mycelial Spear
Experience

sections.title: Part 1 - First steps as a Rot of Gorm Shaman
sections.text:
Read Moldy Note you start with as a new Shaman Character:

It is time for you to accept the gifts of the 
Rotfather.

Come to the Rotten Hollow to learn the ways of 
plague and pestilence. Seek the Rot of Gorm in the 
cavern west of the palace.

                                       Picci M.

Give 'Moldy Note' to Picci Manifold.

You gain experience!

Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better.

The Rotfather beckons and here you are. His blessing, your gift, is a kindness. What life is worth living without decay and death? You and I are bound to this fate. Bear this drape in his honor.

You recieve Shredded Cloak from Picci Manifold.

sections.title: Part 2 - Uncovering the blight
sections.text:
Hail, Picci Manifold

Picci Manifold says, "There are a great many problems to solve before the Rotfather takes us. Will you aid me with my research?"

You say "research"

Picci Manifold says, "The flora and fauna of the Deep are connected in ways that cannot be easily perceived. The myconids are of great interest to me, you see. They may hold the key to spreading the Rotfather's joy to the farthest reaches of Eth-ur, even into lowest abyss."

Picci Manifold says, "I need you to conduct an experiment."

You say "experiment"

Picci Manifold says, "Take this balm and look for the little myconids withing this cavern. The sporlings. Use it on the sickly ones. It is kind of a medicine."

Picci Manifold says, "Return to me with four spore samples from these myconids. If you run out, return the empty jar to me and I will replenish it."

You receive Putrid Fungal Balm from Picci Manifold.

Use the Putrid Fungal Balm (4/4) on a sickly undercap. 
They will attack you. 
Loot Blightspores. 
Return 4 Blightspores to Picci Manifold

Picci Manifold says, "How curious. The spores are more resilient than I expected. A blight is spreading among the myconids, but it is not our doing. We will need to study this further if we are to shape the undercaps to our purpose. False plagues are not to be tolerated."

Picci Manifold frowns.

You receive Petrified Undercap Stem from Picci Manifold.

sections.title: Part 3 - Gather the Specimens
sections.text:
Requires Level 5

--Step 1--

You say, "Hail, Picci Manifold"

Picci Manifold says, "Your spear is unfinished, fledgling. Will you help me continue my research?"

You say, "yes"

Picci Manifold says, "The myconids have a unique connection with the natural flora of the Deep. Like their fungal cousins, they are tethered together. They feel, think, act in unison."

Picci Manifold says, "The blightspores we have collected only tell us that something is changing, but we need to look deeper. Fill this sack with six mycelium roots from mature undercap specimens. Do this, and I will grant you the mycelium bonding threads you need to fashion your plaguespear."

You receive Mycelium Sack from Picci Manifold.

Gather Undercap Mycelium Root from undercap mushrooms and combine them in the Mycelium Sack.

Return to Picci Manifold.

You say, "Hail, Picci Manifold"

Picci Manifold says, "Have you found the mycelium roots I asked for, shaman?"

Give the Full Mycelium Sack to Picci Manifold.

You gain experience!

Your faction with Rot of Gorm got better

Picci Manifold says, "Magnificent. I can learn much from these. Undercap mycelia have special bonding properties. Take this refined mycelial thread. You will need it to assemble your spear."

You receive Mycelial Bonding Thread from Picci Manifold

Picci Manifold says, "Wrap the mycelial threads around your shaman's staff. They should form a strong, living bond."

Right click the thread, it will transform your Petrified Undercap Stem into a Mycelial Staff.

--Step 2--

You say, "Hail, Picci Manifold."

Picci Manifold says, "Your spear remains unfinished, (your name). Help me with one for task and I will provide the spearhead you need."

You say, "What task?"

Picci Manifold says, "For all the myconids have in common with ordinary fungi, they are unique. They are individual. I need the preserved brain of an infected myconid. No lesser specimens will suffice. You must find a myconid whose entire being has been consumed by this blight."

Picci Manifold says, "Place the brain in this jar. It must be submerged in embalming fluid."

You receive Specimen Jar from Picci Manifold.

Take a hunting party out of the North Gate and travel East and find the tunnel that leads to a blight consumed mushroom patch.

Collect the Blightspore Brain from a mindless blightspore, semi-rare spawn. This item is NO RENT.

Purchase Embalming Fluid from Telar Nur'gta in the Underdocks.

Combine the Blightspore Brain and the Embalming Fluid in the Specimen Jar to create the Preserved Specimen.

Return the Preserved Specimen to Picci Manifold.

You gain experience!

Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better.

Picci Manifold says, "Splendid, most splendid. What a peculiar sample it is! I will begin my experiments right away."

Picci Manifold says, "Oh, yes. I almost forgot. You'll be needing this to assemble your spear. This spearhead was carved from the remains of a massive beetle. Go now, (your name). Spread his gifts!"

You receive Jagged Chitin Spearhead from Picci Manifold.

Right-click the Jagged Chitin Spearhead to attach the spearhead.

You Receive Mycelial Spear.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Locate Polietta Two-tone, who spawns in Evershade Weald during the day up on the hill near the Fae Guardians.

You say, "Hail, Polietta Two-tone."

Polietta Two-tone says, "Warm days to you, large-large one! What brings you-you to the toadstool of Polietta? Are you seeking some pixie-pixie glitter, yes-yes?"

You say, "Pixie-pixie glitter?"

Polietta Two-tone says, "Yes-yes! Polietta does have-have much glitter to spare, if one is willing-willing to perform for her a simple favor-favor!"

You say, "You say, "What favor-favor?"

Polietta Two-tone says, "The large-large one has seen the many-many-eyed ones skittering up and down the tree-trees of late, yes-yes?"

Polietta Two-tone says, "Widows I hear-hear them being called, yet Polietta has never-never seen a single husband. The eyes, though! Polietta has-has seen the eyes."

Polietta Two-tone says, "Eight eyes is simply too-too many, I say-say! Proper tings have two-two eyes, one-by-one and not four-by-four!"

Polietta Two-tone says, "You'll bring-bring back to Polietta six of these eye-eyes, so that they're properly down to two-two like things should be-be!"

Polietta Two-tone says, "Six eyes for glitter-glitter is a fair and good trade-trade. No more, no less-less. No hatchling eyes, either! The bigger-bigger ones are best."

Hunt a black widow and an elder widow until you have collected 6 x Widow Eye.

Hand 6 x Widow Eye to Polietta Two-tone.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Court of Summer got better.

Your faction standing with Court of Winter got worse.

Polietta Two-tone says, "Oh, how lovely-lovely! Eight eyes down to two-two, just how things should be-be."

Polietta Two-tone says, "Many thanks-thanks for your favor, large-large one. Here's some of Polietta's famed glitter-glitter!"

You receive Pixie Glitter from Polietta Two-tone.

Pixie Glitter is used for Bard Starter Quest (Faelindral).

sections.text: Icon of the Matswar

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
A priest of the Matswar is located at the Temple of the Matswar, which is in The Necropolis of Night Harbor.

You say, "Hail, a priest of the Matswar."

a priest of the Matswar says, "Hail, friend. I am but a humble priest of the Matswar, offering service in his name."

a priest of the Matswar says, "With the Matswar's blessing, I am able to retrieve long-lost corporeal forms from his realm."

a priest of the Matswar says, "Shall I call forth your expired corpse, or do you require some other assistance?"

You say, "What other assistance can you provide?"

a priest of the Matswar says, "I am able to bind your soul to this location and honor the exchange of icons from other temples."

You say, "Icons?"

a priest of the Matswar says, "Many priests will trade icons of their gods in exchange for offerings. These icons may be exchanged for various services."

a priest of the Matswar says, "For example, if you were to take an icon of the Matswar to the Temple of Relle, the priest there would bind your soul to their temple in exchange."

You say, "Bind my soul?"

a priest of the Matswar says, "Once bound to a location, the Matswar will safely guide your soul there should it depart from your body."

a priest of the Matswar says, "If you would like me to bind your soul, I must first ask that you bring me an offering. A stack of bone chips will suffice."

a priest of the Matswar says, "In return, I will exchange the offering for an icon of the Matswar. The icon can be exchanged at any temple to bind your soul there."

Collect 20 bone chips from rotting skeletons found throughout Night Harbor, then return to a priest of the Matswar and hand them in.

a priest of the Matswar says, "Your gift honors our temple and pleases the Matswar. Take this icon in exchange for your service."

You receive Icon of the Matswar from a priest of the Matswar.

This quest is repeatable.

sections.title: Intro
sections.text:
Speak to a master blacksmith in Night Harbor, who only appears at night (despawns at 6 AM in-game time).

You say, "Hail, a master blacksmith."

a master blacksmith says, "Good evening to you, <player>. I can tell by those shoulders that you've swung y our fair share of smithing hammers. Perhaps you'd like to help me with an experiment?"

You say, "What experiment?"

a master blacksmith says, "During the day, I've been studying the origins of magically reinforced metals, meeting with the local enchanters, and perusing the library in Sageside."
a master blacksmith says, "Well, perusing as much as I'm allowed to, seeing as I'm not enrolled there."
a master blacksmith says, "Based on what I've managed to learn, it seems that most enchantments can be strengthened if the caster imbues a portion of their own essence into the metal itself."
a master blacksmith says, "That got me thinking of those recently discovered ruins..."

You say, "What recently discovered ruins?"

a master blacksmith says, "Wormsfood? Wurmsbite? Something like that. Either way, I've heard there are some powerful spirits within those ruins!"
a master blacksmith says, "Seeing as they must have been there for hundreds of years, I often wonder what I could do with the spiritual essence of such timeless foes."
a master blacksmith says, "If you find yourself within that tomb of... Wordsthane, I'd be grateful if you'd let me borrow a small portion of any spiritual essence you come across."

Go to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane and retrieve Spectral Essence

sections.title: Part 1: Spectral Bar
sections.text:
Hand in the Spectral Essence to a master blacksmith.

a master blacksmith says, "You actually found some! You've my gratitude, <player>. Now, let's see what we're able to accomplish with this lingering soul..."
a master blacksmith says, "Oh, now that is a surprise! The copper has hardened considerably. This essence is truly potent, <player>. I feel like you could make some powerful equipment using this method."
a master blacksmith says, "Here, take the remaining essence. Why don't you give it a try yourself?"
a master blacksmith says, "See if you can fashion a bar using the essence, some enchanted copper, and flux. Show me the results of your handicraft."

Go to a smelter, and use one Enchanted Copper Bars, one Spectral Essence, and one Flux to craft the Spectral Bars.
Hand in the Spectral Bar

a master blacksmith says, "I'd call that a resounding success, wouldn't you, <player>?"
a master blacksmith says, "Something like this is quite special, and I'd be remiss to let you fashion something out of it using crude leathers or cheap padding."
a master blacksmith says, "You should speak to some of the other master artisans in the city and see if they have any ideas for high-grade components that would complement this new alloy."
a master blacksmith says, "You'd do well to inquire about particularly sturdy leather for the straps, and some high-quality cloth for any interior padding."
a master blacksmith says, "Once you've found suitable components, see about fashioning a breastplate from this special alloy. Only the most protective of pieces should be used for something so rare, don't you agree?"
a master blacksmith says, "Take care now, <player>, and may Sorophal's spark illuminate your craft."

sections.title: Part 2: Sturdy Leather Straps
sections.text:
Speak to Leatherworking Trainer.

You say, "I'm looking for sturdy leather."

Leatherworking Trainer says, "You're looking for particularly sturdy leather? Hmm... Well, of all Szuur's beasts, I'd say the crocodiles have the sturdiest hides in the area."

you say, "nasty brute?"

Leatherworking Trainer says, "Though, there's one especially nasty brute with a hide ten times as thick as the others!"
Leatherworking Trainer says, "Ol' Chompers, they call it. Last I heard, it wanders the beaches of the Shaded Dunes, taking a bite out of anything it sees. Though, I'd hate to work a hide like that without the proper treatment."

You say, "What proper treatment?"

Leatherworking Trainer says, "That's a question for the tanner. Chompers' hide is sure to make some quality leather, but I'd show it to them first before you try and trim it down to size."
Leatherworking Trainer says, "...That is, assuming you actually manage to bring down the beast!"

Go hunt Chompers in Shaded Dunes. Loot Chomper's Hide.
Hand in Chomper's Hide to Tanning Trainer.

Tanning Trainer says, "Chompers' hide! You actually managed to bring it down? I'm impressed, <player>!"
Tanning Trainer says, "Look at this hue! The thickness of the scales is unlike anything I've seen. You would need a very potent solution in order to treat a hide like this properly."

You say, "What potent solution?"

Tanning Trainer says, "Hmm, something of this size and quality would need to use alum. It's derived from alunite ore, so you would need to find an alchemist capable of breaking it down for you."
Tanning Trainer says, "Or you could always do so yourself, if you've the skill. Some alum combined with resin would yield a powerful enough solution to treat something this exquisite."

In a mortar and pestle, combine two Alunite Ore to make Alum. 

In a cauldron, combine 5 Alum and 5 Resin to make Alum Solution (Alchemy, Trivial: 25)

Combine Chomper's Hide and Alum Solution in a tanner to create Hardened Crocodile Leather (Tanning, Trivial: < 55)

Hand Hardened Crocodile Leather to Tanning Trainer

Tanning Trainer says, "By the grace of Sorophal, what an impressive piece of leather you've managed to get hold of!"
Tanning Trainer says, "A skilled leatherworker could use this to create components of very high quality. They'd be highly sought after by the smiths in the market, that's for certain!"

Put the Hardened Crocodile Leather in a Leatherworking Kit crafting 3 Hardened Crocodile Leather Straps(Leatherworking, Trivial: < 80)

sections.title: Part 3: High Quality Padding
sections.text:
Go speak to Master Tailor Sansha near the North Gate.

Master Tailor Sansha says, "Greetings, friend. Have you come to practice your weaves?"
You say, "Yes"

Master Tailor Sansha says, "A coarse plant-based thread would clash terribly with this fine silk, so it would be ideal to find a material of similar origin for the stitching."
Master Tailor Sansha says, "I have heard that the farmers in the Strand use lesser spider silks for many of their fabrics. Perhaps a suitable thread could be made from common silks found in that area. You will have to determine that for yourself, however."
Master Tailor Sansha says, "At the very least, I would be sure to have confidence in your skills before attempting such a project. Butchering such fine fabric would be simply heartbreaking, after all!"

You say, "I am looking for high quality cloth."

Master Tailor Sansha says, "I have received a number of high-quality silks from adventurers in the past. If I recall, they said that they found them in a Tel Saman crypt, out in the Shaded Dunes."
Master Tailor Sansha says, "What they brought me was clearly from the smaller arachnids, but I cannot help but wonder what the matriarch of such a brood is capable of weaving."
Master Tailor Sansha says, "Typically, the largest of the spiders produce the finest and sturdiest threads. I would love to see an example one day."

Go to Infested Crypt in Shaded Dunes and kill a crypt broodmother to loot Dreadweave Silk.

Hand in Dreadweave Silk to Master Tailor Sansha.

Master Tailor Sansha says, "Oh, what a wonderfully robust weave! One could certainly use such silk to create a most comfortable material, resistant to wear and stains."
Master Tailor Sansha says, "To speak nothing of its breathability and moisture-wicking properties! These are highly sought-after traits for clothing hear in Szuur."
Master Tailor Sansha says, "Even the blacksmiths would adore such silk for padding their heavy armor. Though, it may require something different to hold a proper weave."

(Part 3 to be continued)

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read Torn Note you start with as a new Spellblade character:

Seek out Jaffar Jhaym in the Spellbinders Spire. It is located in Night Harbor's northeastern district of Sageside. You can often find him in the Spire's observatory.

You will need to use the translocation devices below the wizards' tower to reach the academy grounds. Don't be alarmed.

Your interest in advancement as a Spellblade is well served by Master Jhaym's tutelage. He is both quite accomplished and well regarded within Night Harbor.

Good luck!

Give Torn Note to Jaffar Jhaym.

You gain experience!!

Jaffar Jhaym examines your note and then smiles broadly at you.

Jaffar Jhaym says, "Very well met! Welcome to the Spellbinders Spire!"

Jaffar Jhaym says, "While I will not be training you myself, I'm always excited to meet one of our new Spellblades!"

Jaffar Jhaym says, "I am sure we ill speak more in the days to come, but for now you will be under the tutelage of Master Njau Hansou. You likely passed him in the training yard on your way up."

Jaffar Jhaym says, "Njau trains the academy's Spellblades and Petra Gyle trains the Inquisitors."

You receive Torn Note from Jaffar Jhaym.

Jaffar Jhaym says, "Take Njau the note you just showed me, and he'll know what to do from there."

Jaffar Jhaym bows slightly and smiles at you again.

Give Torn Note to Njau Hansou.

Njau Hansou takes the note and nods at you in a welcoming manner.

Njau Hansou says, "I take it you've spoken to Jaffar already. Wonderful! Let us start then."

Njau Hansou says, "We will test your proficiency with the most basic infusion of your weapon, that of Flameburst. Though, this task will serve several purposes."

Njau Hansou says, "As you likely know, we at the Spire investigate the misuse of magic in Night Harbor. But there is also a form of Corruption at play in this entire region. Of this, we do wish to learn more."

Njau Hansou says, "Take this bag. Fill it with the remains of the undead you find just outside the city's walls and then seal it. But take care to bring us only the remains which bear the markings left by your weapon's infusion."

You receive Njau's Bone Bag from Njau Hansou.'

Njau Hansou gives you a brief nodding bow.

Kill skeletons outside the gates of Night Harbor for Scorched Skeletal Remains.

NOTE: You must deal fire damage through Singe or your Infuse Weapon: Flameburst proc in order for the Scorched Skeletal Remains to drop.

Combine 6 Scorched Skeletal Remains within the Njau's Bone Bag to acquire the Bag of Scorched Bones

Give the Bag of Scorched Bones to Njau Hansou

You gain experience!!

Njau Hansou nods in an appreciative manner, while looking into the bag.

Njau Hansou says, "This is excellent work. I can tell that we have nothing to worry about with regards to your proficiency with a blade. You are a welcome addition to our ranks."

Njau Hansou says, "Please deliver the bag to Buckmarr in the Concourse of Souls. You will find it in the Necropolis District to the west of here. Just look for the ominous green glow."

Njau Hansou smiles.

Njau Hansou says, "Buckmarr can be irritating, but I trust him. So, please bring me any updates he may have for us."

You receive Bag of Scorched Bones from Njau Hansou.

Give the Bag of Scorched Bones to Buckmarr Gorstagg

You gain experience!!

Buckmarr Gorstagg takes the bag from you and looks into it, and at you.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Well, these are interesting scorch marks. But, I guess that's what you people are in the habit of doing. Through, I do find it interesting that both of your guilds are in the business of keeping magical things in check for the city, yet take such wildly different approaches."

Buckmarr Gorstagg pauses for a moment, appearing to think.

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "If the council would put me in charge of running things, I'd likely have a much more efficient solution to dealing with the use of magic, etcetera, etcetera. But... I'm too busy for that anyway."

Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Speaking of... please take this research back to Njau. He's bound to be impressed by my conclusions. And do not let that nosy librarian see it. He's a pest."

You receive Buckmarr's Research from Buckmarr Gorstagg.

Give Buckmarr's Research to Njau Hansou

You gain experience!!

Njau Hansou opens the scroll and quick reads over it, pausing a moment to quickly glance around.

Njau Hansou says, "Thank you for bringing me this."

Njau Hansou says, "Your next tasks will work in support of Petra's Inquisitors. They have been assigned to investigate the activities of a group of smuggler's at a camp far west of here, along the shores of Shaded Dunes."

Njau Hansou says, "Njau Hansou says, "if you observe any of her trainees doing anything out of the ordinary, please report it directly to me. And do not speak to anyone else of this."

Njau Hansou says, "You will be there for legitimate reasons. Engage the smugglers cautiously, but aggressively. Use overwhelming violence in every engagement."

Njau Hansou says, "I believe them to have a logbook in their possession. Please return it to me intact."

Njau Hansou says, "Are you ready to learn of your other tasks?"

I did not take any notes or screenshots on exactly what the items are called below.  If anyone can get those details please edit them below. *added correct damaged logbook name

Kill an ashira raider in Shaded Dunes and loot missing logbook pages 1-6

Kill Toma  the Two-Faced in Shaded Dunes and loot *Smuggler's Damaged Logbook

NOTE:The smuggler's camp can be found on the far South-West side of Shaded Dunes. Follow the water to a small river and it's across the river.
At night the smugglers despawn/respawn as wererats.
The logbook is a 6-slot container
Combine the six logbook pages in *Smuggler's Damaged Logbook to create *Smuggler's Logbook

Return the Smuggler's Logbook to Njau Hansou

You gain experience!!

Njau Hansou says, “This is fantastic work.  It is interesting that the Ashira were only able to escape with a few pages.  Though, perhaps that is all they were looking for.  We will focus on what is said on those pages when we analyze this.”

Njau Hansou says, “If we find the Ashira knowingly took those specific pages, then that may also give credence to the idea that they are a more intelligent race than we’ve assumed.”

Njau Hansou says, “I may have to explore that idea more later.”

Njau Hansou says, “For now, take this.  The wand I just handed you is a Wand of Spectral Sharding.  Stow it somewhere safe and ask me about it, and I will tell you how it is to be used in your next assignment.”

You receive Wand of Spectral Sharding from Njau Hansou.

You have to ask Njau about the wand to get the next dialogue.  This may be an optional step

Njau Hansou says, “Great.  The wand is to be used against four specific ghosts found within the depths of the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane, which is located at the excavation site just west of the city gates.”

Njau Hansou says, “While engaged with these ghosts, you can use the wand to crystallize some of their spectral essence.  This is essentially trapping a tangible piece of them in our Material Plane for use in analysis.”

Njau Hansou says, “Bring me a shard from each of the following ghosts - High Marshal Fionna, Lieutenant Gregan Snyde, Jakob Geffrey, and Timmon Bell.  Return their spectral essences to me along with the wand I just gave you.”

Njau Hansou says, “Do take care.  Little is known about the tomb, and it is very dangerous.  Do not go alone.”

Loot Crystallized Shard's from High Marshal Fionna, Lieutenant Gregan Snyde, Jakob Geffrey and Timmon Bell in Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane

NOTE:You have to click each ghost with the Wand of Spectral Sharding in order to get the Crystallized Shard to drop

Return the four Crystallized Shard and the Wand of Spectral Sharding to Njau Hansou

You gain experience!!

Njau Hansou says, “Your work has been extraordinary.  We will send these shards to be analyzed immediately.”

Njau Hansou says, “For now, please take some time to recover from your adventures.  Go into the city and explore.  Enjoy some food and drink.  Perhaps watch a performance from the Azure Veils.”

Njau Hansou says, “Take this for your efforts.  We will speak again soon.”

You receive Spellbinders Blade Talisman from Njau Hansou.

Return the Smuggler's Logbook to Njau Hansou

You gain experience!!

Njau Hansou says, “This is fantastic work.  It is interesting that the Ashira were only able to escape with a few pages.  Though, perhaps that is all they were looking for.  We will focus on what is said on those pages when we analyze this.”

Njau Hansou says, “If we find the Ashira knowingly took those specific pages, then that may also give credence to the idea that they are a more intelligent race than we’ve assumed.”

Njau Hansou says, “I may have to explore that idea more later.”

Njau Hansou says, “For now, take this.  The wand I just handed you is a Wand of Spectral Sharding.  Stow it somewhere safe and ask me about it, and I will tell you how it is to be used in your next assignment.”

You receive Wand of Spectral Sharding from Njau Hansou.

You have to ask Njau about the wand to get the next dialogue.  This may be an optional step

Njau Hansou says, “Great.  The wand is to be used against four specific ghosts found within the depths of the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane, which is located at the excavation site just west of the city gates.”

Njau Hansou says, “While engaged with these ghosts, you can use the wand to crystallize some of their spectral essence.  This is essentially trapping a tangible piece of them in our Material Plane for use in analysis.”

Njau Hansou says, “Bring me a shard from each of the following ghosts - High Marshal Fionna, Lieutenant Gregan Snyde, Jakob Geffrey, and Timmon Bell.  Return their spectral essences to me along with the wand I just gave you.”

Njau Hansou says, “Do take care.  Little is known about the tomb, and it is very dangerous.  Do not go alone.”

Loot Crystallized Shard's from High Marshal Fionna, Lieutenant Gregan Snyde, Jakob Geffrey and Timmon Bell in Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane

NOTE:You have to click each ghost with the Wand of Spectral Sharding in order to get the Crystallized Shard to drop

Return the four Crystallized Shard and the Wand of Spectral Sharding to Njau Hansou

You gain experience!!

Njau Hansou says, “Your work has been extraordinary.  We will send these shards to be analyzed immediately.”

Njau Hansou says, “For now, please take some time to recover from your adventures.  Go into the city and explore.  Enjoy some food and drink.  Perhaps watch a performance from the Azure Veils.”

Njau Hansou says, “Take this for your efforts.  We will speak again soon.”

You receive Spellbinders Blade Talisman from Njau Hansou.

sections.title: Details
sections.text:
In order to reach the arena, the only known way is to attain a Gilded Claw Compound Key through killing any of the claw members at the compound.





The entrance to the arena is behind the compound in the image above to the left, down a ramp to a locked door.

Once in the locked door there will be patrols that are aligned with the Claws roaming the halls.

In the locked door, there is a room to the right with an oddly colored wall that can be walked through.

It is safe to explore this area as all the NPCs are on the claw faction, aside from the slaves.





In order to start the arena you need to be AMICABLE to the Gilded Claws, this can be accomplished by killing many of the smuggler and bandits in the desert region. This includes smugglers in Fallen Pass, Shaded Dunes, and Sungreet Strand

sections.title: Arena Notes
sections.text:
Shortly after a fight is started Ringmaster Vorn typically despawns to return in 50 minutes.

When handed a note to spawn an encounter, Vorn stays available for a little while, making it possible to hand in multiple notes:

If you are on the same tier of fight, the encounter needs to be defeated before the next person can spawn the same encounter.
Different tiers can be started at the same time, be sure to have the correct person loot the proof of kill.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
All classes are able to complete this quest, but only NEC / SHD can use the Bloodied Bone. The reward is a MAGIC item, so it can be disenchanted through Disenchanting.

Everett Graves is located in the Necropolis. He is in the main room just as one enters the Concourse of Souls.

You say, "Hail, Everett Graves."

Everett Graves says, "Welcome to the Concourse of Souls. Are you a believer?"

You say, "Yes."

Everett Graves says, "Then you shall serve, acolyte. I need your assistance with an investigation. One of our new apprentices has gone missing, but his undead servant was seen wandering near the excavation site, just outside the Western Gate."

Everett Graves says, "I want you to find and destroy it. Bring back any evidence that you discover."

Head to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane and locate an escaped minion. It spawns within a room near the main entrance of the dungeon that contains several upright and open tombs which are embedded in the walls. A good way to know if you are near the right room is to look for a cracked wall with a hole in it. This wall is just outside the room in which the quest NPC can be found in.

an escaped minion DOES have a placeholder.

When you've located the mob, kill it and loot the Bloodied Human Head which can be found on its remains.

Give Bloodied Human Head to Everett Graves in Night Harbor

Everett Graves says, "That poor sap. I told him to summon weak minions until he learned to control them. What hubris he showed, trying to charm the dead so young."

Everett Graves pulls a bloodied bone from Ayvin's brain matter.
