sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest starts by looting an Unusual Jackal Pelt from an ashira shapeshifter.

Warning, this is not repeatable, so if you lose the ring ... you're boned.  " Cursed-Sage "

sections.title: Part 1 - The Pelt
sections.text:
Inspecting the Unusual Jackal Pelt directs the player to interact with someone familiar with pelts.

Seek out Leatherworker Haiat at the Tannery near West Gate in Night Harbor and hand him the pelt.

Leatherworking Haiat says, "These markings are typical for ashira leather. What's made you curious about it, friend?"

Leatherworking Haiat says, "Ashira are known to shapeshift into jackals, their animal form, so to speak, which is probably how you came by it."

Leatherworking Haiat says, "You seem surprised. Don't believe old me? Show the pelt to a seasoned bard, they can tell you more tales about the ashira folk."

Leatherworking Haiat says, "Or if you don't want it, we'll take it off of your hands for a few copper. They're tough and make for a solid base to work with!"

You receive Ashira Pelt from Leatherworker Haiat.

Seek out Jalwa Noor in Glimmermoon Hall (The Bard's Guild in the Night Market) and hand her the pelt.

Jalwa Noor says, "An ashira's pelt? Mayhaps you could tell me why you're showing me this?"

You say, "I wish to learn more about the tales of the ashira folk."

Jalwa Noor says, "The ashira are a race of jackalweres, indigenous to the deserts and foothills of southwestern Aêthoril. They've inhabited these dunes long before us, wanderer."

Jalwa Noor says, "They live harmoniously with nature and loathe the unnatural. In times past, our kin were both at war with and friendly to each other."

Jalwa Noor says, "Trade with them was once common, but of late, you don't see them interacting with the people of Night Harbor anymore. For reasons unknown to me, they've grown wary of us and mostly retreat to their home deep in the gorges of Ain Golot.

Jalwa Noor says, "A shame, truly. Their race is as ancient as the stars themselves, and their abilities are equally extraordinary."

You say, "What abilities?"

Jalwa Noor leans closer, as shadows from the torchlight dance across her face.

Jalwa Noor says, "Oh yes... the ashira have mastered the mystical art of shapeshifting. It was bestowed upon them through the Yowling, a spiritual heritage passed down from their revered ancestors. With a whisper to the wind and a call to the wild, the ashira can transform, taking the form of jackals or even... that of a human."

Jalwa Noor says, "Rumors abound of ashira hiding their true form beneath a veneer of human flesh, weaving through the throngs of cityfolk... even here in Night Harbor. So perfect is their mimicry that one might never know the person beside them is not of human kin."

Jalwa Noor lowers her voice to a reverent hush.

Jalwa Noor says, "But heed this tale well, for the Yowling is no mere parlor trick, It's the echo of their lineage, a bond with the primeval forces that crafted the very essence of our world. To witness an ashira shift is to gaze upon the ancient dance of spirit and flesh, a secret rite as old as time itself."

Jalwa Noor says, "As keepers of this world's ancient tales, some bards hold the secret of a rare chant learned from times of mistrust, one that forces an ashira back to their true form."

Jalwa Noor lets out a sorrowful sigh.

Jalwa Noor says, "Alas, the chant is not known to me, only to the most gifted of bards. My muse and lifelong partner, Alisar, was one of them."

You say, "Who was Alisar?"

Jalwa Noor says, "Alisar was a wonderful musician and storyteller. Many moons ago, I couldn't help but fall deeply in love with his beautiful soul. We wed not long after and voyaged across the continent together."

Jalwa Noor says, "Unfortunately... he is no longer with us. He took his instruments and musical sheets with him to the grave."

Jalwa Noor shakes visibly as her voice cracks.

Jalwa Noor says, "His last voyage took him to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane. He fought alongside his companions to recover a unique pipe organ that had been lost deep below the sands."

Jalwa Noor gazes into the distance, lost in memories long past.

Jalwa Noor says, "I've never heard, nor seen him again since..."

Jalwa Noor whimpers quietly as a solemn tear runs down her cheek.

Jalwa Noor says, "If you dare tread the cursed halls of the tomb to reclaim Alisar's belongings, I'll be in your eternal debt. IF the chant you seek is among them, I'll teach it to you as payment."

sections.title: Part 2 - The Lute
sections.text:
In Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane take the hidden path in the builder room across from Quartermaster Boothroy, and drop down onto the terrace with the pipe organ in the chapel. - Overlooking Timmon Bell spawn location in the chapel. With your back to Bell, /look at the organ then proceed to the cobweb corner to the right and ahead and /take lute.

You receive Broken Lute.

Return Broken Lute to Jalwa

Jalwa Noor says, "You... have returned from the shadowed depths of the tomb, bearing treasures long mourned as lost..."
Jalwa Noor trembles with reverence as she receives Alisar's lute, with the musical sheets hidden inside.
Jalwa Noor says, "In these strings and parchment, the spirit of Alisar Noor dances once more. You've brought back more than just keepsakes, you've restored the echoes of a love that time itself could not silence. Thank you, kind adventurer."
Jalwa Noor sifts through the musical sheets and gently removes one, her gaze meeting yours.
Jalwa Noor says, "Listen closely playername."
Jalwa Noor raises her voice in song, reciting words long lost with a tone of gratitude and rememberance.
Jalwa Noor says, "This is the chant you seek. I'll transcribe the words onto parchment for you. Recite them faithfully to activate its intended use... but use it with the utmost care."
Jalwa Noor says, "A word of warning... I don't know how the ashira will react if you disrupt their shapeshifting. Be careful."

You receive Ancient Chant from Jalwa Noor.

Find Mayana in Saltbreeze Park. Note: Mayana must be alone out of sight of other NPCs for the chant to work. She paths between three locations and it will not work if she is standing at the sojourner campfire or the pool of water by the monk trainer.

Inside the park, try to click the Chant. It'll either work or give an emote.

:You begin casting Ancient Disrupting Chant.
You purge Mayana with a magical chant. (Human Form)

You say, "Hail, Mayana."

Mayana says, "What have you done, biped?! My form..."
Mayana glances around nervously, then takes a combative stance.
Mayana says, "State your intent, quickly! are you friend or foe?!"
Mayana growls at you.

You say, "I am a friend."

Mayana says, "You would keep my identity a secret? Why?"

Hand Ancient Chant to Mayana.

Mayana immediately tears up the chant, then lightly bows her head with apparent relief.
Mayana says, "It is unexpected... but I cannot deny this show of trust."
Mayana says, "Please, take this as a token of our mutual understanding."

You receive Ashira Pack Ring from Mayana.

Mayana says, "I cannot leave the city due to... obligations. My pack is at great risk, both from folk in Night Harbor and within our home in Tel Ekir."
Mayana assumes her human form once more.
Mayana says, "Will you assist us where we suffer most?"

You say "Yes, I will assist you."

Mayana says, "Those crazed goblins who call themselves the bloodynose clan have invaded our home in Tel Ekir. They only seek to slaughter us and summon the unnatural."
Mayana says, "Please... help us protect the Life Font and drive them out. It would ease our spirits' burden."
Mayana says, "If you do this, bring me any goblin ear (Bloodynose Goblin Ear) and heads (Bloodynose Goblin Head) you take. The pack will reward you for proving your worth to us."
Mayana says, "And be sure to wear the ring when you bring them to me, so that I may see your conviction to our cause."

sections.title: Part 3 - The Goblins
sections.text:
You can now bring Bloodynose Goblin Ear and Bloodynose Goblin Head to Mayana for experience and faction.

It looks like the next steps are to gain enough faction (completed at kindly 2) that you can get to Seeress Hamana in Tel Ekir. She's located at the back of the zone up near the Guardian of the Life Font.

You need to collect Head of General Overlord Bloodynose and turn it in, along with your Ashira Pack Ring to receive Refined Ashira Pack Ring.

When you go up to the area above the waterfall where Seeress Hamana is, do NOT venture very far into the wooded area!  There are wisps that will agro, and the Ashira will all assist them, even if you have maximum faction.  Just sneak in along the right wall to Seeress Hamana, do the turn in and skedattle out of there!

sections.title: part 4 - Fallen Pass
sections.text:
after receiving the ring..

Seeress Hamana says, "The pack cannot thankyou enough. This will give our young ones much-needed respite."
Seeress Hamana says, "you Honour the pack."
Seeress Hamana says, "A most urgent matter has reached my ears. Will you lend us a hand once more?"
you say, "lend a hand"
Seeress Hamana says, "Fallen Pass is home to the wretched. These monsters are poisoning our lands and need to be stopped."
Seeress Hamana says, "put an end to their evil deeds. We would be eternally indebted to you."

Obtain Hidden Note from Overseer Shuk'Naru
obtain Sealed Note from Qassem Brolt
hand both into Seeress Hamana
she then asks for the ring (you must have it with you)
receive Delicate Ashira Pack Ring

This quest begins in the Underdocks eastern district inside the build directly across from the landing raft by speaking with Mikra Velrane.

You say, "Hail, Mikra Velrane."

Mikra Velrane says, "Hello. I am the contract clerk for the Descendian guild. If you have a problem you think the guild can take care of, please feel free to submit a request."

You say, "What problems?"

Mikra Velrane says, "There's no end to the number of problems that occur in the Underdocks. Right now, we are tasked with helping the Thieves Guild and the Mushroom Farmers."

You say, "I would like to help the Thieves Guild."

Mikra Velrane says, "Opportunities abound for those who are willing!"

Mikra Velrane says, "Go out and hunt down some bits from the undercaps for dissection and use by the poison makers."

sections.title: Part 1 - Rope for the Job
sections.text:
Level 15 required.

You may first find Tig Pebblebank at the quarry of Sungreet Strand and hail them (press H).

You say, "Hail, Tig Pebblebank."

Tig Pebblebank says, "No, Mr. Brookturner. Give me a moment and I'll help you look for it."

Tig Pebblebank sighs, looking visibly stressed.

Tig Pebblebank says, "What? Oh! Hi there. I'm Lead Measurer Tig Pebblebank."
Tig Pebblebank says, "I'm sorry about all that. We've been really behind lately with all the delays."

You say, "Delays?"

Tig Pebblebank says, "Don't get me started. The foreman should have secured the site, and our camp should have been set up days ago."

Tig Pebblebank shakes her head.

Tig Pebblebank says, "Safety is a high priority for us, we must be allowed to do our delicate work unhindered!"
Tig Pebblebank says, "Now, I must check our equipment and send word to the Church of Trem about what's missing. Someone else will have to take the measurements... there's just too much to do."

You say, "Measurements?"

Tig Pebblebank says, "Part of our charter as representatives of the Measure is to map an exact layout of the quarry. It's a complicated process to complete, but it starts off simple enough."
Tig Pebblebank says, "First we find the surface area of the plot for the purchase records, then we measure the overall volume to determine how much stone has already been excavated."
Tig Pebblebank says, "If I weren't so busy, I'd make these measurements myself, but..."

Tig Pebblebank sighs.

Tig Pebblebank says, "If only I had an apprentice..."

You say, "Apprentice"

Note that if you'r not level 15, the conversation stops here after a few sentences.

Tig Pebblebank says, "You're interested? I could field commission you as an apprentice in service of the Measure. It would be an official errand!"

Tig Pebblebank stares into your eyes intently, as if searching for something.

Tig Pebblebank says, "There's one condition though... it would require you to take an oath. Are you willing?"
Tig Pebblebank says, "If so, I'll swear you in and you can get started immediately. You'll be paid, of course, as befitting a junior member of the Measure."

You say, "I am willing"

Tig Pebblebank says, "Good! Then place your hand over your coin purse. Yes, just like so."

Tig Pebblebank places her hand over her coin purse.

Tig Pebblebank says, "Do you, by the stars that guide us and the sands beneath our feet, under the watchful eye of Trem, god of trade and tradesmen alike, pledge your time and work to the Guild of the Measure?"
Tig Pebblebank says, "Do you promise to chart the unknown with clarity and precision, mark the borders, and endeavor to uncover the secrets of the land?"
Tig Pebblebank says, "Do you vow to uphold the truth in all your measurements, honor the trust placed in you, and serve with diligence and integrity?"
Tig Pebblebank says, "Do you swear, as long as the sun rises and sets, and by the grace of Trem, to remain steadfast and true, to become a beacon of knowledge, and a protective curator of all tools loaned to you for an assigned task?"

Tig Pebblebank smiles and raises her eyebrows.

Tig Pebblebank says, "This is the part where you say I do."

You say, "I do"

Tig Pebblebank says, "With this oath, I bind your spirit to the Measure and the service of Trem, for now and forever, until the terms of your commission have ended."

Tig Pebblebank presents you with a metal disk.

You receive Lead Disk of the Apprentice from Tig Pebblebank.

Tig Pebblebank says, "This disk represents your apprenticeship with the Measure. You'll make good use of it, I'm sure."
Tig Pebblebank says, "Alright then, that's settled. For your task, I have just about everything you need, with the exception of rope."
Tig Pebblebank says, "Go to Night Harbor and visit the Night Market. There's a general store there owned by Sproggets Bedsprings. Tell him I sent you."
Tig Pebblebank says, "We need ten hemp ropes at fifty length each. He should have it in stock. Bring me the ropes and we'll get started."

Travel to Night Harbor and visit the Night Market.

Sproggets Bedsprings says, "Heyo! Looking to get into some adventuring? Take a look at my wares."

You say, "Tig sent me"

Sproggets Bedsprings says, "Oh she did, did she? What does she want this time?"

You say, "Rope"

Sproggets Bedsprings says, "Rope you say. Well, I do have rope for sale, but I'm guessing you're seeking the Guild of the Measurer's standard discount."
Sproggets Bedsprings says, "Fine. Two silver coin and you can have ten ropes of fifty length. I'll even throw in a small field pack to carry them in."
Sproggets Bedsprings says, "Just give me the coin when you're ready. I'll set them aside until you return."

Hand Sproggets Bedsprings 2 silver. Do not buy the rope...

Sproggets Bedsprings says, "Good doing business with you! May Trem's fortune find you."

Sproggets Bedsprings retrieves a small field pack from behind the counter and hands it to you.

You receive Small Field Pack of Ropes from Sproggets Bedsprings.

Travel to Sungreet Strand and return to Tig Pebblebank.

Hand Small Field Pack of Ropes to Tig Pebblebank.

Tig Pebblebank says, "Excellent! Let me prepare the rope for you."

Tig Pebblebank pulls out the ropes one by one and ties them together end to end, creating one long rope.

Tig Pebblebank stretches the rope from foot to head, marking it with knots, and repeats the process until she reaches the end.

Tig Pebblebank says, "Here you go. One knotted rope at about five hundred length. This should be long enough to do the job."
Tig Pebblebank says, "Now, make some room in your pack because there's quite a few items you'll need for the task. Let me know when you're ready!"

You receive Rope, Knotted, 500 Length from Tig Pebblebank.

sections.title: Part 2 - It's actually quite large!
sections.text:
You say, "I am ready"

Tig Pebblebank says, "Good! Here's the survey form to fill out. Use your apprentice disk to mark down any measurements you've taken."

You receive Tig's Survey Form from Tig Pebblebank.

Tig Pebblebank says, "Also, this is a surveying book written by yours truly. You'll find it useful."

You receive The Joy of Surveying from Tig Pebblebank.

Tig Pebblebank says, "And here's an advanced book on surveying."

You receive Advanced Surveying Volume I from Tig Pebblebank.

Tig Pebblebank says, "I know this is a lot of information, but I believe in you. You're also the only one who can do this right now... so there's that too. In Trem we trust, as I guess we must!"
Tig Pebblebank says, "For your first task, you'll need to find the surface area of the quarry. The books cover this, so I wont bore you with the details."
Tig Pebblebank says, "Seek out the markers at the quarry. They've got bright green cloths on them so they should be easy to see, but you might need to take a closer look to see the numbers on them."
Tig Pebblebank says, "Look for marker number one. Secure one end of the rope there, then stretch it all the way to marker two."
Tig Pebblebank says, "Take the first measurement and bring it back to me to check your work."

sections.title: Markers 1 and 2
sections.text:
When you are at location 1, hold Rope, Knotted, 500 Length on your cursor and use the MUD command `/place Rope` to attach the rope to the marker.

Location 1 is at the south eastern corner of the Quarry along the rim (Left of the ramp in and out)

When you are at location 2, hold Rope, Knotted, 500 Length on your cursor and use the MUD command `/place Rope` to attach the rope to the marker.

Location 2 is at the south western corner of the Quarry along the rim (near the ramp in and out of the quarry)

You tie one end of the rope to the marker one.

You tie the other end of the rope to the second marker.

You carefully count the number of knots between the first marker and second marker.

After a few moments you have counted a total of 240 knots, each marking a length. You quickly make a note of this upon the parchment.

Travel back to the locations and use the MUD command `/take Rope` the final result should be a Rope, Knotted, 500 Length in your bags and not another named rope

You untie one end of the rope from the first marker.

You untie one end of the rope from the second marker.

Return to Tig Pebblebank and hand in the updated Tig's Survey Form as well as Rope, Knotted, 500 Length.

If you forget to undo the rope with the MUD Command `/take Rope` you are met with the following:

Tig Pebblebank looks you over and scratches her head.

Tig Pebblebank says, "Where's the knotted rope? Did you know that you left some rope attached to a marker?"
Tig Pebblebank says, "You must untie the rope from the marker and bring it back with you."
Tig Pebblebank says, "Go ahead. I'll be here when you return."

Special Note: If you need to zone from aggro after taking off just one part of a rope, you can zone back and just take the other part off. You will not need to start over. This may be helpful for the last part if you are solo (w/ no FD) - since putting on and taking off the rope drops invis.

sections.title: Markers 2 and 3
sections.text:
Tig Pebblebank looks over the survey and nods.

Tig Pebblebank says, "This is a good start. You just need one more measurement and we'll have what we need to figure out the area."

Tig Pebblebank hands back the survey form.

Tig Pebblebank says, "Now, go back to marker two and get the length from marker two to marker three. Once you've written down the length, bring the survey back to me to check."

When you are at location 2, hold Rope, Knotted, 500 Length on your cursor and use the MUD command `/place Rope` to attach the rope to the marker.

Location 2 is at the south eastern corner of the Quarry along the rim (near the ramp in and out of the quarry)

When you are at location 3, hold Rope, Knotted, 500 Length on your cursor and use the MUD command `/place Rope` to attach the rope to the marker.

Location 3 is at the North Eastern corner of the Quarry along the rim (Follow the rim North of the ramp in and out towards the Glass Flats zone)

You tie one end of the rope to the marker two.

You tie the other end of the rope to the third marker.

You carefully count the number of knots between markers two and three.

After a few moments you have counted a total of 416 knots, each marking a length. You quickly make a note of this upon the parchment.

Travel back to the locations and use the MUD command `/take Rope` the final result should be a Rope, Knotted, 500 Length in your bags and not another named rope

You untie the end of the rope from the second marker.

You untie the end of the rope from the third marker.

Tig Pebblebank looks over the survey and smiles.

Tig Pebblebank says, "Great! You have the measurements needed for the area. Now, we need to get the measurement for the volume."

Tig Pebblebank hands back the survey form.

Tig Pebblebank says, "Go find markers four and five and measure the distance between them. After you've written down the length, bring the survey back to me to look over."
Tig Pebblebank says, "After this measurement, you won't need the rope anymore. Hand that in too when you're done."

sections.title: Markers 4 and 5
sections.text:
Tig Pebblebank looks over the survey and smiles.

Tig Pebblebank says, "Great! You have the measurements needed for the area. Now, we need to get the measurement for the volume."

Tig Pebblebank hands back the survey form.

Tig Pebblebank says, "Go find markers four and five and measure the distance between them. After you've written down the length, bring the survey back to me to look over."
Tig Pebblebank says, "After this measurement, you won't need the rope anymore. Hand that in too when you're done."

Location 4 and 5 are just north of the middle of the quarry. Look for the highest point. When you are at location 4, hold Rope, Knotted, 500 Length on your cursor and use the MUD command `/place Rope` to attach the rope to the marker.

Location 4 can be easily done through invisibility unless the Cinder Herald is roaming, his agro radius is massive.

When you are at location 5, hold Rope, Knotted, 500 Length on your cursor and use the MUD command `/place Rope` to attach the rope to the marker.

Location 5 can be a challenge, the path up can be traveled invisible and is generally free from kill on sight mobs. At the top there are 4 goblins around the the marker that will agro when you place the rope.

If you are doing the quest at 15 these goblins will be deep red. You can agro them and train them around if you need but remember you need to place and then return to TAKE back the rope.

You tie one end of the rope to the fourth marker.

You tie the other end of the rope to the fifth marker.

You carefully count the number of knots between markers four and five.

After a few moments you have counted a total of 42 knots, each marking a length. You quickly make a note of this upon the parchment.

Travel back to the locations and use the MUD command `/take Rope` the final result should be a Rope, Knotted, 500 Length in your bags and not another named rope

You untie the end of the rope from the fourth marker.

You untie the end of the rope from the fifth marker.

Hand in the updated Tig's Survey Form as well as Rope, Knotted, 500 Length.

sections.title: Part 3 - Math? I hate math
sections.text:
You receive Tig's Survey Form from Tig Pebblebank.

Tig Pebblebank says, "You have the lengths! Great! I hope it wasn't too difficult."

Tig Pebblebank puts the knotted rope back into her field pack.

Tig Pebblebank says, "Now, all I need to do on my end is verify the form. The results are, honestly, as I expected."

Tig Pebblebank writes something on the form and hands it back to you.

Tig Pebblebank says, "We're not done though. The surface area needs to be added to the form. Based on your measurements, I know what the area is... but do you?"

Tig Pebblebank says, "Consider this a test of your skill, apprentice. Think carefully about the answer and take your time to get it right. Once you've got it, tell me your answer."

Tig Pebblebank says, "Or, if you just want to be done with the survey, you can hand me the form and go."

You say, "99,840"

You gain experience!!

Tig Pebblebank says, "Well done, that's correct!"

Tig Pebblebank says, "If you don't mind, I'll jot that down on your form."

Tig Pebblebank snatches the form from your hand and quickly scribbles down the answer, then promptly returns it to you.

Tig Pebblebank says, "There, now you have the area of the quarry filled in."

Tig Pebblebank says, "I must say, I'm impressed with your skill so far. Advanced surveying concepts don't come easily."

Tig Pebblebank says, "I wonder... do you happen to know the last measurement, the volume of the quarry? Tell me, and we can finish this form properly."

Tig Pebblebank says, "Once again, this is quite an advanced surveying technique. If it's too much for you, you can hand me the form and go. I'll understand."

You say, "4,193,280"

Tig Pebblebank says, "Trem's fortune favors you, my apprentice! That is correct!"

Tig Pebblebank says, "Hand me the survey. Let us put an end to this task."

Hand in the updated Tig's Survey Form.

Tig Pebblebank takes the note from you and scribbles down a few more words.

Tig Pebblebank folds up the survey and tucks it gently into her robe, smiling.

Tig Pebblebank says, "This will be a great help to not only the Measure, but also to Trem's faithful."

Tig Pebblebank says, "Please take this as thanks for your efforts. Rest well, knowing you've served a higher purpose this day. Trust in Trem."

You gain experience!!

You receive The Measure Stick from Tig Pebblebank.

quests.title: Underdocks Starter Quest
quests.classText: Archer | Beastmaster | Elementalist | Enchanter | Fighter | Ranger | Wizard
quests.relatedNpcs: Marshal Harding | Simrut the Green | Gunder Dinnig | Maude Astarace

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Musty Tunic
Hammered Iron Ring
Polished Iron Ring
Hargrul's Skullcracker
Hargrul's Tenderizer

sections.title: Part 1 - Deep Beetles - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read the Recruitment Notice you start with as a new Archer, Ranger, Enchanter, Beastmaster or Fighter characters.

Calling all hot-blooded--

MEN-AT-ARMS,
SORCERERS,
HUNTERS,
and OLD DOGS.

--be you unemployed, dispossessed, or outlawed.

The DESCENDIAN ORDER holds muster in the Underdocks, EASTERN DISTRICT. Pass inspection for steady work.

GOOD PAY.

Marshal Harding

Ensure your language settings are set to Common Tongue, Marshal Harding cannot understand Deep Tongue as of 2026-09-10.

Take a lift down to the Underdocks Citadel. Then, head east to the Eastern District. You will need to swim across or wait for the raft. Climb the staircase immediately across from the raft docking location to find Marshal Harding and hand him your Recruitment Notice.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

Marshal Harding looks you over.

Marshal Harding says, "You can read this, then? You look like you crawled out of a gutter. Have you come to serve in the Order?"

You say, "I have come to serve in the Order"

Marshal Harding waves the leaf of paper in your face.

Marshal Harding says, "The Descendian Order. I pray you fight better than you read, if you wish to earn your keep."

You say, "I wish to earn my keep"

Marshal Harding laughs.

Marshal Harding says, "As a scullion, no doubt, by your dress."

Marshal Harding rummages through a crate and hands you a shirt.

Marshal Harding says, "It could do with a wash, but at least you might seem to be a page rather than a pauper. Can you fight, then?"

You receive Musty Tunic from Marshal Harding.

You say, "I can fight"

Marshal Harding says, "I'll have the truth of it. Fill this satchel with the shells of deep beetles."

Marshal Harding hands you a threadbare sack.

You receive Beetle Shell Collection Bag from Marshal Harding.

Marshal Harding says, "Do not return if this task is too great."

Facing Northwest, follow the tunnel out of the Eastern District to the Underdocks wall where you can begin hunting a deep beetle.

Collect 6 Deep Beetle Carapace, place them in the Beetle Shell Collection Bag and click combine to create Full Beetle Shell Collection Bag.

sections.title: Part 1 - Notes & FAQ
sections.text:
2026-09-11 as a level 3-4 Archer, this took ~50 beetle kills over about two hours killing every low level mob in sight. Drop rate is about 5% but seems slightly better for the higher level beetles.

Hand in the Full Beetle Shell Collection Bag to Marshal Harding

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

At this point depending on your class he will tell you to take a note to one of a few different NPCs. As a beastmaster or fighter it will be Gunder Dinnig, as an archer or ranger it will be Simrut the Green. As an enchanter, elementalist, or wizard the next step is at Maude Astarace.

Marshal Harding says, "An adequate performance for a scullion. Bring this letter to Simrut, the hunter. He will decide what becomes of you."

Or

Marshal Harding says, "An adequate performance for a scullion. Bring this letter to Gunder Dinnig, who will put you to work."

Or

Marshal Harding says, "An adequate performance for a scullion. Bring this letter to Maude Astarace. She will judge your worth.

You receive Note from Marshal Harding.

Simrut the Green is a goblin standing near some tall stones next to the Archery range.

Gunder Dinnig is a halfling located just up the stairs nearby.

Maude Astarace is a gnome located in the building next to the quartermaster.

Hand the correct NPC your Note

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

Simrut the Green says, "Hrum! Is it a hunter? Yes, yes. You get a hunter's ring."

Or

Gunder Dinnig says, "A new one, fresh from the field then!"
Gunder Dinnig sniffs
Gunder Dinnig says, "Not so fresh as I would have liked. We will have to get that sorted. Accept this ring as a token of your service. Take care not to lose it, lest our comrades mistake you for a poor grotto bandit."

Or

Maude Astarace says, "A new recruit! I hope you will live a little longer than the last one. The marshal is not always the most discerning fellow. Never mind about that. Take this ring and assist me with my reearch"

You receive Hammered Iron Ring.

This ring will have a different stat depending on your class, and the follow up quest will also vary.

sections.title: Part 2 for Archer/Ranger - Wererats - Req. Level 5
sections.text:
After receiving your Hammered Iron Ring, Simrut continues talking...

Simrut the Green says, "Have you seen the rats?

You say, "What rats?"

Simrut the Green says, "Rats! Sneaking, snarling, killing! Hunt bandits, they says. Hunt rats, I says! Riddrick is gone, They took him, I says. I knows. The rats. Big rats. Will you hunt?"

You say, "Who is Riddrick?"

Simrut the Green says, "The scout. He hunted the rats, too. Will you hunt?"

You say, "I will hunt the rats"

Simrut the Green says, "Yes, yes. Good. Hunt rats, find Riddrick!"

If you ask Simrut about the aforementioned bandits, he has this to say:

You say, "What about the bandits?"

Simrut the Green says, "Deepcuts, the deep cutters."

This may be a breadcrumb tie in to the Deepcut Bandit Bounty quest.

You will need to head back the tunnel to the newbie hunting area. You are looking for Wererats, which have a rare chance of dropping Riddrick's Ring. You can find them by following the North wall out of the newbie gate until you find their encampment. You will likely need a party as the Wererats cluster in groups consisting of fighters, shamans and archers.

Hand Simrut the Green Riddrick's Ring.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

Simrut the Green says, "Riddrick's ring! Hrum. No, no. It won't do. No."

Simrut the Green says, "It won't do, <<PLAYERNAME>>! But it is proof. Give these to the lordling, Vosirek. The council must listen."

You receive Riddrick's Ring from Simrut the Green.

You receive Simrut's Report from Simrut the Green.

Facing the same direction as Simrut the Green, head up the stairs towards Gunder Dinnig, walk through the Archer / Ranger building, and you will see Sir Vosirek.

Hand Simrut's Report and Riddrick's Ring to Sir Vosirek.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

Sir Vosirek shakes his head.

Sir Vosirek says, "The latest victim of Simrut's obsessions, I see. He knows the council will not approve of this. Riddrick has likely deserted, or else died senselessly pursuing this folly. There is no coin to be had in rat-hunting."

Sir Vosirek tears a page out of Simrut's report and scrawls a note on the back.

Sir Vosirek says, "You have my sympathy, <<CLASS>>. Give this to the paymaster along with your guild signet ring."

You receive Scrap of Paper from Sir Vosirek.

You say, "Who is the paymaster?"

Sir Vosirek says, "You'll find Elara downstairs."

Head downstairs to find Elara Venn.

Hand the Scrap of Paper and your Hammered Iron Ring to Elara Venn.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

Elara Venn shakes her head.

Elara Venn says, "Oh, Urzebol take Simrut's rats. But you followed orders, and there are always opportunities for those who follow orders. Take this ring."

You receive Polished Iron Ring from Elara Venn.

You receive 10 silver from Elara Venn.

Return to Simrut the Green and Hail him.

You say, "Hail, Simrut the Green."

Simrut the Green says, "Hrumm. No help from council, no. Must find Riddrick."

You say, "But Riddrick is dead. We found his ring!"

Simrut the Green says, "Not dead, I says. Lost his ring, not dead. The rats have him!"

Simrut the Green grins at you.

Simrut the Green says, "Find Riddrick!"

At this point, you are on the search for Riddrick the Cursed, a rare wererat spawn. You will need to be level 12-14 and you may need a group to successfully find and put an end to Riddrick.

Upon killing Riddrick the Cursed, loot Riddrick's Head and return to Simrut the Green.

Hand Riddrick's Head to Simrut the Green.

Missing dialogue here...

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

You receive Ratkiller from Simrut the Green.

sections.title: Part 2 for Enchanter/Elementalist/Wizard - Deepcut Miners in Darrowdwell Mines - Req. Level 4+
sections.text:
After receiving your Hammered Iron Ring, ask Maude about her research...

You say, "What research?"

Maude Astarace says, "The Delvestone and Deepcut quarrel over rocks, and I wish to know why. Their petty conflict is our good fortune, since the mining company will pay us to reclaim their crystals."

Maude Astarace says, "Venture into the Darrowdwell mine about the citadel and fill this box with crystals from the Deepcut miners."

You receive Empty Crystal Box from Maude Astarace.

Maude Astarace says, "In truth, I care not how you acquire these crystals."

Hand in the Full Box of Crystals to Maude Astarace

You gain experience!!

After receiving Full Box of Crystals, Maude Astarace continues talking...

Maude Astarace opens the box and rummages throught it.

Maude Astarace says, "What is this?"

Maude Astarace says, "These are not diamonds, nor sapphires, nor even jaspers. Lusterless rocks, all!"

Maude Astarace says, "I suppose you have earned some coin for your part. The Miners can have their rocks, but something is amiss. Take this to the paymaster along with your guild signet."

Hand in the Darrowdwell Crystal Bounty to Elara Venn at the Bounty Building nearby with your Hammered Iron Ring

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

Elara Venn unfolds Maude's report.

Elara Venn says, "A contract fulfilled. The Delvestone appreciate your work, Class, even if the sorceress does not. Here is your share, and a signet befitting your place."

You receive Polished Iron Ring from Elara Venn.

You recieve 10 silver from Elara Venn.

sections.title: Part 3 for Enchanter/Elementalist/Wizard - Deepcut, Delvestone, Darrowdwell. - Req. Level 8+
sections.text:
Return to Maude Astarace and hail her.

Maude Astarace says, "I do not believe for a moment that the Delvestone would spill their blood or their coin for those worthless rocks. I require your assistance once more, Player Name."

You say, "I will assist you"

Maude Astarace says, "I must have a sample of whatever mineral lies at the heart of this territorial squabble. Deepcut, Delvestone, Darrowdwell. These are insignificant. Find the thing they fight and die for."

Maude Astarace says, "Do this, and I will reward you personally."

To be continued... Updating ASAP

sections.title: Part 2 for Beastmaster/Fighter - Deepcut Overseers in Darrowdwell Mines - Req. Level 4+
sections.text:
After receiving your Hammered Iron Ring, ask Gunder Dinnig about work...

You say, "What work?"

Gunder Dinnig says, "Aye, there are domestic matters we might resolve to our profit. The Delvestone Mining Company quarrel with the Deepcut bandits in Darrowdwell. The company is ill-equipped to to protect their interests, but their pockets run deep."

Gunder Dinnig says, "There is a standing bounty of the heads of Deepcut overseers. Fill this bag and earn your share. Send them packing!"

Gunder Dinnig belches.

You receive Overseer Head Bag from Gunder Dinnig.

Collect 6 Deepcut Overseer Head, place them in the Empty Overseer Bag and click combine to create Full Bag of Overseer Heads.

Hand in the Full Bag of Overseer Heads to Gunder Dinnig

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

Gunder Dinnig Unfastens the Bag.

Gunder Dinning says, "Gruesome work, Player Name. Would that you had a sharper blade... yet a crown hewn is a copper earned. Bring this to Elara, the pay-master, along with your ring."

You receive Deepcut Overseer Bounty from Gunder Dinnig.

Elara Venn says, "You acquit yourself well, Class. Here is your coin, and a signet that might serve you better."

You receive Polished Iron Ring from Elara Venn.

You recieve 10 silver from Elara Venn.

sections.title: Part 3 for Beastmaster/Fighter - More business with the Deepcut - Req. Level 8+
sections.text:
Return to Gunder Dinnig and hail him.

Gunder Dinnig says, "There is more business with the Deepcut."

You say, "what business?"

Gunder Dinnig says, "The bandits have an encampment, a mine where the Delvestone dare not go. My peers wish to rout the blaggards, claim their quarries, and lease them to fill our coffers."

Gunder Dinnig says, "But we must exercise caution. I have a new assignment for you."

You say, "what assignment?"

Gunder Dinnig says, "Find their lair, Player Name, and take no quarter. You may claim a bounty for every six hands of the bandits you slay. Bring them to the clerk, Traven, and he will see that you are paid. But that is not your task."

You say, "what task?"

Gunder Dinnig says, "I wish to know who is behind this sordid outfit. If we are to extend our reach father into the Deep, we must know. Bring me any evidence you can find, however insignificant it might seem to your eye."

Travel to the Deepcut bandit camps which can be found if you keep going east a little way in the Underdocks newbie yard and slay them until you acquire a Dull Coin. Bring this coin back to Gunder.

Gunder Dinnig squints his eyes at the coin.

Gunder Dinnig says, "One of the bandits carried this? It is an elvish coin, though I do not recognize the sigil. Should it belong to one of the great houses..."

Gunder Dinnig says, "There is no contract fulfilled nor bounty to collect for your work today, Player Name, but you have earned a measure of trust. Take this token to Hargrul in the citadel. He is an old friend of mine, and a blacksmith of formidable skill.

You receive a token from Gunder Dinnig.

Take the token over to the blacksmith shop in the citadel and give it to Blacksmith Hargrul.

Blacksmith Hargrul holds the token up to the light of the forge.

Blacksmith Hargrul says, "Hmm, 'Tis my token."

Blacksmith Hargrul looks you up and down..

Blacksmith Hargrul says, "I haven't a blade suited to a young Class such as yourself. But a skullcracker will do."

You receive Hargrul's Skullcracker from Blacksmith Hargrul.

Blacksmith Hargrul says, "If ye cannot wield it, return it to me to receive a smaller battle hammer."

You now have the option to trade it for a one-handed weapon.

Blacksmith Hargrul says, "Haven't the strength, I see. Perhaps it's meant for a more capable Class."

You receive Hargrul's Tenderizer from Blacksmith Hargrul.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Viper's Kick
You gain experience!!

Faction increase with Citizens of Night Harbor

2 x Viper's Kick are used in the quest A Sweet Treat.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Head to Layla Faraj in Glass Flats. Layla is located at the Pyrmos Mercenary / Salt Gatherer camp near the Sungreet Strand zoneline.

You say, "Hail, Layla Faraj."

Layla Faraj says, "Sweltering days and frigid nights here in the flats, my friend. I'm fortunate that the salt gatherers have spared me a tent in exchange for my services."

You say, "What services?"

Layla Faraj says, "I'm a Sojourner of the Crow Clan and an alchemist by trade. I've been able to provide various tinctures and poultices to the workers while I remain here. Though admittedly, they seem to favor my Viper's Kick more than anything!"

You say, "What is Viper's Kick?"

Layla Faraj says, "Viper's Kick is the name I've given to a potent shot of liquor I produce using just enough viper toxin as to not be... fatal."

Layla Faraj says, "It gives you a swift kick in the mouth before making it go numb from the toxin's effects."

Layla Faraj says, "If you care to try it, I can make you a shot with some Black Feather whiskey and a Szuurian viper venom sac."

Kill a Szuurian viper and loot Szuurian Viper Venom Sac.

Travel to Night Harbor and find Nerida Thinblade at The Spirit Tap bar in the Black Feather Bazaar. Purchase Black Feather Whiskey for 2 silver pieces.

Give 1 x Szuurian Viper Venom Sac and 1 x Black Feather Whiskey to Layla Faraj.

Layla Faraj says, "Oh, perfect! Just a moment..."

Layla Faraj carefully extracts just enough venom as to not be dangerous, depositing it into the whiskey and giving it a swift stir.

Layla Faraj says, "Here you are! This is sure to keep you warm on a cool night in the flats."

You receive Viper's Kick from Layla Faraj.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with Citizens of Night Harbor got better.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
The Impaler

Experience

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest starts with hailing Guard Atep.

You say, 'Hail, Guard Atep.'

Guard Atep says, "Citizen, I am offering bounties for various targets of opportunity. Are you interested in hearing about them?"

You say, "Interested"

Guard Atep says, "I currently have a bounty for Ashira."

You say, "What Ashira?"

Guard Atep hands you a wanted poster.

You receive Wanted: Ayip and Yapala from Guard Atep

WANTED: Dead or Alive


Ayip and Yapala of the Ashira


These two mongrel Ashira have raided our lands

and killed innocent civilians long enough. Their

last known location was near the hidden entrance

to Tel Ekir, found in the Shaded Dunes.


Bring their heads to Guard Atep.


-The Red Mantles

Upon turning in the Bloodied Ashira Head (Ayip) and Bloodied Ashira Head (Yapala) Guard Atep responds:

Guard Atep says, "Ha! The only good Ashira is a dead Ashira. You bagged two of their worst. Take this as a token of the League's appreciation."

You receive The Impaler

You gain experience!!

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This quest is repeatable.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
Experience
1 Silver
Faction with The Fight Club

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest begins in the Underdocks upper city district by talking with Draznax. Draznax is located in the center of the mercenary camp, near the wagons on the southern east portion of the upper city.

You say, "Hail, Draznax."

Draznax says, "Hey! Welcome to Ruff's Fight Club."

Draznax looks around timidly.

Draznax says, "I'm the assistant to the assistant, which makes me pretty important around here. I'm tasked with keeping things orderly, safe and secure. But we have a rat problem..."

You say, "What rat problem?"

Draznax grins and looks over his shoulder quickly.

Draznax says, "I can't even think straight with all the chittering coming from the rat's complex down the block. The wererats came over here and attacked us. Tried to steal our food and booze!"

Draznax says, "It's time to send them a message... a deadly one! Go find the rats and chop off their heads. Bring those back to me for your just rewards."

Draznax would like you to hunt some wererats and return a Severed Wererat Head. Note that this is different from the Night Harbor Shadow Knight quest item Wererat Head.

The closest Wererats are in a building on the southwest side of the upper city. These Wererats con red to a level 4 as of 2026-09-11.

Wererats can also be found in the newbie hunting area below the Underdocks. The easiest Wererats are level 5-8 and drop heads at a roughly 30% drop rate as of 2026-09-11. Heads are non-unique and tradable, and likely used for faction grinding.

Hand in Severed Wererat Head one at a time to Draznax.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Fight Club got better.

You receive 1 silver from Daznax.

Draznax says, "Great job! That'll teach those vermin their place."

As of 2026-09-11, a Deep Elf Archer received 1 blue bar of faction with The Fight Club per head turn-in.

Experience

quests.title: Wizard Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
quests.relatedNpcs: Olvin Viscus | Adimah Starseeker | Rallin Wizzentrop

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience

Academy Student's Robe
Gilded Academy Student's Robe

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
you will need 2 snake skins if you want to get them before you start **

Read Carefully Rolled Note you start with as a new Wizard Character:

Student <Player>,

You have been enrolled in the introductory course 
at the Chartered Academy of Arcane Inquiry.

Diligently report to the admissions officer — Olvin
Viscus — to complete the application process.

The Academy is located in the heart of Sageside, in
the northeastern part of the city. The floating 
wizard tower is your destination. Take the
translocation devices to enter.

Please do not tarry in your visit; knowing how to 
manage your newfound powers is of the utmost
importance.

Signed,

— High Doctore Jabir Il-hamar

Head to the wizard tower in the north eastern corner of Night Harbor and Turn in your Carefully Rolled Note to Olvin Viscus

You gain experience!!

Olvin Viscus peers at you over his thick spectacles.
Olvin Viscus says, "No, I am not interested in buying an — Oh, a new student? Well, give it here, then!"
Olvin Viscus says, "Welcome to the Chartered Academy of Arcane Inquiry. I am Olvin Viscus, head administrator of the Academy. I am sure you are eager to learn your first spells, but first, you must introduce yourself to the staff here."
Olvin Viscus reaches into his desk and pulls out a long scroll of parchment, then takes a leather folio and places the scroll inside. He thrusts it into your hands.
Olvin Viscus says, "All five heads of the various schools must sign off on your application before you are formally inducted into the school. They can be found within the Academy grounds, the Grand Library, or elsewhere in Sageside if they are not in their offices. Make haste, get all five signatures, and bring your prospectus back to me. Hurry now, <player>!"

You receive Academy Prospectus from Olvin Viscus.

You receive Academy Folio from Olvin Viscus.

You say, "who Doctores"
Olvin Viscus says, "Our halls are home to some of the most ardent researchers of mystical lore in Szuur—no, in all of Aêthoril!"
Olvin Viscus bows slightly as he begins his spiel.
Olvin Viscus says, "Our illustrious head doctore is none other than Jabir Il-hamar, Doctore of the School of Elemental Mastery. He can be found atop our tower, looking out over the city when he is not busy in his office."
Olvin Viscus says, "Next is the Doctore of the School of Celestial Investigation, Adimah Starseeker. She typically works in the orrery, but if she is not there, she may be out doing her research."
Olvin Viscus says, "Doctore Rallin Wizzentrop is the head of the School of Aberration Research. He can usually be found within the tower itself, accompanied by his wonderful dragon companion. Though we haven't been seeing much of the latter lately, he often sends the creature out on errands."
Olvin Viscus pauses to take a deep breath before continuing.
Olvin Viscus says, "Doctore Veygen Antorious can be found within the tower. This maverick of the School of Aethernautical Exploration often has his head in the clouds, but that is not a bad thing. He is a skilled airship pilot and even possesses the power to travel to other planes. His ability is not to be taken lightly."
Olvin Viscus says, "Finally, you can find Doctore Lanna Invintoria in the Grand Library. She was originally an honored guest from Calafrey, but she decided to join our school! She teaches Humanoid Studies and is a skilled linguist, anthropologist, and historian."
Olvin Viscus claps his hands, feeling accomplished.
Olvin Viscus says, "And those are the wonderful heads of our five schools."

sections.title: Veygen Antorious
sections.text:
Head up the tower and hand your Academy Prospectus to Veygen Antorious

Veygen Antorious inspects the form, then looks you over with a stern gaze.
Veygen Antorious says, "Hmm..."
Veygen Antorious strokes his beard as he appraises you.
Veygen Antorious says, "Yes, I think you'll do. Allow me to sign your form, but know that I expect great things from you—as I do from every prospective student of the Academy. You're a little older than some of the other novices, but I expect you'll catch up in your studies quickly."
Veygen Antorious signs your form with the flick of a quill.
Veygen Antorious says, "I suppose congratulations are in order. Let's hope that the other faculty heards are in agreement with my choice."
Veygen Antorious smiles at you warmly.

You receive Academy Prospectus from Veygen Antorious.

You receive Veygen's Prospectus from Veygen Antorious.

sections.title: Jabir Il-hamar
sections.text:
Head further up the tower and hand your Academy Prospectus to Jabir Il-hamar

Jabir Ilhama smiles takes the letter from you, grasping it in his spindly fingers.
Jabir Il-hamar says, "Ah, I see. A new student wishes to enroll in our illustrious Academy."
Jabir Ilhama strokes his long beard, carefully looking over you.
Jabir Il-hamars ays, "If you wish to join our ranks, I don’t want any sort of whining, complaining, or any other such nonsense. Such trifling gives me a headache, and if you are half as wise as you’re expected to be, you will know that being a pain to me in particular is a poor decision for a student."
Jabir Ilhama sighs, shaking his head. He takes out a long quill, along with a piece of parchment, writing out a statement, before signing both papers, handing them back to you.
Jabir Il-hamar says, "Do not make me regret allowing you into this Academy."
Jabir Ilhama watches you closely as you leave.

You receive Academy Prospectus from Jabir Il-hamar.

You receive Jabir's Prospectus from Jabir Il-hamar.

sections.title: Adimah Starseeker
sections.text:
Head to the bottom of the tower and take the teleporter to the Library.

Hand your Academy Prospectus to Adimah Starseeker
Adimah Starseeker holds up a finger as she continues to read her tome.
Adimah Starseeker says, "Hold."
Adimah Starseeker does not look up from the pages.
Adimah Starseeker furiously writing something down in her notebook before finally meeting your eyes. She snatches the paper from your hand quickly.
Adimah Starseeker says, "Ah, so you wish to join our academy."
Adimah Starseeker looks you over for a moment as she places the prospectus on her desk. She takes one of her notebooks and passes it to you.
Adimah Starseeker says, "Bring this to my adjunct, Domas. You can find him tending to the orrery. He should return my prized quill to you. Bring it back to me, and I will sign your prospectus."
Adimah Starseeker immediately returns to her work, brushing the prospectus aside on her desk.

You receive Adimah's Notebook from Adimah Starseeker.

Head back to the top of the wizard tower and hand Adimah's Notebook to Domas Starseeker

Domas Starseeker flips through the book's pages.
Domas Starseeker says, "Ah, I see you've spoken with my mother. Very well... I take it she wants her quill back, yes? She left it in one of the other notebooks she gave me, you see. She tends to use them as bookmarks."
Domas Starseeker quietly tuts.
Domas Starseeker says, "Well, here's the quill. Hopefully, she'll be happy with it. And tell her to get some rest; she's always staying up too late."
Domas Starseeker shakes his head with a sigh.

You receive Golden-Feathered Quill from Domas Starseeker.

Return back to Adimah Starseeker and hand her the Golden-Feathered Quill.

Adimah Starseeker holds up a finger, once again nose-deep in her tome.
Adimah Starseeker says, "Hold."
Adimah Starseeker sharply glances to your hands.
Adimah Starseeker says, "Ah, my quill. Wonderful."
Adimah Starseeker takes the quill in a surprisingly slow and gentle manner.
Adimah Starseeker says, "Hm, Domas cleaned it for me. I should reward him for that."
Adimah Starseeker says, "Ah, right! Your prospectus! Here you are."
Adimah Starseeker says, "Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a lot more work to do."

You receive Academy Prospectus from Adimah Starseeker.

You receive Adimah's Prospectus from Adimah Starseeker.

sections.title: Rallin Wizzentrop
sections.text:
Head back to the tower and hand your Academy Prospectus to Rallin Wizzentrop

Rallin Wizzentrop takes your prospectus, stuffing it into his pocket.
Rallin Wizzentrop says, "Yes, yes, a work order... Tell Hamsar I've already completed his special item."
Rallin Wizzentrop waves his hand dismissively towards you, before hand you a small wooden box.

You receive Delivery for Hamsar from Rallin Wizzentrop.

Head back to the library and hand the Delivery for Hamsar to Hamsar

Hamsar perks an eyebrow as he takes the box from you. Propping up the lid, he peeks inside before his expression lights up.
Hamsar says, "Oh, I see. Ya brought this from Rallin. Wonderful! I’ve been waiting all month fer him to fix this fer me."
Hamsar adjusts the toolbelt around his waist, then notices you still standing there.
Hamsar says, "Oh, he kept yer prospectus? That’s unfortunate fer ya… I’ll make sure t’write something on this here receipt."
Hamsar scribbles on the scrap of paper before handing it back to you.
Hamsar grins broadly with sparkling teeth.
Hamsar says, "Good luck, newbie!"

You receive Hamsar's Receipt from Hamsar.

Return to Rallin Wizzentrop and hand him Hamsar's Receipt

Rallin Wizzentrop takes the receipt from you. He looks over it, adjusting his thick spectacles, before reaching into his pocket, pulling out a now grease-stained prospectus. He wordlessly stamps it, and, along with what seems to be a pre-signed form of acceptance from his department, passes both to you.

You receive Academy Prospectus from Rallin Wizzentrop.

You receive Rallin's Prospectus from Rallin Wizzentrop.

sections.title: Lanna Ivintoria
sections.text:
Head to the Library to hand your Academy Prospectus to Lanna Ivintoria

Lanna Ivintoria takes the prosepctus from you ginerly, looking over it, before she nods.
Lanna Ivintoria says, "Ah, very well, you wish to study at our Academy?"
Lanna Ivintoria says, "I will sign your prospectus, but I require proof of your arcane prowess. Bring me two snake skins. I require their use in one of my experiments. Any snake you find around Night Harbor will do. Do this, and I will provide you with a signature."
Lanna Ivintoria hands you back the unsigned prospectus.

You receive Academy Prospectus from Lanna Ivintoria.

Head out the North Gate of Night Harbor and kill a snakes until you receive two Snake Skins.

Alternatively you can buy these.

Return to Lanna Ivintoria and hand her your two Snake Skins.

Lanna Ivintoria examines the skins carefully.
Lanna Ivintoria says, "Wonderful, wonderful, they are in fine condition. Yes, this will do. Very well, here is your signed prospectus, as promised."

You receive Lanna's Prospectus from Lanna Ivintoria.

sections.title: Becoming a student
sections.text:
Combine all 5 notes in to the Academy Folio as well as the original Academy Prospectus to receive the Complete Academy Prospectus.

Hand the Complete Academy Prospectus to Olvin Viscus
Olvin Viscus thumbs through the folio.
Olvin Viscus says, "Ah, splendid! I take it you had no difficulty receiving signatures from our illustrious staff?"
Olvin Viscus pulls out a large, ornate brass stamp that, after whispering a few arcane words, glows hot in his hand. He places a cold piece of wax on the closed folio, then presses it shut with the red-hot seal. The wax bubbles for a moment before settling, leaving the crimson seal of the Academy in its place.
Olvin Viscus says, "Please, <Player>, take this to our headmaster. I am sure you know who he is by now, he did have to sign one of your forms after all. Do not tarry!"
Olvin Viscus sends you off with a little wave.

You receive Approved Academy Prospectus from Olvin Viscus.

Head up the tower to Jabir Il-hamar and hand him the Approved Academy Prospectus.

You gain experience!!

Jabir Il-hamar takes the folio from you, inspecting the seal, before quickly leafing through it.
Jabir Il-hamar says, "Very well. It’s all here, it seems. Your diligence has paid off, for you are now a Grade 0 Student at the Chartered Academy of Arcane Inquiry."
Jabir Il-hamar waves his hands, and a scarlet robe, perfectly sized for you, appears in your arms.
Jabir Il-hamar says, "Wear it with pride, <Player>. Now, go and practice your magic. Once you have learned a few more spells, return to me, wearing your robes, and I will offer you your first assignment."

You receive Academy Student's Robe from Jabir Ilhamar.

sections.title: Part 2 - Req. Lvl 4
sections.text:
Once you are level 4, go back to Jabir Il-hamar and hail him. Must be wearing "Academy student's robe".

Jabir Il-hamar strokes his beard as a worried expression crosses his face.
Jabir Il-hamar says, "I'm afraid I have bad news. A few days ago, one of your fellow students was sent to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane... but he has yet to return."

You say, "who was the student?"

Jabir Il-hamar says, "Viridon is his name... he's an experienced student."
Jabir Il-hamar says, "Please go out there, find him, and bring him back to us safely. It's advisable that you take companions with you."

Head to Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane, the Scorched Academy Folio is a random drop off skeleton mobs in the tomb.

Return to Jabir Il-hamar
Turn in Scorched Academy Folio to Jabir Il-hamar.

Jabir Il-hamar says, "A folio from our academy? Why are you..."
Jabir Il-hamar looks at you in shock.
Jabir Il-hamar says, "No, this cannot be! Are you telling me this belonged to Viridon?"
Jabir Il-hamar mutters in disbelief, thrusting the folio back into your hands.
Jabir Il-hamar says, "This is dreadful news! I hope no ill has befallen him. We must investigate... will you help me?"

You say, "I will help you investigate"

Jabir Il-hamar says, "Thank you, player"
Jabir Il-hamar  says, "Please bring Viridon's folio to Liyna in the Grand Library. She'll analyze it and help us find a lead. Go at once!"

Head to the Grand Library and seek out Liyna Esueiruc who is on the lower floors.


Turn in Scorched Academy Folio to Liyna Esueiruc.




Note: I got the following upon handing the folio over...

Liyna Esueiruc looks at the folio, then back to you.
Liyna Esueiruc says, "A folio? I'm not one of the Academy's Doctores."
Liyna Esueiruc hands back the folio.

You receive Scorched Academy Folio from Liyna Esueiruc.

...so, I repeated the hand-in and it advanced..


Turn in Scorched Academy Folio to Liyna Esueiruc.

Liyna Esueiruc pulls a loupe from her pocket and inspects the folio.
Liyna Esueiruc says, "There's odd traces of runic charring on this. It looks like whomever was carrying it was hit by a necromantic spell."
Liyna Esueiruc says, "You've done well to stay out of trouble. Ask Jabir for a just reward."
Liyna Esueiruc says, "I still need more time to investigate, but when you see Jabir, please hand him this message from me."
Liyna Esueiruc says, "We'll speak again, student. Fear not, we'll get to the bottom of this."

You receive Small Note from Liyna Esueiruc.


You gain experience!!





Return to Jabir Il-hamar and turn in your Small Note from Liyna. 


You receive your items back from Jabir Ilhamar.

Jabir Il-hamar looks at the folio as his spectacles slide down to his nose.
Jabir Il-hamar suddenly drops the folio in shock.
Jabir Il-hamar says, "Yes... right... of course."
Jabir Il-hamar says, "Student... thank you... We'll investigate your findings. Please do not worry yourself with it any longer."
Jabir Il-hamar says, "You've earned yourself a reward. Pick up the folio, would you? And hand me your robe as well, I have a new one for you."

Turn in your Academy Student's Robe and Small Note to Jabir Il-hamar .

Jabir Il-hamar takes your old robe and quickly swaps it with a new one.
Jabir Il-hamar says, "You deserve this, Player."
Jabir Il-hamar pats you on the shoulder.

You receive Gilded Academy Student's Robe from Jabir Ilhamar.

You say, "Hail, Jabir Il-hamar ."
Jabir Il-hamar says, "Return to me after you've studied a while longer."

sections.title: Part 3 - Req. Lvl TBD (above 16)
sections.text:
If still too low of level, Jabir Il-hamar will ask you to return when higher level:

Jabir Il-hamar says, "Player, I have important news to discuss with you, but you must continue your studies. Speak with me after training a while longer."

MORE INFO NEEDED

Level 10 Wizard when speaking to Jabir Il-hamar -

'Jabir Il-hamar says,' "You've grown so much in your time here, Player...

'Jabir Il-hamar says,' "I believe it's time that you to hear the truth about Viridon..."

'Jabir Ilhama says,' "He's dead. Liyna is sure of it. It wasn't a nice way to go either, I'm afraid."

'Jabir Ilhama says,' "I need your help to investigate why he was the target of such a heinous crime."

'Jabir Ilhama says,' "He's "

You say, "What happened to Viridon?"

'Jabir Ilhama says,' "No, we haven't found Viridon... but thank you for your concern."

'Jabir Ilhama says,' "I do have another task for you, however. The Academy is in need of burn out lightstones. If you could bring me four, it would be of great value to us."

'Jabir Ilhama says,' "You'll find wisps floating about the Shaded Dunes."

At which point you're effectively asked to do the quest Burnt Out Lightstones (Repeatable)

fields.Related NPCs: Olvin Viscus | Adimah Starseeker | Rallin Wizzentrop

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Experience

Musty Tunic

sections.title: Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1
sections.text:
Read the Recruitment Notice you start with as a new Wizard character:

Calling all hot-blooded--

MEN-AT-ARMS,
SORCERERS,
HUNTERS,
and OLD DOGS.

--be you unemployed, dispossessed, or outlawed.

The DESCENDIAN ORDER holds muster in the Underdocks, EASTERN DISTRICT. Pass inspection for steady work.

GOOD PAY.

Marshal Harding

Ensure your language settings are set to Common Tongue, Marshal Harding cannot understand Deep Tongue as of 2026-09-10.

Take a lift down to the Underdocks Citadel. Then, head east to the Eastern District. You will need to swim across or wait for the raft. Climb the staircase immediately across from the raft docking location to find Marshal Harding and hand him your Recruitment Notice.

You gain experience!!

Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better.

Marshal Harding looks you over.

Marshal Harding says, "You can read this, then? You look like you crawled out of a gutter. Have you come to serve in the Order?"

You say, "I have come to serve in the Order"

Marshal Harding waves the leaf of paper in your face.

Marshal Harding says, "The Descendian Order. I pray you fight better than you read, if you wish to earn your keep."

You say, "I wish to earn my keep"

Marshal Harding laughs.

Marshal Harding says, "As a scullion, no doubt, by your dress."

Marshal Harding rummages through a crate and hands you a shirt.

Marshal Harding says, "It could do with a wash, but at least you might seem to be a page rather than a pauper. Can you fight, then?"

You receive Musty Tunic from Marshal Harding.

You say, "I can fight"

Marshal Harding says, "I'll have the truth of it. Fill this satchel with the shells of deep beetles."

Marshal Harding hands you a threadbare sack.

You receive Beetle Shell Collection Bag from Marshal Harding.

Marshal Harding says, "Do not return if this task is too great."

Facing Northwest, follow the tunnel out of the Eastern District to the Underdocks wall where you can begin hunting a deep beetle.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
The Wyrmsbane Armor sets are obtained through a quest offered by Matheus Griswald of the Easthymn Freebooters, who is found near the entrance of the tomb. You must have a minimum of KINDLY faction to turn in your components.
 


Each piece requires an armor token for one of the available sets which can be found from bosses in the dungeon:

Ancient Tattered Wyrmsbane Cloth
Ancient Rotting Wyrmsbane Leather
Ancient Eroded Wyrmsbane Chain
Ancient Corroded Wyrmsbane Plate

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Wyrmsbane Cloth Set QUEST IS DISABLED AS OF JULY 2026
Wyrmsbane Leather Set QUEST IS DISABLED AS OF JULY 2026
Wyrmsbane Chain Set QUEST IS DISABLED AS OF JULY 2026
Wyrmsbane Plate Set QUEST IS DISABLED AS OF JULY 2026

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest involves talking to Matheus Griswald found within the cave that the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane resides in. Matheus Griswald when shown armor tokens, which the player can receive from named mobs within the tomb, will inform the player on how he can restore them. These armor tokens are turned in for their respective armor types & slots alongside Chipped Star Rose Quartz for cloth armor, Chipped Jasper for leather armor, Chipped Amber for chain armor, and Chipped Fire Opal for plate armor. It is unknown if faction with the Easthymn Freebooters influences your ability to turn in the tokens, however, this faction raises while killing most mobs found within the tomb.

Hail, Matheus Griswald

Matheus Griswald says, "Hail, adventurer. The name's Matheus Griswald, of the Easthymnite Freebooters. I head up this dig site. My crew was searching for long lost relics, but our excavation has fallen into peril."

You say, "What lost relics?"

Matheus Griswald says, "There are many ancient relics within the tomb. Some of which may even be of value to you. If you help us destroy the monstrosities inside, you will earn the favor of the Freebooters. And with that, can come many benefits."

You say, "What benefits?"

Matheus Griswald says, "We know that the ancient armor of the fallen Wyrmsbane still lies within. If you bring it to us, along with certain gems, we can help you restore it."

You say, "What gems?"

Matheus Griswald says, "Are you looking to restore cloth, leather, chain or plate?"

You say, "Cloth."

Matheus Griswald says, "Bring me pieces of the old ancient cloth armor, along with the corresponding amount of Chipped Star Rose Quartz. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Chipped Star Rose Quartz, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five."

You say, "Leather."

Matheus Griswald says, "Bring me pieces of the old ancient leather armor, along with the corresponding amount of Chipped Jasper. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Chipped Jasper, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five."

You say, "Chain."

Matheus Griswald says, "Bring me pieces of the old ancient chain armor, along with the corresponding amount of Chipped Amber. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Chipped Amber, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five."

You say, "Plate."

Matheus Griswald says, "Bring me pieces of the old ancient plate armor, along with the corresponding amount of Chipped Fire Opal. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Chipped Fire Opal, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five."

You say, "Where can I get Chipped Star Rose Quartz"

Matheus Griswald says, "You can find from miners, or mine it yourself from Copper Veins."

sections.title: Changes
sections.text:
11 Aug 24 - It seems as though the dialogue options below are no longer active, as the quest now specifies type of armor and there's no mention of/ need for Flawless Malachites

Matheus Griswald says, "Bring me pieces of the old, ancient armor, along with the corresponding amount of Flawless Malachites. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Flawless Malachite, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five."

Matheus Griswald says, "You must first prove your worth to our cause. Enter the tomb and help us to slay the Undead inside. Then you may ask me again about how we can restore the armor."

Give armor and gems to Matheus

Matheus Griswald says, "I have restored the armor for you. May it protect you well."

4 July 26 - This quest is now DISABLED, and the NPC Matheus Griswald is now missing.
